1.title: FR - Just Add Magic - S01E04 - Just Add Mom
1.plot: The Girls attempt to get Mama P to disclose the mysteries of the past by baking her a Bitter Truth Truffle, but their plans are foiled when Terri accidentally eats one of them. Kelly is forced to spend the day with her mom to cover for her excessive honesty. Meanwhile, Hannah and Darbie butt heads while searching for a way to break Terri's spell.

1.title: FR - Just Add Magic - S01E05 - Just Add Jake
1.plot: In order to convince Jake that magic is real, the Girls cook three mystery spells for him to try. Unfortunately, Jake isn't easily convinced, and the unexpected downsides jeopardize Hannah's chances of winning a school-wide fund raising contest.

1.title: FR - Just Add Magic - S01E06 - Just Add Birthdays
1.plot: When Kelly and Hannah forget Darbie's birthday, they whip up a surprise sugary feast. But a magical mistake causes it to be a celebration they'll never forget. To undo the magic, Darbie must sneak into one of the scariest places in town.

1.title: FR - Just Add Magic - S01E07 - Just Add Mama P
1.plot: After the Girls learn more of the book's secret history from an unexpected ally, they cook Mind Peering Peppermints to learn who cursed Grandma. The magic leads to surprises at home, and they come away with more questions than answers.

1.title: FR - Just Add Magic - S01E08 - Just Add Besties
1.plot: When Kelly finally finds her magical mentor, her cooking and spell knowledge is put to the test. Meanwhile, Darbie and Hannah learn that "forever" is a long time when they use magic to become BFF's with a world famous author who brings new meaning to the term, "stick together."

1.title: FR - Just Add Magic - S01E09 - Just Add Do-overs
1.plot: After Buddy wreaks havoc while Kelly is babysitting him and Ms. Silvers catches Hannah snooping around her house, the Girls cook a "do-over" spell to rewind their day and set things right. The mystery deepens when they discover that Grandma's not the only person who's been cursed in Saffron Falls.

1.title: FR - Just Add Magic - S01E10 - Just Add Memories
1.plot: Looking for clues, Kelly decides to access her memories from the day before Grandma was cursed by cooking a powerful spell which comes with an equally powerful price. Hannah dives into a 50-year-old mystery, and Darbie discovers being Jake isn't easy when she helps him for a day.

1.title: FR - Just Add Magic - S01E11 - Just Add Camping
1.plot: Following the trail of clues, the Girls plan a Father-Daughter camping trip to lead them to Grandma's last stop before she was cursed. The Girls cook Off-The-Trail Mix to uncover the next clue in their quest to save Grandma. Back in Saffron Falls, Jake tries to get his food bike into the upcoming Pluot Festival.

1.title: FR - Just Add Magic - S01E12 - Just Add Pluots Part 1
1.plot: In Part 1 of the season finale, Kelly has finally found a recipe that will save Grandma but the uncertainty around what its side effects are causes a riff between the friends. Before Kelly can cook it, she's grounded and Darbie must eat Walk-In-My-Shoes Schnitzel to impersonate her at home. Hannah continues to unravel secrets about the book that will put all of them at risk.

1.title: FR - Just Add Magic - S01E13 - Just Add Pluots Part 2
1.plot: In Part 2 of the season finale, the true villain is revealed. With the whole town in jeopardy, our Girls are Saffron Falls' only hope, and must rely on what they've learned about cooking with magic to attempt to break the most powerful curse Saffron Falls has ever seen. It's only until after they succeed that they realize some curses aren't always meant to be broken.

2.title: FR - Just Add Magic - S02E01 - Just Add Halloween
2.plot: After their Last Ditch Layer Cake breaks all the town's curses and brings an old enemy back, Kelly, Hannah and Darbie are on the hunt for a special ingredient to determine his whereabouts. The ingredient only blooms once a year... on Halloween, so The Girls have to find a way to go back to last year's Halloween and get it without running into their past selves.

2.title: FR - Just Add Magic - S02E02 - Just Add Summer
2.plot: Using the special ingredient the girls gathered from last Halloween, they cook up a Miso Soup to determine Chuck's location. However, when that fails to work, Kelly instead cooks a "Settle the Beef" sandwich in order to draw Chuck to them instead...but in order for it to work, Kelly has to spell her own Grandma.

2.title: FR - Just Add Magic - S02E03 - Just Add Chuck
2.plot: The girls have their first interaction with Chuck, but it quickly becomes clear that he is suffering from some sort of amnesia. He doesn't remember anything about the Pluot Festival in 1965. Grandma and Mama P think he's lying and can't be trusted, so the girls cook a trust spell that helps Chuck adjust to the modern day - but it also unlocks some of his memories from 1965.

2.title: FR - Just Add Magic - S02E04 - Just Add 1965
2.plot: Unable to get consistent answers from Grandma, Ms. Silvers, or Mama P about exactly what happened with Chuck in 1965, Kelly, Hannah and Darbie cook a recipe that allows them to observe past events. Meanwhile, Chuck gets closer to the Quinn family when he saves Buddy from a skateboarding accident.

2.title: FR - Just Add Magic - S02E05 - Just Add Saphrön
2.plot: Worried that Chuck is getting too close to her family, Kelly and Darbie cook a special mint that acts as a lie detector, so that she can get her Dad to see through Chuck's act. Darbie uses the mint on her own Dad when he invites her to lunch to meet his new girlfriend Amy.

2.title: FR - Just Add Magic - S02E06 - Just Add Fixings
2.plot: When the girls cook a fix it spell to help repair Jake's food bike, they find themselves compelled to remedy all problems, from repairing cabinets to helping Mama P spruce up the café. In the end, Kelly crosses paths with Chuck realizing he needs some emotional fixing.

2.title: FR - Just Add Magic - S02E07 - Just Add 8529
2.plot: The book leads Kelly to Chuck's hideout, hidden by an invisibility spell he cast. Kelly makes herself invisible in order to get inside, and is shocked to discover that Chuck is making his own magic cookbook.

2.title: FR - Just Add Magic - S02E08 - Just Add Muscles
2.plot: After the girls discover Chuck is creating his own magical book using their recipes, they have to cook a strength spell in order to get the book safely returned to them.

2.title: FR - Just Add Magic - S02E09 - Just Add Fire
2.plot: Chuck knows the girls have taken his book, so he gives them, Grandma, Silvers and Mama P a sleep spell. Now, all six of them must stay awake long enough to cook a counter-spell together.

2.title: FR - Just Add Magic - S02E10 - Just Add Meddling
2.plot: Kelly finds herself using magic to solve every problem, big or small, forcing Hannah and Darbie to hide the book from her. Meanwhile, Chuck finds a new way into the girls' lives through Jake.

2.title: FR - Just Add Magic - S02E11 - Just Add Secrets
2.plot: Kelly cooks a secrets spell searching for answers to the Chuck mystery. The spell reveals more questions than answers when everyone around her is compelled to tell her their secrets, culminating in the biggest secret of all - one that is hidden within the pages of the book itself.

2.title: FR - Just Add Magic - S02E12 - Just Add History
2.plot: As the girls continue to uncover details about Chuck's history, they must cook a spell to save Jake from Chuck's magic.

2.title: FR - Just Add Magic - S02E13 - Just Add Rose
2.plot: Kelly, Hannah and Darbie are racing to solve the final mystery within the pages of the book before Chuck manages to trap one of them inside the book for all time. Along the way, they learn a surprising bit of information about Chuck's past and his family.

3.title: FR - Just Add Magic - S03E01 - Just Add Time Travel
3.plot: After re-growing the magical garden, Kelly's Grandma appears...from 1975! Becky has cooked a recipe that inadvertently alters the course of history and everything is turned topsy-turvy. Kelly, Hannah and Darbie have to travel back in time to 1975 to set things straight.

3.title: FR - Just Add Magic - S03E02 - Just Add Plants
3.plot: Magical plants are sprouting up all over Saffron Falls and people across town are being spelled by things growing in their own garden. Could this be the downside of bringing the garden back to life?

3.title: FR - Just Add Magic - S03E03 - Just Add Codes
3.plot: An earthquake rattles Saffron Falls, unearthing a secret bunker belonging to Chuck's family. Kelly, Hannah and Darbie need to cook a decoding spell to get inside before anyone else can.

3.title: FR - Just Add Magic - S03E04 - Just Add Piper
3.plot: Darbie's friendship with Piper is in trouble - and when Kelly and Hannah try to help, they magically get stuck to Piper and have to follow her around all day. Will Piper find out about the magic too?

3.title: FR - Just Add Magic - S03E05 - Just Add Rot
3.plot: An unknown villain puts a spell on the three girls, making any food they touch turn to rot in their hands. This means they can't cook a counter spell themselves and have to turn to an unlikely source for help.

3.title: FR - Just Add Magic - S03E06 - Just Add Tomorrow
3.plot: When a mysterious thief steals an artifact from a museum, Kelly, Hannah and Darbie cook a spell to rewind the day and stop the culprit. Only, they get stuck in a loop and find themselves repeating the same day over and over again.

3.title: FR - Just Add Magic - S03E07 - Just Add Perspective
3.plot: Now that they know who the Night Bandit is, the friends cook a spell that lets them see through the villain's eyes. Things get complicated when Darbie peers through Hannah's eyes and sees that something is troubling her at school.

3.title: FR - Just Add Magic - S03E08 - Just Add Karma
3.plot: Darbie attempts to solve Hannah's problems by cooking a karma spell, while Mama P has a revelation on her extended vacation. In the end, Hannah discovers she can handle her issues at school without the use of magic at all.

3.title: FR - Just Add Magic - S03E10 - Just Add Kelly
3.plot: As they race to break the spell that is poisoning Kelly, Hannah and Darbie hope that they don't face yet another downside.

3.title: FR - Just Add Magic - S03E11 - Just Add Goodbye
3.plot: Grandma disappears into thin air, prompting Kelly, Hannah and Darbie to travel through time to create a brand-new spice that can save her. But will they have to pay the ultimate sacrifice and say goodbye to the cookbook forever?

meta.plot: Une nouvelle génération d'élèves envahit le lycée de Degrassi ! Comme leurs parents avant cela, ils devront relever au cours de leurs études différents challenges, faire face à leurs premiers amours ainsi que leurs premiers échecs, tout en tentant de construire leurs rêves...

1.title: FR - Degrassi : La nouvelle promo - S01E01 - #BootyCall
1.plot: Tristan struggles to put his feelings aside while running for SC President against ex-boyfriend, Miles. Maya searches for a lead guitarist.

1.title: FR - Degrassi : La nouvelle promo - S01E02 - #NoFilter
1.plot: Zoe learns that Grace has a serious illness. Miles gets in trouble for venting about his mother’s new man, which leads him to express his anger towards restrictions in free speech.

1.title: FR - Degrassi : La nouvelle promo - S01E03 - #YesMeansYes
1.plot: Zig takes action to save his relationship and becomes physical with Maya, despite her protests and learns the meaning of consent.

1.title: FR - Degrassi : La nouvelle promo - S01E04 - #NotOkay
1.plot: Maya takes a stand when she experiences sexist micro-aggressions at a gig. Tristan pursues a new romance with Vijay, a grade ten student who idolizes him.

1.title: FR - Degrassi : La nouvelle promo - S01E05 - #ButThatsNoneOfMyBusiness
1.plot: Miles turns to anti-anxiety meds when forced to spend time with his dad. Maya becomes a feminist while protesting against unequal bathroom rights.

1.title: FR - Degrassi : La nouvelle promo - S01E06 - #NotAllMen
1.plot: Worried that no one will accept her for being gay, Zoe sets out to find someone who will. When Hunter’s Gamer Club is shut down because of misogynistic content, Hunter fights back.

1.title: FR - Degrassi : La nouvelle promo - S01E07 - #ThisCouldBeUsButYouPlayin
1.plot: Miles wakes up in a park and realizes he needs serious help. Maya’s turned down by a New York music producer and wonders if she’s messed up her one big chance.

1.title: FR - Degrassi : La nouvelle promo - S01E08 - #TeamFollowBack
1.plot: Tristan is forced to confront the many boys he’s hooked up with when Zoe internet diagnoses him with Chlamydia. Frankie’s friends try to convince her she belongs with Winston but her heart lies with someone else.

1.title: FR - Degrassi : La nouvelle promo - S01E09 - #SinceWeBeinHonest
1.plot: Zig discovers who’s responsible for Maya’s trolling, but is blackmailed into staying silent. After a cry for help from Esme, Miles falls back into a downwards spiral.

1.title: FR - Degrassi : La nouvelle promo - S01E10 - #SorryNotSorry
1.plot: When Hunter refuses to apologize for his online behaviour, he loses his friends’ support, and lashes out at the Snowball. Maya contemplates whether or not she can take back Zig.

2.title: FR - Degrassi : La nouvelle promo - S02E01 - #‎SquadGoals‬
2.plot: After a rival school pranks Degrassi, Frankie retaliates and is called out. When Hunter purposely endangers himself, Miles realises that he needs help. Maya's feelings for Zig threaten her co-op placement opportunity.

2.title: FR - Degrassi : La nouvelle promo - S02E02 - #TurntUp
2.plot: Hunter realises he must accept professional help. Shay considers whether or not she can defend Frankie. Angry, Zig blames Maya for everything that happened between them.

2.title: FR - Degrassi : La nouvelle promo - S02E03 - #‎CheckYourPrivilege
2.plot: Frankie organises a diversity mixer to fix things with Northern Tech. Tristan is worried about pressuring Miles and straining their relationship. Yael's app goes viral, & she has to choose between her integrity & her success.

2.title: FR - Degrassi : La nouvelle promo - S02E04 - #‎BuyMePizza‬
2.plot: When Zoe doesn't receive a call back, she comes up with a way to hide her true self. Grace is made fun of and decides to make a change. When Tiny asks Lola to delete her dating profile, she makes a very bold decision.

2.title: FR - Degrassi : La nouvelle promo - S02E05 - #ThrowBackThursday
2.plot: Lola stages a protest for Tiny's unfair suspension and garners attention during the Degrassi Alumni event. Tristan sets out to alleviate tension in the air by censoring all gala night sketches.

2.title: FR - Degrassi : La nouvelle promo - S02E06 - #ToMyFutureSelf
2.plot: Shay is given the opportunity of a lifetime, but must apologize for the protest & compromise her values in order to get it. When Grace begins spending more time with Zig, Maya decides to pursue a friendship with Peter.

2.title: FR - Degrassi : La nouvelle promo - S02E07 - #ThatAwkwardMomentWhen
2.plot: Frankie tries to escape from her problems by driving off with Jonah, but soon realises that running away isn’t always a solution. A suffering Tiny takes Shay’s advice over Lola’s.

2.title: FR - Degrassi : La nouvelle promo - S02E08 - #RiseAndGrind
2.plot: When Maya asks Vijay to take down his cover of her song, he responds online, and his fans blow up at her. When a dancing opportunity presents itself to Zig, he’s eager to prove himself and turns to Esme for help.

2.title: FR - Degrassi : La nouvelle promo - S02E09 - #TheseAreMyConfessions
2.plot: Grace confesses to having feelings for Zig during a party in the woods. To win Volleyball City Finals, Shay realises that they need Frankie, but wonders if she can forgive her.

2.title: FR - Degrassi : La nouvelle promo - S02E10 - #OMFG
2.plot: Lola shuts down Shay’s request to date Tiny, which leads Shay to act out during their championship game. Zoe’s burning intensifies & as Winston begins to second-guess their relationship, she finally gives in to her true self.

3.title: FR - Degrassi : La nouvelle promo - S03E01 - #BreakTheInternet
3.plot: Degrassi is giving a warm welcome to an influx of Syrian refugees and a spiteful Lola posts a controversial photo.

3.title: FR - Degrassi : La nouvelle promo - S03E02 - #IWokeUpLikeThis
3.plot: The Gamers are determined to make their vlog a success. Maya discovers an interest in 'tragedy porn'. Esme tests Zig's limits on how far is too far to go at school.

3.title: FR - Degrassi : La nouvelle promo - S03E03 - #WorstGiftEver
3.plot: Jonah and Grace pitch the Student Council on a play about the Degrassi bus accident. Goldi has questions about what it really means to be Muslim.

3.title: FR - Degrassi : La nouvelle promo - S03E04 - #PicsOrItDidntHappen
3.plot: Maya meets Saad, who shares a mutual interest in the dark side. Frankie feels that Jonah is hiding something.

3.title: FR - Degrassi : La nouvelle promo - S03E05 - #HugeIfTrue
3.plot: Shay, Lola and Frankie cozy up for girl's night until it becomes...less cozy. Is Frankie ready for more intimacy and will Shay's insecurities put her own relationship in jeopardy?

3.title: FR - Degrassi : La nouvelle promo - S03E06 - #ThatFeelingWhen
3.plot: Frankie is driving herself crazy over Jonah. Miles and Lola work on the play, together experiencing an emotional roller coaster. Zoe and Rasha are also taking a kind of thrill ride.

3.title: FR - Degrassi : La nouvelle promo - S03E08 - #IRegretNothing
3.plot: Lola's friends are not there for her. If Tristan makes it to the play, will Miles' indiscretions be revealed? Maya's obsession with death is getting out of control.

3.title: FR - Degrassi : La nouvelle promo - S03E09 - #Woke
3.plot: Maya can't deal with her depression. Frankie and Jonah are trying to figure things out. It's Ms. Rivas' wedding and Zoe violates her mother's wishes and brings Rasha anyway.

3.title: FR - Degrassi : La nouvelle promo - S03E10 - #ImSleep
3.plot: Everyone loves it but Tristan clearly senses the truth. Maya appears to be happier... but appearances can be deceiving. Opening night and the play receives rave reviews.

4.title: FR - Degrassi : La nouvelle promo - S04E01 - #BackToReality
4.plot: Grace and Jonah keep their relationship on the DL. Tristan starts back slowly at school. Esme is willing to do whatever it takes to keep her man.

4.title: FR - Degrassi : La nouvelle promo - S04E02 - #GetMoney
4.plot: Frankie is uploading some questionable posts on her socials so Esme encourages her re-curate her online persona. Shay is determined to up her game to get scouted.

4.title: FR - Degrassi : La nouvelle promo - S04E03 - #ILookLikeA
4.plot: Goldi has been flirting with Winston and doesn't even know it. Miles questions a post-grad opportunity that seems too good to be true.

4.title: FR - Degrassi : La nouvelle promo - S04E04 - #RollUpToTheClubLike
4.plot: After a terrorist attack in Brussels, the Muslim students at Degrassi find themselves in some very heated situations. Grace creates a bucket list.

4.title: FR - Degrassi : La nouvelle promo - S04E05 - #Preach
4.plot: Saad is torn between his own beliefs and the students' collective show of solidarity for Brussels. Frankie wonders if hanging with Esme and Zig is really good for her.

4.title: FR - Degrassi : La nouvelle promo - S04E06 - #FactsOnly
4.plot: Yael feels like an identity overhaul is needed and turns to Lola for help. Maya auditions for Zoe, Goldi and special celebrity judge for the charity talent show.

4.title: FR - Degrassi : La nouvelle promo - S04E08 - #GetYouAManThatCanDoBoth
4.plot: Tristan and others wonder if his turbo-mode recovery is a good idea. After seeing others get "promposals,'' Shay is hoping that Tiny will do the same.

4.title: FR - Degrassi : La nouvelle promo - S04E09 - #Obsessed
4.plot: The senior prom is delayed due to a code red emergency. Esme is furious when prom doesn't go exactly as she'd hoped.

4.title: FR - Degrassi : La nouvelle promo - S04E10 - #KThxBye
4.plot: The gowns are on and the caps are about to be thrown, it's another Degrassi graduation. Zoe wonders how much support she'll get as she prepares to make her valedictory speech.

meta.plot: Will this expert team unearth legendary pirate treasure? Follow the hunt for buried gold amid the harsh Alaskan wilderness in this documentary series.

1.title: EN - Pirate Gold of Adak Island [Multi-Sub] - S01E01 - The Pirate’s Gambit
1.plot: To save his town and solve a legendary mystery, Adak's Mayor Thom assembles a crew of specialists to find pirate Gregory Dwargstof's remaining treasure.

1.title: EN - Pirate Gold of Adak Island [Multi-Sub] - S01E02 - Bombshell
1.plot: Salvage experts Jay and Burke design blast shields to deal with an unexplored bomb. Geographer Dr. M and tech expert Brian open up a new search zone.

1.title: EN - Pirate Gold of Adak Island [Multi-Sub] - S01E03 - Shallow Grave
1.plot: With their main digging site shut, Dr. M and Brian retrace Dwargstof's steps to locate a new target area. Later, the team digs up something shocking.

1.title: EN - Pirate Gold of Adak Island [Multi-Sub] - S01E04 - Seven Doors of Doom
1.plot: Dr. M gathers more details on their recent find and analyzes soil samples with Brian. The search narrows down to an area underneath an abandoned house.

1.title: EN - Pirate Gold of Adak Island [Multi-Sub] - S01E05 - Tundra Pit
1.plot: While Jay and Burke join Thom to search the tundra pits of Lake Betty, Dr. M and Brian set up camp at the Bay of Waterfalls and run into trouble.

1.title: EN - Pirate Gold of Adak Island [Multi-Sub] - S01E06 - Road to Ruin
1.plot: The crew details more of Dwargstof's criminal activity. Jay, Burke, and Thom continue to follow the footsteps of a fellow treasure hunter at Lake Betty.

1.title: EN - Pirate Gold of Adak Island [Multi-Sub] - S01E07 - A Pirate Decoded
1.plot: Off-limits for months, the team's most promising site is now open to search. The crew discovers mysterious stone markers that become valuable clues.

1.title: EN - Pirate Gold of Adak Island [Multi-Sub] - S01E08 - Parcel 4
1.plot: As a monster storm approaches, the team's short on time to unearth what they can before the freezing temperatures end their search until next year.

1.title: EN - Taiwan Crime Stories [Multi-Sub] - S01E03 - Derailment (3)

1.title: EN - Taiwan Crime Stories [Multi-Sub] - S01E04 - A Matter of Life and Death (1)

1.title: EN - Taiwan Crime Stories [Multi-Sub] - S01E05 - A Matter of Life and Death (2)

1.title: EN - Taiwan Crime Stories [Multi-Sub] - S01E06 - A Matter of Life and Death (3)

1.title: EN - Taiwan Crime Stories [Multi-Sub] - S01E07 - Gravity of Sin (1)

1.title: EN - Taiwan Crime Stories [Multi-Sub] - S01E08 - Gravity of Sin (2)

1.title: EN - Taiwan Crime Stories [Multi-Sub] - S01E09 - Gravity of Sin (3)

1.title: EN - Taiwan Crime Stories [Multi-Sub] - S01E10 - Dark Currents (1)

1.title: EN - Taiwan Crime Stories [Multi-Sub] - S01E11 - Dark Currents (2)

1.title: EN - Taiwan Crime Stories [Multi-Sub] - S01E12 - Dark Currents (3)
