Meanwhile, Cameron and Mitchell discover some interesting reading material in Lily’s room and decide to confront her about it, while Gloria and Jay discover their respective great uncles may have fought on opposing sides of a war.

10.title: FR - Famille moderne - S10E13 - Whanex?
10.plot: While preparing a presentation for his students about their future goals, Cam must also contend with a bully at the school and Jay is having a little technical trouble during his video conference. Meanwhile, the local mall is holding a photo shoot for its new ad campaign and Gloria tricks Phil and Joe into participating.

10.title: FR - Famille moderne - S10E14 - We Need to Talk About Lily
10.plot: Phil may have conquered his biggest real estate challenge when he thinks he found Pepper his dream home. Meanwhile, in an attempt to connect with Lily, Mitch and Cam get invited to an exclusive event for her favorite vlogger.

10.title: FR - Famille moderne - S10E15 - SuperShowerBabyBowl
10.plot: Jay is hosting a Super Bowl party, and Claire is hosting a baby shower for Haley; both at Jay’s house. What could go wrong?

10.title: FR - Famille moderne - S10E16 - Red Alert
10.plot: Lily has reached a womanly milestone that Cam and Mitch are not prepared for – at all – so they call in reinforcements.

10.title: FR - Famille moderne - S10E17 - The Wild
10.plot: Mitch, Cam and Phil crash Jay’s annual hiking trip to find an elusive bald eagle after Gloria asks them to keep an eye on him. Meanwhile, Gloria, Alex, Claire and Haley get together to plan her baby shower.

10.title: FR - Famille moderne - S10E18 - Stand By Your Man
10.plot: Dylan and Luke are really impressed with  Bill’s tales of heroism and survival as a firefighter, which make Phil feel emasculated. To impress the guys, he invites them over for a little male-bonding moment that goes terribly wrong.

10.title: FR - Famille moderne - S10E19 - Yes-Woman
10.plot: In an effort to be less negative, Claire is rebranding herself as the girl who says “yes” and inadvertently approves of Luke’s new relationship with someone from his work. Meanwhile, Phil tries to surprise Alex at school right before she receives an award she didn’t tell him about.

10.title: FR - Famille moderne - S10E20 - Can't Elope
10.plot: Haley and Dylan’s plan to quietly elope before the babies are born doesn’t go as smoothly as they had hoped. Meanwhile, Jay continues to try and get his new business off the ground by courting an Instagram celebrity.

10.title: FR - Famille moderne - S10E22 - A Year of Birthdays
10.plot: As the birth of Haley and Dylan’s twins approaches, we take a look back  at how each family member celebrated their birthdays this past year.

11.title: FR - Famille moderne - S11E01 - New Kids on the Block
11.plot: Haley is determined to follow the advice in her parenting books with the twins, but Phil and Claire think their old methods are better. Meanwhile, Manny is set to direct Jay’s dog bed commercial in the hopes of winning his ex-girlfriend back.

11.title: FR - Famille moderne - S11E02 - Snapped
11.plot: Claire needs to get everyone out of the house before they make her look bad in front of a reporter from an important women’s business magazine. Meanwhile, Jay invites Manny to a little wine tasting in an attempt to spend some quality time together.

11.title: FR - Famille moderne - S11E03 - Perfect Pairs
11.plot: Phil, Claire, Alex and Luke love having the twins around, but taking care of them is exhausting! However, when they realize the babies might help them with a few things on their to-do lists, they offer to give Haley the day off.

11.title: FR - Famille moderne - S11E04 - Pool Party
11.plot: Mitch and Cam help Lily overcome her insecurities about wearing a bathing suit to a pool party but discover their own. Meanwhile, now that Gloria’s new internship is taking up so much of her time, Jay is feeling particularly neglected.

11.title: FR - Famille moderne - S11E05 - The Last Halloween
11.plot: Phil is determined to finally scare Claire on Halloween. Meanwhile, for the first time, Gloria is feeling self-conscious about her age when someone correctly assumes she is Jay’s wife; and Mitch and Cam head to the WeHo Halloween Carnival after Lily decides to go to her first Halloween party alone.

11.title: FR - Famille moderne - S11E06 - A Game of Chicken
11.plot: Gloria is using her alone time with the twins as an opportunity to secretly baptize them before Haley and Dylan get home. Meanwhile, Claire is still dealing with the fallout from the smart closet fiasco, and Cam is at war with his school’s mascot who is threatening his chance at securing a new college coaching job.

11.title: FR - Famille moderne - S11E07 - The Last Thanksgiving
11.plot: Cameron and Mitchell’s friends mistakenly assume they have split up and have definitely chosen a side, and Haley attempts to cook Thanksgiving dinner as a thank you for Claire and Phil’s support with the twins. Meanwhile, Jay invites Phil and Dylan out to fly his model plane, and Phil thinks this is his chance to reclaim his dignity after their first outing 10 years ago went so wrong.

11.title: FR - Famille moderne - S11E08 - Tree's a Crowd
11.plot: The Dunphy house is bursting at the seams when Dylan’s hippie mom moves in and Claire’s lonely stepdad, Jerry, wants to pay them a visit. Meanwhile, Jay and Gloria attempt to help Manny get over his big breakup with Sherry.

11.title: FR - Famille moderne - S11E09 - The Last Christmas
11.plot: Cameron is hoping to keep everyone happy for their annual Christmas dinner as he hides and prepares for his big interview for a head coaching position out-of-state. Meanwhile, Haley is excited to be finally be reunited with wine and Mitchell is suspicious of Cam’s holiday trip to visit his family in Missouri.

11.title: FR - Famille moderne - S11E10 - The Prescott
11.plot: Alex’s new company is putting her up at a new luxury apartment with full amenities and a list of high-profile residents that the family is eager to take advantage of, without her knowing. Phil is on a mission to review the restaurant’s famous sliders for his food blog, while Mitch and Cam sneak in separately to meet its most famous resident, David Beckham. Meanwhile, Luke and Manny head straight for the gym to try and pick up on older women and end up in some hot water with a few of the residents.

11.title: FR - Famille moderne - S11E11 - Legacy
11.plot: Phil pays a visit to his dad to make sure he is ok after hearing some concerning news about him. Meanwhile, Jay gives Claire and Mitch a bunch of their old childhood memorabilia that triggers them to reevaluate a long-held story about their first family vacation.

11.title: FR - Famille moderne - S11E12 - Dead on a Rival
11.plot: Mitchell learns a valuable life lesson when Murray, a former resident of the house, shows up unexpectedly. Meanwhile, the Dunphy’s old neighbor-turned-tech-titan, Kenneth, comes to visit with a big surprise for Phil. Then, Manny’s dad, Javier, shows up with a big opportunity for his son.

11.title: FR - Famille moderne - S11E13 - Paris
11.plot: In one last family trip, the Pritchett-Dunphy-Tucker clan heads to Paris so Jay can accept a lifetime achievement award for his work in the closet industry. However, his old nemesis, Earl Chambers, finds a way to haunt him. Meanwhile, Claire has a secret rendezvous in one of the most romantic cities in the world, and Cam’s lifelong dream of performing as Fizbo on the streets of Paris is about to become a reality.

11.title: FR - Famille moderne - S11E14 - Spuds
11.plot: Phil and Claire take Haley and Dylan to dinner to reassure them they are not bad parents. While out to dinner, they run into Mitch and Cam who are chaperoning Lily’s first date, as well as Jay and Gloria after attending Joe’s school play.

11.title: FR - Famille moderne - S11E15 - Baby Steps
11.plot: Claire has landed an interview for her dream job and is thwarted on her way to the interview by Phil’s tricky staircase. Meanwhile, Cam and Mitch debate the pros and cons of adopting another baby after unexpectedly receiving a call from their adoption agency.

11.title: FR - Famille moderne - S11E16 - I'm Going to Miss This
11.plot: Mitchell is having a hard time letting go of his old life and Gloria steps in to help him say goodbye. Meanwhile, Haley, Luke and Alex decide to throw a party at the Dunphy house when Claire and Phil leave for a trip, and Dylan’s mom takes the twins for the night.

11.title: FR - Famille moderne - S11E17 - Finale (1)
11.plot: Mitchell and Cam settle in on their new normal, and Phil and Claire decide that one of the kids needs to move out in order to take control of the house again. Meanwhile, as Gloria becomes more successful at work, she notices Jay, Manny and Joe don’t seem to need her as much.

11.title: FR - Famille moderne - S11E18 - Finale (2)
11.plot: The entire family discovers saying goodbye is much harder than it seems.

meta.plot: In late 19th-century Turin, the young Lidia Poët, fights against everything and everyone to get what is rightfully hers: to be enrolled in the official register of lawyers. A profession, at the time, reserved exclusively for men. Nevertheless, nothing could stop her dream of becoming the first female lawyer in Italy.

3.title: EN - The Law According to Lidia Poët [MULTI-SUB] - S03E02 - Episode 2
3.plot: As Lidia and Fourneau land on opposing sides of a case that hits close to home, Enrico aids a painter whose alibi for a murder hints at a larger scandal.

3.title: EN - The Law According to Lidia Poët [MULTI-SUB] - S03E03 - Episode 3

3.plot: While teaming up to search Fontana's estate, Lidia and Jacopo unearth a vital clue they hope will alter the outcome of Grazia's landmark case.

1.plot: Danny moves from fear into panic as new crises arise. Willing to do whatever it takes to keep June safe, Amy devises a perilous scheme.

1.plot: The consequences of their actions leave Danny and Amy in a surreal situation that tests their grasp on reality.

meta.plot: After the party of heroes defeated the Demon King, they restored peace to the land and returned to lives of solitude. Generations pass, and the elven mage Frieren comes face to face with humanity’s mortality. She takes on a new apprentice and promises to fulfill old friends’ dying wishes. Can an elven mind make peace with the nature of life and death? Frieren embarks on her quest to find out.

Orphen is a powerful sorcerer who is notoriously lazy. Everything changes when he finds a way to save his sis, who was turned into a dragon during their days at magic academy. Betrayed by friends who refused to help, Orphen will stop at nothing to track her down, even if he has to go it alone.

1.title: EN - Sorcerous Stabber Orphen [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The Tower of Fangs
1.plot: Orphen, Volkan, and Dortin are captured by the authorities after the fiasco with the monster that appeared. Orphen is then summoned by Heartia to go talk to his former master, Childman.

1.title: EN - Sorcerous Stabber Orphen [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Heed My Call, Beast
1.plot: Orphen goes with Childman and the other Black Sorcerers in order to try to track down Azalie before they can kill her. He manages to track down the creature, and despite his best efforts to talk to her, the creature attacks.

meta.plot: Most of the world's needs are fulfilled by humanoid robots called hIE's. One day, 17-year-old Arato Endo meets the android Lacia and becomes her owner. She is one of five androids with advanced AI. Each of the five units have their own motivations, and fight to gain each other's abilities. What will the relationship between man and machine be moving forward? That is something Arato must find.

1.title: EN - Beatless [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Contract
1.plot: April. A second year high school student, Arato had a normal life he spent with his friends Ryo and Kengo. Until that night. On his way home from shopping, Arato is attacked by a corrupted hIE, but a beautiful hIE named Lacia comes to his rescue.

1.title: EN - Beatless [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Analog Hacking
1.plot: After binding an owner contract with Arato, Lacia has come to live with the Endo's. Arato's sister Yuka has completely accepted Lacia, and even enters her into an hIE modeling audition. Meanwhile, Arato can't hide his apprehension with living with someone who looks to be a beautiful girl his own age.

1.title: EN - Beatless [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - You'll Be Mine
1.plot: Despite his awareness of analog hacking, Arato can't help himself from being drawn to Lacia. Amid all of this, Lacia is "kidnapped" right in front of Yuka. Arato is upset with the police and their unwillingness to treat this as anything but property theft, so he gets the help of Ryo and Kengo to investigate on their own.

1.title: EN - Beatless [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Automatic World
1.plot: Kouka, the violent hIE who calls herself Lacia's first sister. With her control over the antibody network, she is planning to carry out a horrifying act of terrorism. When Arato learns that her scheme is putting Kengo in danger, Arato sets out to rescue Kengo with Lacia's help.

1.title: EN - Beatless [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Tools for Outsourcers
1.plot: Arato arrives at the industrial promotion center which is the target for the antibody network's terrorist attack. He heads up the stairs and sees the android politician Mikoto his father developed, which leaves him with feelings of uneasiness. Soon after, the terrorist unit led by Kouka as well as another Lacia-class hIE arrive on the scene. A big battle is about to break out!

1.title: EN - Beatless [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Higgins Village
1.plot: Arato manages to rescue Kengo from the calamity at the industrial promotion center. However, even after returning to normal life, he finds himself consumed by the ever deepening mysteries. Meanwhile at the Memeframe Corporation, a factional dispute becomes escalated. Within the upheaval, the Lacia-class hIE Methode is about to make her move.

1.title: EN - Beatless [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Boy meets Pornography
1.plot: Lacia has a new modeling gig. It is an image commercial to promote a new type of relationship between hIE's and human beings, one in which people view hIE's of the opposite sex as an equal partner.

1.title: EN - Beatless [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Awakening of Sleeping Beauty
1.plot: Having made a contract with Shiori, Methode suddenly attacks Lacia while she is filming a commercial. As the circumstances surrounding Arato and Lacia are about to shift again dramatically, a new transfer student arrives at Arato's high school. Erica Burrows-the Sleeping Princess born in the 21st Century who just awoke from suspended animation, and Arato senses animosity from her.

1.title: EN - Beatless [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - My Whereabouts
1.plot: Shiori puts her plan into motion. At this rate, Arato will lose ownership of Lacia. "Mr. Arato, please allow me to be with you." This unexpected plea from Lacia moves Arato, and he heads to Chubu International Airport to stop Shiori.

1.title: EN - Beatless [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Dwellings and Surroundings
1.plot: Arato is given two weeks of suspension after the fight between Methode and Lacia leaves him with paying 4.5 million yen worth of damages they caused. In order to apologize to his father Kozo who offered to pay half of the damages, Arato takes Lacia, Yuka, and Ryo to Tsukuba where a large-scale hIE experiment is being conducted.

1.title: EN - Beatless [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Dystopia Game
1.plot: Methode abducts Yuka right in front of Lacia. Arato and Ryo head to rescue her, but standing in their way are all of the hIE's in the experimental city who have been infected by Ginga Watarai to act like zombies. In order to get the hIE's to regain control, Arato and Ryo head to the administration center, but...

1.title: EN - Beatless [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Slumber of Human
1.plot: Ginga Watarai's death puts an end to the incident at the experimental city. During all of the chaos, Arato had revealed his feelings to Lacia which she accepted. Yuka has mixed feelings about this sudden new coupling within her household. Meanwhile, the security police and Lacia-class masters begin to respond to the ever-changing situation.

1.title: EN - Beatless [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - The Prayer Within
1.plot: After being summoned by Erika to the Burrows estate, the Lacia-class hIE's fight entered the next phase. As each of them contemplated their next move, Kouka felt her possibility for a future quickly closing as she was being pursued as a suspect in the Chubu Airport bombing by the security police.

1.title: EN - Beatless [MULTI-SUB] - S01E14 - An Answer to Survive
1.plot: Kouka carries out an antibody network terrorist attack against the Next-Gen Society Research Center on her own. Kouka's overwhelming destructive power is streamed around the globe, inspiring fear and zeal to the masses. This was Kouka's path to her future.

1.title: EN - Beatless [MULTI-SUB] - S01E15 - Edge Line
1.plot: Kengo is arrested by the security police in connection to Kouka's terrorist activities. Arato decides to save Kengo and gives Lacia the order. Following the plan she has devised, Arato finds himself face to face with the PMC â€œHOO,â€ the military group responsible for destroying Kouka.

1.title: EN - Beatless [MULTI-SUB] - S01E16 - Plus One
1.plot: Affected by Kouka's destruction, Snowdrop moved up her own plans, taking over the Mitaka transformer substation to secure a steady energy supply and bringing disaster to the surroundings. Arato and Lacia try to stop her, but Methode and Ryo stand in their way.

1.title: EN - Beatless [MULTI-SUB] - S01E17 - A Reason of Our Own
1.plot: Lacia's secret is revealed. Arato is unable to handle it and steps away from Lacia. Defenseless on his own, he's captured by Ryo and Methode where he could do nothing but watch the monitor as Snowdrop spread her seeds of destruction.

1.title: EN - Beatless [MULTI-SUB] - S01E18 - Protocol of Love
1.plot: Pushed by Shiori and Yuka, Arato decided to face Lacia once again. If his last order was still in place, Lacia should be trying to stop Snowdrop. With this thought, Arato heads towards Mitaka, a place which has transformed into an unrecognizable landscape by Snowdrop's power.

1.title: EN - Beatless [MULTI-SUB] - S01E19 - Paper Tiger
1.plot: It has been two months since the tragic events in Mitaka. The world returned to some semblance of normalcy, and Arato and Lacia lay low as they prepare for whatever may come next. However, their brief period of happiness is disturbed after they are contacted by the super intelligent AI Astraia.

1.title: EN - Beatless [MULTI-SUB] - S01E20 - Our Error World
1.plot: Super intelligent AI have spurred society to change. As the fight surrounding Arato and Lacia escalates, the leaders of the old guard discuss how they could maximize their own profits. Among the participants, only Erika Burrows expresses anger towards their foolishness.

1.title: EN - Beatless [MULTI-SUB] - S01E21 - Higgins' Silo
1.plot: The super intelligent AI Higgins. The core of Memeframe, one of the keys to humanity's future, and the creator of Lacia. Arato and Lacia traverse through a giant underground facility in order to contact Higgins. There they will find a future far beyond the human imagination...

1.title: EN - Beatless [MULTI-SUB] - S01E22 - Pygmalion
1.plot: Once again, Methode appears to stand in the way of Arato and Lacia down in the underground facility containing Higgins. They must also be wary of Snowdrop who had been sent there by a rival super intelligent AI. As the conflict escalates, Arato and Ryo try their best to fulfill their duties as representatives of humanity.

1.title: EN - Beatless [MULTI-SUB] - S01E23 - Beatless
1.plot: Snowdrop appears in the underground facility as some sort of hybrid between bird and person, a strange new creature created by a super intelligent AI which no longer needed humanity to exist. Lacia attempts to hack the cloud system that stores hIE behavior controls in order to stop Snowdrop. Her efforts would determine the outcome of the entire human race.

1.title: EN - Beatless [MULTI-SUB] - S01E24 - Boy Meets Girl
1.plot: Arato and Lacia walk towards the heart of the Higgins storage facility in order to choose a future. The two act like one as they help and support each other. However, damaged from the intense battle, Lacia does not have much time left...

meta.plot: The anime takes place in a world that long ago featured the existence of magic, but has long since lost that ability. The story begins when the very normal high school student Mangetsu Kohinata meets Shingetsu Ernesta Fukami, who has migrated back to Japan from Germany, on a night with a full moon.

1.title: EN - Granbelm [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Only Mages in the World
1.plot: The night of the crimson full moon. The full moon of Konichi, who had been living a normal high school life, is caught up in the battle to become the only magician in the world at the school where he returned to get his forgotten. It is explained that this world was overflowing with magic from the girl and the new moon which met there, and it is a full moon which runs away puzzled.

1.title: EN - Granbelm [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Why I'm Here
1.plot: As dawn breaks, Mangetsu awakens in Shingetsu's apartment. On her way back home, Shingetsu tells her more about mages and GRANBELM. Determining that Mangetsu has no intention of fighting, Shingetsu prepares to erase her memories, but her technique is unsuccessful. When Shingetsu is about to give up, Mangetsu asks her for more information about GRANBELM.

1.title: EN - Granbelm [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - The Bell Tolls at the Full Moon
1.plot: Mangetsu meets Anna at school in a chance encounter, and Anna tells her that Shingetsu ruined her family. During lunch the next day, Mangetsu tells Shingetsu that she wants to participate in GRANBELM. Shingetsu offers to help her, but at that moment, a car carrying Anna and some of her family passes by

1.title: EN - Granbelm [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Feng Shui Master Lin Fen Fen
1.plot: Mangetsu experiences her second GRANBELM. As the battle grows more intense with all the girls' emotions running high, Mangetsu and Shingetsu struggle against Nene's ARMANOX, JI GUAN LONG. But all along, another mech is approaching them

1.title: EN - Granbelm [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - A Small Girl's Small Wish
1.plot: Nene reveals her identity to Mangetsu and Shingetsu, vowing to fight them fair and square. Then, on the next full moon, Mangetsu and Kuon face off against JI GUAN LONG together according to a plan they devised before the battle, while Shingetsu draws Anna away from them. As shots are exchanged, Mangetsu finally figures out where JI GUAN LONG is

1.title: EN - Granbelm [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Magic Stones
1.plot: After getting a glimpse of Nene's past, Mangetsu realizes what it means to fight in GRANBELM, but at the same time finds herself with even more questions about it. Still, now she knows that every participant has her own reasons for fighting. Meanwhile, Anna attempts to steal the Fugo family's powerful magic stone, which leads Suishou to give up on her and leave the Fugo household.

1.title: EN - Granbelm [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Miss Ressentiment
1.plot: Shingetsu learns that Anna's mother was attacked and hurries to visit her at the hospital. She then makes up her mind to find Anna, who has gone missing, and defeat her once and for all. When the full moon rises, the next GRANBELM battle begins, and Shingetsu is faced with a much more powerful Anna... thanks to the power of the Fugo family's magic stone.

1.title: EN - Granbelm [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - What It Means to Become a Mage
1.plot: Mangetsu and Kuon are overwhelmed by Suishou's unsettling aura as they fight her, barely managing to hold out until the end of the battle. Mangetsu awakens back at Shingetsu's house, then sets out to visit Nene after receiving a message from her. They discuss the events of last night's battle, but Nene has no recollection of Anna whatsoever. Perturbed, Mangetsu and Shingetsu hurry to the Fugo household, but what they find isn't what they expected...

1.title: EN - Granbelm [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - NOCTURNE Changes Colors
1.plot: While Nene is investigating abnormal magic signals, she realizes that Mangetsu lies at the center of the astronomically high readings. Meanwhile, as Kuon is thinking about her older sister Shisui, who has long been asleep due to a curse, she somehow receives a message from her. She heads toward the location indicated in it and finds none other than the one responsible for the curse: Suishou.

1.title: EN - Granbelm [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - The Pensive Doll
1.plot: Mangetsu and Shingetsu have been expertly played by Suishou, leaving them unable to fight her effectively. Kuon tries to get them to leave the area and sets up a powerful attack aimed at Suishou, but a moment's inattention leaves her open to a vicious counterattack...

1.title: EN - Granbelm [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Even If My Goodbye Doesn't Reach You
1.plot: Mangetsu, who has become uncertain of her own existence, runs into Kuon's older sister, Shisui. As she talks with Shisui, Mangetsu feels moved to send a message to Shingetsu. Meanwhile, Shingetsu is convinced that Mangetsu is suffering because of the wish she made, and her guilt brings her to tears. As she's talking with Mangetsu, she becomes unable to bear it any longer and runs from the house...

1.title: EN - Granbelm [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Magiaconatus
1.plot: Shingetsu heads into the final battle with Mangetsu's feelings held within her heart. Suishou is fighting to prove that no human is worthy of becoming the one true mage, while Shingetsu and Mangetsu are fighting to rid the world of magical power for good. As the battle intensifies, Shingetsu becomes caught within Suishou's grasp. Mangetsu tries desperately to save her, but Shingetsu takes the full force of the beam Suishou fires...

1.title: EN - Granbelm [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - For the Only Two of Their Kind in the World
1.plot: GRANBELM is finally down to two participants. Their mechs surpass their own limits, but eventually they can no longer withstand the impact sustained during the battle, and their functions begin to fail. When Shingetsu's situation grows dire, she's surprised by the appearance of Mangetsu, who was supposed to have disappeared...

meta.plot: Special agents Sam and Kit hop the globe with their sleuthing skills, science facts and cool gadgets to solve the animal kingdom's many mysteries.

1.plot: Animal detectives Sam and Kit collect all the clues while searching for the suspect who bit an express train's engineer.

1.title: EN - The Creature Cases [Multi-Sub] - S01E02 - The Riddle of Raging Rhinos
1.plot: Sam and Kit are sent to the African Grasslands to investigate rampaging rhinos at a watering hole gathering, and a bug-loving genet is caught in the act.

1.title: EN - The Creature Cases [Multi-Sub] - S01E03 - The Trouble in the Tundra
1.plot: When the Mice Squad go missing in the Arctic Tundra, Sam and Kit go on a long-winded search and discover that despite what it may seem, a nearby herd of musk oxen are likely involved.

1.title: EN - The Creature Cases [Multi-Sub] - S01E04 - The Puzzle of the Plummeting Eggs
1.plot: Sent to the European Wetlands to investigate falling bird eggs, Sam and Kit are given unexpected help from Wally Bungler as they race to stop a sneaky cuckoo bird.

1.title: EN - The Creature Cases [Multi-Sub] - S01E05 - The Missing Mole Rat Princess
1.plot: Sam and Kit are sent to the African Desert to locate a missing mole rat- the princess of the current kingdom. With time running short, however, the duo have to hurry before a hungry owl finds her first.

1.title: EN - The Creature Cases [Multi-Sub] - S01E06 - The Hunt for the Hidden Hive
1.plot: Sam and Kit are sent to the African Grasslands to help a lost honeybee find her hive and family, with Director Scratch assigning Indy, a nearby field agent, to assist in the search.

1.title: EN - The Creature Cases [Multi-Sub] - S01E07 - The Trouble of the Toppled Trees
1.plot: Trees are falling over in a mysterious fashion in the North American Forest, and Sam and Kit have to find the culprit before the entire forest is destroyed. However, the burrowing suspect is hard to catch.

1.title: EN - The Creature Cases [Multi-Sub] - S01E08 - The Mysterious Fruit Thief
1.plot: An orangutan is struck by a thief who has been stealing fruit from her island in the Asian Jungle, but even when Sam and Kit cover all their bases, the mystery bandit keeps slipping by their sights.

1.title: EN - The Creature Cases [Multi-Sub] - S01E09 - The Riddle of the Wrestling Lizards
1.plot: Sam and Kit are dispatched to the North American Desert to try and break up a fight between a pair of gila monsters. However, they manage to bite and poison Kit, forcing Sam to work on the case by himself before the lizards leave the town in ruins.

1.title: EN - The Creature Cases [Multi-Sub] - S01E10 - The Disappearing Dung Ball
1.plot: Sam and Kit are sent to find a missing ball of giraffe dung on the African Grasslands. Sam, however, is less than enthused, particularly due to his germophobic nature.

1.title: EN - The Creature Cases [Multi-Sub] - S01E11 - The Search for the Spotted Frog
1.plot: Wally Bungler joins Kit and Sam in the South American Jungle as they search for a tarantula's pet dotted humming frog. Unfortunately, the surrounding area is full of frogs, and finding the one they're looking for is a real challenge.

1.title: EN - The Creature Cases [Multi-Sub] - S01E12 - The Case of the Big Chomp
1.plot: The Mice Squad van's satellite dish is chomped off by a mysterious creature, and both Sam and Kit are at odds at who the culprit is.

1.plot: Simon’s life is a tragedy. He’s attracted to his dad’s fiancée, the stripper he just slept with is actually a real policewoman, and Jenny is livid after he told the students her lessons were boring.

1.plot: As the deaths of Maggie and Paul make headlines worldwide, past "accidents" spur new accusations, driving Alex to a seemingly desperate act.

2.plot: Eyewitness accounts of Alex's behavior before and after the murders, expert insights and police interrogation videos raise startling questions.

2.title: EN - Murdaugh Murders: A Southern Scandal [MULTI-SUB] - S02E03 - A Tangled Web We Weave
2.plot: "Cousin Eddie" breaks his silence, a video found on Paul's phone stuns the courtroom, and Alex takes the stand. After the verdict, doubts still linger.

meta.plot: Mayumi Dojima, a second-year student at the exclusive Yubiwa Academy middle school, has lost something—a star she glimpsed just once, ten long years ago. But help is on the way, in the form of the unofficial, secretive, and thoroughly mysterious Pretty Boy Detective Club! Rumored to solve problems within the school (most of which they themselves might as well created) for reasons aesthetic rather than financial, these five gorgeous boys sweep Mayumi into their world of excitement, danger, and overwhelming beauty.

1.title: EN - Pretty Boy Detective Club [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Dark Star that Shines for You Alone (Part 1)
1.plot: Mayumi Dojima gazes at the stars from the rooftop of Yubiwa Academy Middle School. She has been searching for a star that she saw in the night sky ten years ago. She meets a mysterious and beautiful boy named Manabu Sotoin who suddenly takes her to the headquarters of the Pretty Boy Detective Club, where she meets five pretty boys with unique personalities. She asks the Pretty Boy Detective Club to search for the lost star but...

1.title: EN - Pretty Boy Detective Club [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The Dark Star that Shines for You Alone (Part 2)
1.plot: The members of the Pretty Boy Detective Club: Manabu Sotoin, Nagahiro Sakiguchi, Michiru Fukuroi, Hyota Ashikaga, and Sosaku Yubiwa, along with Mayumi Dojima, visit the location where she saw the lost star ten years ago. The deadline imposed by her parents to stop searching for the star is quickly approaching. Meanwhile, she finds herself being tailed by a shadowy figure! She escapes from its evil clutches only to be told a shocking truth from the Pretty Boy Detective Club...

1.title: EN - Pretty Boy Detective Club [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - The Dark Star that Shines for You Alone (Part 3)
1.plot: On their way home from school, Mayumi Dojima and Manabu Sotoin are abducted by a group that call themselves the Twenties. They are after a secret hidden within the star that Mayumi saw ten years ago. The remaining members of the Pretty Boy Detective Club take action to save their friends and finally face the Twenties in a battle! What will Mayumi’s decision be after the search for the missing star ends?

1.title: EN - Pretty Boy Detective Club [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Swindler, the Vanishing Man, and the Pretty Boys (Part 1)
1.plot: The Pretty Boy Detective Club obtains an invitation to a mysterious casino called Reasonable Doubt. When they arrive at the casino, they find that all the patrons and employees appear to be middle school kids. The manager of the casino, Lai Fudatsuki, challenges Nagahiro Sakiguchi to a showdown, and if Nagahiro wins, he acquires the right to operate the casino!

1.title: EN - Pretty Boy Detective Club [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Swindler, the Vanishing Man, and the Pretty Boys (Part 2)
1.plot: Nagahiro loses to Lai, but the Pretty Boy Detective Club figures out the trick that Lai used to win. In order to battle Lai again, they sneak into the Reasonable Doubt Casino. But at the moment of the showdown, the detectives are met with an unexpected situation! What will be the outcome of the battle between the rival middle schools?

1.title: EN - Pretty Boy Detective Club [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Pretty Boy in the Attic (Part 1)
1.plot: During the renovation of the Pretty Boy Detective Club headquarters, the team finds thirty-three paintings in the attic. The mysterious paintings appear to be based on works by legendary painters but are missing human figures. Who created these paintings and for what purpose? While the members of the Pretty Boy Detective Club each present their own theories, they find their way to the person who created the paintings...

1.title: EN - Pretty Boy Detective Club [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - The Pretty Boy in the Attic (Part 2)
1.plot: The artist who created the paintings found in the attic was a former art teacher named Kowako Towai. She was a suspect in a kidnapping case that happened seven years ago. How will the Pretty Boy Detective Club solve the mystery of the thirty-three paintings in the attic and the kidnapping case?

1.title: EN - Pretty Boy Detective Club [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - The Pretty Boy Traveling with the Brocade Portrait (Part 1)
1.plot: A huge oshie-hagoita (wooden paddle decorated with a brocade portrait) from an anonymous sender suddenly arrives at the art room that has been transformed into the Pretty Boy Detective Club headquarters. The Pretty Boy Detective Club deduce that the sender was Kodaki Kawaike, a first-year student at Yubiwa Academy and Nagahiro’s young fiancée. Contrary to her beautiful looks, Kodaki is feared by the Detective Club members as a demon...

1.title: EN - Pretty Boy Detective Club [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - The Pretty Boy Traveling with the Brocade Portrait (Part 2)
1.plot: The reason for Kodaki’s strange behavior remains unclear, but her family background and an “incident” that occurred in the past between her and the Pretty Boy Detective Club becomes apparent. Nagahiro finally decides to break his engagement with Kodaki. What will be the fate between the girl known as the devil and the Pretty Boy Detective Club?

1.title: EN - Pretty Boy Detective Club [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - The Pretty Boy on D. Hill (Part 1)
1.plot: The student council elections are coming up at Yubiwa Academy Middle School, and Wana Naganawa, the current student council vice-president and leading presidential candidate, is forced to withdraw her candidacy after becoming the victim of a hit-and-run accident. The Pretty Boy Detective Club sense that there is a conspiracy behind the elections and begin their search for the suspect. They set up Mayumi as a new candidate to run in the elections but...

1.title: EN - Pretty Boy Detective Club [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - The Pretty Boy on D. Hill (Part 2)
1.plot: With the help of Odoru Sotoin, Manabu Sotoin’s older brother and the founder of the Pretty Boy Detective Club, Mayumi steadily gains more supporters in the election. However, the Detective Club is unable to solve Wana Nagawa’s hit-and-run case, let alone find any clues. The culprit behind the hit-and-run case is now targeting Mayumi and...

1.title: EN - Pretty Boy Detective Club [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - The Pretty Boy on D. Hill (Part 3)
1.plot: On the day of the elections for student council president, Kinshiro Yokuya, Mayumi’s rival candidate and classmate, sits next to her. Before Mayumi’s speech, Kinshiro sets his last trap...! Will the Pretty Boy Detective Club be able to protect Yubiwa Academy?

meta.plot: Pour empêcher l'Iran de passer au nucléaire, l'agent de renseignement John Tavner doit se passer de tout filet de sécurité et endosser le rôle d'"agent illégal" : celle d'un employé moyen dans une usine de tuyauterie industrielle du Midwest.

1.title: FR - American Patriot - S01E01 - Milwaukee, America
1.plot: After a helicopter crash changes the stakes of a foreign election, a former-intelligence officer for the U.S. State Department has to choose between returning to the line of duty in order to dismantle a dangerous political movement in a war torn country as a matter of national security or his personal obligations as the head of a young family.

1.title: FR - American Patriot - S01E02 - C-19
1.plot: With the situation mounting in Iran, getting back to Luxembourg looks grim as John struggles to adjust to life and work in Milwaukee, while a driven homicide detective begins to build her case.

1.plot: Homicide Detective Agathe Albans arrives in Milwaukee to interview Dennis. John must make a desperate last minute push to remain on the travel team.

1.title: FR - American Patriot - S01E04 - John's To-Do List 5/18/12

1.title: FR - American Patriot - S01E05 - Un Monsieur Triste En Costume
1.plot: John's effort to retrieve evidence brings him dangerously close to Agathe. Tom arrives in Luxembourg to help John catch his breath only to ask more of him.

1.title: FR - American Patriot - S01E06 - The Structural Dynamics of Flow

1.plot: John returns to Milwaukee a person of interest in Agathe's investigation, while his already fragile mental state worsens. At McMillan, Stephen's recovery and a sudden promotion further jeopardize the mission.

1.title: FR - American Patriot - S01E08 - L'Affaire Contre John Lakeman

1.title: FR - American Patriot - S01E09 - Dick Cheney

1.title: FR - American Patriot - S01E10 - Dead Serious Rick
1.plot: John returns to Luxembourg where his dedication to his father is put to the test, just as Agathe gathers final evidence that may allow her to learn the truth about John.

2.title: FR - American Patriot - S02E01 - American Dimes
2.plot: John must make a choice at the train platform - be free from his obligations and adversaries by letting Agathe take the money or pursue her in an effort to protect his brother, father, and country.

2.title: FR - American Patriot - S02E02 - The Vantasner Danger Meridian
2.plot: Edward's captor is revealed. John prepared for a dangerous act in his first step toward the assassination of Cantar Walley, just as Walley's elite security team arrives in Paris.

2.title: FR - American Patriot - S02E03 - The Guns of Paris
2.plot: John gets closer to completing his perilous assignment, only to have matters jeopardized by a childhood mistake. Friends get involved in an unprecedented and gravely consequential way.

2.title: FR - American Patriot - S02E04 - The Sword and the Hand
2.plot: Recent events tell a story that could reveal John's plan to assassinate Cantar Walley, so John takes preemptive measures, risking himself to divert attentions and create the illusion that the story is over.

2.title: FR - American Patriot - S02E05 - Army of Strangers
2.plot: John acts against standard protocol, which alerts adversaries of his whereabouts and necessitates the abandonment of the John Lakeman cover identity, jeopardizing all.

2.title: FR - American Patriot - S02E06 - Fuck John Wayne
2.plot: An unexpected day off provides the opportunity for a last-minute bachelor party. Collective inebriation follows. John fully embraces the celebration with his wife and friends until the time line for his mission abruptly moves up.

2.title: FR - American Patriot - S02E07 - Loaded
2.plot: Drunk and stoned, John breaks into Cantar Walley's compound. Alice considers the cost of betraying her father-in-law in order to protect her husband. In the meantime, Agathe finds a powerful new ally.

2.title: FR - American Patriot - S02E08 - Escape From Paris
2.plot: All hell breaks loose.

meta.plot: At times dark, at times disturbing, four short films explore stories of those who dare to dream and desire — and those determined to stand in their way.

1.title: IN - Paava Kadhaigal [Multi-Sub] - S01E01 - Thangam
1.plot: Facing longtime bullying and ostracization, a trans villager risks everything to support the dream of a beloved childhood friend.

1.title: IN - Paava Kadhaigal [Multi-Sub] - S01E02 - Love Panna Uttranum
1.plot: Fearing their father’s staunch views on marriage, two sisters take separate approaches to tell him who they love, with wildly different outcomes.

1.title: IN - Paava Kadhaigal [Multi-Sub] - S01E03 - Vaanmagal
1.plot: A family grapples with guilt, anger and social stigma after their spirited young daughter suffers a traumatic incident.

1.title: IN - Paava Kadhaigal [Multi-Sub] - S01E04 - Oor Iravu
1.plot: Estranged from her family after eloping, a now-pregnant young woman is brought home by her father, who says he wishes to hold a baby shower for her.

meta.plot: Located in the center of a remote island, the Abyss is the last unexplored region, a huge and treacherous fathomless hole inhabited by strange creatures where only the bravest adventurers descend in search of ancient relics. In the upper levels of the Abyss, Riko, a girl who dreams of becoming an explorer, stumbles upon a mysterious little boy.

1.title: EN - Made In Abyss [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The City of the Great Pit
1.plot: While exploring the Abyss, Riko comes across something she has never seen before. How does this new discovery impact her?

1.title: EN - Made In Abyss [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Resurrection Festival
1.plot: Riko and Reg find out more about their past but the question still remains, who or what exactly is Reg?

1.title: EN - Made In Abyss [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Departure
1.plot: Reg goes on his first cave raid! Meanwhile, Riko makes preparations to go into the abyss to find her mother.

1.title: EN - Made In Abyss [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Edge of the Abyss
1.plot: Riko and Reg start their adventure into the Abyss, while there they run into an unexpected familiar face.

1.title: EN - Made In Abyss [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Incinerator
1.plot: Riko and Reg descend into the Forest of Temptation. What new dangers will they find laying in wait for them there?

1.title: EN - Made In Abyss [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Seeker Camp
1.plot: Reg and Riko make it to the Seeker Camp where they meet Ozen the Immovable, the person who saved Riko all those years ago. But there is more to Ozen than meets the eye.

1.title: EN - Made In Abyss [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - The Unmovable Sovereign
1.plot: Ozen reveals more about the Abyss as well as the truth behind Riko's origins. What will happen when Ozen shows her true colors?

1.title: EN - Made In Abyss [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Survival Training
1.plot: Ozen tasks Riko and Reg to survive alone outside the Seeker Camp. Do they come out alive and unscathed? Or does the Abyss have a dirty trick up its sleeve?

1.title: EN - Made In Abyss [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - The Great Fault
1.plot: Reg and Riko continue their descent after they leave Ozen's Seeker Camp. Riko's mettle is tested as Reg passes out and she has to fend for herself.

1.title: EN - Made In Abyss [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Poison and the Curse
1.plot: Reg and Riko run into trouble deep in the fourth layer where they meet an interesting creature, but are they friend or foe?

1.title: EN - Made In Abyss [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Nanachi
1.plot: Nanachi sends Reg on a mission to find certain items that could possibly save Riko. Meanwhile, Nanachi reveals a little more about themself.

1.title: EN - Made In Abyss [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - The True Nature of the Curse
1.plot: Nanachi shows Reg the truth about the Abyss. Meanwhile, Riko is still recovering from her injuries when she has a strange dream.

2.title: EN - Made In Abyss [MULTI-SUB] - S02E01 - The Compass Pointed to the Darkness
2.plot: An old man speaks of a golden city that lies within a devouring abyss somewhere in uncharted waters. One explorer may be the key to finding both.

2.title: EN - Made In Abyss [MULTI-SUB] - S02E02 - Capital of the Unreturned
2.plot: Riko, Reg and Nanachi take their first steps into the sixth layer. Both wonders and dangers await the trio, but they are unaware they are being watched.

2.title: EN - Made In Abyss [MULTI-SUB] - S02E03 - Village of the Hollows
2.plot: Riko couldn’t have known the consequences of her words, but she sealed the villager’s fate as soon as she acknowledged Meinya was priceless. The Balancing has begun…

2.title: EN - Made In Abyss [MULTI-SUB] - S02E04 - Friend
2.plot: Faputa and Reg once knew each other, but Reg cannot remember her at all now. Meanwhile, Nanachi is stunned by news so unexpected that it should be impossible to believe.

2.title: EN - Made In Abyss [MULTI-SUB] - S02E05 - Concealment
2.plot: Some say there’s a secret hidden deep within the dark cave at the edge of the village. Villagers don’t investigate and stay far away, but Riko isn’t a villager.

2.title: EN - Made In Abyss [MULTI-SUB] - S02E06 - The Luring
2.plot: The villagers must lure abyssal fauna into the village to hunt them. But when one creature proves too much to handle, Riko needs to help the villagers defend their home.

2.title: EN - Made In Abyss [MULTI-SUB] - S02E07 - The Cradle of Desire
2.plot: What happened to the expedition? The truth is far more tragic and horrifying than anyone could have imagined.

2.title: EN - Made In Abyss [MULTI-SUB] - S02E08 - The Form the Wish Takes
2.plot: They had their reasons for descending into that infernal pit. They found damnation and salvation in equal measure.

2.title: EN - Made In Abyss [MULTI-SUB] - S02E09 - The Return
2.plot: Faputa can help Reg save Nanachi, but everything has a price. In exchange, Reg must help her enter the village.

2.title: EN - Made In Abyss [MULTI-SUB] - S02E10 - All That You Gather
2.plot: The reckoning comes, but Reg is too kind and foolish to be a bystander.

2.title: EN - Made In Abyss [MULTI-SUB] - S02E11 - Value
2.plot: The village’s membrane has been breached, and through the gap floods chaos itself. But as attackers enter from without, aid comes from within.

2.title: EN - Made In Abyss [MULTI-SUB] - S02E12 - Gold
2.plot: In the end, everything comes full circle.

meta.plot: At the age of 39, Nina finds herself a trainee nurse under the orders of Léo, a 15-year-younger "girl" with a difficult temperament, and Dr. Proust, who likes to scare her ... Not easy ! Especially for all, Nina is the wife of the boss, Costa Antonakis, his ex with whom nothing is really settled despite their divorce. But after healing Lily, their daughter, for ten years, nothing scares Nina! With years spent in hospitals in contact with doctors such as nurses and health-care aides, Nina, the daughter of a great internist and a renowned obstetrician, runs the risk of disappointing them to trace her own path in the hospital universe to which she can not really escape ... Listening and care as a profession of faith, the desire to live and love as a prescription ...

1.title: FR - Nina - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: When joining her ex-husband's hospital as a trainee nurse, Nina, who fails to go unnoticed, inadvertently stokes tensions within the department.

1.title: FR - Nina - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Nina saves the life of a surgeon who she catches in the act with a student nurse. She covers for the young woman but in doing so, she ends up looking like the mistress.

1.title: FR - Nina - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: When her father is urgently taken to hospital, Nina puts on her white coat to stay at his bedside and finds herself looking after a man accused of domestic violence.

1.title: FR - Nina - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Nina becomes attached to a patient who Dr Proust has developed a casual attitude towards. Léo, her adviser and housemate, becomes fond of a very religious patient.

1.title: FR - Nina - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: When the department is overwhelmed by a flu epidemic, Nina crosses paths with an old friend. Léo looks after a diabetic patient who has passed out on his wedding day.

1.title: FR - Nina - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Nina confronts Dr Proust about a patient who has come to spend his final days in hospital, away from his mother. The pediatrics department is concerned over a potential case of meningitis.

1.title: FR - Nina - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Nina and Léo bring a young woman to the hospital who has just given birth in the street and her baby is in a bad way. An incident disrupts the internal medicine unit.

1.title: FR - Nina - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: At the end of her training, Nina fears the worst from Dr Proust. Meanwhile, Lily has issues starting her job shadowing and Léo is under pressure.

meta.plot: When CIA analyst Jack Ryan stumbles upon a suspicious series of bank transfers his search for answers pulls him from the safety of his desk job and catapults him into a deadly game of cat and mouse throughout Europe and the Middle East, with a rising terrorist figurehead preparing for a massive attack against the US and her allies.

1.title: EN - Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: CIA analyst Jack Ryan uncovers a series of suspicious transactions that take him and his boss James Greer out from behind their desks into the field to hunt down a powerful new threat to the world. Hanin begins to question her husband's affairs after he brings a mysterious outsider into their home.

1.title: EN - Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - French Connection
1.plot: Jack and Greer decode a fresh piece of intel that takes them to Paris and one step closer to the elusive Suleiman. Hanin's husband returns home with a renewed fervor for his secretive mission, leaving her unsure of their family's future.

1.title: EN - Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Black 22
1.plot: Drone pilot Victor struggles with the immense responsibility attached to his job. Jack and Greer join French Intelligence officers on a mission to track down Suleiman's brother. Hanin is forced to make a dangerous decision for the sake of their children.

1.title: EN - Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Wolf
1.plot: As Jack and Cathy grow closer, Jack's double-life is put to the test. A show of force from Suleiman adds to his ranks and brings him one step closer to his next attack.

1.title: EN - Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - End of Honor
1.plot: After the horrific Paris church attack, Jack and Greer discover a deeper strategy behind Suleiman's actions, forcing Jack to suggest an unusual trap for him. Hanin faces new challenges in her quest for freedom.

1.title: EN - Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Sources and Methods
1.plot: Jack's moral code is tested when he and Greer use a Turkish criminal to help them track down a high-value target who may be able to lead them to Suleiman. Hanin tries to evade her pursuers and keep her daughters safe. Cathy investigates an outbreak of a virulent form of Ebola that may point to something more ominous.

1.title: EN - Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - The Boy
1.plot: Jack and Greer try to convince their superiors to lead a covert ground assault to capture Suleiman. Jack's double life costs him an important relationship.

1.title: EN - Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Inshallah
1.plot: Jack and Greer fear Suleiman's next attack could be on U.S. soil. They must figure out how to stop him or risk enormous costs.

2.title: EN - Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan [MULTI-SUB] - S02E01 - Cargo
2.plot: Jack Ryan searches for the truth behind Venezuela's transactions with various World Powers. James Greer, about to get sidelined from his new post in Russia, joins Jack in Venezuela and the two find themselves in the midst of a Venezuelan leader's re-election effort.

2.title: EN - Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan [MULTI-SUB] - S02E02 - Tertia Optio
2.plot: Jack is granted permission from Senator Chapin to stay in Venezuela. President Reyes denies involvement in the events that are keeping Jack in country. Meanwhile, Jack and Harry team up to follow a lead that could create dissension within the ranks.

2.title: EN - Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan [MULTI-SUB] - S02E03 - Orinoco
2.plot: The U.S. Special Activities team lands in Venezuela where Jack's intel leads them to a militia guarded compound. Deep in the jungle, Jack’s search for answers puts the whole team in danger. President Reyes' opponent, Gloria Bonalde, proves to be a real contender in the upcoming election.

2.title: EN - Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan [MULTI-SUB] - S02E04 - Dressed to Kill
2.plot: Relieved of duty in Venezuela, Jack follows a new trail to London and seeks the help of MI5, only to discover the man he's after is also after him. Back in Venezuela, Reyes makes Gloria an offer.

2.title: EN - Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan [MULTI-SUB] - S02E05 - Blue Gold
2.plot: Using Max's daughter as bait, Jack and Harry convince Max to meet face to face. Stranded in the jungle, Marcus stumbles across a prisoner camp. Greer visits Gloria hoping to draw a connection between Reyes and her missing husband.

2.title: EN - Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan [MULTI-SUB] - S02E06 - Persona Non Grata
2.plot: Reyes accuses the U.S. of tampering with the election. The U.S. Embassy is evacuated. Jack, Greer and Mike November must decide whether to follow orders or go off the grid. Reyes' men pursue Matice and the American soldiers in the jungle.

2.title: EN - Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan [MULTI-SUB] - S02E07 - Dios y Federación
2.plot: The election in Venezuela is moved up. Stranded in a hostile country, Jack and Mike fight for their lives, while Greer is interrogated. The Ubarri family must decide to flee or face Reyes.

2.title: EN - Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan [MULTI-SUB] - S02E08 - Strongman
2.plot: Jack heads to the Presidential Palace to retrieve Greer. When the polls are shutdown, violent protests erupt outside the palace, and Jack must make a decision that could determine his future.

3.title: EN - Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan [MULTI-SUB] - S03E01 - Falcon
3.plot: Jack Ryan investigates a secret plan to restore the Soviet Empire through war, embarking on a dangerous op with the help of Rome Station Chief Elizabeth Wright and Head of Russia House James Greer. Meanwhile, an assassination on home soil forces Czech President Alena Kovac into a dangerous position with Russia.

3.title: EN - Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan [MULTI-SUB] - S03E02 - Old Haunts
3.plot: Jack, out in the cold and on the run after the fallout from his failed operation in Greece, must evade authorities both foreign and domestic before receiving help from an old friend.

3.title: EN - Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan [MULTI-SUB] - S03E03 - Running with Wolves
3.plot: Jack travels to Vienna to track down the source of his original intelligence on Sokol. Greer advises Alena on a key NATO deal. Petr Kovac, Alena’s father, hosts a hunt in the Czech woods.

3.title: EN - Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan [MULTI-SUB] - S03E04 - Our Death's Keeper
3.plot: In Budapest, Jack and Mike plan a sting on a slippery arms dealer to ascertain the whereabouts of the Sokol nuclear device, as Greer discovers some intriguing and potentially incriminating information on Petr Kovac.

3.title: EN - Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan [MULTI-SUB] - S03E05 - Druz'ya I Vragi
3.plot: Jack and Mike head to a mysterious, abandoned outpost in Russia to seize the Sokol nuclear device, but an unexpected visitor foils their plans. Meanwhile, Petr seeks to rescue Alena, who has been kidnapped by her own head of security.

3.title: EN - Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan [MULTI-SUB] - S03E06 - Ghosts
3.plot: Jack races to stop the detonation of the Sokol nuclear device, which has traveled to the Czech Republic. Petr and Luka’s secret histories come to the surface in a deadly reckoning.

3.title: EN - Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan [MULTI-SUB] - S03E07 - Moscow Rules
3.plot: In Moscow, Jack teams with Luka to expose the high-ranking cabal members within the government who are now orchestrating the secret Sokol plan.

3.title: EN - Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan [MULTI-SUB] - S03E08 - Star on the Wall
3.plot: Jack, Greer, Wright, Alena and Luka all work in concert to prevent the start of a third world war.

4.title: EN - Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan [MULTI-SUB] - S04E01 - Triage
4.plot: Jack, given the task of cleaning up the CIA, makes difficult decisions that have immediate consequences. A cartel operator moves in the shadows to organize an important meeting.

4.title: EN - Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan [MULTI-SUB] - S04E02 - Convergence
4.plot: Jack digs deeper into Miller's dirty operations and learns more about Chavez. Back in Myanmar, Chao must navigate the tension in the compound to keep his family safe.

4.title: EN - Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan [MULTI-SUB] - S04E03 - Sacrifices
4.plot: Jack's team heads to Mexico to get answers. Wright attempts to smooth things over in Nigeria, hoping to find some resolution of her own.

4.title: EN - Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan [MULTI-SUB] - S04E04 - Bethesda
4.plot: Jack, Chavez and November pursue their Croatia lead to an unsettling affair. Chao takes a mandatory trip to Geneva to speak with his boss. Greer works on connecting the two shell companies.

4.title: EN - Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan [MULTI-SUB] - S04E05 - Wukong
4.plot: Complications arise in Jack's plan to extract Chao and his family from the compound in Myanmar. Back in D.C., Greer comes to a shocking conclusion.

4.title: EN - Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan [MULTI-SUB] - S04E06 - Proof of Concept
4.plot: If Wright wants to get Jack out alive, compromises must be made. Groundbreaking intel gives the CIA a chance to prevent a domestic terrorist act.

meta.plot: Spy-in-training Lily is desperate to score a passing grade. Eager to prove herself, she leaps at the chance to join the mysterious team Lamplight and beat the Impossible Mission. Too bad the task ahead is even more harrowing than she imagined…

1.title: EN - Spy Classroom [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - MISSION: Flower Garden I
1.plot: Spy-school washout Lily just accepted a provisional graduation, and she couldn’t be happier! But there’s more to her new assignment (and her new teacher) than meets the eye.

1.title: EN - Spy Classroom [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - MISSION: Flower Garden II
1.plot: From defeat comes wisdom. To vanquish Klaus, Team Lamplight must learn from their mistakes — but once they enter enemy territory, the time for mistakes will be over.

1.title: EN - Spy Classroom [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - MISSION: Flower Garden III
1.plot: Impossible Mission or not, it doesn’t make sense for a team that legendary to go down so easily. A traitor betrays his team.

1.title: EN - Spy Classroom [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - FILE: Fool Erna
1.plot: Nine elite members form a new team called Lamplight, and they’re going to pick up where Inferno left off.

1.title: EN - Spy Classroom [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - FILE: Lamplight Days
1.plot: With Wunderkind Lily at its head, Lamplight's going to lead the charge. Their inaugural Impossible Mission is just around the corner.

1.title: EN - Spy Classroom [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - FILE: Pandemonium Sybilla
1.plot: The girls receive some advice: “Deceive each other. Trick each other. Improve each other.”

1.title: EN - Spy Classroom [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - FILE: Meadow Sara
1.plot: With a ghost on the loose and a literal ticking time bomb, the girls start worrying about the manor's structural integrity.

1.title: EN - Spy Classroom [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - MISSION: Daughter Dearest I
1.plot: Coming back from a break, everyone is recharged and ready for the next mission. Lamplight's been promoted from a provisional team to an actual team.

1.title: EN - Spy Classroom [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - MISSION: Daughter Dearest II
1.plot: When you’re a spy, sometimes being stealthy is not enough. You also have to be well fed!

1.title: EN - Spy Classroom [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - MISSION: Daughter Dearest III

1.plot: Lamplight faces a battle they have to win on their own.

1.title: EN - Spy Classroom [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - FILE: Daughter Dearest Grete
1.plot: This will be the first time in a long while that all nine Lamplight members back together!
