8.title: FR - The Office - S08E01 - The List
8.plot: Robert California stops by for the first time as CEO and leaves behind a mysterious list that has a line down the middle and every member of the office on either one side or the other. The office members frantically try to figure out what it means. Meanwhile, the new manager Andy faces a crisis.

8.title: FR - The Office - S08E02 - The Incentive
8.plot: After Robert California challenges the Dunder Mifflin staffers to double their sales, Andy, taking matters into his own hands, creates an incentive program. Eventually, he promises to tattoo himself if the staff doubles their sales. Meanwhile, Pam strikes up an unlikely friendship with Angela, both of whom are pregnant.

8.title: FR - The Office - S08E03 - Lotto
8.plot: The entire warehouse staff quits after winning the lotto, leaving Andy and Darryl to scramble for replacements while several of the office workers get a taste of the warehouse life.

8.title: FR - The Office - S08E04 - Garden Party
8.plot: Andy plants the seeds of trying to impress Robert California by throwing a garden party at Schrute Farms. Andy's parents and brother also attend the event, only to make him feel awkward.

8.title: FR - The Office - S08E05 - Spooked
8.plot: Erin works to make a spooky, non-childish Halloween party with help from Gabe. Dwight becomes friends with Robert's son, and Pam and Jim debate the existence of ghosts. Meanwhile, Robert tries to figure out everyone's deepest fears.

8.title: FR - The Office - S08E06 - Doomsday
8.plot: Dwight installs a Doomsday device that will fire all of the employees and effectively close down the branch if they make too many mistakes. Meanwhile, Gabe attempts to court the new warehouse worker, Val.

8.title: FR - The Office - S08E07 - Pam's Replacement
8.plot: Pam trains an attractive temporary worker to take her place while she is on maternity leave, and enlists Dwight's support when she tries to show that Jim finds her replacement attractive. Meanwhile, Robert California surprises Andy, Kevin, and Darryl when he requests to join their band.

8.title: FR - The Office - S08E08 - Gettysburg
8.plot: Andy takes some of the office staff on a field trip to Gettysburg for inspiration. Meanwhile, the rest of the office, under orders from Robert California, are tasked with coming up with a new business idea for Dunder Mifflin. Kevin proposes several ideas that catch California's attention, although they are rather idiotic.

8.title: FR - The Office - S08E09 - Mrs. California
8.plot: Robert California brings his wife into the office for a job, and tells Andy behind her back not to give her one which turns disastrous. Meanwhile, Dwight opens a gym in the building and tries to get Darryl to join it.

8.title: FR - The Office - S08E10 - Christmas Wishes
8.plot: Andy attempts to make everyone's Christmas wishes come true, including those of a drunken Erin. Meanwhile, Dwight and Jim are entangled in an escalating prank war wherein one attempts to frame the other.

8.title: FR - The Office - S08E11 - Trivia
8.plot: Pressed to boost the bottom line, Andy finds a novel way to improve sales, while Dwight explores corporate opportunities outside Scranton.

8.title: FR - The Office - S08E12 - Pool Party
8.plot: After Robert decides to sell his mansion following his divorce, Kevin suggests that he have an office pool party. Erin tries to make Andy jealous by flirting with Dwight. Meanwhile, Robert gives everyone a tour of his massive home.

8.title: FR - The Office - S08E13 - Jury Duty
8.plot: Jim returns from jury duty, only to have to deal with Dwight's pesky questions about the details of the case. Elsewhere, Angela and her senator beau welcome their baby.

8.title: FR - The Office - S08E14 - Special Project
8.plot: Dwight scores a special assignment at Sabre's Florida headquarters. As a result, he and Andy must decide which Scranton staffers will join him. Elsewhere, Pam returns from maternity leave.

8.title: FR - The Office - S08E15 - Tallahassee
8.plot: Dwight arrives in Tallahassee with his team and sets out to win over the president of Sabre's special projects. Back in Scranton, Andy fills in for reception and enjoys himself.

8.title: FR - The Office - S08E16 - After Hours
8.plot: A power play unfolds in Tallahassee when Dwight and Todd Packer compete to become Nellie's vice president. Meanwhile, Jim receives an unwelcome visitor, and Andy forces the Scranton staffers to work late.

8.title: FR - The Office - S08E17 - Test the Store
8.plot: The Florida contingent puts the final touches on the new Sabre store, with Dwight preparing a theatrical presentation in his continuing bid to impress Nellie. Back in Scranton, a red-faced Andy arrives at work with a humiliating injury.

8.title: FR - The Office - S08E18 - Last Day in Florida
8.plot: Jim comes to Dwight's rescue when Robert slams the plan for the Sabre Store concept. Andy discovers Erin doesn't plan to return to Scranton.

8.title: FR - The Office - S08E19 - Get the Girl
8.plot: Andy makes a game-changing decision and takes a road-trip odyssey in the name of romance. Elsewhere, Nellie arrives at the Scranton branch and sets out to seize the manager position.

8.title: FR - The Office - S08E20 - Welcome Party
8.plot: Robert California forces the office to throw a welcome party for Nellie, but the Party Planning Committee works on ways to sabotage it. Meanwhile, Erin tries to help Andy figure out a way to break up with Jessica.

8.title: FR - The Office - S08E21 - Angry Andy
8.plot: Andy returns to the office to find Nellie in the manager's chair. Meanwhile, Kelly struggles to choose between Ryan and a new man.

8.title: FR - The Office - S08E22 - Fundraiser
8.plot: Unemployed Andy crashes a fundraiser for the Senator and winds up adopting twelve disabled dogs. Dwight discovers that winning an auction means losing money, and Darryl teaches Nellie how to eat a taco.

8.title: FR - The Office - S08E23 - Turf War
8.plot: Andy takes a break from flambéing cherries and composing rock operas to jumpstart his Dunder Mifflin comeback. When Robert drunkenly shuts down a nearby branch, Jim and Dwight join forces to outsmart a salesman from Scranton’s uglier sister city.

8.title: FR - The Office - S08E24 - Free Family Portrait Studio
8.plot: Dwight offers free family portraits, and a stolen diaper leads to a high-speed car chase. With help from David Wallace, Andy goes undercover to try to get his job back. A new business opportunity arises for Robert California.

9.title: FR - The Office - S09E01 - New Guys
9.plot: Two new, young employees throw Dwight and Jim off balance; Andy returns from leadership training with a desire for revenge.

9.title: FR - The Office - S09E02 - Roy's Wedding
9.plot: A toast at Roy's wedding leads to Pam and Jim searching their relationships for buried secrets; Dwight reacts to Nellie's mandatory charity initiative.

9.title: FR - The Office - S09E03 - Andy's Ancestry
9.plot: Andy flaunts his genealogy when he discovers he's related to Michelle Obama. Meanwhile, Darryl struggles in his new post, Dwight teaches Erin a new language to wow her boyfriend's family, and Nellie tries to persuade Pam that Jim's having an affair.

9.title: FR - The Office - S09E04 - Work Bus
9.plot: The staffers hit the road in a rented bus when the building is deemed unsafe. Meanwhile, Nellie reaches out to Andy for help in adopting a baby, and Jim uses pie to spread cheer to Pam.

9.title: FR - The Office - S09E05 - Here Comes Treble
9.plot: It's Halloween in the office and Andy invites his college a cappella group to perform, which leads to a confrontation with his frenemy Broccoli Rob. Meanwhile, Dwight finds evidence that a madman is loose in the office and tries to track him down, and the first meeting of Jim's new job causes a fight with Pam.

9.title: FR - The Office - S09E06 - The Boat
9.plot: Money problems plague Andy's family. Meanwhile, Dwight guests on a local radio show, so the staffers harass him with outrageous phone calls, and Kevin unearths a big secret about Oscar.

9.title: FR - The Office - S09E07 - The Whale
9.plot: The women of the office try to teach Dwight how to interact with female clients; Angela suspects the senator of cheating; Toby convinces some of the guys to grow mustaches.

9.title: FR - The Office - S09E08 - The Target
9.plot: Angela goes to Dwight for help when she learns that her husband is having an affair. Stanley and Phyllis take advantage of Jim when he needs a favor, and Pete distracts Pam as she begins painting her mural.

9.title: FR - The Office - S09E09 - Dwight Christmas
9.plot: When the party planning committee drops the ball on the annual Christmas party, Dwight gets everyone to celebrate with a traditional Schrute German Christmas. Darryl fears that Jim has forgotten to include him in the new job in Philadelphia. Pete teaches Erin about his favorite movie, Die Hard.

9.title: FR - The Office - S09E10 - Lice
9.plot: Pam accidentally brings lice into the office and lets Meredith take the fall, while Dwight vows to destroy the parasites. Meanwhile, Jim has a fantastic day in Philly wooing a potential business associate. Meanwhile, Phyllis, Nellie and Kevin meddle in Darryl's love life.

9.title: FR - The Office - S09E11 - Suit Warehouse
9.plot: Clark brings an espresso maker to the office. Dwight and Clark pretend to be a father-and-son to land a sale. Darryl goes on an interview at Jim's company, where Pam drops by unexpectedly.

9.title: FR - The Office - S09E12 - Customer Loyalty
9.plot: Dwight tries to stop Darryl from moving to Jim's start-up company. Jim misses his daughter's first recital, to Pam's dismay. Nellie spills the beans about Pete and Erin.

9.title: FR - The Office - S09E13 - Junior Salesman
9.plot: Dwight is tasked with hiring a part-time salesman to be Jim's substitute, so he rounds up a supergroup of his cronies, including his oddball beet-farmer cousin, Mose. Pam is left wondering who her new deskmate will be. Erin seeks her birth parents with help from Pete.

9.title: FR - The Office - S09E14 - Vandalism
9.plot: Pam’s warehouse mural is defaced. Darryl has difficulty dealing with the Jim's cleanliness habits in their apartment. Angela grudgingly allows Oscar and Kevin to attend her son’s first birthday party.

9.title: FR - The Office - S09E15 - Couples Discount
9.plot: The staffers pair up as faux couples to score a Valentine's Day discount at a mall. Erin tells Pete that she'll break up with Andy when he returns, but Pete has his doubts. Jim and Pam socialize with the documentary's soundman.

9.title: FR - The Office - S09E16 - Moving On
9.plot: Pam interviews for a job in Philadelphia, but her potential manager reminds her of her former boss, Michael Scott. Dwight acquires the help of Angela in order to give his elderly Aunt Shirley a bath. Meanwhile, Andy attempts to make Pete and Erin feel uncomfortable.

9.title: FR - The Office - S09E17 - The Farm
9.plot: The adventures of Dwight at his family beet farm and bed-and-breakfast come to light. Here, he and his siblings receive a surprise inheritance. Back at the office, Todd Packer tries to atone for a lifetime of boorish behavior.

9.title: FR - The Office - S09E18 - Promos
9.plot: Everyone in the office is excited when promos start running on TV for the documentary. Dwight makes Angela jealous when he starts dating a brussel sprout farmer. Meanwhile Jim has a big meeting with Major League baseball player, Ryan Howard.

9.title: FR - The Office - S09E19 - Stairmageddon
9.plot: The elevator goes out at the office, forcing everyone to use the stairs. Dwight forces Stanley to make a sales call. Pam and Jim talk to Nellie and Toby about relationship problems. Angela supports her man.

9.title: FR - The Office - S09E20 - Paper Airplane
9.plot: Dwight and Angela participate in a paper airplane contest and compete against each other. Meanwhile, Andy prepares for a potential acting job, and Jim and Pam utilize new skills.

9.title: FR - The Office - S09E21 - Livin' the Dream
9.plot: Dwight becomes regional manager after Andy quits his job, Jim dedicates more time to his Dunder Mifflin job to save his marriage, and Angela has problems with her new living arrangements after her breakup with The Senator.

9.title: FR - The Office - S09E22 - A.A.R.M.
9.plot: Jim convinces Dwight that he needs to choose someone to act as an Assistant to the Assistant Regional Manager; the two subsequently hold tryouts for the position. After her daycare turns away her child, Angela is forced to bring her kid to work. Andy auditions for "The Next Great A Cappella Sensation".

9.title: FR - The Office - S09E23 - Finale
9.plot: One year later, Dunder Mifflin employees past and present reunite for a panel discussion about the documentary and to attend Dwight and Angela's wedding.

meta.plot: The true story of three courageous women inside the notorious Calabrian ‘Ndrangheta mafia, working with newly-minted female prosecutor, Alessandra Cerreti, to bring down down the criminal empire.

1.title: EN - The Good Mothers [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Nella Bocca Del Lupo
1.plot: Anna Colace prepares a revolutionary strategy to challenge the ‘Ndrangheta. Lea Garofalo and her daughter Denise reconnect with their husband and father, Carlo Cosco, hoping to reconcile and put an end to their years of living on the run.

1.title: EN - The Good Mothers [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Famiglia E Lealta
1.plot: Denise is catapulted into an unknown world after a devastating tragedy. Meanwhile, Anna initiates a surveillance operation on the women of the ‘Ndrangheta, focusing on Giuseppina Pesce and Maria Concetta Cacciola.

1.title: EN - The Good Mothers [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Un'altra Vita
1.plot: When migrants whom the Ndrangheta have exploited spill out into the streets to protest their working conditions, Anna makes a risky phone call to accelerate a new phase of her operation. The search for Lea makes significant progress in the meantime.

1.title: EN - The Good Mothers [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Tradimento
1.plot: As the Pesce clan falters after Giuseppina’s arrest, Anna turns her attention to another potential witness: Maria Concetta Cacciola. In the meantime, Denise leaves Reggio Calabria to meet an old acquaintance.

1.title: EN - The Good Mothers [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Madri e figli
1.plot: Giuseppina’s decision to collaborate enables Anna to attack members of the ‘Ndrangheta clans. Her tactics clash with those in the media. Maria Concetta takes matters into her own hands, Giuseppina faces a new challenge and Denise learns a shocking secret.

1.title: EN - The Good Mothers [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Coraggio
1.plot: Anna Colace suffers a setback with Giuseppina. Maria Concetta fights against her new life in isolation and Denise returns to Dalia Masi in order to honour her mother’s memory.

meta.plot: A tragic accident leaves an ambitious prosecutor with the mind of a child – forcing him and his mother to embark on a journey to heal their relationship.

1.title: EN - The Good Bad Mother [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: After a tragedy turns her world upside down, Jin Young-soon raises her son with the aim of steering him away from a life of hardship like hers.

1.title: EN - The Good Bad Mother [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Filled with childhood resentment, Choi Kang-ho navigates his career with ruthless ambition — later approaching Young-soon with a cruel motive.

1.title: EN - The Good Bad Mother [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: A shocking accident leaves Kang-ho's outlook uncertain. Young-soon takes him home and seizes an opportunity for redemption.

1.title: EN - The Good Bad Mother [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: As Kang-ho recovers, he and Young-soon get closer. However, Young-soon later visits Seoul and witnesses unfavorable traces of Kang-ho's life.

1.title: EN - The Good Bad Mother [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: After retuning home, Lee Mi-joo encounters Kang-ho in his new condition. Young-soon faces aggression from an unrelenting neighbor.

1.title: EN - The Good Bad Mother [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Kang-ho experiences a mysterious attack. Mi-joo finds an fortuitous business opportunity. The town convenes to rally against Young-soon.

1.title: EN - The Good Bad Mother [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Young-soon panics about the future after she receives scary news. Another sudden blow forces her to make hard decisions about herself and Kang-ho.

1.title: EN - The Good Bad Mother [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: Young-soon pushes Kang-ho to the limits. She later finds a perplexing item from her son's old life. Mi-joo navigates her complex feelings around Kang-ho.

1.title: EN - The Good Bad Mother [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Episode 9
1.plot: Young-soon and Kang-ho go through recollections of Kang-ho's past — discovering another side to his story.

1.title: EN - The Good Bad Mother [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Episode 10
1.plot: Young-soon prepares Kang-ho for a safer future. After a startling incident, Mi-joo and Kang-ho share a tender moment — further complicating their lives.

meta.plot: The adventures of The Doctor, a time-traveling humanoid alien known as a Time Lord. He explores the universe in his TARDIS, a sentient time-traveling spaceship. Its exterior appears as a blue British police box, which was a common sight in Britain in 1963 when the series first aired. Along with a succession of companions, The Doctor faces a variety of foes while working to save civilizations, help ordinary people, and right many wrongs.

1.title: FR - Doctor Who - S01E01 - An Unearthly Child
1.plot: After discussing a strange pupil, Susan Foreman, teachers Ian and Barbara follow her to a junkyard. They meet her grandfather, the Doctor, and force their way inside a police box with frightening results.

1.title: FR - Doctor Who - S01E02 - The Cave of Skulls
1.plot: The enigmatic Doctor, afraid that schoolteachers Ian Chesterton and Barbara Wright will reveal his secrets to the people of 20th century Earth, has taken them and his granddaughter Susan back to the dawn of human history. There, the four travellers are dragged into the savage politics of a tribe of cavemen who have lost the secret of making fire…

1.title: FR - Doctor Who - S01E03 - The Forest of Fear
1.plot: Prisoners of the earliest humans, the TARDIS crew are caught in a deadly power play for leadership of the tribe.

1.title: FR - Doctor Who - S01E04 - The Firemaker
1.plot: The TARDIS crew must make fire for the early humans to stay alive. But once they do, they may not be allowed to leave!

1.title: FR - Doctor Who - S01E05 - The Dead Planet
1.plot: Time Unknown, Planet Unknown. The TARDIS lands in an eerie petrified forest overlooking a magnificent steel city. The Doctor wants to explore the city – but what is waiting there?

1.title: FR - Doctor Who - S01E06 - The Survivors
1.plot: The dead planet is not uninhabited after all. The Doctor is about to meet what will become his greatest enemies. And he and his crew are dying of radiation sickness.

1.title: FR - Doctor Who - S01E07 - The Escape
1.plot: Imprisoned on Skaro by the scheming Daleks, the Doctor and his companions work to escape their clutches.

1.title: FR - Doctor Who - S01E08 - The Ambush
1.plot: The time travellers work desperately to both escape the Dalek city and prevent a bloody massacre.

1.title: FR - Doctor Who - S01E09 - The Expedition
1.plot: The time travellers have escaped from the Daleks, but left a vital piece of the TARDIS behind. Getting it back will mean pushing the Thals to mount a dangerous operation.

1.title: FR - Doctor Who - S01E10 - The Ordeal
1.plot: Ian, Barbara and the Thals struggle through the caves to reach the Dalek city. Will they get there in time? Is there even a way through the treacherous caves? And what are the Daleks planning?

1.title: FR - Doctor Who - S01E11 - The Rescue
1.plot: Time is running out as the Doctor and his companions try to defeat the Daleks before they wipe out all life on Skaro.

1.title: FR - Doctor Who - S01E12 - The Edge of Destruction
1.plot: A mysterious explosion has knocked the TARDIS into void. And in their confusion, the crew are turning on one another.

1.title: FR - Doctor Who - S01E13 - The Brink of Disaster
1.plot: The TARDIS is adrift, the crew turning on each other. Only by working together can they find their way out before they are destroyed.

2.title: FR - Doctor Who - S02E01 - Planet of Giants
2.plot: When the TARDIS malfunctions and the doors open in the time vortex, the travellers and their Ship shrink to the size of insects. When they arrive on Earth, they uncover a murderous plot involving a new insecticide - but how can they stop the crime in their miniaturised condition ? (Originally broadcast in three parts.)

2.title: FR - Doctor Who - S02E02 - Dangerous Journey
2.plot: Ian and Barbara are accidentally taken into Smithers' laboratory and, while the Doctor and Susan face a hazardous journey to reach them, they witness the deadly effects of DN6 first hand.

2.title: FR - Doctor Who - S02E03 - Crisis
2.plot: The Doctor and his friends face a race against time to expose Forrester's plans and return to normal size before Barbara succumbs to the effects of DN6.

2.title: FR - Doctor Who - S02E04 - World's End
2.plot: Ian and Barbara believe the TARDIS has finally returned to their contemporary London, but soon discover signs of plague and warfare. Their old enemies, the Daleks, have invaded the Earth of the 22nd century. Separated and fighting for their lives, the travellers must try to aid the remaining humans and overthrow the Daleks' cruel tyranny. (Originally broadcast in six parts.)

2.title: FR - Doctor Who - S02E05 - The Daleks
2.plot: The Doctor and Ian are taken to the Dalek saucer while Susan and Barbara join the rebels in planning an attack.

2.title: FR - Doctor Who - S02E06 - Day of Reckoning
2.plot: The Doctor manages to escape from the Dalek saucer and meet up with Susan and David but Ian is left trapped onboard. Meanwhile, Barbara and her new friends face a dangerous journey across London.

2.title: FR - Doctor Who - S02E07 - The End of Tomorrow
2.plot: While Susan and David try to find a way out of London, Ian and Larry infiltrate the Dalek mine workings.

2.title: FR - Doctor Who - S02E08 - The Waking Ally
2.plot: The Doctor's party investigate the Daleks' central control in Bedfordshire while Barbara and Jenny's attempt to reach it are derailed when they are betrayed.

2.title: FR - Doctor Who - S02E09 - Flashpoint
2.plot: The Daleks' plan to transform Earth into a giant spaceship and wipe out its inhabitants is nearing completion and the Doctor and his friends face a race against time to prevent them from destroying the planet's core.

2.title: FR - Doctor Who - S02E10 - The Powerful Enemy
2.plot: On the planet Dido, the monstrous Koquillion terrorizes Bennett and Vicki, the only survivors of a crashed spaceship. When the TARDIS lands, the Doctor, Ian, and Barbara team up with Vicki to discover what Koquillion is hiding. (Originally broadcast in two parts.)

2.title: FR - Doctor Who - S02E11 - Desperate Measures
2.plot: The Doctor and Ian reach the crashed spaceship and meet up with Barbara and Vicki, where the Doctor uncovers the truth about Koquillion.

2.title: FR - Doctor Who - S02E12 - The Slave Traders
2.plot: The travellers decide to take a holiday near ancient Rome, but after a month the Doctor gets restless. He and Vicki determine to visit Rome, and while they are gone Ian and Barbara are abducted by slave traders. All roads lead to Rome, however, and the travellers find themselves at the mercy of the country's petulant emperor, Nero... (Originally broadcast in four parts.)

2.title: FR - Doctor Who - S02E13 - All Roads Lead to Rome
2.plot: While the Doctor and Vicki meet with Nero, Barbara is taken to Rome to be sold while Ian is forced to work as a galley slave.

3.title: FR - Doctor Who - S03E01 - Four Hundred Dawns
3.plot: After an encounter with a hostile robot called a Chumblie, the Doctor and his companions are rescued by a group of female Drahvins.

3.title: FR - Doctor Who - S03E02 - Trap of Steel
3.plot: With the knowledge that the planet will be destroyed in two days, the Drahvins instruct the Doctor to help them steal the Rills' ship.

3.title: FR - Doctor Who - S03E03 - Air Lock
3.plot: The Doctor and Vicki encounter the Rills and learn the situation is more complex than they thought while Steven finds the Drahvins' hospitality ever more perilous.

3.title: FR - Doctor Who - S03E04 - The Exploding Planet
3.plot: The Doctor and Vicki enlist the aid of the Chumblies to rescue Steven from the Drahvins and then find a way off the planet before its destruction.

3.title: FR - Doctor Who - S03E05 - Mission to the Unknown
3.plot: Whilst The Doctor, Steven and Vicki are traveling to their next destination. On the planet Kembel, Marc Cory, a Space Security Service agent discovers The Daleks are attending a secret meeting with their allies. Where Cory discovers the Dalek's evil plan, which sets the stage for the epic 12-part adventure "The Dalek Master Plan".

3.title: FR - Doctor Who - S03E06 - Temple of Secrets
3.plot: The TARDIS lands in the middle of the Trojan War, where the Doctor is mistaken for the god Zeus.

3.title: FR - Doctor Who - S03E07 - Small Prophet, Quick Return
3.plot: While Odysseus forces the Doctor to find a way to win the war, Steven decides to get himself taken prisoner in order to enter Troy and find Vicki and the TARDIS.

3.title: FR - Doctor Who - S03E08 - Death of a Spy
3.plot: With Steven and Vicki being held prisoner by the Trojans, the Doctor's only hope of seeing them again is to suggest the idea of the Trojan Horse.

3.title: FR - Doctor Who - S03E09 - Horse of Destruction
3.plot: The Doctor waits inside the Trojan Horse for a chance to reach his companions but Steven's assumed identity as a Greek soldier and Vicki's growing feelings for Troilus endanger their escape.

3.title: FR - Doctor Who - S03E10 - The Nightmare Begins
3.plot: The Doctor runs afoul of the Daleks and Special Security Agent Bret Vyon on the planet Kembel.

3.title: FR - Doctor Who - S03E11 - Day of Armageddon
3.plot: The Doctor infiltrates the Daleks' conference to try and discover their plans, leaving Steven, Katarina and Bret to find a way off the planet.

3.title: FR - Doctor Who - S03E12 - Devil's Planet
3.plot: The Doctor and his friends escape Kembel in the Spar ship but the Daleks force them down on the planet Desperus, where they are threatened by a group of convicts.

3.title: FR - Doctor Who - S03E13 - The Traitors
3.plot: With Katarina being held hostage, the Doctor, Steven and Bret are in danger of having to given in to Kirksen's demands, while, on Earth, Chen has them listed as traitors.

4.title: FR - Doctor Who - S04E01 - The Smugglers (1)
4.plot: The Doctor discovers Polly and Ben aboard the TARDIS shortly before the ship arrives in 17th century Cornwall, where the local churchwarden gives the Doctor a cryptic message shortly before being murdered.

4.title: FR - Doctor Who - S04E02 - The Smugglers (2)
4.plot: Pike is convinced that the Doctor knows the location of Avery's treasure while Polly and Ben try to convince the locals they were not responsible for Longfoot's murder.

4.title: FR - Doctor Who - S04E03 - The Smugglers (3)
4.plot: Polly and Ben are placed in the custody of Blake, who reveals he also has his suspicions about the Squire, while the Doctor and Kewper are forced to team up to escape from Pike's ship.

4.title: FR - Doctor Who - S04E04 - The Smugglers (4)
4.plot: The Doctor and his friends are at the mercy of Cherub, who is now seeking Avery's treasure for himself, while Pike prepares to attack the village.

4.title: FR - Doctor Who - S04E05 - The Tenth Planet (1)
4.plot: In 1986 a new planet appears in the Solar System which turns out to be a long-lost twin of Earth's named Mondas. Its inhabitants are the Cybermen.

4.title: FR - Doctor Who - S04E06 - The Tenth Planet (2)
4.plot: The Doctor's warnings are ignored and the Cybermen take over the base, hampering the crew's efforts to help Zeus IV.

4.title: FR - Doctor Who - S04E07 - The Tenth Planet (3)
4.plot: With the Doctor out of action, it is up to Polly, Ben and Barclay to stop Cutler using the Z-Bomb and devastating half the world.

4.title: FR - Doctor Who - S04E08 - The Tenth Planet (4)
4.plot: The Cybermen take over the base again, apparently to stop the humans using the Z-Bomb, but then the Doctor realises they intend to use it themselves to destroy Earth.

4.title: FR - Doctor Who - S04E09 - The Power of the Daleks (1)
4.plot: The TARDIS arrives on the Earth colony of Vulcan where the newly-regenerated Doctor assumes the identity of an Earth Examiner.

4.title: FR - Doctor Who - S04E10 - The Power of the Daleks (2)
4.plot: While the Doctor worries about the inert Daleks in the capsules, Lesterson makes plan to reactivate one of them.

4.title: FR - Doctor Who - S04E11 - The Power of the Daleks (3)
4.plot: The Doctor fails to convince the colonists of the danger posed by the Daleks and soon the other two are also reactivated.

4.title: FR - Doctor Who - S04E12 - The Power of the Daleks (4)
4.plot: With Polly being held prisoner by the rebels, the Doctor and Ben decide to investigate them, while Lesterson discovers the Daleks are reproducing.

4.title: FR - Doctor Who - S04E13 - The Power of the Daleks (5)
4.plot: The Doctor and Quinn attempt to escape in order to stop Bragen using the Daleks to take over the colony.

5.title: FR - Doctor Who - S05E01 - The Tomb of the Cybermen (1)
5.plot: The Doctor, Jamie and Victoria arrive on Telos, where an archaeological group are exploring the Tomb of the Cybermen. But are the Cybermen as dormant as they believe?

5.title: FR - Doctor Who - S05E02 - The Tomb of the Cybermen (2)
5.plot: The archaeologists learn they are stranded on Telos and Klieg suggests they use the opportunity to explore the Cybermen's tombs.

5.title: FR - Doctor Who - S05E03 - The Tomb of the Cybermen (3)
5.plot: The Cybermen have been revived and plan to convert the archeologists into their own kind, prompting Hopper to attempt a rescue.

5.title: FR - Doctor Who - S05E04 - The Tomb of the Cybermen (4)
5.plot: Klieg attempts to do a deal with the Cybercontroller while the Doctor tries to find a way to refreeze the Cybermen permanently.

5.title: FR - Doctor Who - S05E05 - The Abominable Snowmen (1)
5.plot: When the TARDIS materialises in the Himalayas, the Doctor decides to pay a return visit to the nearby Det-Sen monastery only to be accused of murder.

5.title: FR - Doctor Who - S05E06 - The Abominable Snowmen (2)
5.plot: Jamie and Victoria make their way to the monastery shortly before it is attacked by the Yeti.

5.title: FR - Doctor Who - S05E07 - The Abominable Snowmen (3)
5.plot: While the Doctor and Jamie return to the TARDIS for equipment, the control sphere Jamie brought to the monastery is reactivated.

5.title: FR - Doctor Who - S05E08 - The Abominable Snowmen (4)
5.plot: The Yeti escapes from the monastery and Victoria and Thonmi are accused of assisting it, while the Doctor and Jamie endure a perilous journey back across the mountains.

5.title: FR - Doctor Who - S05E09 - The Abominable Snowmen (5)
5.plot: Victoria falls under the mental influence of Padmasambhva as the Yeti attack in order to drive the monks from the area.

5.title: FR - Doctor Who - S05E10 - The Abominable Snowmen (6)
5.plot: With the Great Intelligence on the verge of becoming corporeal, the Doctor challenges Padmasambhva to a mental battle in order to defeat it.

5.title: FR - Doctor Who - S05E11 - The Ice Warriors (1)
5.plot: The Doctor, Jamie and Victoria are brought to a base which is attempting to halt the flow of the Second Ice Age.

5.title: FR - Doctor Who - S05E12 - The Ice Warriors (2)
5.plot: Varga revives and takes Victoria hostage as he works to revive his crew while the Doctor and Jamie find Penley stealing medical supplies.

5.title: FR - Doctor Who - S05E13 - The Ice Warriors (3)
5.plot: Jamie and Arden venture out to rescue Victoria only to find the rest of the Ice Warriors are now active.

6.title: FR - Doctor Who - S06E01 - The Dominators (1)
6.plot: The TARDIS arrives on the planet Dulkis where the Doctor, Zoe and Jamie decide to have a quiet holiday. Only to find the Evil Dominators and their robotic slaves, The Quarks have arrived on a radioactive island, where they plan to detonate a bomb in the planet's core, which will turn the entire planet as source of radioactive fuel for their invasion fleet.

6.title: FR - Doctor Who - S06E02 - The Dominators (2)
6.plot: The Doctor and Jamie are captured by the Dominators, who subject them to an intelligence test, while Zoe and Cully attempt to convince the Dulcian council of the threat.

6.title: FR - Doctor Who - S06E03 - The Dominators (3)
6.plot: Zoe and Cully are captured by the Dominators and put to work alongside the survey team while the Doctor and Jamie decide to return to the island to help.

6.title: FR - Doctor Who - S06E04 - The Dominators (4)
6.plot: The Doctor and Zoe are interrogated by Rago, who is planning to present his terms to the Dulcian council, while Jamie and Cully try to find a way to strike back against the Quarks.

6.title: FR - Doctor Who - S06E05 - The Dominators (5)
6.plot: Jamie and Cully manage to rescue the Doctor's party and together they try to find a way to stop the Dominators before they destroy the entire planet.

6.title: FR - Doctor Who - S06E06 - The Mind Robber (1)
6.plot: The TARDIS arrives in a white void, having made an emergency take-off to escape the volcanic eruption on Dulkis. The Doctor, Jamie and Zoe find themselves in the Land of Fiction, where characters from the imagination come to life, and The Master, the mysterious ruler, chooses the Doctor to take his place.

6.title: FR - Doctor Who - S06E07 - The Mind Robber (2)
6.plot: With the TARDIS destroyed, the Doctor, Jamie and Zoe find themselves in a strange forest patrolled by mysterious soldiers.

6.title: FR - Doctor Who - S06E08 - The Mind Robber (3)
6.plot: The Doctor realises that the travellers are trapped in a world where fiction is real and where creatures are a threat if people believe in them.

6.title: FR - Doctor Who - S06E09 - The Mind Robber (4)
6.plot: The Doctor, Jamie and Zoe reach the citadel at the centre of the land, where they finally encounter the Master of the Land of Fiction.

6.title: FR - Doctor Who - S06E10 - The Mind Robber (5)
6.plot: With Jamie and Zoe having been turned into fiction, the Doctor must find a way to save them without suffering the same fate or becoming part of the Master Brain.

6.title: FR - Doctor Who - S06E11 - The Invasion (1)
6.plot: The Doctor and the newly formed UNIT must stop a Cybermen Invasion and a Sinister Industrialist in league with them

6.title: FR - Doctor Who - S06E12 - The Invasion (2)
6.plot: The Doctor and Jamie are taken prisoner by their mysterious observers and have a reunion with an old friend while Zoe and Isobel carry out their own investigation of IE.

6.title: FR - Doctor Who - S06E13 - The Invasion (3)
6.plot: The Doctor and Jamie return to the IE factory in search of Zoe and Isobel, where they meet with Professor Watkins and fall foul of Vaughn.

7.title: FR - Doctor Who - S07E01 - Spearhead from Space (1)
7.plot: As the newly-regenerated Doctor arrives on Earth, so does the Nestene too.

7.title: FR - Doctor Who - S07E02 - Spearhead from Space (2)
7.plot: UNIT's attempts to locate the meteorites are hampered by the mysterious plastic Autons, being constructed by Channing at a nearby factory, while the Doctor makes another attempt to escape from the hospital.

7.title: FR - Doctor Who - S07E03 - Spearhead from Space (3)
7.plot: Ransome manages to escape from the plastics factory and alert UNIT, prompting the Doctor and the Brigadier to start an investigation.

7.title: FR - Doctor Who - S07E04 - Spearhead from Space (4)
7.plot: With UNIT's investigation being blocked by the Replica of Scobie, the Doctor and Liz visit Madame Tussaud's to try and find out more as Channing prepares to activate the Autons.

7.title: FR - Doctor Who - S07E05 - Doctor Who and the Silurians (1)
7.plot: The Doctor and Liz are summoned to the Wenley Moor Research Centre by the Brigadier, after several staff members suffer nervous breakdowns.

7.title: FR - Doctor Who - S07E06 - Doctor Who and the Silurians (2)
7.plot: The Doctor attempts to convince people there are monsters in the caves, prompting Major Baker to start shooting at a reptile man.

7.title: FR - Doctor Who - S07E07 - Doctor Who and the Silurians (3)
7.plot: The Silurians contact Quinn for help in retrieving the creature while the Doctor and the Brigadier organise a search of the moors.

7.title: FR - Doctor Who - S07E08 - Doctor Who and the Silurians (4)
7.plot: With Quinn dead, the Brigadier decides to take an armed party into the caves, prompting the Doctor to contact the Silurians himself.

7.title: FR - Doctor Who - S07E09 - Doctor Who and the Silurians (5)
7.plot: Worried about the Old Silurian's growing friendship with the Doctor, the Young Silurian has the scientist infect Baker with a virus and then release him.

7.title: FR - Doctor Who - S07E10 - Doctor Who and the Silurians (6)
7.plot: While the Doctor and Liz try to find a cure to the virus spread by Baker, the Young Silurian kills the Old Silurian and takes control of his people.

7.title: FR - Doctor Who - S07E11 - Doctor Who and the Silurians (7)
7.plot: While Liz distributes the cure to the virus, the Doctor discovers the Silurians now plan to wipe out humanity by destroying the Van Allen Belt.

7.title: FR - Doctor Who - S07E12 - The Ambassadors of Death (1)
7.plot: While the Brigadier investigates a loss of contact with Mars Probe 7, the Doctor realises signals coming from the probe are of extra-terrestrial origin.

7.title: FR - Doctor Who - S07E13 - The Ambassadors of Death (2)
7.plot: UNIT retrieve the returned Recovery 7 but then Carrington hijacks it while the Doctor and Liz try to decode the signal he sent.

8.title: FR - Doctor Who - S08E01 - Terror of the Autons (1)
8.plot: When a Nestene Energy Unit is stolen and a radio telescope sabotaged, the Doctor is contacted by a Time Lord who tells him his old rival the Master is responsible.

8.title: FR - Doctor Who - S08E02 - Terror of the Autons (2)
8.plot: Attempting to find out where Jo encountered the Master, the Doctor heads to the circus where he falls foul of Rossini.

8.title: FR - Doctor Who - S08E03 - Terror of the Autons (3)
8.plot: The Doctor and the Brigadier head to Farrel's factory but the Master and the Autons have already left and are distributing plastic daffodils around the country.

8.title: FR - Doctor Who - S08E04 - Terror of the Autons (4)
8.plot: The Doctor discovers the plastic daffodils are designed to fire a spray that asphyxiates people, causing havoc prior to the Nestene's arrival, but before he can alert anyone he and Jo are captured by the Master.

8.title: FR - Doctor Who - S08E05 - The Mind of Evil (1)
8.plot: The Doctor and Jo head to Stangmoor Prison to investigate the Keller Machine, which drains the evil impulses from prisoners' minds, while UNIT are handling security at the first world peace conference.

8.title: FR - Doctor Who - S08E06 - The Mind of Evil (2)
8.plot: The Doctor is recalled by UNIT to help investigate Cheng-Tiek's murder but is unaware that Chin-Lee is under the control of the Master.

8.title: FR - Doctor Who - S08E07 - The Mind of Evil (3)
8.plot: Realising Chin-Lee has been using the power of the Keller Machine to carry out assassinations, the Doctor heads back to Stangmoor, only to find the Master has teamed up with Mailer to stage another riot.

8.title: FR - Doctor Who - S08E08 - The Mind of Evil (4)
8.plot: With the Doctor and Jo being held prisoner, the Master convinces Mailer to help him steal the Thunderbolt.

8.title: FR - Doctor Who - S08E09 - The Mind of Evil (5)
8.plot: The Doctor is forced to help the Master control the mind parasite while Yates finds out where the Thunderbolt has been taken only to be captured by the Master's men.

8.title: FR - Doctor Who - S08E10 - The Mind of Evil (6)
8.plot: The Brigadier has recaptured Stangmoor but the Master still has control of the Thunderbolt and the Doctor must find a way to stop him and destroy the Keller Machine.

8.title: FR - Doctor Who - S08E11 - The Claws of Axos (1)
8.plot: When a mysterious object lands near the Nuton power complex, UNIT investigate and encounter the Axons, a group of aliens who offer the mineral axonite, which can duplicate matter, as a gift.

8.title: FR - Doctor Who - S08E12 - The Claws of Axos (2)
8.plot: The Doctor and Winser begin to analyse axonite while Chinn plots to secure its use exclusively for Britain.

9.title: FR - Doctor Who - S09E01 - Day of the Daleks (1)
9.plot: When someone tries to assassinate diplomat Sir Reginald Styles, UNIT investigate the possibility his attacker came from the future.

9.title: FR - Doctor Who - S09E02 - Day of the Daleks (2)
9.plot: Jo uses the guerrillas' time machine to travel to the 22nd century where the Controller tricks her into telling the Daleks where she's come from.

9.title: FR - Doctor Who - S09E03 - Day of the Daleks (3)
9.plot: The Doctor forces the guerrillas to take him to the 22nd century where he is soon captured by the Controller.

9.title: FR - Doctor Who - S09E04 - Day of the Daleks (4)
9.plot: The guerrillas infiltrate the Daleks' base to rescue the Doctor and Jo and ask them to return to their own time and alter history before the 20th century is plunged into a Third World War.

9.title: FR - Doctor Who - S09E05 - The Curse of Peladon (1)
9.plot: The Doctor and Jo arrive on the medieval planet Peladon, where the Doctor is mistaken for the Earth Delegate of the Galactic Federation and Jo is mistaken for a princess.

9.title: FR - Doctor Who - S09E06 - The Curse of Peladon (2)
9.plot: The Doctor is convinced the Ice Warriors are trying to sabotage the conference but his attempts to prove it see him accused of sacrilege.

9.title: FR - Doctor Who - S09E07 - The Curse of Peladon (3)
9.plot: The Doctor is sentenced to fight Grun to the death and his attempt to escape leads to an encounter with Aggedor.

9.title: FR - Doctor Who - S09E08 - The Curse of Peladon (4)
9.plot: Hepesh's plan has been exposed but he is still determined to prevent Peladon joining the Galactic Federation by leading a rebellion against the King.

9.title: FR - Doctor Who - S09E09 - The Sea Devils (1)
9.plot: The Doctor and Jo visit the Master at his island prison where the Doctor becomes curious about a number of ships sinking in the area.

9.title: FR - Doctor Who - S09E10 - The Sea Devils (2)
9.plot: The Doctor and Jo are trapped on the fort by a Sea Devil while the Master convinces Trenchard to help him steal some electronic components.

9.title: FR - Doctor Who - S09E11 - The Sea Devils (3)
9.plot: The Doctor is held prisoner by Trenchard while the Master attempts to contact the Sea Devils.

9.title: FR - Doctor Who - S09E12 - The Sea Devils (4)
9.plot: The Sea Devils attack the island prison and rescue the Master, prompting the Doctor to venture underwater to try and contact them.

9.title: FR - Doctor Who - S09E13 - The Sea Devils (5)
9.plot: The Doctor is taken to the Sea Devils' underwater colony where he tries to make peace with the creatures, only for the navy to attack the base.

10.title: FR - Doctor Who - S10E01 - The Three Doctors (1)
10.plot: England, the near future. A strange anti-matter creature arrives on Earth and attacks UNIT HQ. It seems to be specifically seeking the Doctor out - but why? With the Time Lords themselves unable to help, it seems the only person who can help the Doctor is himself - or selves...

10.title: FR - Doctor Who - S10E02 - The Three Doctors (2)
10.plot: The third Doctor and Jo find themselves on an artificial world inside the black hole while the second Doctor tries to find a way to control the organism.

10.title: FR - Doctor Who - S10E03 - The Three Doctors (3)
10.plot: The Time Lord Omega reveals himself to the third Doctor along with plans for vengeance against his own kind.

10.title: FR - Doctor Who - S10E04 - The Three Doctors (4)
10.plot: Omega reveals the purpose behind bringing the Doctor to his antimatter world, but the Doctor(s) discover a startling fact about Omega that he didn't know himself and eventually strike a bargain.

10.title: FR - Doctor Who - S10E05 - Carnival of Monsters (1)
10.plot: The Doctor attempts to test his new dematerialisation circuit by taking Jo to Metebelis Three but instead the TARDIS arrives in the hold of a 1920s cargo ship.

10.title: FR - Doctor Who - S10E06 - Carnival of Monsters (2)
10.plot: The Doctor and Jo attempt to find a way out of the Scope but, when Vorg attempts to entertain the Minorans, the crew of the Bernice suddenly become a lot more dangerous.

10.title: FR - Doctor Who - S10E07 - Carnival of Monsters (3)
10.plot: The Doctor and Jo return to the Bernice to try and aid their escape but find themselves pursued by the Drashigs.

10.title: FR - Doctor Who - S10E08 - Carnival of Monsters (4)
10.plot: The Doctor escapes from the Scope and joins forces with Vorg to try and save its inhabitants but Kalik is still determined to use the Drashigs to start a rebellion.

10.title: FR - Doctor Who - S10E09 - Frontier in Space (1)
10.plot: The Doctor and Jo land on a spaceship in the far future as it is attacked by Ogrons, which the human crew see as Draconians. The Doctor and Jo are taken to Earth as spies.

10.title: FR - Doctor Who - S10E10 - Frontier in Space (2)
10.plot: The Doctor and Jo are taken to Earth, where both humans and Draconians believe them to be a spy for the other side.

10.title: FR - Doctor Who - S10E11 - Frontier in Space (3)
10.plot: The Doctor is sentenced to life imprisonment at a lunar penal colony while Jo encounters an old enemy.

10.title: FR - Doctor Who - S10E12 - Frontier in Space (4)
10.plot: The Master rescues the Doctor from the lunar penal colony, aiming to take him and Jo to the Ogrons' planet, and the Doctor's attempt to escape leaves him stranded in space.

11.title: FR - Doctor Who - S11E01 - The Time Warrior (1)
11.plot: England, the 12th century. Robber baron Irongron is recruited by Linx, a Sontaran warrior whose starship has been forced down on Earth. Linx is forced to use a time-travel device to steal resources and scientists from the future to repair his ship, but in doing so involves UNIT and the Doctor...

11.title: FR - Doctor Who - S11E02 - The Time Warrior (2)
11.plot: The Doctor tracks the missing scientists to Irongron's castle, where Linx is using them to repair his spaceship and construct advanced weapons for Irongron.

11.title: FR - Doctor Who - S11E03 - The Time Warrior (3)
11.plot: The Doctor escapes the castle with Sarah and Hal and must persuade Sir Edward to trust him before Irongron launches an attack on them.

11.title: FR - Doctor Who - S11E04 - The Time Warrior (4)
11.plot: The Doctor attempts to return the scientists to their own time, before Linx tries to use his spaceship and destroys the entire castle.

11.title: FR - Doctor Who - S11E05 - Invasion (1)
11.plot: The Doctor and Sarah return to London in the present day only to find the city strangely deserted, while nearby UNIT are dealing with a series of monster appearances.

11.title: FR - Doctor Who - S11E06 - Invasion of the Dinosaurs (2)
11.plot: The Doctor attempts to solve the mystery of the monster invasion. His first move - the capture of a dinosaur.

11.title: FR - Doctor Who - S11E07 - Invasion of the Dinosaurs (3)
11.plot: Yates sabotages the Doctor's equipment to stop him finding the location of Whitaker's base but then the tyrannosaur escapes, placing Sarah in danger.

11.title: FR - Doctor Who - S11E08 - Invasion of the Dinosaurs (4)
11.plot: Sarah attempts to find a way off the spaceship while the Doctor tries to track down the source of the time displacements.

11.title: FR - Doctor Who - S11E09 - Invasion of the Dinosaurs (5)
11.plot: The Doctor has been framed as the monster maker by Finch and is on the run from the army, while Sarah attempts to alert UNIT to what Grover is up to.

11.title: FR - Doctor Who - S11E10 - Invasion of the Dinosaurs (6)
11.plot: The Doctor is rescued from Finch by the Brigadier and Benton and tries to persuade them to stop Grover before millions of people are erased from history.

12.title: FR - Doctor Who - S12E01 - Robot (1)
12.plot: Can the Doctor, now in his fourth incarnation, recover from his post regenerative trauma to save the Earth from Think Tank and their plot for world domination ?

12.title: FR - Doctor Who - S12E02 - Robot (2)
12.plot: The Doctor and Sarah Jane become convinced Think Tank are behind the electronic component thefts but are unable to stop them carrying out another raid.

12.title: FR - Doctor Who - S12E03 - Robot (3)
12.plot: Sarah Jane and Kettlewell infiltrate an SRS meeting to try and find out what Miss Winters is up to but there is a surprise in store.

12.title: FR - Doctor Who - S12E04 - Robot (4)
12.plot: UNIT attempt to get into the bunker to stop Miss Winters setting off the world's nuclear missiles but first they have to get past the K1.

12.title: FR - Doctor Who - S12E05 - The Ark in Space (1)
12.plot: The Doctor's attempt to give Harry a trip in the TARDIS sees the two of them and Sarah Jane arriving onboard a space station in the far future, with some rather deadly security mechanisms.

12.title: FR - Doctor Who - S12E06 - The Ark in Space (2)
12.plot: The Doctor and Harry revive the Ark's medtech, Vira, to help Sarah Jane. But when station commander Noah is revived, he becomes suspicious of the newcomers.

12.title: FR - Doctor Who - S12E07 - The Ark in Space (3)
12.plot: Knowing that Noah has been infected by the Wirrn, the Doctor persuades Vira to halt the reviving of her people, knowing it will place them in danger as well.

12.title: FR - Doctor Who - S12E08 - The Ark in Space (4)
12.plot: The Doctor tries to protect the humans still in cryogenic suspension from the Wirrn, who are determined to use Earth as their new breeding ground.

12.title: FR - Doctor Who - S12E09 - The Sontaran Experiment (1)
12.plot: The Doctor, Sarah Jane and Harry teleport to Earth to ensure the planet is safe for the survivors on board Nerva Beacon to return and reinhabit their world. A Sontaran named Styre has captured a group of humans and is conducting experiments on them to discover the human body's weaknesses, as part of the Sontaran's goal for domination of the galaxy.

12.title: FR - Doctor Who - S12E10 - The Sontaran Experiment (2)
12.plot: The Doctor learns that Styre has been experimenting on the Galsec crewmembers to pave the way for a Sontaran invasion of Earth and decides the only way to halt his plans is to challenge him to a duel.

seasonsMeta.name: The Trial of a Time Lord

meta.plot: As a cultivation genius who has achieved a new realm every two years since he was a year old, Wang Ling is a near-invincible existence with prowess far beyond his control. But now that he’s sixteen, he faces his greatest battle yet – Senior High School. With one challenge after another popping up, his plans for a low-key high school life seem further and further away…

1.title: EN - The Daily Life of the Immortal King [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Wang Ling's Triple Kill of Tuntian-ha
1.plot: Wang Ling is  rookie at the Songhai School. With only 5 points of spiritual strength, he will have to face some problems.

1.title: EN - The Daily Life of the Immortal King [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - A Fair and Just Class President Election
1.plot: Sun Rong and Chen Chao compete for the position of student president of the elite class. Will Sun Rong be able to pull it off with an enchantment?

1.title: EN - The Daily Life of the Immortal King [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - How to Make an Origin Fostering Pill
1.plot: In  the elite class, students learn how to make vitality pulls. Although the others use wacky ovens or cauldrons, Wang Ling decides to use a microwave.

1.title: EN - The Daily Life of the Immortal King [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - What Should I Do When the Goddess Forces Me on a Date
1.plot: Sun Rong asks Wang Ling out on a special date. But what she doesn't know is that two killers will try to spoil her fun.

1.title: EN - The Daily Life of the Immortal King [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Three Brothers of Shadow Stream
1.plot: The killers return to attack the school. But this time the school is prepared to face any threat. However, the attack of the three brothers is too powerful.

1.title: EN - The Daily Life of the Immortal King [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - B++ is the Best Language in the World
1.plot: Wang Ling comes out first in the national power test and decides to infiltrate the system to change his score.

1.title: EN - The Daily Life of the Immortal King [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - 18 Tips for Maintaining a Spiritual Sword
1.plot: Wang Ling will participate in the interschool sword competition with his friends against his rival, the 59th school.

1.title: EN - The Daily Life of the Immortal King [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Like Master, Like Sword
1.plot: Wang Ling doesn't want to participate in the competition and looks for the perfect moment to pretend to feel bad. When his amulet is about to break, Wang Ling's health is in danger of seriously deteriorating.

1.title: EN - The Daily Life of the Immortal King [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Master of the Shadow Stream
1.plot: Wang Ling needs his father to come to his aid or disaster is imminent. While he waits, Wang Ling runs into a dangerous female leader in the halls of School 59.

1.title: EN - The Daily Life of the Immortal King [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Drive! Drive! Drive!
1.plot: The amulet is broken and now Wang Ling must control his emotions on his own. Meanwhile, Sun Rong is ready to help her most important friend.

1.title: EN - The Daily Life of the Immortal King [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - The Aohai Rondo
1.plot: Wang Ling tries to keep a low profile now that his amulet is broken. At the Water Alter, Sun Rong confronts Tang Jingze.

1.title: EN - The Daily Life of the Immortal King [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - A Dog is a Man's Best Friend
1.plot: As Wang Ling begins to lose control, Toad jumps on top of him and absorbs his negative energy. At that moment, something amazing happens that gives Wang Ling the ability to use his strength without restraint from him.

1.title: EN - The Daily Life of the Immortal King [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - Let Us Burn!!
1.plot: Tang Jingze's spirit sword engages Sun Rong and destroys his weapon. Wang Ling's father implores them to stop the competition before someone gets hurt.

1.title: EN - The Daily Life of the Immortal King [MULTI-SUB] - S01E14 - Accident
1.plot: The competition comes to an end. The leader of the League of Shadows attacks and Wang Ling finally loses control.

1.title: EN - The Daily Life of the Immortal King [MULTI-SUB] - S01E15 - Helplessness of the Immortal King
1.plot: Wang Ling quickly realizes his mistake: not having stopped the leader of the League of Shadows sooner, so he decides to take the risk once more.

meta.plot: Kyotaro Ichikawa, a boy barely clinging to the bottom rung of his school's social ladder, secretly believes he’s the tortured lead in some psychological thriller. He spends his days dreaming up ways to disrupt his classmates' peaceful lives and pining after Anna Yamada, the class idol. But Kyotaro's not nearly the troubled teen he pretends to be…and it turns out Anna's a bit odd herself!

1.title: EN - The Dangers in My Heart [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - I Was Stolen Away
1.plot: At first glance, he’s just the disturbed boy, and she’s just the popular girl. But people are more than the sum of their parts, as both Kyotaro and Anna are about to discover.

1.title: EN - The Dangers in My Heart [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - I Died
1.plot: Despite his misgivings, Kyotaro keeps helping Anna the more they interact. He may be a better person than he believes.

1.title: EN - The Dangers in My Heart [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - I Want to Hug You
1.plot: Anna and her friends keep their guard up around the boys; it’s obvious what they want. But Kyotaro’s different. Each brief interaction brings him and Anna closer together.

1.title: EN - The Dangers in My Heart [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - I Have a Problem
1.plot: Like many people his own age, Kyotaro has a tendency to overthink everything. Anna, however? She has her own way of approaching life.

1.title: EN - The Dangers in My Heart [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - We Got Split Up
1.plot: It’s not like Kyotaro wants to join Anna’s group or anything. But when a certain other classmate tries to join the group, Kyotaro just gets swept up in events. That’s all!

1.title: EN - The Dangers in My Heart [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - I Melted It
1.plot: As Kyotaro wrestles with his feelings, he notices Anna’s been acting differently. Could it be that she—? No, he shouldn’t read too much into it. She’s just being nice. Right?

1.title: EN - The Dangers in My Heart [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - We Swapped Places
1.plot: Kyotaro can no longer deny he likes Anna. He tells himself it’s not like he wants to be her boyfriend, but there’s a detail he hasn’t considered: maybe Anna wants him to be.

1.title: EN - The Dangers in My Heart [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - I Had a Dream
1.plot: Parent-teacher day mortifies Kyotaro. Not only is his mother at school, but she’s bonding with Anna! Things couldn’t get any worse.

1.title: EN - The Dangers in My Heart [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - I Hate Yamada
1.plot: Despite all the hints Anna throws at him, and others beginning to notice, Kyotaro refuses to believe that she could actually like him. He is his own worst enemy.

1.title: EN - The Dangers in My Heart [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - We Walked Slowly
1.plot: It’s Japan’s most romantic time of the year, and Kyotaro and Anna are not-on-a-date. Kyotaro is keeping a running tally of all his screw-ups, but Anna is enjoying herself.

1.title: EN - The Dangers in My Heart [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - We’re a Bit Alike
1.plot: Distance separates Kyotaro and Anna, but their thoughts are of each other. However, their budding relationship faces a threat: Haruya still has his eyes set on Anna.

1.title: EN - The Dangers in My Heart [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - I Wanted to Be Seen
1.plot: Kyotaro didn’t think his cunning plan for New Year’s all the way through. Anna showed up early, and now his sister is trying to be his wingwoman.

meta.plot: Ertuğrul Bey and the Knights Templar in the 13th century Alba and step and step with the struggle against brutal Mongols depicts the process of establishing the Ottoman principality.

1.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Winter approaches Suleyman Shah's camp. On a hunt, Ertugrul rescues prisoners from the Crusaders. Commander Titus and Ustadi Azam build a new army.

1.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Kara Toygar threatens the Kayi camp when Suleyman Shah refuses to turn over the prisoners. Titus learns the excruciating truth about his brother.

1.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: In the search for a new camp, Suleyman sends Ertugrul to Aleppo and fuels fraternal jealously. Kurdogu makes a deal with Kara Toygar.

1.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: On the way to Aleppo, a dangerous enemy crosses paths with Ertugrul. Halime and her family come under attack.

1.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Fate hands Titus a golden chance for revenge, but the timing is not right. Selcan conspires with Gokce to boost their status in the family.

1.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: A premonition saves Ertugrul's life as Titus raises the stakes against him. Ustadi Azam turns up the heat on his rivals.

1.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Suleyman's prayers are answered, but Gundodgu's life hangs by a thread. Kurdoglu puts another plan into action.

1.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: A mysterious messenger puts a damper on the Kayi tribe's festivities. Suleyman presses Halime's father about his true identity.

1.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Episode 9
1.plot: Sensing imminent danger, Sehzade Numan asks Suleyman for a favor. Suleyman shows Kara Toygar that he has the upper hand - but not for long.

1.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Episode 10
1.plot: The prisoner exchange goes awry. At the camp, Hayde stands up to Kurdoglu, who exploits another opportunity to strike against Suleyman.

1.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Episode 11
1.plot: Kurdoglu puts his plan in motion, but Ertugrul is one step ahead of him. Selcan tries to turn the tables in her favor.

1.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Episode 12
1.plot: Kurdoglu intervenes on behalf of Kara Toygar. Selcan's maneuvering pays off, but Gundogdu spoils everything.

1.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - Episode 13
1.plot: On the way to Aleppo, Ertugrul and Halime walk into lion's den. Gundogdu and Kurdoglu have a heated face-off.

1.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S01E14 - Episode 14
1.plot: Ustadi Azam is determined to eliminate anyone who stands in the way of his campaign. Suleyman's greatest threat is close by.

1.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S01E15 - Episode 15
1.plot: Selcan tries to kill two birds with one stone, but her ambition becomes her downfall. With Halime in critical condition, Ertugrul's group splits up.

1.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S01E16 - Episode 16
1.plot: Ustadi Azam uses Ibn Arabi to tighten the screws on Giovanni. An informant pulls the wool over Sahabettin's eyes.

1.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S01E17 - Episode 17
1.plot: Sahabettin falls deeper into love's trap. The Knights Templar's lethal weapon strikes the Kayi tribe on the eve of their migration.

1.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S01E18 - Episode 18
1.plot: Sahabettin is key to Ertugrul's plan, but El Aziz stands in the way. Turgut and Yigit are still missing, but Ertugrul has a more immediate problem.

1.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S01E19 - Episode 19
1.plot: After narrowly escaping a tragic fate, Ertugrul makes a radical plan as time runs out for Sahabettin.

1.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S01E20 - Episode 20
1.plot: With El Aziz unwavering in his decision, Sahabettin prepares to embrace his fate, but a hooded stranger makes a surprise showing.

1.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S01E21 - Episode 21
1.plot: Izadora takes Yigit under her wing, Nasir has El Aziz wrapped around his finger and orders a thorough manhunt to finish what he started.

1.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S01E22 - Episode 22
1.plot: Ertugrul cautions Numan, who puts himself in the firing line at El Aziz's palace. A visitor gives Turgut hope.

1.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S01E23 - Episode 23
1.plot: Deli Demir heads for Aleppo and cannot believe what he sees upon arrival. Ertugrul puts his life on the line to set a trap for Nasir.

1.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S01E24 - Episode 24
1.plot: Titus brushes up against a sworn enemy from the past. During a confrontation with Nasir, Ertugrul faces a difficult choice.

1.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S01E25 - Episode 25
1.plot: Leyla helps Ertugrul at a critical moment, but her absence draws attention. Seeking answers about her family, Izadora makes a deal with Turgut.

1.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S01E26 - Episode 26
1.plot: Ertugrul makes a narrow escape. Nasir has an elaborate plan for Halime, who struggles to make El Aziz see the truth.

2.plot: Aykiz takes matters into her own hands and pays Eftelya a visit. Ustadi Azam goes after a mole on his own turf.

2.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S02E02 - Episode 2
2.plot: Gundogdu and Selcan come to blows over her ambitions. Ertugrul brings pressure to bear on Eftelya, but the tribe needs her alive.

2.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S02E03 - Episode 3
2.plot: To infiltrate the Knights Templar's base, Ertugrul deliberately leaks information. Numan's decision deals a major blow to Halime.

2.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S02E04 - Episode 4
2.plot: Ertugrul captures an important prisoner on the way. Ustadu Azam grooms Yigit for the final stage of his plan.

2.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S02E05 - Episode 5
2.plot: A message arrives at the Kayi camp, and Selcan decides it is time to settle accounts with Suleyman. Marcus falls for the Kayi tribe's ruse.

2.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S02E06 - Episode 6
2.plot: Titus wreaks havoc on the camp. A surprise visitor knocks on Afsin's door, and Numan leaves Ertugrul no choice but to walk away from Halime.

2.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S02E07 - Episode 7
2.plot: As Titu's plan spirals out of control and he and Kurdoglu look for a way out, Sahabettin watches them closely.

2.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S02E08 - Episode 8
2.plot: The Knights Templar's position in Aleppo depends on Eftelya, who tries to turn Ertugrul against Halime.

2.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S02E09 - Episode 9
2.plot: Eftelya decides her own fate. A showdown between Ertugrul and Titus gets interrupted, and Ertugrul questions Kara Toygar's true motives.

2.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S02E10 - Episode 10
2.plot: Nasir oversteps his bounds with El Aziz, and Halime seizes her chance to appeal on behalf of the Kayi tribe.

2.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S02E11 - Episode 11
2.plot: In pitting herself against Selcan, Aykiz plays with fire. Ertugrul rushes to head off the diplomatic mess Nasir created.

2.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S02E12 - Episode 12
2.plot: Selcan falls out of Hayme's favor. Ertugrul walks into an important meeting and exposes a conspiracy against his tribe.

2.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S02E13 - Episode 13
2.plot: El Aziz hands down a harsh sentence to Leyla and Nanny. Ertugrul and Gundogdu return home to a slew of shocking news.

2.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S02E14 - Episode 14
2.plot: News about Halime sends Ertugrul back on the road. Claudius accepts a mission that puts Ibn Arabi in harm's way.

2.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S02E15 - Episode 15
2.plot: Kurdoglu tries to turn Suleyman and Gundogdu against Ertugrul, who negotiates with El Aziz at knife-point.

2.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S02E16 - Episode 16
2.plot: Ustadi Azam loses his grip on Aleppo. At the camp, public opinion is not in Suleyman's favor, and Hayme cracks down on Selcan.

2.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S02E17 - Episode 17
2.plot: Claudiu's mission hits a snag. Hayme discovers that Selcan has a personal vendetta, but Gundogdu stands by Selcan.

2.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S02E18 - Episode 18
2.plot: Gundogdu unwittingly becomes a part of Kurdoglu's scheme. Hayme gives Halime and Gokce a dilemma.

2.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S02E19 - Episode 19
2.plot: Gundogdu squares off with Ertugrul. Selcan stirs the pot at the family meal, where an unexpected guest arrives with distressing news for Halime.

2.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S02E20 - Episode 20
2.plot: Cardinal Thomas and Titus carry out their plan with Turgut, whose decisions spell disaster for Ertugrul.

2.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S02E21 - Episode 21
2.plot: Suleyman meets with the Seijuks, but Ertugrul's return throws the camp into disarray. Halime refuses the Seijuk sultan's offer.

2.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S02E22 - Episode 22
2.plot: With their greatest obstacle out of the way, Ustadi Azam and Kurdoglu advance on their target, but Gundogdu tests Kurdoglu loyalty.

2.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S02E23 - Episode 23
2.plot: A visitor brings news of Turgut to the Kayi camp and puts Kurdoglu in an unfavorable position. A murder plot unravels.

2.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S02E24 - Episode 24
2.plot: Kurdoglu incurs Selcan's wrath. Izadora helps Suleyman connect the dots, and Eftelya gets her hands on an important letter.

2.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S02E25 - Episode 25
2.plot: Ertugrul and Suleyman put Kurdoglu on the stand, but Gundogdu steps in. Thomas tests Ustadi Azam's patience.

2.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S02E26 - Episode 26
2.plot: Turgut is not out of the woods yet. Selcan pulls strings to influence Gundogdu, and Hayme loses control of the situation.

2.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S02E27 - Episode 27
2.plot: Gokce overhears Selcan's secret plan, and Suleyman invites a contest for power that threatens to pit his sons against each other.

2.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S02E28 - Episode 28
2.plot: Gokce sees Selcan's true colors and confronts her. Gundogdu plays into Kurdoglu's hands, but someone more powerful has a hidden plan.

2.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S02E29 - Episode 29
2.plot: Selcan loses favor with Gundogdu as her ambitions get the best of her. Kurdoglu unleashes another weapon to sow chaos in the camp.

2.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S02E30 - Episode 30
2.plot: While Suleyman gives him the benefit of the doubt, Kurdoglu misleads Suleyman's men. Yigit life is in enemy hands.

2.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S02E31 - Episode 31
2.plot: After losing their only witness, Ertugrul and his men are back to square one on the hunt for the traitor, but Izadora gives them another lead.

2.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S02E32 - Episode 32
2.plot: Kurdoglu takes advantage of Ertugrul's absence. When the Knight's Templar outnumber Ertugrul, his wit is the only thing that can save him.

2.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S02E33 - Episode 33
2.plot: Kurdoglu tries to force Selcan's hand and makes Turgut his right-hand man. Ertugrul has valuable information that Ustadi Azam needs.

2.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S02E34 - Episode 34
2.plot: Struggling to keep order among his subjects, Kurdoglu hands down Suleyman's sentence and sets a dangerous trap for him and Hayme.

2.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S02E35 - Episode 35
2.plot: Selcan repents and decides to mend fences with those she has betrayed. Ertugrul meets an unlikely ally.

3.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S03E01 - Episode 1
3.plot: A few years have passed since Ertugrul and his loyalists from the clan have settled right next to the Byzantine Empire. Sultan Aladdin is making Ertugrul work on secret missions. Ertugrul visits Bazaar for a top priority quest

3.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S03E02 - Episode 2
3.plot: The Knights Templar's plan comes apart at the seams, and Izadora pays a price. Claudius causes a rift between Thomas and Ustadi Azam.

3.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S03E03 - Episode 3
3.plot: A confrontation between Ertugrul and Kurdoglu ends in bloodshed. With Ustadi Azam in grave condition, Thomas gains the upper hand.

3.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S03E04 - Episode 4
3.plot: Kurdoglu judgment day arrives, but Thomas still has one advantage over the Kayi tribe. Ibn Arabi convince Selcan to change her ways.

3.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S03E05 - Episode 5
3.plot: Titus is determined to eradicate the Kayi tribe. Claudius brings urgent news to Ertugrul, who plans an offensive campaign into enemy territory.

3.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S03E06 - Episode 6
3.plot: After Deli Demir and Afsin Bey find a way to infiltrate the Knights Templar, the Kayi tribe readies for battle.

3.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S03E07 - Episode 7
3.plot: Ertugurl's army catches the Knights Templar of guard. In a tight spot, Titus suspects there's an informant from within.

3.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S03E08 - Episode 8
3.plot: Under Titu's watch, Omer plays a risky double game. Selcan's sudden realization changes her fate.

3.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S03E09 - Episode 9
3.plot: Omer pays a heavy price for his betrayal. Yigit helps to lead Erttugrul and his army on the road to victory.

3.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S03E10 - Episode 10
3.plot: Turgut gets his sweet revenge. With Titus still a threat to the Kayi tribe, Ertugrul's men set out on a manhunt.

3.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S03E11 - Episode 11
3.plot: Gundogdu responds unexpectedly to Selcan's big news. At the Kayi camp, danger still lingers in the shadows.

3.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S03E12 - Episode 12
3.plot: Selcan atones for her crimes and risks her life for Gundogdu, who confronts a dangerous enemy from the past.

3.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S03E13 - Episode 13
3.plot: Ibn Arabi leaves Ertugrul with a valuable relic. A perilous journey lies ahead for Ertugrul and Suleyman.

3.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S03E14 - Episode 14
3.plot: As Ertugrul consolidates power across Anatolia, Hayme fears that an ominous premonition may come true.

3.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S03E15 - Episode 15
3.plot: As the Kayi tribe struggles with its sudden loss, Hayme calls meeting to form a strategy against new threats.

3.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S03E16 - Episode 16
3.plot: Ertugrul and Halime encounter new enemies, and sudden misfortune befalls the Kayi camp.

3.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S03E17 - Episode 17
3.plot: Ertugrul's fate is uncertain, and the Oguz Turks swear to take revenge, but a shadowy figure watches them.

3.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S03E18 - Episode 18
3.plot: Aytolun has her own ambitions. Gokce overhears Halime break the big news to Hayme.

3.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S03E19 - Episode 19
3.plot: Gundogdu attempts to track down Noyan, while the Kayi tribe mourns two tragic losses.

3.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S03E20 - Episode 20
3.plot: Selcan warns Gundogdu about the alliance, as Aytolun plants ideas in Tugtekin's head. Noyan turns up the heat on Ertugrul.

3.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S03E21 - Episode 21
3.plot: An informant lurks among the Turks, who mobilize for a new campaign. Aytolun sets her plan in motion and inquires after Gokce.

3.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S03E22 - Episode 22
3.plot: The Turks and Mongols play cat and mouse as Gundogdu and Tugtekin attempt to isolate the mole in their group.

3.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S03E23 - Episode 23
3.plot: To solidify the alliance, Korkut Bey makes Hayme an offer. Aytolun learns something new about Gokce that complicates her plan.

3.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S03E24 - Episode 24
3.plot: Hayme's decision threatens to pit Selcan against Aytolun. Ertugrul's disappearance leaves Noyan in a vulnerable position.

3.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S03E25 - Episode 25
3.plot: Gundogdu tries to get behind Noyan's motives, but the Kayi tribe's greatest threat lies within.

3.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S03E26 - Episode 26
3.plot: Tugtekin faces a new competitor and lets his ambitions get the best of him. Tensions escalate between the clans.

3.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S03E27 - Episode 27
3.plot: Aytolun and Tugtekin plot a power grab, and Ertugrul's announcement leads to an important vote in the camp.

3.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S03E28 - Episode 28
3.plot: The vote heightens tensions between the clans and sets Gokce against Halime, as Selcan's warnings fall on deaf ears.

3.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S03E29 - Episode 29
3.plot: Tugtekin becomes fed up with Ertugrul's lingering influence on the camp. Ertugrul makes a separate plan with those still loyal to him.

3.title: EN - Resurrection: Ertugrul [MULTI-SUB] - S03E30 - Episode 30
3.plot: Noyan makes Gundogdu his next target. Kocabas's words instigate a confrontation that changes Ertugrul's place in the camp.
