2.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S02E01 - Secrets, Lies and School Supplies
2.plot: As Abby and the rest of the O’Briens prepare for the town’s annual lantern festival, Trace must return to Nashville to face a mistake from his past. Mick takes his granddaughters back-to-school shopping while covertly working on a business deal that is bound to cause family conflict.

2.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S02E02 - Pasts and Presents
2.plot: Mick makes some unpopular business decisions when he plans to sell the nightclub that he and Trace had built together. When planning her cousin’s wedding goes awry, Jess turns to an unexpected source for help. Bree fights to regain control in the production of her play.

2.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S02E03 - Photographs and Memories
2.plot: As Abby sends her girls off to their first day at a new school, conflict arises between Trace and Wes about their roles in the family—complicated further by a Nashville recording label taking interest in Trace’s new demo with a former flame. Mick butts heads with his brother over family land.

2.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S02E04 - It's Always Nashville
2.plot: Trace hits the road to record an album with his ex-girlfriend but has trouble channeling creative inspiration while he is away from Abby. A well-intentioned Jess creates trouble for Bree when she advertises that a famous author will attend a book reading at Bree’s new bookstore.

2.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S02E05 - Buried Treasures
2.plot: Nell discovers a treasure map that Bree made as a teen, leading Bree and Kevin to hunt for a family time capsule in the backyard. While Trace is in Nashville fighting his producer Mark Hall to keep Leigh on an upcoming album at the risk of his own career, Abby meets a handsome widower in the PTA.

2.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S02E06 - Grand Openings
2.plot: As the nightclub opening nears, Trace spends late nights practicing with Leigh and his band, while Mick fights city hall to receive a live music permit. Abby receives a promotion at work, but it leaves her with less time to spend with the family and Trace.

2.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S02E07 - All Our Yesterdays
2.plot: Mick receives damaging information about Thomas and considers whether to use it in their town hall debate over the family land trust. Jess plans a special meal to win David over but is fearful to take the next step in their relationship.

2.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S02E08 - Forest Through the Trees
2.plot: Away from the distraction of technology, Abby and Trace talk about their past and the future during a camping getaway. With some encouragement from Nell, Mick and Thomas try to work out their differences in person.

2.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S02E09 - The Royal Court
2.plot: After his band’s video goes viral, Trace receives offers from music executives, but tries to convince his band to give Mark Hall another shot. Abby, Nell and Megan spend some family time together preparing a princess birthday party for Carrie.

2.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S02E10 - Freefall
2.plot: After Mark offers Trace and his band a worldwide tour deal, Trace and Abby worry about how it might impact their future together. As Nell ponders a lost love from her past, Abby, Jess and Bree are faced with the possibility of losing their new loves in the present.

3.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S03E01 - An Open Book
3.plot: Just in time for the Chesapeake Shores Oyster Festival, Trace returns to Abby after three months on tour, only to discover a family in turmoil: Bree's completed manuscript turns out to be a thinly veiled story of the family, and Mick ends the fight over the family Trust but begins a feud with Connor after a fateful mistake.

3.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S03E02 - The Way We Were
3.plot: With a nod to the past, Nell tries to save the Wish Fountain; Abby discovers a never-opened letter that she sent to Trace; Mick inherits a sailboat and reunites with his brother Thomas; and Bree welcomes an old friend back into her life. After Kevin witnesses a secret hug, Connor's future is thrown and Jess's future beckons with an invitation from everyone's favorite chef.

3.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S03E03 - The Rock is Going to Roll
3.plot: While Jess and Bree in Maine visit David and his fabulously wealthy family, Trace's role in Abby's family is questioned. Meanwhile, everyone helps out running the B&B and Wordplay, and Connor learns the truth about Danielle.

3.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S03E04 - Once Upon Ever After
3.plot: While Jess and Bree discover David's parents' secret plans, Abby joins Trace on tour, realizing that it will be impossible to stay clear of Trace's newfound fame.  Thomas's vow renewal sparks Mick and Megan to re-examine their own relationship, as Connor reconciles with Kevin.

3.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S03E05 - Love Eventually
3.plot: Abby is burdened by continued paparazzi attention from Trace’s growing fame. As he works through his loneliness while on tour away from Abby, Trace writes a song for Abby, which prompts an unexpected reaction from Leigh. Mick tries to repair his relationship with Connor at Megan’s insistence, but their tumultuous history makes Connor reluctant to reconcile. Kevin is concerned when Sarah seeks adventure after a near-death accident at work, noticing similarities between her behavior and his after his wartime injury. Bree edits her novel with Simon’s help, and realizes she and one of her characters share the same drive for self-preservation that stunts their relationships. Meanwhile, Jess fears her relationship with David is over.

3.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S03E06 - Here and There
3.plot: Abby learns her ex-husband is in a serious relationship navigates their new family dynamic. Abby misses Trace by her side as she explores the new co-parenting roles with Wes and his girlfriend. Pulled in many directions with work obligations, Trace misses out on family moments with Abby and the girls. Mick and Megan’s relationship continues to evolve, but is influenced by their past. Having worked independently for months, Jess adjusts to David’s return to the bed and breakfast. Also adjusting to a man in her life is Bree, who attempts to define her partially professional, partially romantic relationship with Simon. At the Chesapeake Shores Fire Department, Kevin enjoys a week of on-the-job training with Sarah. Meanwhile, Nell recruits Connor to investigate a contestant who is breaking the rules in an annual gardening competition, but a surprising discovery makes her rethink the plan.

3.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S03E07 - It's Just Business
3.plot: Trace discovers that The Bridge has fallen into debt while he was on tour in and tries to repair the damage. Trace’s discovery prompts Mick to reconsider the terms of their partnership and to put aside friendship and family when business is at stake. Abby works to try and balance her stressful workload with being a “super mom” to keep up with Wes’ new fiancé. Jess is suspicious when David’s sister arrives in town looking for help with the business. Bree asks Nell to read her manuscript, but realizes the real test will come when she gives it to Megan. When Kevin doesn’t receive a job offer near Chesapeake Shores, Sarah considers relocating for a dream job. Facing relationship troubles of his own, Connor goes up against an ex-girlfriend in court. Meanwhile, Megan plays hardball when the mayor eliminates her job at the Arts Counc

3.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S03E08 - All Our Tomorrows
3.plot: Abby develops an unexpected friendship with a client, while Trace faces conflict at The Bridge. Though initially hesitant to work with her ex-husband’s fiancé, Abby helps her out tremendously and builds a new rapport with her while on a project. Trace, however, has a more difficult time at work and considers putting his friendship with Mick in jeopardy during a professional disagreement. Kevin graduates from his EMT program, but the reality of he and Sarah moving apart looms over the happy occasion. When Connor’s ex-girlfriend offers him a job, he senses familiar romantic feelings developing. At Nell’s urging, Bree shares her manuscript with Megan and begins to realize there are two sides to every story. Meanwhile, Jess receives devastating news about the inn that she fears will impact her whole life – including her future with David.

3.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S03E09 - Forward to the Past
3.plot: Chaos reigns with the closure of the Bridge, and the O'Briens are at war over Bree's manuscript. Meanwhile, Kevin is heartbroken visiting Sarah's family in Philadelphia, especially after he's offered his dream job back in Chesapeake Shores. When Trace realizes that he might not return to Chesapeake Shores, his relationship with Abby is cast into doubt, as Jess wonders if her relationship with David can survive without the B&B.

3.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S03E10 - Before a Following Sea
3.plot: On the eve of the Chesapeake Shores Regatta, with Mick recruiting family members to join him on the water, Abby finally has to make a decision whether or not to break up with Trace for good. Meanwhile, Bree's relationship with Simon is rocked when Caroline appears, and David and Jess have to finally figure out their relationship without the B&B. In a surprise twist, a letter from Ireland might decide Nell's future.

4.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S04E01 - The End Is Where We Begin
4.plot: Kevin mulls marriage with Sarah; Jess and David run their new B&B in Tanglewood; and Abby and Mick both discover that their careers are in jeopardy.

4.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S04E02 - A Leap of Faith
4.plot: A legend visits Trace as Megan plans Kevin's wedding; Jess and David discover their past can't be repaired, and Simon joins Bree as her play begins rehearsals

4.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S04E03 - A Sonnet for Caroline
4.plot: As Jess and David try to buy an inn, love and loss surround the O'Briens; Mick and Megan explore feelings; Kevin and Sarah make a decision that can upend the family; and Bree and Connor suspect true love might not last forever.

4.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S04E04 - Breaking Hearts and Playing Parts
4.plot: The play is in jeopardy, it's Abby and Trace to rescue. David and Jess learn to work together, Bree learns to work alone. Mick and Megan come together while Connor goes it alone. Kevin and Sara return with a surprise announcement.

4.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S04E05 - All the time in the World
4.plot: Trace rethinks sharing ownership of The Bridge with Mick. Jay helps Abby reconsider her priorities. Jess and David find themselves hosting guests before they are ready. Connor pursues an intriguing new opportunity. Kevin and Sarah discuss their future. Bree prepares for opening day of her play.

4.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S04E06 - Watercolors, Wishes, and Weddings
4.plot: As season four comes to a close, Trace and the O’Briens face decisions affecting their personal and professional lives. Trace weighs his relationship with Emma against her musical potential. Abby and Connor consider new career paths, while a new agent has Bree questioning what’s next.

5.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S05E01 - A Kiss is Still a Kiss
5.plot: As the O'Brien family welcomes Bree home from London they ruminate on how the past two months have changed them all. Kevin and Sarah try for a baby, Jess and David plan for their wedding, and Abby thinks back to her conversation with Trace after their kiss on the beach.

5.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S05E02 - Nice Work If You Can Get It
5.plot: Abby reflects on the past and contemplates a future on her own terms. She and Mick deal with the damage to the reputation of O'Brien Construction, Jess struggles with something David's parents gave her, and Bree realizes two different men from her past may be returning to her life and her heart.

5.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S05E03 - Are the Stars Out Tonight?
5.plot: O'Brien Construction's eccentric billionaire client, Evan Kincaid, comes to town and throws Abby and Mick off their game. At a moment of triumph, Connor discovers his law firm is hiding information from him, and Megan discovers a lost painting that leads her to a famous, reclusive local artist who wants nothing to do with her.

5.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S05E04 - Happy Trails
5.plot: Jess and David host visitors in town for the traditional Snallygaster hunt. Mick and Thomas revisit a weekend-long hiking trip from their youth.

5.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S05E05 - They Can't Take That Away From Me
5.plot: As work continues on his hotel, Evan and Abby learn a bit more about each other. Evan stays a night at Jess's B&B.

5.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S05E06 - Love Is Here to Stay
5.plot: Jess and David's wedding is here, but the O'Brien family still has a lot to face before the celebration. Abby and Evan get into an argument over his hotel, threatening the entire project.

5.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S05E07 - What's New?
5.plot: When Evan comes to the house, he throws out his back and must recover for a few days on the O'Brien couch, connecting him with the family in a way Abby never anticipated.

5.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S05E08 - Where or When?
5.plot: Kevin and Sarah try to keep a secret while Bree discovers one from Luke’s past. Evan whisks Abby away on a business trip, but his intentions are not what she originally thinks.

5.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S05E09 - What a Difference a Day Makes
5.plot: Evan finds himself wondering if he has feelings for Abby; Luke is threatened.

5.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S05E10 - As Time Goes By
5.plot: Luke’s court case is here and Connor comes to his defense despite personal risks. Abby faces a romantic dilemma when Evan declares his true feelings and Jay wants more than friendship.

6.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S06E01 - The Best is Yet to Come
6.plot: The O’Brien family comes together in the aftermath of Connor’s heart attack. Jess and David deal with media fallout after Dennis Peck goes on the run, and we finally discover who Abby called.

6.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S06E02 - Memories Are Made of This
6.plot: Abby goes all out to plan the perfect second date. David’s family makes a surprise visit to the B&B, and Megan must consider whether to take the job offer at the Getty or help Connor recover.

6.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S06E03 - Night and Day
6.plot: One of the O’Briens wrestles with a problem. Abby and Evan participate in a Road Rally, Connor breaks out of the house, Bree helps Luke with nightmares, and Mick and Megan discuss their pasts.

6.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S06E04 - That's All There Is to That
6.plot: Sarah and Kevin come together with exciting news. Connor and Margaret’s law firm struggles to make ends meet, and when Mick’s pill addiction starts to noticeably affect his life, the O’Briens must rally together and stage an intervention.

6.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S06E05 - L-O-V-E
6.plot: A fortune telling machine shares uncomfortable truths with the O’Brien couples. Mick and Megan struggle with their long-distance relationship, Abby’s more comfortable with her new romance.

6.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S06E06 - Straighten Up and Fly Right
6.plot: Various issues are troubling the O’Briens. Mick is in denial about his addiction. Margaret passes the bar. Jess pursues a new idea, and Bree tries mending the rift between her and Luke.

6.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S06E07 - It's Not for Me to Say
6.plot: Kevin learns something new while David questions what he thought was true. Bree finds she and Luke share a birthday. Kevin discovers the gender of the baby. David confronts his father.

6.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S06E08 - I Get a Kick Out of You
6.plot: Secrets are exposed to reveal the past can’t be escaped. A DNA test reveals a location for Evan’s father. Jess hosts a historical reenactment. A Hollywood star comes to offer Bree a movie deal.

6.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S06E09 - Spring Can Really Hang You up the Most
6.plot: Mick gets closer to the ones he loves while Evan and Luke push themselves away. Mick continues to rebuild his relationship with Megan. Luke recovers from a gunshot after stopping a robbery.

6.title: FR - Chesapeake Shores - S06E10 - All or Nothing at All
6.plot: Sarah and Kevin’s baby arrives, kicking off a week of celebration. Mick and Megan prepare for their wedding, broken relationships are mended, and new surprises abound in the finale of “Chesapeake Shores.”

FR - So Help Me Todd - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: Razor-sharp, meticulous attorney Margaret Wright hires her talented but scruffy, aimless son, Todd, as her law firm's in-house investigator

1.title: FR - So Help Me Todd - S01E02 - Co-Pilot
1.plot: Margaret and Todd work two seemingly unrelated cases, only to discover a key piece of information in the details of Todd’s humorously boring civil case could help Margaret’s high-profile client.

1.title: FR - So Help Me Todd - S01E03 - Second Second Chance
1.plot: When Todd reunites with a childhood friend with a checkered past, he convinces Margaret to represent him in a minor legal case.

1.title: FR - So Help Me Todd - S01E04 - Corduroy Briefs
1.plot: Margaret and Todd work to bring justice to an Olympic athlete who lost his leg in a plane crash resulting from a defective aircraft.

1.title: FR - So Help Me Todd - S01E05 - Let the Wright One In
1.plot: Margaret attempts to join an elite philanthropy club and must represent a former club employee accused of using the organization to smuggle drugs. Also, Todd goes undercover as a waiter at the elite club to get information to help Margaret’s case.

1.title: FR - So Help Me Todd - S01E06 - So Help Me Pod
1.plot: Margaret and Francey enlist the help of a popular true crime podcaster, Lea Luna, to help exonerate a client who is serving a life sentence. Also, Todd solicits dating advice from his sister and Susan when sparks fly between him and Lea.

1.title: FR - So Help Me Todd - S01E07 - Long Lost Lawrence
1.plot: When Margaret is disappointed that no one but Todd can attend her family Thanksgiving dinner, Todd tries to convince his brother, Lawrence, to come home. Also, Margaret's family inadvertently helps her crack a case involving an injured bank teller and robbery.

1.title: FR - So Help Me Todd - S01E08 - Big Bang Theories
1.plot: When Lyle’s niece, Angie, is accused of committing a crime on her college campus, Lyle enlists Margaret and Todd to vindicate her.

1.title: FR - So Help Me Todd - S01E09 - Swipe Wright
1.plot: Margaret asks Todd for help on a seemingly straight forward wrongful termination case over a dating app, but with Todd’s investigation they quickly realize it’s much more complicated. Also, tensions between Margaret and Gus simmer as they come across each other on a dating app.

1.title: FR - So Help Me Todd - S01E10 - The Devil You Know
1.plot: When Margaret finds herself on the verge of losing a prominent case involving the murder of an investigative journalist, Todd seeks help from an unlikely source: his imprisoned ex-girlfriend, Veronica.

1.title: FR - So Help Me Todd - S01E11 - Side Effects May Include Murder
1.plot: When Margaret's client faces an attempted murder charge, she mounts a creative defense to prove her client's innocence, and Todd takes an experimental drug to find evidence. Also, Allison finds herself in trouble and reaches out to Todd for help.

1.title: FR - So Help Me Todd - S01E12 - Psilo-Sibling
1.plot: Lawrence and the governor seek Margaret's help with a personal legal matter related to the governor's sister, and while Margaret is ecstatic to be of assistance, Lawrence refuses to let Todd anywhere near the case.

1.title: FR - So Help Me Todd - S01E13 - Wall of Fire
1.plot: When Todd agrees to help Susan’s fiancé locate a missing employee, he stumbles into a case Margaret agreed to co-counsel with Gus. Margaret and Todd realize their cases are converging and a firewall is put into place to prevent them from communicating with each other.

1.title: FR - So Help Me Todd - S01E14 - Against All Todds
1.plot: When Veronica appears at the law firm requesting a favor from Todd, he agrees to help but soon realizes she may be out for revenge. Also, Margaret is upset when she is taken off a high-stakes case.

1.title: FR - So Help Me Todd - S01E15 - Ivan the Terrible
1.plot: Margaret represents a gifted 17-year-old hacker charged with releasing classified defense documents and faces off against her college nemesis; Todd is tasked with babysitting the teen hacker for the duration of the trial.

1.title: FR - So Help Me Todd - S01E16 - Twelve Worried Persons
1.plot: When a juror dies during Susan’s first big trial as lead attorney, Margaret and Todd work to exonerate Amy, a juror from the same trial suspected of the murder. Also, Margaret’s sister Patty is in town and sparks fly between Todd and Amy.

1.title: FR - So Help Me Todd - S01E17 - The First Date Is the Deepest
1.plot: Margaret helps a client who lost his mother during a routine surgery at Allison’s hospital, performed by her colleague Dr. Ross Woods. Also, Margaret and Gus go on their first date and Todd is asked by the firm to investigate Gus.

1.title: FR - So Help Me Todd - S01E18 - Gloom and Boom
1.plot: When a stranger with a bomb appears at the law firm demanding Margaret reverse her efforts to free her client on death row or the bomb will detonate, Margaret and Todd must rely on their legal and detective skills to untangle the crime, uncover the intentions of the bomber and save everyone at the firm.

1.title: FR - So Help Me Todd - S01E19 - 86’d
1.plot: Margaret represents Lauren, Susan’s good friend, in a hostile work environment lawsuit after she quits her job at a Michelin-starred restaurant, but it unexpectedly turns into a murder trial when the head chef is found dead. Also, when Todd gets sick, Margaret must go undercover as a dishwasher in a fancy restaurant while Todd acts as a restaurant critic to gather more intel on the possible suspect.

1.title: FR - So Help Me Todd - S01E20 - More Fang for Your Chuck
1.plot: Margaret must represent Chuck when he faces 20 years in federal prison after being accused of fixing a cash prize giveaway at the Portland Widows hockey game. Also, Lyle finds a new love interest in a forensic accountant and Allison asks Susan to be her divorce lawyer.

1.title: FR - So Help Me Todd - S01E21 - Are You There Todd? It’s Me, Margaret
1.plot: When Margaret is too sick to work on the final day of an important negotiation, Todd must step in and impersonate a lawyer while Margaret uses her investigative skills. Also, Margaret and Gus finally share their first kiss.

2.title: FR - So Help Me Todd - S02E01 - Iceland Was Horrible
2.plot: Margaret and Todd tackle a case involving a murder on live local morning news and must rethink their working relationship after Todd decides to open his own PI business.

2.title: FR - So Help Me Todd - S02E02 - Your Day in Court
2.plot: As Margaret and Todd work on two separate cases, Todd suspects a crime is happening in the courthouse right under their noses.

2.title: FR - So Help Me Todd - S02E03 - The Queen of Courts
2.plot: Margaret and Todd defend the "Queen of Hearts," a notoriously unscrupulous lawyer accused of orchestrating a fraudulent accident that resulted in the death of a "fake victim."

2.title: FR - So Help Me Todd - S02E04 - Dial Margaret for Murder
2.plot: While in the hospital recovering from an emergency appendectomy, Todd is convinced he overheard a plot to murder someone. When Margaret realizes her clients are interested in Todd's theories, she jumps into the role of private investigator.

2.title: FR - So Help Me Todd - S02E05 - End on a High Note
2.plot: Margaret and Todd defend international opera star, supreme diva and Lyle's mother, Jaqueline.

2.title: FR - So Help Me Todd - S02E06 - Is the Jury Out?
2.plot: Lawrence enlists Todd's services to find out the sexual orientation of a judge. Also, with her client's livelihood at stake, Margaret and Lyle search for a reluctant witness.

2.title: FR - So Help Me Todd - S02E07 - Faux-Bituary
2.plot: Margaret and Todd team up to help a man who has been declared legally dead, even though he is very much alive.

2.title: FR - So Help Me Todd - S02E08 - P.I.'s Wide Shut
2.plot: While Margaret helps Susan serve justice for a tennis coach accused of drugging a teen athlete, Todd and Lyle embark on an epic office prank war.

meta.plot: L'avocate méticuleuse Margaret Wright engage son fils Todd, talentueux, mais débraillé, comme enquêteur interne de son cabinet d'avocats. Lorsque Todd fait équipe avec sa mère sur une affaire, elle est surprise de se trouver dûment impressionner sa capacité astucieuse à rechercher des informations grâce à son charme et à ses connaissances technologiques étendues. Enfin, Margaret voit un moyen de mettre son fils sur la voie appropriée pour vivre une vie d'adulte et financièrement solvable qu'elle approuve, et elle lui demande de rejoindre son entreprise.

1.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S01E01 - Children of the Gods (1)
1.plot: When powerful aliens come through Earth's Stargate, Colonel Jack O'Neill returns to Abydos to retrieve Daniel Jackson, who has discovered that the alien transit system includes much more than the two planets.

1.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S01E02 - Children of the Gods (2)
1.plot: Colonel O'Neill, leading the new SG-1, track Apophis back to the planet Chulak to rescue Sha're and Skaara, and befriend one of Apophis' Jaffa guards.

1.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S01E03 - The Enemy Within
1.plot: Major Kawalsky is possessed by a Goa'uld, and the SGC must find a way to remove it without killing him.

1.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S01E04 - Emancipation
1.plot: An alien civilization is forced to reconsider their views on women when Carter rebels against their social customs.

1.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S01E05 - The Broca Divide
1.plot: Members of SG-1 become infected with an alien virus that turns them into primitive beings. Dr. Fraiser must find a cure to save the team and the alien population from whom it was contracted.

1.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S01E06 - The First Commandment
1.plot: SG-1 must stop a renegade Stargate commander, who has gone mad and set himself up as a god on an alien planet.

1.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S01E07 - Cold Lazarus
1.plot: During an off-world assignment, Jack is struck down by energy from a blue crystal... which creates a duplicate of him that returns to Earth in Jack's place.

1.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S01E08 - The Nox
1.plot: Pressed by the government to acquire new technologies, SG-1 is led to a world inhabited by a seemingly primative race. When Apophis arrives, SG-1 ambush him with disasterous consequences.

1.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S01E09 - Brief Candle
1.plot: SG-1 discovers a race of attractive people who age extremely rapidly. The situation becomes personal when O'Neill begins to suffer from the same accelerated aging, and must live out the rest of his life on the planet.

1.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S01E10 - Thor's Hammer
1.plot: Teal'c and O'Neill are transported to an underground cage designed by the Asgard to protect an alien world from the Goa'uld.

1.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S01E11 - The Torment of Tantalus
1.plot: SG-1 tracks down Catherine Langford's fiancee, who took the first Stargate trip in 1945, and discovers an ancient meeting hall that may hold the secrets of the universe itself.

1.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S01E12 - Bloodlines
1.plot: Teal'c returns to Chulak to stop his people from implanting his son with a larval Goa'uld.

1.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S01E13 - Fire and Water
1.plot: Daniel is taken captive by an alien with a hidden agenda, while SG-1 is made to believe he is dead.

1.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S01E14 - Hathor
1.plot: The banished Goa'uld Hathor is found in an ancient sarcophagus Earth, and takes over the S.G.C. with hopes of raising a new army against the System Lords.

1.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S01E15 - Singularity
1.plot: A mysterious affliction wipes out the entire population of a planet, plus an SG team -- except for one young girl. Carter befriends her, but learns that she is being used by the Goa'uld.

1.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S01E16 - Cor-Ai
1.plot: Teal'c must stand trial for a crime committed while he served as first prime of Apophis when a villager on an alien world identifies him as the Jaffa who killed his father.

1.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S01E17 - Enigma
1.plot: The SG-1 team rescues a group of advanced humans from a planet near destruction, and must find a new home for the refugees before the Pentagon gets their hands on them.

1.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S01E18 - Solitudes
1.plot: Colonel O'Neill and Captain Carter are separated from Jackson and Teal'c during a Stargate journey, and are trapped on a desolate ice world with no way of escape.

1.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S01E19 - Tin Man
1.plot: The members of SG-1 arrive on P3X-989 and are knocked unconscious. They wake up and return to Earth only to find that they are not quite themselves.

1.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S01E20 - There But For the Grace of God
1.plot: An alien artifact transports Daniel to an alternate reality, where he is not a part of the Stargate program and the Goa'uld -- led by Teal'c -- are invading Earth.

1.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S01E21 - Politics (1)
1.plot: Senator Kinsey arrives at the SGC to investigate the program and determine whether the great drain on the U.S. budget is worthwhile, prompting the team to recall missions from the past year.

2.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S02E01 - The Serpent's Lair (3)
2.plot: With SG-1 trapped on Klorel's ship, it seems that Earth is doomed as the Pyramid Ships prepare to destroy Earth.

2.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S02E02 - In the Line of Duty
2.plot: Carter is possessed by a Goa'uld who claims to be an enemy of the System Lords.

2.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S02E03 - Prisoners
2.plot: SG-1 is put on trial and exiled to a prison world, where a woman maintains a strange control over her fellow prisoners.

2.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S02E04 - The Gamekeeper
2.plot: SG-1 is imprisoned in a virtual reality realm and forced to relive the worst moments of their lives over and over.

2.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S02E05 - Need
2.plot: Jackson becomes addicted to the effects of a Goa'uld sarcophagus, and falls for the planet's manipulative princess.

2.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S02E06 - Thor's Chariot
2.plot: SG-1 returns to Cimmeria, and finds that without protection from the Asgard the planet has been invaded by the Goa'uld.

2.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S02E07 - Message in a Bottle
2.plot: SG-1 discovers an ancient artifact that takes O'Neill and the S.G.C. hostage.

2.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S02E08 - Family
2.plot: The SG-1 team attempt to rescue Teal'c's son, who has been kidnapped and brainwashed by Apophis. Teal'c learns disturbing news about his wife.

2.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S02E09 - Secrets
2.plot: Jackson discovers that his wife has returned to Abydos, and is nine months pregnant with the son of Apophis. O'Neill must keep the secret of the Stargate program from being uncovered.

2.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S02E10 - Bane
2.plot: Teal'c is infected with deadly venom from a giant insect, and begins a terrible transformation. When he escapes the S.G.C., SG-1 must find him before Colonel Maybourne does.

2.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S02E11 - The Tok'ra (1)
2.plot: SG-1 locates the Tok'ra, a Goa'uld resistance movement who oppose the System Lords, and attempt to form an alliance. Jacob Carter's cancer brings him near death.

2.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S02E12 - The Tok'ra (2)
2.plot: While SG-1 tries to form an alliance with the Tok'ra, a spy betrays the rebels to the Goa'uld. Jacob Carter finds that the Tok'ra may be his only hope of survival

2.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S02E13 - Spirits
2.plot: SG-1 finds a planet inhabited by Native American Indians, protected by spirits who are actually advanced alien shapeshifters.

2.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S02E14 - Touchstone
2.plot: SG-1 is accused of stealing an important weather-controlling device, sending a primative planet into chaos. The team discovers that Earth's second Stargate is being misused.

2.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S02E15 - The Fifth Race
2.plot: O'Neill becomes the unwilling receptacle for a library of alien knowledge.

2.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S02E16 - A Matter of Time
2.plot: After gating to a world on the edge of a black hole, the S.G.C. cannot disengage the Stargate. All of Earth becomes endangered by the time-distorting gravity field.

2.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S02E17 - Holiday
2.plot: SG-1 discovers an elderly man known for developing technology to fight the Goa'uld. Daniel is tricked into switching bodies with the man, Ma'chello, who believes he is "owed" for all the good he has done.

2.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S02E18 - Serpent's Song
2.plot: Apophis, SG-1's greatest enemy, seeks sanctuary from Sokar and ends up near death in the S.G.C. infirmary.

2.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S02E19 - One False Step
2.plot: A group of primitive aliens begin to fall deathly ill after SG-1 arrives.

2.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S02E20 - Show and Tell
2.plot: A young boy arrives through the Stargate, and warns of plot by invisible aliens to kill all of the human race in order to rob the Goa'uld of potential hosts.

2.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S02E21 - 1969
2.plot: A cosmic accident causes SG-1 to be sent back 30 years into Earth's past, where they must locate the Stargate and find a way home.

2.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S02E22 - Out of Mind (1)
2.plot: O'Neill, Carter and Jackson awaken from stasis in what appears to be the S.G.C. -- almost 80 years in the future.

3.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S03E01 - Into the Fire (2)
3.plot: O'Neill, Carter and Jackson must escape Hathor's clutches, while Teal'c tries to raise a Jaffa army on Chulak. General Hammond must take desperate measures to rescue the team.

3.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S03E02 - Seth
3.plot: SG-1 must find a renegade Goa'uld who has been hiding on Earth for thousands of years.

3.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S03E03 - Fair Game
3.plot: The Asgard aid Earth in negotiating a nonagression treaty with the Goa'uld System Lords.

3.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S03E04 - Legacy
3.plot: When Daniel goes insane, SG-1 must deal with the legacy of Machello's anti-Goa'uld technology.

3.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S03E05 - Learning Curve
3.plot: SG-1 discovers a planet where children are used to acquire knowledge for the entire population, then discarded.

3.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S03E06 - Point of View
3.plot: SG-1 must free an alternate reality Earth from a Goa'uld invasion after duplicates of Samantha Carter and Charles Kawalsky come through the quantum mirror.

3.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S03E07 - Deadman Switch
3.plot: SG-1 is taken captive by an alien bounty hunter with uncertain loyalties.

3.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S03E08 - Demons
3.plot: SG-1 finds a medieval Christian society terrorized by Sokar and the Unas, and is accused of being possessed by demons.

3.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S03E09 - Rules of Engagement
3.plot: SG-1 discovers a military camp where young men are trained to impersonate SGC personnel to infiltrate Earth.

3.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S03E10 - Forever in a Day
3.plot: Jackson deals with the apparent death of his wife, Sha're, at the hands of Teal'c.

3.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S03E11 - Past and Present
3.plot: SG-1 encounters an entire planet suffering from amnesia.  The planet's leader returns to Earth with SG-1 to find a cure,  but SG-1 suspects she may not be who she appears to be.

3.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S03E12 - Jolinar's Memories (1)
3.plot: When Major Carter's father Jacob is kidnapped by Sokar, the SG-1 team must infiltrate a prison moon designed to look like hell to rescue him.

3.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S03E13 - The Devil You Know (2)
3.plot: SG-1 must escape a hellish prison moon, and one of their worst enemies.

3.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S03E14 - Foothold
3.plot: SG-1 returns from a mission and discovers that metamorphic aliens have taken over the complex.

3.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S03E15 - Pretense
3.plot: The Tollan put Skaara and Klorel on trial to determine who will control the host body.

3.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S03E16 - Urgo
3.plot: SG-1 receives alien brain implants that manifest themselves as a bizarre man, who tells them that they would not survive the procedure to remove him.

3.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S03E17 - A Hundred Days
3.plot: After a meteor strike buries the Stargate, O'Neill finds himself stranded on a planet with no hope of rescue.

3.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S03E18 - Shades of Grey
3.plot: O'Neill steals technology from the Tollan, and is forced to leave the Stargate program. Maybourne offers an intriguing proposal.

3.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S03E19 - New Ground
3.plot: The members of SG-1 are imprisoned on a planet and become pawns in a war of ideology.

3.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S03E20 - Maternal Instinct
3.plot: SG-1 discovers the mystical planet Kheb, and must find the Harcesis child of Apophis and Sha're before Apophis's army does.

3.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S03E21 - Crystal Skull
3.plot: An alien artifact causes Daniel to disappear, and the team looks for help from his institutionalized grandfather.

3.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S03E22 - Nemesis (1)
3.plot: SG-1 faces creatures of mass destruction that even the Asgard can't control, and must destroy Thor's infested vessel before the Replicator bugs reach Earth.

4.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S04E01 - Small Victories (2)
4.plot: O'Neill and Teal'c risk their lives to keep the Replicator bugs from gaining a foothold on Earth, while Carter helps the Asgard fend off a Replicator invasion.

4.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S04E02 - The Other Side
4.plot: A warring alien race offers to exchange their advanced technology for Earth's help in defeating their enemy.

4.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S04E03 - Upgrades
4.plot: A Tok'ra archaeologist arrives at the SGC with newly discovered technology, giving the SG-1 team superhuman powers.

4.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S04E04 - Crossroads
4.plot: Teal'c is reunited with his lost love -- a woman who claims to have found a way to communicate with her symbiote and defeat the Goa'uld.

4.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S04E05 - Divide and Conquer
4.plot: When a member of the SGC tries to kill a Tok'ra, it is revealed that O'Neill and Carter may be victims of an untraceable form of Goa'uld mind control.

4.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S04E06 - Window of Opportunity
4.plot: O'Neill and Teal'c are caught in a time loop in the SGC, and must relive the same 10 hours over and over again.

4.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S04E07 - Watergate
4.plot: The Russians recover a Stargate from the bottom of the ocean, and turn to the SGC for help when their experiments go awry.

4.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S04E08 - The First Ones
4.plot: Dr. Jackson is taken captive by an Unas while on an archaeological dig. The SGC mounts a rescue operation, but discovers a danger of their own.

4.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S04E09 - Scorched Earth
4.plot: SG-1 is caught in a conflict between two civilizations trying to colonize the same planet.

4.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S04E10 - Beneath the Surface
4.plot: The members of SG-1 are used as forced labor in an underground alien facility after their memories are erased by the ruling elite.

4.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S04E11 - Point of No Return
4.plot: SG-1 investigates a conspiracy theorist who has detailed knowledge of the Stargate program.

4.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S04E12 - Tangent
4.plot: A test gone wrong leaves Jack and Teal'c marooned in space aboard a damaged prototype attack ship

4.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S04E13 - The Curse
4.plot: When his former mentor dies, Dr. Jackson returns to his roots -- and discovers an ancient Egyptian artifact containing a Goa'uld parasite.

4.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S04E14 - The Serpent's Venom
4.plot: SG-1 must stop Apophis and Heru-ur from forming an alliance of their powerful forces, while Teal'c is captured and tortured by the Goa'uld.

4.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S04E15 - Chain Reaction
4.plot: SG-1 must adjust to a new commanding officer when General Hammond steps down -- but O'Neill discovers foul play behind the general's resignation.

4.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S04E16 - 2010
4.plot: Ten years into the future, the former members of SG-1 must send a message into the past to prevent the extinction of the human race.

4.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S04E17 - Absolute Power
4.plot: Jackson's teammates notice a disturbing change in him when he is reunited with the Harcesis child and given the Goa'uld genetic memory.

4.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S04E18 - The Light
4.plot: SG-1 finds a deserted Goa'uld palace, where a beautiful device causes suicidal tendencies.

4.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S04E19 - Prodigy
4.plot: Carter must help keep a promising young cadet from throwing away a future at the SGC. O'Neill and Teal'c encounter a dangerous life form at an offworld research base.

4.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S04E20 - Entity
4.plot: The SGC is invaded by an alien life force that takes up residence in the base computer system -- and in Major Carter.

4.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S04E21 - Double Jeopardy
4.plot: SG-1 must rescue an alien world from the Goa'uld -- with help from an unexpected source. Teal'c seeks revenge on the System Lord Cronus for the murder of his father.

4.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S04E22 - Exodus (1)
4.plot: SG-1 helps to evacuate the Tok'ra to a new base -- but matters are complicated when a spy reveals their location to Apophis. The team attempts a daring plan to take out the Goa'uld's powerful fleet.

5.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S05E01 - Enemies (2)
5.plot: SG-1 finds themselves stranded in a crippled ship in a distant galaxy -- with Apophis threatening to destroy them. Teal'c is brainwashed and made loyal to Apophis once again.

5.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S05E02 - Threshold (3)
5.plot: His mind altered by Apophis, Teal'c must undergo a ritual that takes him to the edge of death itself, in order for him to rediscover who he is.

5.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S05E03 - Ascension
5.plot: An alien being is smitten with Carter and follows her back to Earth. It assumes a human form and pursues a relationship with her.

5.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S05E04 - The Fifth Man
5.plot: O'Neill and Lieutenant Tyler are ambushed by Goa'uld forces and trapped behind enemy lines -- while the rest of their team discover they don't know who Tyler is.

5.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S05E05 - Red Sky
5.plot: SG-1 discovers that their recent trip through the Stargate may have inadvertently doomed an entire civilization.

5.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S05E06 - Rite of Passage
5.plot: Cassandra mysteriously falls ill, sending SG-1 back to her home planet -- where they uncover a dark Goa'uld secret.

5.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S05E07 - Beast of Burden
5.plot: SG-1 discovers a civilization that uses Unas as slave labor, and attempt to liberate Daniel's friend, Chaka.

5.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S05E08 - The Tomb
5.plot: SG-1 teams with a Russian unit when one of their Stargate teams goes missing in a mysterious alien ziggurat.

5.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S05E09 - Between Two Fires
5.plot: The Tollan offer Earth advanced weapons technology, prompting a secret investigation on Tollana -- one that leads to a startling discovery.

5.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S05E10 - 2001
5.plot: SG-1 encounters a potential new, technologically advanced ally in the war against the Goa'uld -- though they do not know the Aschen's dark secret.

5.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S05E11 - Desperate Measures
5.plot: When Carter goes missing, O'Neill teams up with Col. Maybourne again to free her.

5.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S05E12 - Wormhole X-Treme!
5.plot: An alien ship approaches Earth, sending SG-1 to an old friend for some answers -- where they discover that Martin Lloyd has created a TV show about the Stargate program.

5.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S05E13 - Proving Ground
5.plot: SG-1 trains a team of raw cadets, and Colonel O'Neill is forced to take them into a real-life battle situation when he learns of a possible alien incursion at the SGC.

5.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S05E14 - 48 Hours
5.plot: Disaster strikes the Stargate, trapping Teal'c in transit. SG-1 must turn to Russia -- and to their enemies -- for help.

5.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S05E15 - Summit (1)
5.plot: The Tok'ra war with the Goa'uld escalates, and the rebel faction sends Daniel Jackson to a secret meeting between the System Lords.

5.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S05E16 - Last Stand (2)
5.plot: Dr. Jackson's undercover mission to a Goa'uld summit is complicated by the arrival of a surprise guest. The rest of the team face a full-scale invasion of the Tok'ra homeworld.

5.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S05E17 - Fail Safe
5.plot: Earth finds itself threatened by something even larger than the Goa'uld when the team learns that an asteroid is on a collision course with the planet.

5.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S05E18 - The Warrior
5.plot: A charismatic Jaffa leader seeks to forge an alliance between Earth and his rebel followers, winning the allegiance of Teal'c and Bra'tac.

5.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S05E19 - Menace
5.plot: SG-1 encounters a young woman with the ability to control Replicators, and who may hold the key to the salvation of the Asgard.

5.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S05E20 - The Sentinel
5.plot: SG-1 must turn to a pair of convicted criminals to save a world from annihilation by the Goa'uld.

5.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S05E21 - Meridian
5.plot: Daniel Jackson is exposed to a lethal dose of radiation while visiting an alien civilization that is building a weapon of mass destruction.

5.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S05E22 - Revelations
5.plot: SG-1 must come to the rescue of their once-powerful allies when the Goa'uld attack a secret Asgard laboratory.

6.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S06E01 - Redemption (1)
6.plot: Tragedy reunites Teal'c with his son, who blames him for the death of his mother. O'Neill and Carter launch a risky plan with untested technology when Earth comes under attack by the Goa'uld.

6.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S06E02 - Redemption (2)
6.plot: Carter must find a way to save Earth from total destruction at the hands of the Goa'uld, who have turned the Stargate into a doomsday bomb. Rya'c joins his father on a mission to destroy the Goa'uld weapon.

6.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S06E03 - Descent
6.plot: SG-1 boards an abandoned Goa'uld mothership that has mysteriously arrived in Earth's orbit, and must escape the doomed vessel when it crashes into the ocean.

6.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S06E04 - Frozen
6.plot: SG-1 investigates the discovery of a woman frozen in the ice in Antarctica, who may be a link to the gate builders. A mysterious disease threatens to kill everyone at the research base.

6.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S06E05 - Nightwalkers
6.plot: Carter, Teal'c and Jonas investigate the death of a scientist with connections to the Goa'uld, and find a small town whose citizens harbor a dark secret.

6.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S06E06 - Abyss
6.plot: O'Neill is captured and tortured by the Goa'uld, and must rely on an old friend to survive.

6.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S06E07 - Shadow Play
6.plot: Jonas' people ask Earth for military aid in an impending war with their rival nations, but his former mentor offers another solution: a resistance movement ready for a coup.

6.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S06E08 - The Other Guys
6.plot: When SG-1 is captured by the Goa'uld, a pair of scientists mount a rescue operation ... whether they're wanted or not.

6.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S06E09 - Allegiance
6.plot: Tensions rise between the Tok'ra and rebel Jaffa at the S.G.C.'s offworld base when they are attacked by an invisible enemy.

6.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S06E10 - Cure
6.plot: An alien world offers Earth a medicine with the power to cure any illness -- but the hidden price may be too high to pay.

6.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S06E11 - Prometheus (1)
6.plot: A news reporter threatens to expose a top-secret military project, but when Carter and Jonas give her a tour of the X-303, they discover that she is a pawn in a much larger plot.

6.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S06E12 - Unnatural Selection (2)
6.plot: The team is called into battle unexpectedly when the Asgard homeworld is overrun by Replicators -- which have evolved into a startling new form.

6.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S06E13 - Sight Unseen
6.plot: The team returns to Earth with a piece of technology that allows them to see alien creatures everywhere, and must attempt to contain the problem when it spreads beyond the base.

6.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S06E14 - Smoke & Mirrors
6.plot: Colonel O'Neill is charged with the murder of Senator Kinsey, and the rest of the team must uncover a conspiracy in order to clear his name.

6.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S06E15 - Paradise Lost
6.plot: Colonel O'Neill is trapped on an alien planet with Maybourne, and must fight to stay alive as his companion becomes increasingly paranoid.

6.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S06E16 - Metamorphosis
6.plot: SG-1 attempts to save a planet's inhabitants from Nirrti's genetic experimentation, but find themselves to be her next victims.

6.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S06E17 - Disclosure
6.plot: General Hammond and the Pentagon reveal the existence of the Stargate to other world governments, and must defend the fact that the program is operated by the United States military.

6.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S06E18 - Forsaken
6.plot: When the team finds a crashed ship on another planet, their efforts to help the crew effect repairs are hindered by a group of aliens.

6.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S06E19 - The Changeling
6.plot: A near-death trial causes Teal'c to imagine his life as very different from the one he knows, where he is a normal person living on Earth -- until he can no longer distinguish reality.

6.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S06E20 - Memento
6.plot: Prometheus is forced to land on an alien world, where the local Stargate is the team's only chance of returning home -- though the local population believe the gate to be a myth.

6.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S06E21 - Prophecy
6.plot: The team finds an impoverished world enslaved by a Goa'uld underlord, but their plans to free it may be compromised when Jonas experiences unexplained visions of the future.

6.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S06E22 - Full Circle
6.plot: SG-1 is called to defend the people of Abydos from the Goa'uld once again when they learn that Anubis, in search of a powerful device, is about to attack.

7.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S07E01 - Fallen (1)
7.plot: While searching for the Lost City of the Ancients on a distant planet, SG-1 is stunned to find Daniel Jackson alive and in human form but stripped of his memory.  O'Neill convinces Daniel to return with them to the SGC, where he is reinstated for a daring mission to destroy Anubis' powerful new super-weapon!

7.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S07E02 - Homecoming (2)
7.plot: The team returns to Jonas' homeworld when they learn that the Goa'uld are after its naquadria. When Jonas is captured by Anubis, Daniel is his only hope.

7.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S07E03 - Fragile Balance
7.plot: A teenage boy shows up at the S.G.C. claiming to be Jack O'Neill, sending the team on a mission to uncover his true identity.

7.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S07E04 - Orpheus
7.plot: After an injury, Teal'c must put aside his self-doubt when SG-1 launches a mission to rescue his son and his mentor from a Jaffa death camp.

7.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S07E05 - Revisions
7.plot: The team gates to a climate-controlled environment amidst a toxic wasteland, whose people are all linked to a central computer.

7.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S07E06 - Lifeboat
7.plot: When SG-1 finds a crashed alien space ship, Daniel's mind is taken over by its disembodied passengers.

7.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S07E07 - Enemy Mine
7.plot: When Earth's attempts to exploit a newly-discovered naquadah mine are thwarted by a tribe of indigenous Unas, SG-1 must turn to an old friend for help.

7.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S07E08 - Space Race
7.plot: Major Carter joins an alien pilot for a space race, where the winner is awarded a lucrative contract with the planet's most powerful corporation. But the rest of the team discovers that there is more at stake than the finish line.

7.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S07E09 - Avenger 2.0
7.plot: An S.G.C. scientist creates a computer virus to be used to disable enemy Stargates -- but succeeds in shutting down the entire gate network.

7.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S07E10 - Birthright
7.plot: The team finds a fugitive colony of Jaffa women, who must prey on other Jaffa to acquire symbiotes.

7.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S07E11 - Evolution (1)
7.plot: The team investigates an unstoppable new enemy soldier engineered by Anubis. Dr. Jackson leads a team in search of an alien device in Central America, but gets more than he bargained for.

7.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S07E12 - Evolution (2)
7.plot: O'Neill seeks help from a former comrade to rescue Daniel and Dr. Lee, who have been kidnapped in Central America. Carter, Teal'c and Jacob infiltrate Anubis' super-soldier facility.

7.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S07E13 - Grace
7.plot: Carter is injured when the Prometheus is attacked by an unknown ship, and awakens to find herself stranded alone in deep space.

7.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S07E14 - Fallout
7.plot: When the Kelownans discover that a massive underground vein of naquadah is being converted into naquadria, Jonas Quinn seeks help from Earth in avoiding the total destruction of his planet.

7.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S07E15 - Chimera
7.plot: Daniel is plagued by dreams of his former girlfriend, who has been taken as a Goa'uld host. Samantha Carter begins a romantic relationship with a detective, from whom she must hide her life at Stargate Command.

7.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S07E16 - Death Knell
7.plot: Earth's secret offworld base is attacked by Anubis' forces, and Major Carter finds herself being hunted by the enemy. General Hammond and Jacob Carter make an unnerving discovery about the Earth-Tok'ra alliance.

7.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S07E17 - Heroes (1)
7.plot: A film crew arrives to document the work of the S.G.C. for eventual disclosure to the public, but finds that the base's personnel are less than eager to participate.

7.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S07E18 - Heroes (2)
7.plot: SG-1 is called into action while a film crew is documenting the Stargate program, but the S.G.C. comes under investigation after the mission goes terribly wrong.

7.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S07E19 - Resurrection
7.plot: SG-1 investigates a secret N.I.D. laboratory, where a ruthless scientist has used cloning technology to create a Goa'uld-human hybrid.

7.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S07E20 - Inauguration
7.plot: The newly-elected president is debriefed about the Stargate program, and Vice President Kinsey makes a new play for control of the program.

7.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S07E21 - Lost City (1)
7.plot: O'Neill goes to great lengths to keep the Ancients' knowledge from falling into Goa'uld hands when the team discovers a second repository. The President replaces General Hammond with a civilian diplomat.

8.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S08E01 - New Order (1)
8.plot: Carter and Teal'c go in search of the Asgard to try and save Colonel O'Neill, but discover that the Asgard's enemy has returned with a vengeance. The System Lords seek an alliance with Earth against a common enemy.

8.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S08E02 - New Order (2)
8.plot: While the Goa'uld threaten to attack Earth, SG-1 and the Asgard make a last, desperate stand against the Replicators, which have captured Major Carter and invaded the last outpost of the Asgard civilization.

8.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S08E03 - Lockdown
8.plot: The S.G.C. is put under quarantine after a mysterious infection leaves a Russian officer in the infirmary -- but the disease may not be a disease at all.

8.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S08E04 - Zero Hour
8.plot: General O'Neill tries to settle into his new job, but faces never-ending crises - including the capture of SG-1 by the Goa'uld.

8.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S08E05 - Icon
8.plot: Daniel is stranded on another planet after the team's arrival on an alien world sparks a violent civil war.

8.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S08E06 - Avatar
8.plot: Teal'c is trapped in a virtual reality simulation, in which he must defend the base from a Goa'uld super-soldier incursion.

8.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S08E07 - Affinity
8.plot: Teal'c becomes the chief suspect in a murder investigation after he moves into an apartment off-base. Carter considers her future with Pete.

8.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S08E08 - Covenant
8.plot: A businessman threatens to expose the secrets of alien life to the world, forcing Stargate Command to bring him into the loop.

8.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S08E09 - Sacrifices
8.plot: The impending wedding of his son is the least of Teal'c's worries when the Hak'tyl plan an uprising against the Goa'uld Moloc, driving a wedge between Teal'c and Ishta.

8.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S08E10 - Endgame
8.plot: The Stargate is stolen, leading SG-1 to discover that the Trust has taken control of an advanced ship in orbit. Teal'c investigates a series of wide-spread Jaffa deaths.

8.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S08E11 - Gemini
8.plot: A duplicate of Colonel Carter seeks help from Stargate Command in defeating the Replicator Fifth, who she claims has found a way to counter the Asgard's new weapon.

8.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S08E12 - Prometheus Unbound
8.plot: After the Prometheus responds to a distress call from a Goa'uld ship, Daniel Jackson finds himself a captive when Earth's ship is stolen.

8.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S08E13 - It's Good to Be King
8.plot: SG-1 comes to the aid of a world about to be invaded by the Goa'uld, only to discover that the local king is Earth's Harry Maybourne.

8.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S08E14 - Full Alert
8.plot: Relations between the U.S. and Russia are strained when Russian military leaders claim that the U.S. government has been compromised by the Goa'uld.

8.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S08E15 - Citizen Joe
8.plot: Jack is confronted in his home by an irate barber...who claims to know everything about the Stargate project and SG-1.

8.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S08E16 - Reckoning (1)
8.plot: The Replicators begin a systematic attack of the Goa'uld, forcing Baal to come to Earth for help. The Jaffa Resistance risk their entire movement in an attempt to retake a holy city in Baal's domain.

8.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S08E17 - Reckoning (2)
8.plot: The fate of the galaxy hangs in the balance as Sam and Jacob search for the only weapon capable of stopping the Replicator onslaught. O'Neill leads a defense of the S.G.C., while Daniel squares off against Replicator Carter.

8.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S08E18 - Threads
8.plot: While Daniel finds himself in a mysterious diner suspended between death and ascension, Jacob's fate takes an unexpected turn, Jack and Sam consider their romantic lives, and Anubis unleashes his plan for galactic destruction.

8.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S08E19 - Moebius (1)
8.plot: SG-1 travels back in time in a daring plan to steal a piece of Ancient technology from Ra, the powerful Goa'uld who ruled in ancient Egypt.

9.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S09E01 - Avalon (1)
9.plot: An Air Force pilot attempts to reassemble SG-1 after they have gone their separate ways. An old "friend" arrives on Earth asking for Daniel's help in finding an ancient treasure -- and she won't take no for an answer.

9.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S09E02 - Avalon (2)
9.plot: An Ancient communications device renders Daniel and Vala unconscious, sending their minds to another galaxy -- where they inhabit the bodies of two people persecuted by the followers of an evil religion.

9.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S09E03 - Origin (3)
9.plot: Daniel comes face to face with the Ori, a fiery race of beings who demand the worship of mortals. Elsewhere, Stargate Command encounters the first Ori missionary in our galaxy.

9.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S09E04 - The Ties That Bind
9.plot: Jackson and Mitchell must join Vala on an interplanetary scavenger hunt when they learn that they are still bound together by an alien energy field.

9.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S09E05 - The Powers That Be
9.plot: SG-1 visits a world whose people once worshipped Vala as a god -- and demand that she stand trial when she confesses to manipulating them.

9.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S09E06 - Beachhead
9.plot: Samantha Carter returns to Stargate Command when the Ori seize control of a planet, using an expanding force field to gain a foothold in our galaxy.

9.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S09E07 - Ex Deus Machina
9.plot: SG-1 investigates when evidence suggests that there are still Goa'uld hiding on Earth -- including a former System Lord. Tensions between Earth and the Free Jaffa continue to mount.

9.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S09E08 - Babylon
9.plot: Colonel Mitchell is injured in a skirmish with a warrior from a mythic tribe of rebel Jaffa, and is trained in their fighting techniques only so that he may engage in a ritual battle to the death.

9.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S09E09 - Prototype
9.plot: SG-1 finds a genetically advanced Goa'uld-human hybrid created by Anubis, and returns him to Earth for study. But even keeping him alive may not be worth the risk.

9.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S09E10 - The Fourth Horseman (1)
9.plot: Earth is infected with a deadly Ori plague, prompting an ally from SG-1's past to come to their aid. Gerak proposes that the Free Jaffa follow the Ori religion.

9.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S09E11 - The Fourth Horseman (2)
9.plot: As the Ori plague spreads rapidly, SG-1 hopes that the Prior who caused the disease may hold the key to its cure. Gerak tries to rally the Jaffa to the Ori's cause, prompting Teal'c and Bra'tac to initiate a resistance.

9.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S09E12 - Collateral Damage
9.plot: When SG-1 travels to an Asgard Protected Planet, Colonel Mitchell is accused of a murder he did not commit.

9.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S09E13 - Ripple Effect
9.plot: Multiple SG-1s show up at Stargate Command, leading the "real" team to conclude that they have each been inadvertantly displaced from different parallel realities.

9.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S09E14 - Stronghold
9.plot: Baal kidnaps Teal'c as part of a plot to brainwash those Jaffa advocating a move toward democracy. Cameron Mitchell learns that an old friend is about to die.

9.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S09E15 - Ethon
9.plot: Daniel is imprisoned on a world under the influence of the Ori, and the Prometheus is caught in a firefight when SG-1 tries to rescue him.

9.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S09E16 - Off the Grid
9.plot: SG-1 is captured after a deal with the Lucian Alliance goes bad ... and the planet's Stargate goes missing. Meanwhile, a former System Lord attempts to rebuild his empire.

9.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S09E17 - The Scourge
9.plot: A tour of an off-world research base for a group of foreign diplomats turns dangerous when an insidious insect species gets loose.

9.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S09E18 - Arthur's Mantle
9.plot: Mitchell and Carter are shifted to another dimension, making them invisible to everyone at the S.G.C. Meanwhile, Teal'c and SG-9 discover that the Sodan have been brutally attacked.

9.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S09E19 - Crusade
9.plot: Vala Mal Doran makes contact with Stargate Command from the Ori home galaxy, and tells the story of her life undercover in a village of followers building the Ori's invasion fleet.

9.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S09E20 - Camelot
9.plot: SG-1 discovers the village of Camelot on an alien world, and must face Merlin's security system when they go in search of an Ancient weapon. Elsewhere, Earth and its allies assemble a fleet when a working Ori Supergate is discovered.

10.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S10E01 - Flesh and Blood
10.plot: As the Ori invade the Jaffa planet Chulak, Vala and Daniel must deal with their leader: Vala's young daughter, rapidly aged by the Ori to serve their purposes.

10.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S10E02 - Morpheus
10.plot: SG-1 investigates a problem off-world and soon finds that they have become victims themselves: they cannot stay awake. Meanwhile, Vala Mal Doran undergoes an evaluation on Earth, hoping to join SG-1.

10.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S10E03 - The Pegasus Project
10.plot: Daniel and Vala travel to Atlantis in search of Merlin's anti-Ori weapon, while Sam, and Mitchell join forces with Dr. McKay to lock out the Ori supergate.

10.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S10E04 - Insiders
10.plot: When Ba'al comes to Earth seeking help, Stargate Command must capture his clones and determine which one is the genuine article.

10.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S10E05 - Uninvited
10.plot: Teal'c discovers a world where people are being savagely attacked by an elusive creature, leading SG-1 to a stunning discovery about its potential origin.

10.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S10E06 - 200
10.plot: Martin Lloyd seeks out SG-1 for assistance when his failed TV show based on the real Stargate program becomes a feature film.

10.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S10E07 - Counterstrike
10.plot: The Jaffa take the fight to the Ori, using a genocidal weapon on their new worshipers and landing SG-1 in the middle of a war they can't control.

10.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S10E08 - Memento Mori
10.plot: Stricken with amnesia and on the run, Vala takes a job as a waitress as she tries to piece together who she is and what happened to her.

10.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S10E09 - Company of Thieves
10.plot: Cameron Mitchell must go undercover inside the deadly Lucian Alliance to prevent his teammates from becoming casualties of an Alliance civil war.

10.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S10E10 - The Quest (1)
10.plot: SG-1 races against Baal in the hunt to find the Sangraal, Merlin's anti-Ori weapon, and comes up against a series of ancient trials.

10.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S10E11 - The Quest (2)
10.plot: When the team finds Merlin himself, they must help him complete the Sangraal weapon before Adria and her Ori forces can track them down.

10.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S10E12 - Line in the Sand
10.plot: SG-1 tries to defend a planet from the Ori by hiding its people in another dimension. Vala attempts to convince her husband Tomin of the Ori's true motives.

10.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S10E13 - The Road Not Taken
10.plot: An experiment gone wrong pulls Samantha Carter into a parallel reality, where she must save Earth from an Ori assault before she will be allowed to return home.

10.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S10E14 - The Shroud
10.plot: When SG-1 discovers that Daniel Jackson has been turned into a Prior of the Ori, they must determine whether or not his plan to destroy the Ori is genuine.

10.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S10E15 - Bounty
10.plot: When the Lucian Alliance puts a bounty on SG-1's heads, Cameron Mitchell finds himself a target while attending his high school reunion.

10.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S10E16 - Bad Guys
10.plot: SG-1 realizes they have stepped through the gate into another planet's museum -- but are mistaken for a band of zealous rebels who have taken hostages.

10.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S10E17 - Talion
10.plot: When a terrorist attack decimates a Jaffa summit Teal'c strikes out on a quest for revenge, believing that the perpetrator is one of his own pupils.

10.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S10E18 - Family Ties
10.plot: Earth provides sanctuary for Vala's estranged, con artist father after he provides intel about a Jaffa plot to attack the planet.

10.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S10E19 - Dominion
10.plot: SG-1 hatches an elaborate plan to try and capture Adria, using Vala as bait.

10.title: FR - Stargate SG-1 - S10E20 - Unending
10.plot: Trapped on board the Odyssey, the members of SG-1 must live out the rest of their lives together when Carter activates a time dilation field to save the ship from destruction.

meta.plot: The story of Stargate SG-1 begins about a year after the events of the feature film, when the United States government learns that an ancient alien device called the Stargate can access a network of such devices on a multitude of planets. SG-1 is an elite Air Force special operations team, one of more than two dozen teams from Earth who explore the galaxy and defend against alien threats such as the Goa'uld, Replicators, and the Ori.

meta.plot: The Darling family's obscene wealth and enormous power makes them easy  targets for their rivals, enemies, and the tabloids. Patriarch Tripp  uses his money and influence to shield his five adult children from the  prying eyes of the world. As the Darlings' reluctant personal lawyer,  Nick George has barely begun to discover the legal - and illegal - needs  of the family. Blackmail threats. Questionable deals. Illegitimate  children. A chronicle of the lives of the aristocratic Crawley family and their servants in the post-Edwardian era—with great events in history having an effect on their lives and on the British social hierarchy.

1.title: FR - Downton Abbey - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: After the death of the heir, Violet wishes that Robert's daughter Mary could inherit Downton Abbey.

1.title: FR - Downton Abbey - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Matthew Crawley and his mother Isobel arrive at Downton, and have difficulty settling in. Carson is mortified when confronted by his past. Violet attempts to promote a match between Matthew and Mary. Isobel is elected to serve on the hospital board.

1.title: FR - Downton Abbey - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Cora's tries to set up Mary with Evelyn Napier, who falls for his friend instead, with significant consequences for the household. Bates takes action to help cure his limp.

1.title: FR - Downton Abbey - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Mrs Hughes finds herself the focus of speculation when she meets a former suitor who makes her question her position. Violet and Isobel clash over a medical ailment affecting Molesley. Carson is concerned there is a thief at work in the grounds.

1.title: FR - Downton Abbey - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Isobel finds herself at odds with Violet. Mary is introduced to a potential suitor but wants to be with Matthew. Anna works out who stole a valuable snuff box. O'Brien plans a way for Edith to get even with Mary.

1.title: FR - Downton Abbey - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Sybil puts herself in danger when a fight breaks out. Sybil's sisters notice Matthew's feelings for her. Mary is surprised by a marriage proposal. Bates clears his name over the missing wine but resigns rather than name the real culprit.

1.title: FR - Downton Abbey - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Cora's pregnancy throws the inheritance issue into doubt. Matthew must  wait for an answer to his wedding proposal. O'Brien discovers more compromising information about Bates. Thomas leaves.

2.title: FR - Downton Abbey - S02E02 - Episode 2
2.plot: Carson is finding it tough maintaining standards in the house, and the suicide of a young officer prompts Isobel to suggest converting Downton Abbey into a convalescent hospital.

2.title: FR - Downton Abbey - S02E03 - Episode 3
2.plot: After Downton is turned into a convalescent home for wounded officers, Matthew brings a general to visit, but Branson has a surprise in store. And is Lavinia hiding something?

2.plot: Tensions flare between Isobel and Cora. Ethel's flirtation with Major Bryant lands her in hot water. There is worrying news about Matthew. Branson declares his feelings for Sybil.

2.title: FR - Downton Abbey - S02E05 - Episode 5
2.plot: Robert receives some shocking news from the front. Daisy's relationship with William moves faster than she would like. Vera threatens to expose old secrets.

2.title: FR - Downton Abbey - S02E06 - Episode 6
2.plot: Carlisle threatens to ruin Mary if she jilts him. A major comes to stay - but is he really who he claims to be? Bates learns that Vera has succeeded in scuppering the divorce.

2.title: FR - Downton Abbey - S02E07 - Episode 7
2.plot: How long can Sybil and Branson keep their secret? Carlisle puts Anna in a difficult position, Bates is left reeling from the news about Vera, and Thomas embarks on a new scheme.

3.title: FR - Downton Abbey - S03E01 - Episode 1
3.plot: Cora’s mother sweeps into Downton for Matthew and Mary’s wedding, but with the couple’s relationship under strain will they even make it to the altar? New footman Alfred strives to meet Carson’s high standards, under the watchful eye of his aunt O’Brien. Robert’s shocking news brings financial worries to the fore, on an unprecedented scale. Might he lose Downton itself and all it stands for?

3.title: FR - Downton Abbey - S03E02 - Episode 2
3.plot: The estate's future is hanging in the balance and Mary is hoping to receive a bailout from grandmother Martha. Violet also attempts to help her make sure that Downton puts on a bigger show than ever before with a grand party for friends and neighbours. Mrs Hughes gets some news that worries her. O'Brien's attempts to boost Alfred's progress are met with disapproval from Thomas.

3.title: FR - Downton Abbey - S03E03 - Episode 3
3.plot: Edith's wedding day arrives but will her enthusiasm be able to convince the family that Strallan's age doesn't really matter. Mrs Hughes awaits her results. Anna manages to make a breakthrough as she tries to help Bates. Mary decides to take matters into her own hands to secure the estate's future.

3.title: FR - Downton Abbey - S03E04 - Episode 4
3.plot: Branson's political views manage to get him into trouble while Sybil's loyalty is tested to the limit. Ethel finds herself being torn between head and heart as she makes a decision about her son's future. Anna is upset by Bates's silence and wonders what could be the cause. Carson looks for a new footman and a good-looking candidate called Jimmy creates interest below stairs.

3.title: FR - Downton Abbey - S03E05 - Episode 5
3.plot: An exciting offer for Edith divides opinion in the house. Isobel ends up throwing Ethel a lifeline. Ivy is attracting plenty of attention below stairs. Anna’s perseverance finally pays off for her.

3.title: FR - Downton Abbey - S03E06 - Episode 6
3.plot: Tempers are left on edge after a kind gesture by Isobel backfires. Mary attempts to fight Branson's corner after his decisions are put under scrutiny. Robert and Cora's relationship feels the strain and Violet attempts to make them see things differently. Some extreme measures are taken by Bates.

3.title: FR - Downton Abbey - S03E07 - Episode 7
3.plot: It's a good day as Anna's patience is rewarded and Edith gets some admiration from an unexpected quarter. Matthew refuses to back down over the estate management. Branson's plan for the christening causes some consternation, as does the sudden arrival of his brother.

3.title: FR - Downton Abbey - S03E08 - Episode 8

Thomas finds out that his future lies in Carson's hands.

3.title: FR - Downton Abbey - S03E09 -

4.title: FR - Downton Abbey - S04E04 - Episode 4
4.plot: Amid the fallout from the eventful house party, Mary faces a pressing question about her future. Carson reveals surprisingly intimate details of his former life, and a trip to the bright lights of London sees Rose put the reputation of the Crawleys in jeopardy.

4.title: FR - Downton Abbey - S04E05 - Episode 5

4.title: FR - Downton Abbey - S04E06 - Episode 6
4.plot: A birthday party is planned for Robert, but Rose's surprise contribution to the event ruffles feathers above and below stairs. A new farming venture on the Downton estate comes with dramatic repercussions for Mary, and Edith receives more unwelcome news.

4.title: FR - Downton Abbey - S04E07 - Episode 7

Blake and Mary are forced to put aside their differences to deal with a new farming venture on the estate. When Violet is taken ill, help comes from an unlikely quarter. In spite of Mrs Hughes, Mrs Patmore and Carson's attempts to keep the peace, romantic tensions below stairs cause problems.

4.title: FR - Downton Abbey - S04E08 - Episode 8
