Isobel is the object of someone's attention, while Mary asks Gillingham for a favour. Rose is frustrated when things do not go her way and Alfred realises too late that he may have made a mistake. Just as Bates and Anna seem to be getting over the worst, some unexpected news shakes her up.

4.title: FR - Downton Abbey - S04E09 -

5.title: FR - Downton Abbey - S05E01 - Episode 1
5.plot: The story moves on to 1924, when the first ever Labour government heralds a sea change that is felt throughout the nation - nowhere more so than at Downton. A suggested plan for a war memorial unexpectedly pits Carson against Robert and Mrs Hughes. Young Jimmy the footman is the object of some unwanted female attention. Thomas gives Baxter an ultimatum. Branson's growing friendship with someone Robert considers quite unsuitable causes concern. After the tragedy she has been through, Lady Mary now seems ready to find love once more. Cracks appear in Edith and Tim Drewe's special arrangement as she struggles to keep her emotions in check - something which may have disastrous consequences for the entire household.

5.title: FR - Downton Abbey - S05E02 - Episode 2
5.plot: With the house recovering from the night’s dramatic events, Robert is faced with a very difficult decision. As Daisy continues to struggle with her studies, Mrs Patmore has an idea which might solve everything. Thomas has it in for Baxter. As Rose tries to convince Robert of the virtues of a wireless at Downton, Lord Merton continues his hot pursuit of Isobel. When Mary puts her reputation on the line, Anna is made a reluctant accomplice.

5.title: FR - Downton Abbey - S05E03 - Episode 3
5.plot: Mary's secret assignation is very nearly blown, but Violet's quick thinking saves the day. Robert is left red faced and furious when things do not go as planned. The events surrounding Green's death come under scrutiny once again. Mrs Patmore is devastated when old wounds are reopened but Carson is unsympathetic. Branson receives an interesting proposition concerning the future of the Downton estate. A figure from Violet's distant past suggests she has buried secrets of her own.

5.title: FR - Downton Abbey - S05E04 - Episode 4
5.plot: Sarah Bunting continues to cause waves above stairs, but this time she may have gone too far. On returning to Downton, Thomas suffers an inexplicable illness and Baxter suspects there’s more to it than he’s letting on. Violet reveals to Isobel the surprising truth of her past with Prince Kuragin. Mary comes to a decision concerning Lord Gillingham, but things don’t go quite as planned. When Rose’s father returns to Downton, he breaks news that will shock the whole family.

5.title: FR - Downton Abbey - S05E05 - Episode 5
5.plot: Simon Bricker returns to Downton to discuss the painting with Cora. Branson makes a difficult decision about Sarah Bunting. Rose encounters a handsome stranger. Determined to stop Isobel making the wrong decision about Lord Merton, Violet enlists the help of Doctor Clarkson. Charles Blake surprises Mary with a cunning plan to help her get exactly what she wants. Mrs Patmore seeks Carson's advice on a financial matter. Inspector Vyner returns with some ominous words of warning for Anna.

5.title: FR - Downton Abbey - S05E06 - Episode 6
5.plot: Relations between Robert and Cora continue to be strained. Blake's scheming starts to come to fruition when Mary is unexpectedly pitted against her love rival. Edith receives some terrible news and decides to take drastic action. Following a mysterious tip off, Baxter becomes embroiled in the investigation of Green's death. Thomas' condition deteriorates, prompting him to finally reveal the truth to Baxter. Love is in the air for more than one member of the Crawley family.

5.title: FR - Downton Abbey - S05E07 - Episode 7
5.plot: Rosamund shows up at Downton following Edith's surprise departure. Rose is pleased to introduce Atticus and his parents to everyone. Anna and Bates think about a fresh start, now that that their problems seem to be behind them. Molesley is worried after Daisy becoming disillusioned with her studies. Mary and Blake seize a chance to send Gillingham a strong message.

5.title: FR - Downton Abbey - S05E08 - Episode 8
5.plot: Preparations are under way for Rose's wedding, but family tensions on both sides threaten to derail proceedings. Edith's arrangement with Marigold is happily working out, but how long can she and Cora conceal the truth from Robert? Denker reveals an unexpected side to her personality, which causes trouble for more than one of the servants. With the war memorial due to be unveiled, Mrs Patmore is still upset, but Robert has something up his sleeve. Branson comes to a heart-wrenching decision, and the storm clouds that have been gathering over Anna and Bates finally burst.

Molesley and Daisy rise to the challenges of examination day, Andy's secret is brought to light, Thomas feels isolated, and Mrs Patmore and Mrs Hughes teach Carson a lesson.

1.title: FR - Ourika - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: In a Paris suburb, Moussa Jebli, a successful cannabis trafficker, sees his shipment seized by the drug enforcement authorities. His whole family is swept up in his downfall, including his younger brother, Driss, a brilliant student who has always kept his distance from the family business. Opposite them, William, a newly transferred young cop, discovers the rules of the police game.

1.title: FR - Ourika - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Moussa's arrest has set the neighborhood on fire. William realises the consequences of his actions and tries to redeem himself in the eyes of his colleagues. Driss finds himself threatened by his brother's creditors and turns to his childhood friends to find a solution. In prison, Moussa has to deal with old acquaintances.

1.title: FR - Ourika - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: William confesses to his colleague Taz that he has been duped by his informant. They decide to follow him, only to find themselves in Driss's path. Forced to sell the cocaine stolen in the robbery, the young student begins dealing at Parisian parties, under the reproachful gaze of his girlfriend Inès.

1.title: FR - Ourika - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: The Jebli family heads to Morocco to win back the trust of their uncles, who produce the cannabis in the Rif mountains. William and Racheton, the head of the drug squad, are hot on their trail. But political intrigue thwarts the plans of both the police and the dealers.

1.title: FR - Ourika - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: After the tragedy at the ambassador's reception, Racheton and William must return to France. Defying his superiors, William stays in Morocco to continue tracking down the Jebli family. Driss is determined to take revenge on the Benali son and regain control of the family land himself, at the expense of his uncles, who are not pleased with this power grab.

1.title: FR - Ourika - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Thanks to their alliance, Driss and William rise to power in their respective circles. William shines in the drug squad, making one record seizure after another, creating jealousy between the various law enforcement services. Driss is flooding the market with his product, while his clients are dropping off one by one. Left in the dark, Moussa becomes suspicious of his brother's spectacular rise.

1.title: FR - Ourika - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Driss, blinded by his hunger for revenge, has finally managed to track down Benali. But following Moussa's information, the Customs raid his home. Racheton and William are compromised and will do anything to protect themselves. William must now go all the way to arrest his former ally.

meta.plot: En 2005, dans une cité française, une saisie des Stups bouleverse le réseau d’une famille de trafiquants. Driss, étudiant brillant, se voit contraint de reprendre le business familial, s’engageant dans une spirale infernale. Face à lui William, jeune flic ambitieux et idéaliste, va tout faire pour l'en empêcher. Cette lutte effrénée les emmènera des cités de banlieue à la vallée de l'Ourika.

1.title: FR - The Baxters - S01E01 - Under the Surface
1.plot: A celebratory Mother's Day for the Baxter family's matriarch, Elizabeth, is disrupted when one of her daughters, Kari, discovers a shocking revelation about her husband, Tim.

1.plot: Looking for comfort from family and friends, Kari moves back home with her parents. Tim looks to deepen his relationship with Angela. While at home, Kari learns that her first love, Ryan, has moved back to town.

1.title: FR - The Baxters - S01E03 - Irreconcilable Differences
1.plot: Dirk confronts Angela about her affair. Tim attempts to give Kari divorce paperwork, but Elizabeth intercepts it. Determined to save her marriage, Kari reveals an unexpected truth to Tim that could change their lives forever.

1.title: FR - The Baxters - S01E04 - In Hindsight
1.plot: After Kari reveals her pregnancy to Tim, Angela shows her frustration at the lack of progress in his divorce. Dirk continues to obsess over Angela. Kari spends the day with Ryan. John shares a profound message of hope for Elizabeth and his family.

1.title: FR - The Baxters - S01E05 - In the Heat Of
1.plot: Tim's drinking spirals out of control. Luke invites Reagan to the Baxter family home for a pool date. Ashley has an unexpected run-in with an old crush from high school and Kari looks to her mom for advice on her marriage.

1.title: FR - The Baxters - S01E06 - For Better or Worse
1.plot: Kari and Tim decide to work on fixing their marriage. Luke and Reagan continue their courtship. Ryan gets an unexpected coaching opportunity that would take him away from Kari. Elizabeth sees an old friend with ties to Ashley's traumatic past.

1.title: FR - The Baxters - S01E07 - Old Wounds
1.plot: Five months have passed. Kari and Tim are in marriage counseling. Luke plans a fundraiser at church, but when Ashley unexpectedly arrives, old family wounds are reopened. Dirk's obsession with Angela and Tim takes a dangerous turn.

1.title: FR - The Baxters - S01E08 - Food for Thought
1.plot: The Baxter family Thanksgiving is full of food and football with a side of drama. After showing up late to dinner, Ashley is confronted by her family. Luke tells Reagan about his best friend's tragic death while Kari and Tim share good news.

1.title: FR - The Baxters - S01E09 - Justin D. James & Jessie Rosen
1.plot: As Christmas approaches, Luke seeks reconciliation with his sister, but Ashley's past haunts her. Kari and Tim's marital bond grows stronger as Tim celebrates six months of sobriety, but an unforeseen event could shatter everything.

1.title: FR - The Baxters - S01E10 - A Guide to Guilt
1.plot: Ashley tells Elizabeth and John about the guilt tied to her involvement in Colton Ashford’s death. Elizabeth celebrates the completion of the church nursery. Meanwhile, Dirk holds Kari and a guest hostage in her home.

2.title: FR - The Baxters - S02E01 - Blank Canvas
2.plot: Kari visits Tim's grave with their three-month-old daughter, Jessie. Ashley takes advice from Elizabeth and Erica regarding a job interview. John and Brooke fight to save the life of a close family friend.

2.title: FR - The Baxters - S02E02 - The Easy Part
2.plot: Elizabeth and Erin finish the new nursery. Ashley starts her new job, but a troublesome manager makes her first day difficult. Luke and Reagan discuss meeting Reagan’s family. Back at the hospital, Landon continues to fight for his life.

2.title: FR - The Baxters - S02E03 - Erin's Birthday
2.plot: The Baxters prepare for Erin's birthday party. Now that Landon has miraculously recovered, he and Ashley have a difficult conversation. Kari and Ryan are in regular contact, while Erin and her husband Sam share unexpected news at the birthday party.

2.title: FR - The Baxters - S02E04 - One Step Forward
2.plot: Elizabeth's nursery project at the church pays off, with new families touring the space. At Tim's grave, Kari makes a monumental decision. Ashley speaks up at work and reaches out to Landon for one last chat before he moves to California.

2.title: FR - The Baxters - S02E05 - Memory Box
2.plot: Ashley attempts a kind gesture for one of her patients, but her manager, Belinda, rebukes her efforts. Luke and Reagan go bowling with her dad, and an unexpected visitor interrupts their cheerful outing. Kari makes a bold move to reconnect with Ryan.

2.title: FR - The Baxters - S02E06 - Allure
2.plot: As Luke and Reagan's relationship grows deeper, Luke has a crisis of faith. Ashley and Landon work on their friendship but discover that keeping things platonic isn't easy. On a seemingly normal Sunday at church, something unimaginable happens.

2.title: FR - The Baxters - S02E07 - When the Smoke Clears
2.plot: The Baxter family is in turmoil as they try to understand the tragedy at their church. John helps the paramedics and victims while Reagan begins to pull away from Luke. Ashley finds comfort with one of her patients at the care facility.

2.title: FR - The Baxters - S02E08 - Paris
2.plot: The Baxters are recovering from the tragic tragedy at church. John considers building a monument to honor the dead. Luke tries to restore his relationship with Reagan, and Ryan considers staying in town to help John and Kari at the church.

2.title: FR - The Baxters - S02E09 - Broken Pieces
2.plot: John works on the church's memorial garden. Ashley discovers a shocking truth about her manager, Belinda. Landon is frustrated with Ashley for not opening up about her past. Ryan shares a secret he’s been keeping from Kari.

2.title: FR - The Baxters - S02E10 - Say a Little Prayer
2.plot: Kari confronts Ashley about kissing Ryan. Luke and Lori's relationship takes an unexpected turn. Ashley speaks with her former boss about Belinda’s deception. Kari's marriage counseling service at church gets its first participant.

2.title: FR - The Baxters - S02E11 - Waiting for Wings
2.plot: Erin takes Kari's advice as she works on her marriage with Sam. Luke considers leaving home after he's confronted by Elizabeth and John. Kari and Ryan look to mend their relationship, and Ashley has a surprise for the patients and their families.

2.title: FR - The Baxters - S02E12 - It's Not Perfect
2.plot: Ashley helps Landon prep for his big move and shares a traumatic event from her past. Elizabeth asks Luke to attend the memorial garden's dedication ceremony at church. Reagan has been keeping a life-changing secret.

3.title: FR - The Baxters - S03E01 - New Beginnings
3.plot: John and Elizabeth sell their house. Kari prepares for Jessie's first birthday. Ashley misses Landon, who is battling fires in California. Luke is living with Lori, but it's trouble in paradise for the young couple.

3.title: FR - The Baxters - S03E02 - Cautionary Tale
3.plot: Landon spends time with Reagan in the hospital. Kari goes wedding dress shopping. Ashley moves forward with painting and looks for opportunities out West. Luke's life unravels, and John meets a Vietnam veteran who shares a valuable lesson.

3.title: FR - The Baxters - S03E03 - A Sisters Trip
3.plot: With the pressures of planning a wedding mounting, Kari joins Ashley on her trip to California. Landon spends time with Reagan as she struggles to cope with being a single mom. Pregnant and scared to tell Luke the truth, Lori reaches out for help.

3.title: FR - The Baxters - S03E04 - The Moment of Truth
3.plot: Ashley confronts Landon about what she saw in the park. Kari makes a shocking discovery. Luke approaches Lori about the lies she's been telling him. Later, Lori falls ill and is taken to the hospital under John’s care.

3.title: FR - The Baxters - S03E05 - A Step Forward
3.plot: Struggling with the responsibilities of being a single mom, Reagan confides in Kari. Ashley and Landon attend a trendy art gallery event in Los Angeles. Elizabeth and John's efforts to reconnect with Luke have failed, so Ryan makes one last attempt.

3.title: FR - The Baxters - S03E06 - Unexpected Guest
3.plot: After recovering from her infection, Lori visits Elizabeth to confess a secret. Kari and Tim look at wedding venues. Ashley gives something to Luke that might help him find his way back to God. In California, Landon makes a life-changing decision.

3.title: FR - The Baxters - S03E07 - Grief and Joy
3.plot: On the anniversary of Tim's passing and Jessie's first birthday, Kari debates whether to tell Tim's mom about her engagement. Elizabeth and Lori continue to bond. Erin seeks guidance about starting a family. Ashley gets a disturbing call from Paris.

3.title: FR - The Baxters - S03E08 - A Protest
3.plot: Lori returns home to work things out with Luke. The Baxters attend a community service project after church. Ashley receives more mysterious calls from Paris. When Luke and Lori attend a protest rally, everything spirals out of control.

1.plot: Lady Hamilton wants to make changes and Garland is in her sights. The hotel manager insists he's not worried and that he just needs to show how indispensable he is, but Peggy and Feldman aren't so sure. Charity meets Joe and reveals her plans for revenge, but he refuses to help her. Emma and Betsey hit the town.

1.title: FR - The Halcyon, un palace dans la tourmente - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: In the wake of the fall of France to the Germans, guests flood into the hotel, including one who catches Lady Hamilton's eye - the Comte de St Claire. Peggy worries about Billy's enthusiasm to sign up as soon as he turns 18, but knows there is little she can do to protect him. When Max faces hostility from the staff, Emma goes out on a limb to defend him - and immediately regrets it.

1.title: FR - The Halcyon, un palace dans la tourmente - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Joe is offered the opportunity of a lifetime, but finds himself unexpectedly torn as the moral responsibility of staying in England to tell the story of the war weighs heavily on his shoulders. Betsey's mother comes for a surprise stay, leaving Sonny unsettled and wary of the reaction she incites from Betsey, while Lucian and Lady Hamilton continue their flirtation and Emma anxiously awaits news of Freddie when she hears that a plane from Squadron 392 has gone down.

1.title: FR - The Halcyon, un palace dans la tourmente - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Emma is in charge of the hotel and is put to the test hosting a society wedding for Lady Hamilton's friends the Ashworths. Celina Radimsky comes to the hotel to meet Freddie, who tries to offer consolation after her husband's death. Garland goes to the East End to help Peggy with some housekeeping, but has an encounter with a figure from his past while waiting outside a shop.

1.title: FR - The Halcyon, un palace dans la tourmente - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Garland asks Emma to take over running the celebrations for the 50th anniversary of the hotel, and Betsey catches the eye of a handsome man in the bar. Meanwhile MI5 officers arrive with a warrant to search the premises.

1.title: FR - The Halcyon, un palace dans la tourmente - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: The Halcyon celebrates its 50th anniversary. Lucian struggles to keep things in order as the pressure mounts. Garland and Lady Hamilton find a cause together.

meta.plot: Covert operative Tom Keen joins forces with Susan "Scottie" Hargrave, the brilliant and cunning chief of a covert mercenary organization that solves problems that are too dangerous for the government.

1.title: FR - The Blacklist: Redemption - S01E01 - Leland Bray
1.plot: A routine trip to New York turns perilous when ex-operative Tom Keen is recruited by a mercenary chief to help rescue a kidnapped CIA agent.

1.title: FR - The Blacklist: Redemption - S01E02 - Kevin Jensen
1.plot: The Halcyon team scrambles to rescue Scottie's close family friend after he's falsely arrested for espionage in a dangerous foreign country.

1.title: FR - The Blacklist: Redemption - S01E03 - Independence, U.S.A.
1.plot: A plane crash in the Ural Mountains sends Tom and Nez to Russia on a covert operation to infiltrate a mysterious, top-secret military facility. Scottie enlists Mr. Solomon to find answers about her husband.

1.title: FR - The Blacklist: Redemption - S01E04 - Operation Davenport
1.plot: When ruthless terrorists escape from a "black site'' prison in Manhattan, Tom and the Halycon team must lock down the city and find the terrorists before disaster strikes.

1.title: FR - The Blacklist: Redemption - S01E05 - Borealis 301
1.plot: Tom and Mr. Solomon go under cover on an international flight that they believe will be hijacked by a ring of ruthless thieves who steal classified material. Howard urges Tom to find proof of a conspiracy orchestrated by Scottie.

1.title: FR - The Blacklist: Redemption - S01E06 - Hostages
1.plot: When a wealthy businessman, his wife and young son are abducted by professional kidnappers, the Halcyon team is tasked to get the family back. But with time running out, the team must make a dangerous choice. Meanwhile, Tom risks exposure to save Howard from Scottie.

1.title: FR - The Blacklist: Redemption - S01E07 - Whitehall (1)
1.plot: Tensions escalate between Scottie and Howard forcing Tom to reach out to an unexpected ally for help. As explosive family secrets come to light, Tom races against time to learn the truth about Whitehall.

1.title: FR - The Blacklist: Redemption - S01E08 - Whitehall: Conclusion (2)
1.plot: In the explosive season finale, Scottie and Howard battle for control of Halcyon and the dangerous technology tied to Whitehall. Tom clashes with Mr. Solomon as he makes a fateful choice.

1.title: FR - L'Atelier de Justin - S01E01 - Justin's Biggest Fan
1.plot: Teams are challenged with designing and putting their own unique take on Little Free Libraries.

1.title: FR - L'Atelier de Justin - S01E02 - Hole in Won
1.plot: Teams are challenged with designing and building their very own mini-golf holes.

1.title: FR - L'Atelier de Justin - S01E03 - Ramps & Champs
1.plot: Teams are challenged with turning iconic school items into skate park obstacles.

1.title: FR - L'Atelier de Justin - S01E04 - Bridge or Bust
1.plot: The fourth episode of Disney’s Shop Class sees three teams of young builders, who are tasked with designing, building, and testing a bridge.

1.title: FR - L'Atelier de Justin - S01E05 - Boulder Bash
1.plot: Teams are challenged with putting a modern twist on the classic picnic table.

1.title: FR - L'Atelier de Justin - S01E06 - Downhill Derby
1.plot: Teams are challenged with designing and building supersized downhill derby racers.

1.title: FR - L'Atelier de Justin - S01E07 - Ready for Launch
1.plot: Six semi-final teams build and launch spacecrafts capable of transporting egg payloads.

1.title: FR - L'Atelier de Justin - S01E08 - Build Your Own Adventure
1.plot: The finalists vie for the title “Shop Class Champs” by building contemporary backyard forts.

meta.plot: Un nouveau jeu où des élèves plein d’imagination sont chargés de concevoir, construire et tester de nouvelles machines. Dans chaque épisode, un groupe de spécialistes évalue leur travail sur les critères suivants : ingénierie, conception et ultime prototype. Les finalistes, révélés dans le dernier épisode, seront sacrés "champions de l’atelier".

1.title: FR - Dallas - S01E01 - Digger's Daughter
1.plot: Bobby has a wife, and no one in the house of Ewing wants her there. Pamela Barnes is the daughter of the most hated man in Jock's history, Digger. This marriage of Bobby and Pam should have ended the Barnes-Ewing Feud, but it only served to escalate it.

1.title: FR - Dallas - S01E02 - The Lesson
1.plot: Lucy is playing hooky, and the only person who will make sure she gets to school is her new aunt, Pam. But Lucy finds a new way to get out of school, a phony sexual harassment case against her principal. It works, but Lucy soon becomes a victim of her lies as Roger sees the whole thing and blackmails Lucy. He can clear the principal's name, but only if Lucy "satisfies" him.

1.title: FR - Dallas - S01E03 - Spy in the House
1.plot: Pam's brother, Cliff, is unhappy about her getting married to a Ewing. Cliff ends up with a document Pam was supposed to give to Ewing Oil.

1.title: FR - Dallas - S01E04 - Winds of Vengeance
1.plot: Trouble occurs in the House of Ewing, when J.R.'s affair reaches the wrong men.

1.title: FR - Dallas - S01E05 - Barbecue
1.plot: It's time for the annual Ewing Barbecue (where the Ewings feed half of Texas) but there is an unexpected guest, Digger Barnes. But this guest comes alongside unexpected news, Pam's pregnant!

2.title: FR - Dallas - S02E01 - Reunion (1)
2.plot: The Ewing family is complete when Bobby and Pam find Gary, the long-lost third Ewing brother. But J.R. has other plans: Get Gary out of the house. Something happens to only strengthen the bond between the family and Gary, Lucy brings her mother back to Southfork

2.title: FR - Dallas - S02E02 - Reunion (2)
2.plot: JR is frustrated with Gary back, and even more so with the return of Val, but he soon gets his way, as JR often does.

2.title: FR - Dallas - S02E03 - Old Acquaintance
2.plot: Jenna Wade, Bobby's ex-girlfriend, arrives in Dallas seeking Bobby's help.  Meanwhile, J.R. hopes that Pam's jealousy will make her decide to leave Dallas.

2.title: FR - Dallas - S02E04 - Bypass
2.plot: Jock suffers a heart attack and must undergo bypass surgery to survive. Meanwhile, Bobby is sceptical of J.R.'s business ideas.

2.title: FR - Dallas - S02E05 - Black Market Baby
2.plot: Worried about not being able to produce a Ewing heir before Pamela does, Sue Ellen decides to pursue illegal adoption.

2.title: FR - Dallas - S02E06 - Double Wedding
2.plot: Pam is thrown for a loop when her ex-husband arrives in Dallas claiming they are still legally married.  Upon hearing this, J.R. decides to use it to his advantage.

2.title: FR - Dallas - S02E07 - Runaway
2.plot: It's Lucy's birthday, but after a fight with Jock, she runs away from home.

2.title: FR - Dallas - S02E08 - Election
2.plot: J.R. tries to stop Cliff Barnes from running for state senate and gets help in doing so from Pamela.

2.title: FR - Dallas - S02E09 - Survival
2.plot: Sue Ellen and Pamela fear the worst about their husbands when they receive news that the Ewing Oil plane has crashed.

2.title: FR - Dallas - S02E10 - Act of Love
2.plot: Sue Ellen is devastated when after having an affair with Cliff, she learns she's pregnant and does not know who the father is.

2.title: FR - Dallas - S02E11 - Triangle
2.plot: A love triangle emerges when Ray decides to pop the question to Garnett McGee, a country singer, but she falls for J.R. when he lands her a recording contract.

2.title: FR - Dallas - S02E12 - Fallen Idol
2.plot: Guzzler, an old friend of Bobby's arrives in Dallas and the two decide to do business together by opening a shopping mall in Southfork.  However, the rest of the Ewings are strongly against their plan.

2.title: FR - Dallas - S02E13 - Kidnapped
2.plot: When Bobby is kidnapped, J.R. and Ray come together to stage a rescue.

2.title: FR - Dallas - S02E14 - Home Again
2.plot: Miss Ellie is beyond belief when her brother, Garrison, who has been presumed dead for several years, returns to Southfork very much alive.

2.title: FR - Dallas - S02E15 - For Love or Money
2.plot: When J.R. strays from his marriage once again, Sue Ellen leaves Southfork to stay with her mother and sister.

2.title: FR - Dallas - S02E16 - Julie's Return
2.plot: Jock gets back together with Julie, his former secretary, who doesn't treat him nice because of his heart attack.

2.title: FR - Dallas - S02E17 - The Red File (1)
2.plot: J.R. has Cliff arrested for murder when Julie is found dead.

2.title: FR - Dallas - S02E18 - The Red File (2)
2.plot: Pamela is convinced J.R. framed Cliff for Julie's death so Bobby sets out to find out what really caused Julie's death.

2.title: FR - Dallas - S02E19 - Sue Ellen's Sister
2.plot: While Pamela is out of town, Kristin tries to seduce Bobby.

2.title: FR - Dallas - S02E20 - Call Girl
2.plot: J.R. finds the perfect opportunity to make Pam look bad after she becomes friends with a former call girl.

2.title: FR - Dallas - S02E21 - Royal Marriage
2.plot: J.R. believes he can create a business dynasty when Lucy announces that she is engaged to the son of a Texas oil family.

2.title: FR - Dallas - S02E22 - The Outsiders
2.plot: Ray falls for Donna McCullum and J.R. uses the fact that Donna is married to Senator Sam Culver in his plot to stop Cliff.

2.title: FR - Dallas - S02E23 - John Ewing III (1)
2.plot: J.R. becomes worried when Sue Ellen begins to drink while she is pregnant.  Lucy also begins to head down a path of self-destruction when she begins to take drugs after her engagement falls apart.

2.title: FR - Dallas - S02E24 - John Ewing III (2)
2.plot: Due to her erratic behavior and alcoholism, Sue Ellen is sent to a sanitarium.  When she is able to escape, Sue Ellen delivers her baby following a near-death experience.  Meanwhile, Bobby begins to suspect that Cliff is the father of Sue Ellen's baby.

3.title: FR - Dallas - S03E01 - Whatever Happened to Baby John? (1)
3.plot: Sue Ellen suffers post-partum depression and becomes disinterested in her newborn child.  Meanwhile, Cliff claims that John Ross is his son.

3.title: FR - Dallas - S03E02 - Whatever Happened to Baby John? (2)
3.plot: Bobby suspects that Cliff is to blame when John Ross goes missing.  Meanwhile, J.R. receives a 1 million dollar ransom demand.

3.title: FR - Dallas - S03E03 - The Silent Killer
3.plot: When it is uncovered that Digger has a fatal genetic disorder, Cliff worries that he may have passed on the faulty gene to John Ross if indeed he is the father.

3.title: FR - Dallas - S03E04 - Secrets
3.plot: As Pam decides to not tell Bobby she's pregnant due to the family's genetic disorder, Val tries to convince Bobby to have Lucy meet with her.

3.title: FR - Dallas - S03E05 - The Kristin Affair
3.plot: Kristin begins to pursue J.R. romantically after he gives her a summer job in his office.  Meanwhile, Bobby learns the truth that Pam is pregnant before she makes a decision about having an abortion due to the risk of genetic defect.

3.title: FR - Dallas - S03E06 - The Dove Hunt
3.plot: J.R. and Jock are both shot by a sniper when a man seeks revenge on the Ewing family during a hunting trip in Louisiana.

3.title: FR - Dallas - S03E07 - The Lost Child
3.plot: As Bobby bonds with the ranch hand's son, Pam informs him that their unborn child may have a fatal genetic defect.  Meanwhile, J.R. hires a man to tail Sue Ellen.

3.title: FR - Dallas - S03E08 - Rodeo
3.plot: At the annual Ewing rodeo, Sue Ellen develops a crush on Dusty Farlow, a cowboy, and Digger uses the event to find time to see John Ross.

3.title: FR - Dallas - S03E09 - Mastectomy (1)
3.plot: Miss Ellie worries that her marriage will fall apart when she believes she has breast cancer.  Meanwhile, Sue Ellen has a fling with Dusty, the cowboy; and Alan furthers J.R.'s plan.

3.title: FR - Dallas - S03E10 - Mastectomy (2)
3.plot: Miss Ellie must cope with Jock and Lucy's poor reaction to her mastectomy.  Meanwhile, Sue Ellen meets up with Dusty at a hotel.

3.title: FR - Dallas - S03E11 - The Heiress
3.plot: Lucy pursues Alan Beam.  Pam confronts Bobby about trying to ruin Cliff and as she does so she inadvertently learns about J.R.'s oil deal in Asia.

3.title: FR - Dallas - S03E12 - Ellie Saves the Day
3.plot: J.R. must admit that Southfork may be threatened when Asian oil drilling is delayed by storms and his loan on the property is due.

3.title: FR - Dallas - S03E13 - Mother of the Year
3.plot: Sue Ellen's continuing post-partum depression and avoidance of John Ross begins to create conflict among the family.  Meanwhile, Jock must sell the Asian oil leases in order to keep Southfork.

3.title: FR - Dallas - S03E14 - Return Engagements
3.plot: Miss Ellie's sadness over Gary's birthday is short-lived when she learns the he and Val plan to marry in Dallas.

3.title: FR - Dallas - S03E15 - Love and Marriage
3.plot: J.R. works to get Bobby back in the office so that Jock will be forced to say home.  Pam surrounds herself with her work after losing her baby.

3.title: FR - Dallas - S03E16 - Power Play
3.plot: Much to Kristin's surprise, J.R. convinces Alan to marry Lucy.

3.title: FR - Dallas - S03E17 - Paternity Suit
3.plot: Digger admits to a reporter that Cliff is the father of John Ross.  After the news breaks, a series of custody suits lead to a blood test that determines the paternity of John Ross once and for all.

3.title: FR - Dallas - S03E18 - Jenna's Return
3.plot: As Sue Ellen continues to see Dusty, Bobby meets up with Jenna when Pam leaves town.  Meanwhile, Ray and Donna second guess their relationship.

3.title: FR - Dallas - S03E19 - Sue Ellen's Choice
3.plot: Sue Ellen receives pressure from Dusty to leave J.R., which ultimately leads Sue Ellen to ask for a divorce.  Meanwhile, Bobby and Pam's marriage is also on shaky ground due to Jenna's return.

3.title: FR - Dallas - S03E20 - Second Thoughts
3.plot: J.R. tries to convince Alan and Lucy to relocate to Chicago, but Jock works to find Alan a law partnership in Dallas.

3.title: FR - Dallas - S03E21 - Divorce - Ewing Style
3.plot: When J.R. learns that Sue Ellen is having him followed, he strikes back by stopping her from taking John Ross away from him by proving she is drinking again.

3.title: FR - Dallas - S03E22 - Jock's Trial (1)
3.plot: Cliff investigation of the body found on Southfork leads him to suspect that Jock is to blame.

3.title: FR - Dallas - S03E23 - Jock's Trial (2)
3.plot: Jock goes on trial for murder.  Sue Ellen begins drinking heavily to deal with Dusty's death.

3.title: FR - Dallas - S03E24 - The Wheeler Dealer
3.plot: J.R. continues to try to strike a deal for his Asian oil and Pam sets out to find information on her mother who is believed to be dead.

3.title: FR - Dallas - S03E25 - A House Divided
3.plot: Bobby and Pam leave Southfork.  Meanwhile, J.R. is shot following the nationalization of the Asian oil wells which ends up ruining competing oil wells.

4.title: FR - Dallas - S04E01 - No More Mister Nice Guy (1)
4.plot: J.R. is rushed to the hospital in critical condition following his gunshot wound.  As the police investigate, they discover many people have the motive for shooting J.R. and everyone patiently waits by J.R.'s bedside hoping he will wake up and identify the shooter.

4.title: FR - Dallas - S04E02 - No More Mister Nice Guy (2)
4.plot: J.R., paralyzed after the shooting, undergoes further surgery to help save his life.  While J.R. is in the hospital, Bobby takes over Ewing Oil for the time being.  Meanwhile, Sue Ellen worries that she was the shooter as the police identify more suspects in the shooting.

4.title: FR - Dallas - S04E03 - Nightmare
4.plot: Bobby has a hard time running Ewing Oil with J.R. undermining his every decision.  Meanwhile, Miss Ellie finds the gun that was used in the shooting and Sue Ellen, full of guilt, has nightmares about J.R.'s shooting.

4.title: FR - Dallas - S04E04 - Who Done It?
4.plot: Sue Ellen is arrested for the shooting and the Ewings abandon her completely, not coming to her aid.  After bail is posted by an unknown person, a session with a psychiatrist reveals the real shooter.

4.title: FR - Dallas - S04E05 - Taste of Success
4.plot: Loving his newfound power as head of Ewing Oil, Bobby works to accomplish something that Jock or J.R. never did -- buy a refinery.

4.title: FR - Dallas - S04E06 - The Venezuelan Connection
4.plot: Jock is torn between Bobby and J.R. when J.R. decides to take back control of Ewing Oil, but Bobby refuses to relinquish his position.  Meanwhile, Pam continues to search for her mother and Lucy's friends meet Mitch Cooper.

4.title: FR - Dallas - S04E07 - The Fourth Son
4.plot: Amos, Ray Krebbs' father, arrives in Southfork with shocking news.  Meanwhile, Bobby must deal with his first crisis at Ewing Oil when a tanker and the 600,000 barrels onboard sink.

4.title: FR - Dallas - S04E08 - Trouble at Ewing 23
4.plot: When Ewing 23 receives a bomb threat, the incident gives J.R. an opening to take back control of Ewing Oil.  Meanwhile, Ray reels from the shocking news that he is Jock's son and worries that Donna is slipping away from him.

4.title: FR - Dallas - S04E09 - The Prodigal Mother
4.plot: Pam believes that she has finally located her mother.  Meanwhile, Mitch agrees to marry Lucy and J.R. hatches his plan to regain power of Ewing Oil.

4.title: FR - Dallas - S04E10 - Executive Wife
4.plot: Pam begins to feel lonely as Bobby spends most of his time preoccupied with Ewing Oil.  Meanwhile, J.R. tries to convince Jock to work on a deal that would go against Bobby.

4.title: FR - Dallas - S04E11 - End of the Road (1)
4.plot: J.R. falls for Mitch's sister, Afton, and tries to gain the upper hand when Bobby makes a deal on behalf of Ewing Oil.

4.title: FR - Dallas - S04E12 - End of the Road (2)
4.plot: As J.R. flirts with Afton at the wedding, Sue Ellen finds herself pursuing an old boyfriend.

4.title: FR - Dallas - S04E13 - Making of a President
4.plot: As J.R. returns to his position at Ewing Oil, J.R. undergoes a public relations campaign in order to help his image.  Meanwhile, Sue Ellen finds Pam with Alex and Miss Ellie continues to be angry with Jock.

4.title: FR - Dallas - S04E14 - Start the Revolution With Me
4.plot: J.R. sets out to exact revenge on the Asian government after it takes over Ewing Oil wells.  Meanwhile, Bobby looks into solar energy.

4.title: FR - Dallas - S04E15 - The Quest
4.plot: J.R. sets out to put an end to Cliff's potential political career, but is surprised when he learns who else is looking into having a political career.  Meanwhile, Sue Ellen believes she has a stalker.

4.title: FR - Dallas - S04E16 - Lover, Come Back
4.plot: Though at first she is overjoyed that Dusty is alive, Sue Ellen's happiness proves to be short-lived.  Meanwhile, J.R.'s dealings in Asia brings the Cartel back to life.

4.title: FR - Dallas - S04E17 - The New Mrs. Ewing
4.plot: As Donna and Ray tie the knot, Lucy competes for Miss Young Dallas.  Meanwhile, Jock and Miss Ellie continue to feud.

4.title: FR - Dallas - S04E18 - Mark of Cain
4.plot: As J.R. continues to deal in Asia, the Ewing family split over what is being done.  Meanwhile, Lucy's inflated ego over her pageant win creates tension and Sue Ellen continues her affair with Clint Ogden.

4.title: FR - Dallas - S04E19 - The Gathering Storm
4.plot: With their marriage on the rocks, Jock threatens to sell Ewing Oil if Ellie divorces him.  Meanwhile, Clint tries to convince Sue Ellen to leave J.R.; Lucy's ego continues to threaten her marriage; and Pam becomes suspicious of Cliff.

4.title: FR - Dallas - S04E20 - Ewing vs. Ewing
4.plot: Newlyweds Donna and Ray tries to fix Jock and Ellie's strained marriage.  Meanwhile, J.R. continues to try to sell out Ewing Oil.

4.title: FR - Dallas - S04E21 - New Beginnings
4.plot: J.R.'s plan to sell is cut short by Jock and Ellie's reconciliation.  Meanwhile, Jeremy Wendell sets out to get revenge against J.R.

4.title: FR - Dallas - S04E22 - Full Circle
4.plot: Kristen makes her return to Dallas; Lucy and Mitch split up; and Cliff meets his mother.

4.title: FR - Dallas - S04E23 - Ewing-Gate
4.plot: J.R.'s deals in Asia may end up costing him Ewing Oil, as well as his freedom.  Meanwhile, Dusty tries to get Sue Ellen to take John Ross and leave J.R.

5.title: FR - Dallas - S05E01 - Missing Heir
5.plot: The body found in the pool on Southfork is finally identified, which prompts J.R. and Cliff to accuse each other of the murder.

5.title: FR - Dallas - S05E02 - Gone, But Not Forgotten
5.plot: Cliff and J.R. continue to clash -- J.R. hatches a plot to get John Ross back, but Cliff decides to leave Dallas.  Meanwhile, Lucy tries to repair her marriage.

5.title: FR - Dallas - S05E03 - Showdown at San Angelo
5.plot: With the help of Miss Ellie, J.R. is able to see John Ross while he is at Clayton Farlow's ranch.  Meanwhile, Ray goes into business.

5.title: FR - Dallas - S05E04 - Little Boy Lost
5.plot: J.R. gets ready for a custody battle while Bobby begins the search for a child to adopt.  Meanwhile, Cliff meets Katherine, his half-sister.

5.title: FR - Dallas - S05E05 - The Sweet Smell of Revenge
5.plot: J.R. confronts the Farlows about John Ross.  Meanwhile, Pam is sent to the hospital following a breakdown.

5.title: FR - Dallas - S05E06 - The Big Shut Down
5.plot: J.R. tries to seek revenge on the Farlow's by drying up their oil supply.  Meanwhile, Bobby is able to buy information about Kristin's baby.

5.title: FR - Dallas - S05E07 - Blocked
5.plot: J.R.'s plot to dry up the Farlows' oil backfires.  Meanwhile, Pam continues to withdraw from the family.

5.title: FR - Dallas - S05E08 - The Split
5.plot: Jock unveils the new plan for Ewing Oil.  Meanwhile, Ray's development runs into problems and Donna's book is published.

5.title: FR - Dallas - S05E09 - Five Dollars a Barrel
5.plot: Cliff confronts J.R. about the note he is holding for the Ewings and threatens foreclosure.  Meanwhile, Bobby uncovers a link between Kristin and J.R.

5.title: FR - Dallas - S05E10 - Starting Over
5.plot: Miss Ellie discovers J.R.'s true motives as J.R. heads to a broker to look into selling Ewing stock.  Meanwhile, Bobby uncovers the truth about Kristin's baby.

5.title: FR - Dallas - S05E11 - Waterloo at Southfork
5.plot: Miss Ellie turns on J.R. as J.R. tries to get Sue Ellen declared an unfit mother. Meanwhile, Ray pulls out of his development deal.

5.title: FR - Dallas - S05E12 - Barbecue Two
5.plot: Miss Ellie puts together a homecoming barbecue when she learns that Jock is coming home from South Africa.  However, the plans are put on hold when the family receives a devistating phone call.

5.title: FR - Dallas - S05E13 - The Search
5.plot: In shock over Jock's disappearance, J.R., Bobby and Ray head to South America to help the crash investigation.

5.title: FR - Dallas - S05E14 - Denial
5.plot: The reality of Jock's death hits J.R. hard.  Meanwhile, Miss Ellie stops Jock's will from being read and Ray and Donna's relationship begins to fall apart.

5.title: FR - Dallas - S05E15 - Head of the Family
5.plot: While J.R. recovers from the devistation of Jock's death, Bobby takes over Ewing Oil.  Meanwhile, Bobby lies to Pam about where the baby come from.

5.title: FR - Dallas - S05E16 - The Phoenix
5.plot: As J.R. makes his return to Ewing Oil, Ray faces conflict with Bobby and Donna.  Meanwhile, Lucy is stalked by her photographer friend.

5.title: FR - Dallas - S05E17 - My Father, My Son
5.plot: J.R. wants Ray's Ewing Oil voting shares and to ruin Sue Ellen and Cliff's friendship. Bobby manages to make some inroads into adopting Christopher. Donna begins to work on her next book. After seeing Mitch with somebody else, Lucy ends up with another man.

5.title: FR - Dallas - S05E18 - Anniversary
5.plot: J.R. arranges a job opportunity so that Cliff will be out of Dallas. He then attempts to reunite with Sue Ellen. Donna finds Ray with another woman. Bobby buys a business for Pam to run. Evelyn informs Lucy that she wants to be with Mitch.

5.title: FR - Dallas - S05E19 - Adoption
5.plot: Bobby wants Sue Ellen's approval to allow him to adopt Christopher. J.R. attempts to get Ray's voting shares once and for all. Roger's obsession with Lucy gets out of control. Cliff learns about J.R.'s plan to get him out of Dallas.

5.title: FR - Dallas - S05E20 - The Maelstrom
5.plot: Not knowing how Christopher really is, J.R. attempts to find out what happened to Kristin's son. Ray starts to put his life back together. Mitch wants Lucy to agree to a divorce. J.R. meets Katherine Wentworth.

5.title: FR - Dallas - S05E21 - The Prodigal
5.plot: Katherine need help from J.R. after Cliff is given power at Wentworth Tool and Die. Donna discovers a dreadful secret from the Ewing and Culver family pasts. J.R. manages to get his hands on Christopher's birth records.

5.title: FR - Dallas - S05E22 - Vengeance
5.plot: Cliff ends up falling for the fake land deal. J.R.'s belief that's he's Christopher's father ends up leading to a blackmail plot. Lucy's request for a different photographer annoys Roger.

5.title: FR - Dallas - S05E23 - Blackmail
5.plot: Bobby finds himself being questioned about Farraday's murder. The rest of the family await word about Lucy's kidnapping. Donna reveals what she found out about Jock and Sam's scheme.

5.title: FR - Dallas - S05E24 - The Investigation
5.plot: Cliff attempts to get money from Sue Ellen. Bobby and Pam attempt to find Lucy. Bobby receives a visit from Farraday's associates.

5.title: FR - Dallas - S05E25 - Acceptance
5.plot: Miss Ellie decides to accept that Jock is dead and comes to a decision on Donna's book. Bobby tries to help the police set up a sting to catch Farraday's killers. Cliff  ends up being fired for embezzlement by his mother; J.R. attempts to win back Sue Ellen.

5.title: FR - Dallas - S05E26 - Goodbye, Cliff Barnes
5.plot: Cliff is really upset by Sue Ellen's return to J.R.. Bobby ends up revealing the truth about Christopher's parentage to Pam. Clayton returns to town. Lucy ends up admitting a terrible secret.

6.title: FR - Dallas - S06E01 - Changing of the Guard
6.plot: J.R. looses his position as Ewing Oil president and discovers that he's not Christopher's father. A comatose Cliff fights for his life. Lucy awaits to find out if she is pregnant. Holly Harwood meets Bobby and ends up making J.R. an interesting offer.

6.title: FR - Dallas - S06E02 - Where There's a Will
6.plot: J.R. attempts to get an early look at Jock's will. Lucy reveals the truth to Pam. Sue Ellen thinks about if she really wants to marry J.R. Marilee Stone offers Cliff a job. Ray learns about Amos Krebbs' health problems.

6.title: FR - Dallas - S06E03 - Billion Dollar Question
6.plot: J.R. wants to have Jock's will executed and has the IRS pay a visit to Bobby. Lucy deals with her pregnancy. Miss Ellie decides to go to the Oil Barons Ball. Ray is told about Amos' death.

6.title: FR - Dallas - S06E04 - The Big Ball
6.plot: J.R. is still running Harwood Oil and hopes that the Jock Ewing Scholarship will lead to him being declared officially dead. Dusty wants to know if he and Sue Ellen could have a future togther. Ray and Donna go to Amos' funeral.

6.title: FR - Dallas - S06E05 - Jock's Will
6.plot: Jock's will ends up revealing the future fate of Ewing Oil. Ray asks Mickey to come stay at Southfork. Pam thinks that Lucy needs to get back to work. J.R. and Sue Ellen decide the date to get remarried.

6.title: FR - Dallas - S06E06 - Aftermath
6.plot: J.R. and Bobby start the contest to try and gain control of Ewing Oil. A plot to gain revenge sees Rebecca buying an oil company.

6.title: FR - Dallas - S06E07 - Hit and Run
6.plot: Cliff takes over Barnes-Wentworth leaving Pam feeling more torn than ever between the Barnes and Ewing families. J.R. goes to great lengths to gain a drilling variance. Lucy goes ahead with her divorce. Ray is not happy with Mickey's behavior.

6.title: FR - Dallas - S06E08 - The Ewing Touch
6.plot: J.R. manages to get a drilling variance and competes with Bobby. Christopher's adoption is finally finalized. Cliff feels Pam should help his company. Mickey continues to infuriate Ray.

6.title: FR - Dallas - S06E09 - Fringe Benefits
6.plot: Afton and Sue Ellen attempt to help their men gain a lucrative refinery contract. J.R. isn't happy about aeeing Miss Ellie socializing with men. Pam attempts to convince Bobby to end the contest for Ewing Oil.

6.title: FR - Dallas - S06E10 - The Wedding
6.plot: It is the day of J.R. and Sue Ellen's wedding. Ray doesn't want Mickey becoming involved with Lucy. The Cartel wants J.R. to stop over-producing crude oil. Donna comes a decision about serving on the Texas Energy Commission.

6.title: FR - Dallas - S06E11 - Post Nuptial
6.plot: Cliff fights with J.R. - Donna is concerned that being on the TEC will cause more family problems. Bobby believes that J.R. is involved in illegal oil sales.

6.title: FR - Dallas - S06E12 - Barbecue Three
6.plot: J.R is confronted by Cliff and the Cartel at the annual Ewing barbecue. Miss Ellie decides that she needs to take action against the effects Jock's will is having on the family.

6.title: FR - Dallas - S06E13 - Mama Dearest
6.plot: Bobby and J.R. are not happy about Miss Ellie's decision to contest Jock's will. Afton attempts to get a commiment out of Cliff/ J.R.'s cheap gasoline ends up making the headlines.

6.title: FR - Dallas - S06E14 - The Ewing Blues
6.plot: Miss Ellie feels conflicted about contesting Jock's will. Pam meets Mark Graison. Donna thinks about leaving the TEC. Holly wants to end her partnership with J.R.

6.title: FR - Dallas - S06E15 - The Reckoning
6.plot: The battle over Jock's will ends up in court. J.R. wants to use Mark Graison to cause problems between Pam and Bobby.

6.title: FR - Dallas - S06E16 - A Ewing is a Ewing
6.plot: Cliff wants J.R. to run for office and be out of the oil business. Mark maintains an interest in Pam. Miss Ellie take a holiday in Galveston. Bobby thinks that J.R. has the TEC in his back pocket.

6.title: FR - Dallas - S06E17 - Crash of '83
6.plot: Bobby attempts to blackmail Hicks into stopping J.R. J.R. is concerned that Clayton will undermine his standing with Miss Ellie. Mickey and Lucy start to grow closer.

6.title: FR - Dallas - S06E18 - Requiem
6.plot: Rebecca fights for her life following the plane crash as Cliff and Pam pray for her recovery. The TEC have a rethink concerning J.R.'s drilling variance

6.title: FR - Dallas - S06E19 - Legacy
6.plot: After Pam leaves Southfork it gives J.R. an opportunity to alienate her more from Bobby. Rebecca's will is read following her death. Lucy and Mickey continue to grow closer. J.R. makes a deal in the Caribbean. Clayton admits that he's dating Miss Ellie.

6.title: FR - Dallas - S06E20 - Brothers and Sisters
6.plot: Katherine plots to make sure that Bobby sees Pam with Mark Graison. Holly isn't happy about J.R.'s Caribbean oil dealings.  Clayton sells the Southern Cross and moves closer to Miss Ellie.

6.title: FR - Dallas - S06E21 - Caribbean Connection
6.plot: Bobby and Ray attempt to stop J.R.'s deal to ship oil to Cuba. Sue Ellen is concerned that her personal life could ruin J.R.'s chances if he enters politics. Donna believes that greed is motivating Mickey's interest in Lucy. Cliff rebounds from his mother's death.

6.title: FR - Dallas - S06E22 - The Sting
6.plot: Bobby and Ray are able to stop J.R.'s Cuban oil deal/ Walt and Holly vow to get revenge. Bobby warns Mark away from Pam. Mickey and Lucy kiss.  Katherine wants to help J.R. in his fight against Cliff.

6.title: FR - Dallas - S06E23 - Hell Hath No Fury
6.plot: J.R. attempts to gain permission to travel to Cuba. Holly wants to hurt J.R. and Sue Ellen's marriage. Lucy starts to model again. Weather ends up threatening to hurt Bobby's Canadian venture. Ray offers his assistance in the fight for Ewing Oil.

6.title: FR - Dallas - S06E24 - Cuba Libre
6.plot: J.R. has to go to Cuba to get his money back. Katherine takes advantage of Mark and Pam's French holiday to make a move on Bobby. Aunt Lil shows up to see Mickey.

6.title: FR - Dallas - S06E25 - Tangled Web
6.plot: After having arrived in Cuba, J.R. attempts to get his $40 million back. Katherine confronts Cliff about the drill bit Bobby requires. Miss Ellie quizzes Clayton about his relationship with Sue Ellen. Ray informs Aunt Lil that Jock was his real father and not Amos. Things heat up between Mark and Pam.

6.title: FR - Dallas - S06E26 - Things Ain't Goin' Too Good at Southfork
6.plot: J.R.'s infidelity sees Sue Ellen beginning to drink again. Miss Ellie wants to know if Clayton has feelings towards Sue Ellen. Pam returns from France wanting to know what is going on between Bobby and Katherine. Cliff still refuses to allow Bobby to have the needed drill bit he requires.

6.title: FR - Dallas - S06E27 - Penultimate
6.plot: Mickey is left comatose following the car crash. Bobby blames Holly and Clayton blames J.R. for Sue Ellen starting to drink again. Lucy blames Sue Ellen for what has happened to Mickey. J.R. offers Holly the chance to buy him out of her company. Mark wants a commitment from Pam.

6.title: FR - Dallas - S06E28 - Ewing Inferno
6.plot: J.R. works out that Holly's desire to pay him in installments is because of Bobby. Pam wants a divorce. Aunt Lil believes that it could have been better had Mickey died in the accident. Clayton wants Miss Ellie to travel with him. A fire breaks out at Southfork after Ray and J.R. fight.

7.title: FR - Dallas - S07E01 - The Road Back
7.plot: Bobby attempts to rescue those trapped in the fire at Southfork. Mickey opens his eyes.

7.title: FR - Dallas - S07E02 - The Long Goodbye
7.plot: Sue Ellen wants autonomy from J.R. Pam and Bobby talk about getting back together. Clayton wants Bobby to look after Miss Ellie.

7.title: FR - Dallas - S07E03 - The Letter
7.plot: Katherine attempts to convince both Bobby and Pam to get a divorce. Sue Ellen looks help in dealing with John Ross' mental health issues.

7.title: FR - Dallas - S07E04 - My Brother's Keeper
7.plot: Pam and Bobby begin divorce proceedings. Peter starts to become smitten with Sue Ellen. Lucy attempts to comfort Mickey; J.R. continues to play Bobby in their contest to control the company.

7.title: FR - Dallas - S07E05 - The Quality of Mercy
7.plot: Mickey's depression increases Ray ends up taking some drastic action after Micjey's health deteriorates. Pam considers an offer to team with Cliff and Mark. Cliff wants Sly to spy for him.

7.title: FR - Dallas - S07E06 - Check and Mate
7.plot: Ray ends up being charged with Mickey's murder. Punk reveals who the winner is in the battle for Ewing Oil. Holly attempts to pursue a relationship with Bobby.

7.title: FR - Dallas - S07E07 - Ray's Trial
7.plot: Ray's murder trial gets under way. Bobby runs into Jenna Wade. Sue Ellen's interest in Peter causes jealousy from J.R.

7.title: FR - Dallas - S07E08 - The Oil Baron's Ball
7.plot: Ray learns his fate as his trial for the murder of Mickey comes to an end. Pam isn't happy to see Jenna at the Oil Baron's Ball.

7.title: FR - Dallas - S07E09 - Morning After
7.plot: Cliff's comments about Jock and Digger don't sit to well with the Ewing family. After Jenna and Bobby spend the night together, Katherine is upset at not being Bobby's date. J.R. wonders if Charlie could be Bobby's daughter.

7.title: FR - Dallas - S07E10 - The Buck Stops Here
7.plot: In an effort to hold onto Bobby, Katherine attempts to bribe Jenna. JR is concerned that Sue Ellen and Peter have become more than friends but Sue Ellen is keeping her distance.

7.title: FR - Dallas - S07E11 - To Catch a Sly
7.plot: JR's secretary is forced by Cliff into spying for him. After JR finds out he turns Sly into a double agent. Bobby and Pam continue to fight their feelings for each other.

7.title: FR - Dallas - S07E12 - Barbecue Four
7.plot: Miss Ellie and Clayton return home for the annual Southfork barbecue. JR manages to get one over on Cliff. Katherine vows to get rid of Jenna.

7.title: FR - Dallas - S07E13 - Past Imperfect
7.plot: J.R. is determined to break up Ellie and Clayton's engagement. Jenna is not happy after Bobby buys her a boutique to secure her own independence.

7.title: FR - Dallas - S07E14 - Peter's Principles
7.plot: Mark is not happy with Pam for meeting Bobby. Sue Ellen ends up giving in to her passion for Peter. J.R. investigates Clayton's family.

7.title: FR - Dallas - S07E15 - Offshore Crude
7.plot: Sue Ellen reminds JR that they have an open marriage as she desperately attempts to stay away from Peter.

7.title: FR - Dallas - S07E16 - Some Do… Some Don't
7.plot: Sue Ellen is told by JR to finish her affair with Peter because he wants another baby.

7.title: FR - Dallas - S07E17 - Eye of the Beholder
7.plot: Sue Ellen is left upset after she sees Peter with Lucy. Ellie decides not to marry Clayton.

7.title: FR - Dallas - S07E18 - Twelve Mile Limit
7.plot: Mark asks Pam to marry him. Edgar is discovered unconscious in his hotel room.

7.title: FR - Dallas - S07E19 - Where is Poppa?
7.plot: JR and Peter find out that Sue Ellen miscarried as a result of the accident. Mark pressures Pam for an answer to his marriage proposal.

7.title: FR - Dallas - S07E20 - When the Bough Breaks
7.plot: Jenna is quizzed by Bobby about Charlie's father. Peter considers having a baby with Sue Ellen.

7.title: FR - Dallas - S07E21 - True Confessions
7.plot: Jenna tells Bobby the reasons why she named him as the father on Charlie's birth certificate.

7.title: FR - Dallas - S07E22 - And the Winner Is...
7.plot: The winning bidder of the oil contract is revealed. Sue Ellen hears a confession from Peter.

7.title: FR - Dallas - S07E23 - Fools Rush In
7.plot: Miss Ellie sets a wedding date to marry Clayton. Katherine attempts to convince Pam to marry Mark.

7.title: FR - Dallas - S07E24 - The Unexpected
7.plot: JR attempts to destroy Peter. Pam finally gives Mark an answer to his marriage proposal.

7.title: FR - Dallas - S07E25 - Strange Alliance
7.plot: Jenna wants Bobby to sort out the way he is feeling. Lucy wonders why Peter won't go on a date with her.

7.title: FR - Dallas - S07E26 - Blow Up
7.plot: Lucy works outs that Peter and Sue Ellen have been seeing one another. JR and Jessica make plans to stop the wedding.

7.title: FR - Dallas - S07E27 - Turning Point
7.plot: Clayton warns his sister to stay away from JR. Sue Ellen wonders why Pam agreed to marry Mark.

7.title: FR - Dallas - S07E28 - Love Stories
7.plot: JR manages to trick Katherine. Cliff realises the severity of his current situation.

7.title: FR - Dallas - S07E29 - Hush, Hush, Sweet Jessie
7.plot: JR ends up realizing that his mother could be in grave danger after he takes a look into someone's past.

7.title: FR - Dallas - S07E30 - End Game
7.plot: The tensions increase at the Ewing's ranch as the search for Miss Ellie and Jessica continues.

8.title: FR - Dallas - S08E01 - Killer at Large
8.plot: Afton finds Bobby shot in J.R.'s office. Lucy suspects J.R. framed Peter. Ray tries to warn J.R. against Randolph. Sue Ellen and J.R. have a new "marital arrangement" after the showdown with Peter. Lucy, J.R., and Sue Ellen rush to Dallas Memorial where Bobby undergoes an operation. J.R. realises the killer was after him. Tract 340 comes in and Cliff is delighted. The bullet wound blinds Bobby. Marilee is angry with J.R. after Cliff strikes oil. Afton suspects Cliff shot Bobby. Jenna and Pam meet by Bobby's hospital bed. An attempt is made on J.R.'s life. Afton leaves Cliff. Pam stops Katherine from going into the hospital to see Bobby. Marilee seduces Cliff. Bobby is sceptical about J.R. "watching" the Ewing Oil business while he's away. J.R. and Bobby learn that the killer is still at large.

8.title: FR - Dallas - S08E02 - Battle Lines
8.plot: Bobby informs Jenna that marriage is off the cards unless he manages to regain his sight. Cliff ends up being arrested for attempted murder.

8.title: FR - Dallas - S08E03 - If at First You Don't Succeed
8.plot: Pam vows to ruin JR. The Ewing family receives sad news about Jock's brother Jason.

8.title: FR - Dallas - S08E04 - Jamie
8.plot: Katherine is discovered attempting to kill Bobby and is taken off to jail. JR meets his niece Jamie.

8.title: FR - Dallas - S08E05 - Family
8.plot: JR is not convinced that Jamie is really a Ewing. Pam and Jackie see Mark's car.

8.title: FR - Dallas - S08E06 - Shadow of a Doubt
8.plot: After Pam receives some flowers from 'Mark' she wonders if he is still really alive.

8.title: FR - Dallas - S08E07 - Homecoming
8.plot: Pam decides to hire a salvage expert to find out what really happened to Mark in the plane crash.

8.title: FR - Dallas - S08E08 - Oil Baron's Ball III
8.plot: Pam is upset after she finds out about Bobby and Jenna's upcoming marriage plans.

8.title: FR - Dallas - S08E09 - Shadows
8.plot: Miss Ellie ends up realizing that Clayton is still feeling sensitive about her past with Jock.

8.title: FR - Dallas - S08E10 - Charlie
8.plot: Cliff believes that there is a conspiracy going on between JR and Wendell.

8.title: FR - Dallas - S08E11 - Barbecue Five
8.plot: Mandy ends up going on a lunch date with JR, but only after Cliff approves of the idea.

8.title: FR - Dallas - S08E12 - Do You Take This Woman…
8.plot: Lucy ends up giving in to Eddie's charms in a deserted stable. Bobby ends up being jilted at the alter by Jenna.

8.title: FR - Dallas - S08E13 - Deja Vu
8.plot: Pam attempts to hide her happiness after she learns that Bobby's wedding was cancelled.

8.title: FR - Dallas - S08E14 - Odd Man Out
8.plot: Bobby finds it hard to come to terms with the fact that Jenna has married somebody else. Pam continues to look for Mark.

8.title: FR - Dallas - S08E15 - Lockup in Laredo
8.plot: J.R. is confronted by Jamie about his marital indiscretions. Lucy attempts to help Eddie.

8.title: FR - Dallas - S08E16 - Winds of War
8.plot: Lucy and Eddie begin working together. Bobby ends up being contacted about a ransom.

8.title: FR - Dallas - S08E17 - Bail Out
8.plot: Pam discovers the truth behind her search for Mark.

8.title: FR - Dallas - S08E18 - Legacy of Hate
8.plot: Mandy finds herself feeling torn between Cliff and J.R. Pam is out for revenge.

8.title: FR - Dallas - S08E19 - Sins of the Fathers
8.plot: Jenna is scared that she could have killed Marchetta.

8.title: FR - Dallas - S08E20 - The Brothers Ewing
8.plot: The Ewing brothers attempt to protect the family fortune. Sue Ellen takes a trip overseas.

8.title: FR - Dallas - S08E21 - Shattered Dreams
8.plot: J.R. confides in Mandy and tries to get Cliff out of her life. Miss Ellie vows to stay at Southfork with Clayton through the troubled times. Donna argues with Ray over his involvement in the fight for Ewing Oil. Veronica Robinson contacts Bobby. On her way to Hong Kong, Pam feels she's still attached to Bobby. Cliff tries to figure out a way to make sure Jamie stays on his side. The venue of Jenna's trial is changed to Dallas. Lucy learns she's been sharing Eddie with his girlfriend Betty. Cliff offers Jamie a job. J.R.'s plan to win over Mandy backfires. Lucy confronts Eddie and tells him off. Pam gets her hopes up for finding Mark in Hong Kong. Clayton proposes a truce to Ray. Veronica is found dead and Jenna's hopes are shattered again.

8.title: FR - Dallas - S08E22 - Dead Ends
8.plot: Bobby refuses to believe that Veronica died of natural causes. Barnes-Wentworth hires Jamie as a drilling expert. Ray and J.R. investigate Jason Ewing's past. In Hong Kong, Pam suspects J.R. may be behind her trip. Cliff tries to rush his lawyer in the lawsuit against the Ewings. Police say Veronica died of a drug overdose. J.R. wants to have a fresh start with Mandy. Despite an initial setback, Pam is determined to find Mark in Hong Kong. Cliff tries to get closer to Jamie. Ray explains to Donna his reasons for siding with J.R. Sly Lovegren returns to Ewing Oil. Bobby and Jenna locate a man from Veronica's flight. Marilee Stone makes up with Jamie. Cliff insults Mandy and gets a punch from J.R. Pam is disappointed in Hong Kong.

8.title: FR - Dallas - S08E23 - Trial and Error
8.plot: Sue Ellen consoles Pam in Hong Kong after her dreams of finding Mark Graison are shattered. Mandy Winger fears a deeper involvement with J.R. Christopher misses Pamela and is consoled by Bobby. Ray and Donna have a big fight after she strikes oil. Pam continues to suspect that J.R. is behind her Hong Kong trip. J.R. is seriously worried that Jenna Wade may go to prison and he wants to keep Bobby and Pamela apart. Bobby is forced to testify at Jenna's trial. Donna and Ray have serious marital problems and she moves into Southfork. Veronica's sister refuses to testify at Jenna's trial. Pam accepts that Mark is dead.

8.title: FR - Dallas - S08E24 - The Verdict
8.plot: Pam and Sue Ellen decide to stop over on the way from Hong Kong. Ewing 17 is shut down for contaminating drinking water and J.R. plots to set up the head of the Texas Energy Commission. Bobby pressures Veronica's sister Anne to testify for Jenna. Ray wants Donna back home. Anne cooperates with Bobby to some extent. Pam and Sue Ellen return to Dallas. Miss Ellie has a breakdown at the trial. Bobby tries to console Pam but Jenna is upset seeing them together up close. Mandy refuses to continue to see J.R. as long as he remains married to Sue Ellen. A verdict is pronounced in Jenna's murder trial.

8.title: FR - Dallas - S08E25 - Sentences
8.plot: J.R. blackmails the head of the Texas Energy Commission. Pam tells Cliff that she has finally accepted Mark Graison's death. Charlie has a tough life, with her father dead and her mother found guilty of manslaughter. Pam consoles Bobby after the verdict in Jenna's trial. Cliff and Jamie get a lot closer. Bobby makes a shocking announcement in court during Jenna's sentencing. Jamie tells Sue Ellen about her and Cliff. Sue Ellen learns for the first time about J.R. and Mandy Winger. Eddie and Lucy's partnership is dissolved and he leaves Dallas. Pam thinks Bobby lied to her about Charlie's paternity. Sue Ellen confronts J.R. about Mandy and threatens divorce. A court date is set in Jamie and Cliff's lawsuit against the Ewings. J.R. has a surprise meeting with Pam about her, Bobby, and the future. Bobby and Scotty Demarest question a stewardess about Veronica. Ray advises Lucy to contact Mitch. J.R. succeeds in manipulating the Texas Energy Commission's head into making trouble for Cliff.

8.title: FR - Dallas - S08E26 - Terms of Estrangement
8.plot: J.R. plots to have Pam and Bobby get back together. Cliff fears his offshore operation may be shut down. The airline comes up with breakthrough evidence in Jenna's case. J.R. is offered information on the lawsuit. Mandy Winger tells J.R. off. J.R. has an angry confrontation with Sue Ellen and Clayton. Cliff proposes to Jamie. Sue Ellen and Donna wonder about "the curse of Ewing men." J.R. gets Bobby thinking about going back to Pam. Jamie's brother Jack appears and offers J.R. a deal. Jenna's case is reopened but Bobby faces a problem with Jenna herself. Lucy succeeds in contacting Mitch.

8.title: FR - Dallas - S08E27 - The Ewing Connection
8.plot: J.R. tells Bobby and Ray about Jack's deal. Jamie is very upset after seeing Jack. Sue Ellen continues in her therapy group. Lucy meets with Mitch in Atlanta. Jack reveals his deal to the Ewing brothers. Pam and Bobby reminisce about old times and kiss. Cliff's Gold Canyon 340 continues to be shut down and Cliff is mad at the head of the Texas Energy Commission. John Ross has a medical emergency. Cliff tries to find Jack. The Ewing brothers sign a deal with Jack Ewing. Cliff rushes his marriage to Jamie. Donna learns she's pregnant. Police spot a suspect who probably killed Veronica. J.R. makes Sue Ellen feel guilty about John Ross' medical emergency and she turns to alcohol again.

8.title: FR - Dallas - S08E28 - Deeds and Misdeeds
8.plot: J.R. promises Mandy that Sue Ellen will soon be out of the picture for good. Cliff and Jamie make wedding preparations as the Ewing family discover proof their claim to Ewing Oil is false. Lucy and Mitch start to become closer again. Donna wants to tell Ray about the baby she is expecting.

8.title: FR - Dallas - S08E29 - Deliverance
8.plot: John Ross recovers after the surgery. Miss Ellie tells J.R. he should show Cliff the new evidence in the lawsuit. Police question the suspect in Jenna's case. J.R. asks Cliff to drop the lawsuit. Bobby and Pam vow love for one another. Ray gets excited about nailing Cliff in court and Donna doesn't like it. Donna conceals her pregnancy from Ray. The suspect confesses to having murdered Marchetta. Mitch asks Lucy to move in with him. The Ewings win the case against Cliff and Jamie. J.R. promises Mandy Winger to put Sue Ellen away into "the hands of professional medical help." Jenna is released and the Ewings throw a big victory party.

8.title: FR - Dallas - S08E30 - Swan Song
8.plot: Sue Ellen gets drunk at the Ewing victory party. Donna tells Ray about her pregnancy. J.R. reassures Mandy Winger that the problem with Sue Ellen will be resolved. Jenna can't wait to get married and Bobby is confused about who he should marry. Sue Ellen assures Clayton and Miss Ellie that she stopped drinking. Mitch and Lucy remarry. Cliff considers an annulment of his marriage to Jamie. Dusty reappears. Pam tells Bobby he has to marry Jenna. J.R. asks Sue Ellen to agree to end their marriage. Bobby proposes to Pam. Jamie surprises Cliff during their conversation about annulment. Then as Bobby leaves Pam's house, a car drives straight towards Pamela, Bobby pushes Pam out of the way and the car hits him. The crash and the driver is revealed to be Katherine Wentworth who is dead. Bobby is rushed to hospital where he dies of massive internal injuries.

9.title: FR - Dallas - S09E01 - The Family Ewing
9.plot: The Ewing family come together for Bobby's funeral. Dusty informs Sue Ellen that he is in love with her. Miss Ellie is happy to see Gary back home for a while.

9.title: FR - Dallas - S09E02 - Rock Bottom
9.plot: After Sue Ellen gets drunk again, a worried Clayton and Miss Ellie look for her. Bobby's will is read, leaving Cliff hoping to take advantage of what it says. Mandy wants J.R. to divorce Sue Ellen.

9.title: FR - Dallas - S09E03 - Those Eyes
9.plot: Clayton and Miss Ellie continue to look for Sue Ellen. Pam finds herself being courted by two offers for Christopher's Ewing Oil shares. J.R. and Dusty face off over Sue Ellen.

9.title: FR - Dallas - S09E04 - Resurrection
9.plot: Miss Ellie thinks about Jeremy Wendell's offer for her Ewing Oil stock. Dusty vows to stick by Sue Ellen. Pam is followed by a mysterious person.

9.title: FR - Dallas - S09E05 - Saving Grace
9.plot: Pam is shocked to find out that Mark Graison really is still alive. J.R. looks into Jack's background. Ray and Miss Ellie consider whether to accept Weststar's offer for their Ewing Oil stock. Dusty is concerned that his efforts to help Sue Ellen could actually be a hindrance to her recovery.

9.title: FR - Dallas - S09E06 - Mothers
9.plot: Sue Ellen's mother pays a visit to Southfork, hoping to reunite her and J.R. Mark explains his absence to Pam. Jack grows closer to Jenna. Miss Ellie wrestles with her decision about what to do with her Ewing Oil shares.

9.title: FR - Dallas - S09E07 - The Wind of Change
9.plot: Miss Ellie and Pam come to their final decisions about the Weststar offer. Donna and Ray receive some bad news about their unborn child. Sue Ellen continues to progress in her recovery. Jack attempts to woo Jenna further. Mandy makes an appearance at the Oil Baron's Ball.

9.title: FR - Dallas - S09E08 - Quandary
9.plot: Ray and Donna consider their options about what they can do with their unborn baby with down syndrome. Dusty claims that he's remaining in Dallas. J.R. attempts to find a way to rid himself of Pam. Cliff wants Jamie back. Angelica Nero tries to impress the city's oilmen.

9.title: FR - Dallas - S09E09 - Close Encounters
9.plot: Angelica makes an appearance at the Southfork Rodeo. Sue Ellen's mother warns her to stay away from Dusty. J.R. offers Jack a position at Ewing Oil. Donna is rushed to the hospital.

9.title: FR - Dallas - S09E10 - Suffer the Little Children
9.plot: Cliff attempts to repair his relationships with both Jamie and Pam. Sue Ellen restarts the custody battle with J.R.

9.title: FR - Dallas - S09E11 - The Prize
9.plot: John Ross runs away as his parents battle it out to gain custody of him. Angelica attempts to push through her deal with Ewing Oil. J.R. continues to investigate her motives.

9.title: FR - Dallas - S09E12 - En Passant
9.plot: J.R. decides to appeal having lost John Ross' custody. Donna and Ray attempt to deal with the loss of their baby in very different ways. J.R.'s kidnapped detective is used by Angelica and Nicholas to futher the Marinos venture. Sue Ellen and her mother clash about her future.

9.title: FR - Dallas - S09E13 - Goodbye, Farewell, and Amen
9.plot: J.R. attempts to trick Sue Ellen into giving up custody of their son. Jenna cools things off with Jack. Pam wants to go on vacation with Mark. Clayton makes a deal without Miss Ellie knowing about it.

9.title: FR - Dallas - S09E14 - Curiosity Killed the Cat
9.plot: Clayton attempts to shield Miss Ellie from his financial problems. Ray and Donna move into Southfork. Cliff attempts to make Mandy see that J.R. doesn't care about her. Jack disappears.

9.title: FR - Dallas - S09E15 - The Missing Link
9.plot: Pam looks for answers about the emerald from Matt Cantrell. Mandy ends up double-crossing J.R. Jack is still missing.  Sue Ellen starts a new job.

9.title: FR - Dallas - S09E16 - Twenty-Four Hours
9.plot: The search for Jack increases as his sister is close to death. Donna begins working with people suffering from Down Syndrome. Angelica reveals the reason why Jack is so important to her. Pam looks for a way to work with Mark.

9.title: FR - Dallas - S09E17 - The Deadly Game
9.plot: Jamie starts to recover at the hospital. J.R. recruits Marilee Stone into the Marinos deal. Clayton's problems improve as he has no idea that Miss Ellie is the source of the improvement. Pam plans a visit to Mark's Colombian emerald mine.

9.title: FR - Dallas - S09E18 - Blame it on Bogota
9.plot: J.R. and Cantrell continue to work together to set up Pam. Angelica begins to grow unhappy over the profit sharing arrangement from the Marinos deal. Mark feels he and Pam might not have a future together.

9.title: FR - Dallas - S09E19 - Shadow Games
9.plot: Pam and Matt make their way to Colombia.; Sue Ellen's stability causes J.R. reevaluate her. Clayton finds out that Miss Ellie has been helping him. Donna confides to Miss Ellie that her baby would've been disabled. Jenna becomes more and more despondant over Bobby's death.

9.title: FR - Dallas - S09E20 - Missing
9.plot: J.R. and local authorities attempt to find Pam who has disappeared in Colombia. Jack gives into Grace's charms. Mandy stops working for Cliff.

9.title: FR - Dallas - S09E21 - Dire Straits
9.plot: Mark and Cliff attempt to secure Pam's release. Jenna's depression increases. Donna ends up going grows closer to a disabled child. J.R. believes that he understands Dimitri. Mandy admits her treachery.

9.title: FR - Dallas - S09E22 - Overture
