1.plot: When Spidey and Ant-Man try to rescue people off a collapsing bridge, Hulk decides to pitch in but his "smashing" makes things worse. In order to save everyone, all three heroes discover the importance of self-control and thinking before you act.

1.title: FR - Marvel Super Hero Adventures - S01E05 - Electric Youth
1.plot: When Spidey and Ms. Marvel both show up to stop a bank robbery, they have to put aside their differences and work together to take down the evil Electro.

1.title: FR - Marvel Super Hero Adventures - S01E06 - The Toys Are Back In Town
1.plot: Spidey teams up with the famous Captain America to track down a toy thief known as the Tinkerer. As our heroes rescue the stolen toys, Captain America reminds Spider-Man that being a hero means doing the right thing, no matter what.

1.title: FR - Marvel Super Hero Adventures - S01E07 - Way Outer Space
1.plot: When a manned space shuttle malfunctions, Spider-Man, with the help of Captain Marvel, has to overcome his fear of space and try something new to save the astronauts on board.

1.title: FR - Marvel Super Hero Adventures - S01E08 - Family Friendly
1.plot: When Absorbing Man destroys a bridge, separating kids from their parents, Spider-Man teams with Black Panther and is reminded that there's nothing more important than family.

1.title: FR - Marvel Super Hero Adventures - S01E09 - Stomp and Listen
1.plot: Spidey joins forces with Wasp to stop the rampaging Rhino and soon learns that the best way to get what you want is to speak clearly and stand up for yourself.

1.title: FR - Marvel Super Hero Adventures - S01E10 - Are You Sure? I'm Positive!
1.plot: During a frustrating chase to stop Stegron from destroying a museum, Spider-Man gets a boost from his pal Reptil, who teaches him the power of positive thinking.

1.title: FR - Ms. Marvel - S01E01 - Generation Why
1.plot: Kamala Khan attends Avengercon only to discover that she herself might have superpowers.

meta.plot: A great student, avid gamer, and voracious fan-fic scribe, Kamala Khan has a special affinity for superheroes, particularly Captain Marvel. However, she struggles to fit in at home and at school — that is, until she gets superpowers like the heroes she’s always looked up to. Life is easier with superpowers, right?

1.title: FR - Les Piliers de la terre - S01E01 - Anarchy
1.plot: The succession to the crown of England is in doubt and causes King Henry’s daughter and nephew to compete for the throne. The Hamleigh family’s hope for an advantageous marriage for their son William falls apart. Tom Builder and his family search for work and encounter Ellen and her mysterious son Jack. Church politics see Philip, a monk, elected the new prior, which leaves him indebted to Deacon Waleran.

1.title: FR - Les Piliers de la terre - S01E02 - Master Builder
1.plot: A fire destroys Kingsbridge church, giving Tom, son Alfred and stepson Jack the chance to build a new cathedral. Prior Philip learns the power of politics when he gets caught between Bishop Waleran and the Hamleighs’ quest for Shiring Castle. Kingsbridge is rocked by the accusation of Ellen being a witch. William takes Aliena and Richard by surprise in a brutal attack. Aliena makes a promise to her father.

1.title: FR - Les Piliers de la terre - S01E03 - Redemption
1.plot: Aliena protests her father’s imprisonment. Prior Philip and William find themselves in a standoff over access to stone in the Shiring quarry. Jack’s artistic talents take hold as he begins to carve a statue to honor the cathedral relic. King Stephen visits the cathedral work-site, but collapses in a fit of terror. Aliena starts a fleece business to help earn money for Richard’s chance to become a knight.

1.title: FR - Les Piliers de la terre - S01E04 - Battlefield
1.plot: William applies to have his father’s title of Earl transferred to him, and discovers a mysterious knight is also a rival for the Earldom. King Stephen, frightened by Jack’s appearance, orders an assassin to kill him. The battle between King Stephen and Maud sees each side’s leader being taken hostage. Philip is tortured into a confession when Waleran tells Maud that he is the man who betrayed Earl Bartholomew.

1.title: FR - Les Piliers de la terre - S01E05 - Legacy
1.plot: Waleran and Regan engineer the prisoner exchange so that they remain on the winning side of the war. Tom wants Jack and Alfred to be friends, but their rivalry over their work lives and Aliena is too intense. Meanwhile, William decides to attack Kingsbridge as a way to stop the fleece fair and Aliena’s success. The Hamleighs and Prior Philip are granted rights to Shiring land, but it comes with a price.

1.title: FR - Les Piliers de la terre - S01E06 - Witchcraft
1.plot: Richard returns from war to find his sister penniless, with no more money to support his knighthood. Alfred offers himself to Prior Philip as master-builder. Aliena has to choose between her love for Jack and her oath to her father. Regan forces Waleran to speak to the King about William’s long-delayed Earldom. A disaster at Kingsbridge becomes a way for Waleran to remove Prior Philip from his position.

1.title: FR - Les Piliers de la terre - S01E07 - New Beginnings
1.plot: As a result of his journeys, Jack has learned how to fulfill Tom Builder’s dream of a cathedral filled with light. Aliena tracks Jack by following the trail of his carvings. Waleran offers Philip a new position, but it means that Philip must always obey Waleran. Kingsbridge becomes prosperous again which infuriates Regan and William, who plan an attack that is met with resistance from Richard, Jack and Philip.

1.title: FR - Les Piliers de la terre - S01E08 - The Work of Angels
1.plot: Eight years later, Jack’s fixation with the cathedral leaves him little time or energy for anything else, while Aliena’s fixation with the distant Earldom of Shiring has married her to Alfred, a man she hates. Waleran and Alfred develop a plot to get rid of Jack for good and it seems to be working until evidence comes to light that makes all wrongs rectified.

meta.plot: Passion et complots dans l'Angleterre du XIIème siècle. Maud, la fille du monarque Henri 1er, se dispute la succession au trône avec son cousin, Stephen. Une lutte de pouvoir qui cause des tensions et déchire le royaume. L'évêque Waleran Bigot et les Hamleigh en profitent pour tirer avantage de la situation et satisfaire leurs propres ambitions. Au milieu de cette guerre, le Prieur Philip doit surmonter les innombrables obstacles pour assurer la construction de la cathédrale de Kingsbridge. Face à l’ampleur de la tâche, il peut heureusement compter sur le maître-maçon Tom Builder, son beau-fils Jack, et la jeune Aliena. Ensemble, ils vont se serrer les coudes pour réaliser leur rêve…

1.title: FR - Crooks - S01E01 - Panther
1.plot: Charly's former life as a talented safecracker catches up to him when he is forced to steal a valuable coin from crime boss Hassan Al-Walid.

1.title: FR - Crooks - S01E02 - The Al-Walids
1.plot: Charly sends Samira and Jonas to Marseille and finds an unlikely ally in Joseph, a washed-up gangster who was sent to retrieve the coin.

1.title: FR - Crooks - S01E03 - Red
1.plot: With multiple killers hot on his heels, Charly agrees to sell the coin for his safety. Joseph sees an opportunity for payback.

1.title: FR - Crooks - S01E04 - The Ambulance
1.plot: Charly and Joseph flee to Italy to seek shelter. Meanwhile, Hassan sends his volatile cousin to Marseille.

1.title: FR - Crooks - S01E05 - Old Friends
1.plot: Joseph sees only one way out, but Charly pulls him back from the brink. Samira and Jonas are discovered by the Al-Walids.

1.title: FR - Crooks - S01E06 - Rami
1.plot: Charly discovers that the most feared woman in Marseille has taken Samira and Jonas. Joseph stumbles across a safe spot for the coin.

1.title: FR - Crooks - S01E07 - Madame
1.plot: Joseph enlists Nina's help. Hassan finds a traitor in his midst. Charly is forced to plan an impossible heist.

1.title: FR - Crooks - S01E08 - The Sea
1.plot: In his effort to save Samira and Jonas, Charly comes face-to-face with Hassan. Everything comes down to the toss of a coin.

2.title: FR - Crooks - S02E01 - Bussi Bussi
2.plot: Pressured by the German police to retrieve the coin, Charly heads to Bangkok to meet an old friend. In Vienna, old foes plot as money dries up.

2.title: FR - Crooks - S02E02 - Humans, Animals, Sensations
2.plot: As danger circles Charly's family in Austria, Charly and Joseph hunt the coin through Bangkok. In Vienna, mob boss Zakeyev reaches out to his daughter.

2.title: FR - Crooks - S02E03 - Live Is Life
2.plot: Katharina faces an impossible choice. While Charly and Joseph are trapped between rival gangs, Rio and Zwanziger make moves with dangerous consequences.

2.title: FR - Crooks - S02E04 - The Combine
2.plot: Charly strikes up a deal with the Thai syndicate to pull off a heist for their sacred idol, and Samira persuades Rio to approach Katharina in Vienna.

2.title: FR - Crooks - S02E05 - The Scorpion
2.plot: Back in Vienna, Charly and Joseph race to reach Samira. Rio closes in on the coin, but the game gets murky. Zakeyev stops at nothing to win.

2.title: FR - Crooks - S02E06 - Catherine the Great
2.plot: As Rio's rampage — fueled by betrayal — shakes Vienna, Charly faces Zakeyev's ultimatum. Samira makes a bold move as it all rides on a coin toss.

meta.plot: A priceless coin puts rival gangs across Europe at odds, forcing a retired safecracker to team up with a two-bit gangster for one last heist.

1.title: FR - Furies - S01E01 - I work for her
1.plot: As she vows to avenge her family after her birthday ends in bloodshed, Lyna edges closer to the one person she holds responsible: the Fury.

1.title: FR - Furies - S01E02 - Broken heart > Bullet in the head
1.plot: With a police officer hot on her tail, Lyna's first mission sees her go deep undercover in Mama's bordello where a simple task turns very complicated.

1.title: FR - Furies - S01E03 - I'd never have bet on you
1.plot: The Fury races to retrieve a missing safe ahead of the Writing Ceremony. Dynamics shift as Lyna grapples with disturbing news about her parents.

1.title: FR - Furies - S01E04 - The Fury is like scabies
1.plot: As Parques' ambitions come to the fore, the Fury turns to Fehim for support. Not knowing whom she can trust, Lyna looks for her own form of back-up.

1.title: FR - Furies - S01E05 - Hello, my love
1.plot: A prison visit results in a major encounter for Lyna, but her search for answers leaves a trail of destruction in its wake.

1.title: FR - Furies - S01E06 - Nature abhors a vacuum
1.plot: Lyna tries to predict the masked attacker's next move but patience is wearing thin. Her desperation leads to a last ditch attempt to restore order.

1.title: FR - Furies - S01E07 - Where are the knives?
1.plot: In the creeping shadows of a hostile forest, an unlikely alliance is formed as common enemies circle close, poised to swoop in for the kill.

1.title: FR - Furies - S01E08 - Namaste, asshole
1.plot: A hazardous train ride brings the Arago family saga to an explosive conclusion. Yet when old lies are covered up with new ones, the rot still lingers.

2.title: FR - Furies - S02E01 - Picking up Strays
2.plot: With a new order in charge of the underworld, the Furies turn to unlikely allies to help eliminate the organisation and take down its shadowy leader.

2.title: FR - Furies - S02E02 - How Do You Stop an Armored Van?
2.plot: When an extraction mission attracts unwanted guests, Lyna struggles to keep her link with Elie a secret. Selma pays a visit to her old foe, The Carny.

2.title: FR - Furies - S02E03 - You Missed the Deal of the Century
2.plot: With news that Oz is coming to town, the crew devises a plan of attack. Lyna vies for Varda's trust, while Selma targets a Damocles weapons delivery.

2.title: FR - Furies - S02E04 - A truce
2.plot: The Furies' ploy sends Selma on the run, holed up by The Carny. As Lyna gains unprecedented access to Damocles, she's forced to face off with Orso.

2.title: FR - Furies - S02E05 - The Lie
2.plot: As Lyna races through Paris, Selma makes her intentions clear about Oz — and anyone who stands in her way. A suspicious Elie places his trust in Iris.

2.title: FR - Furies - S02E06 - I Can Always Kill You Tomorrow
2.plot: A grand plan unfolds as old allegiances crumble and unlikely bonds form. Refusing to accept the new order, Lyna prepares for one last fight.

meta.plot: Seeking to avenge her father's death, a young woman becomes entangled in the web of the Fury, peacekeeper of the Paris criminal underworld.
When a struggling comedian shows one act of kindness to a vulnerable woman, it sparks a suffocating obsession which threatens to wreck both their lives.

1.title: EN - Baby Reindeer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Struggling comedian and barman Donny meets a lonely woman claiming to be a lawyer. He offers her a cup of tea on the house, and she's instantly obsessed.

1.title: EN - Baby Reindeer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: On a date with Teri, Donny opens up about his stalker. Trying to be kind, he gives Martha false hope, which only encourages her further.

1.title: EN - Baby Reindeer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Donny takes some time off from the pub and tries to make amends with Teri. But no matter how much he avoids Martha, he can't escape her for long.

1.title: EN - Baby Reindeer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: As Donny reports Martha to the police, it triggers the memory of a traumatic experience he had with a man he met at the Edinburgh Fringe years before.

1.title: EN - Baby Reindeer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Liz learns the truth about Martha and asks Donny to move out. It's a fresh start for him and Teri, but his memories stop them from getting truly close.

1.title: EN - Baby Reindeer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Martha finds new ways to get to Donny: by hurting the people he loves. With the police still failing to intervene, he takes matters into his own hands.

1.title: EN - Baby Reindeer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: For the first time in his career, Donny feels like he's going somewhere. Until he makes one careless mistake that lets Martha explode back into his life.

meta.plot: Eerie encounters, bizarre disappearances, haunting events and more perplexing phenomena are explored in this chilling investigative docuseries.

1.title: EN - Files of the Unexplained [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - File: Pascagoula Alien Abduction
1.plot: In 1973, a fishing trip in Pascagoula led to an unbelievable encounter that drew attention from the media and changed two men's lives forever.

1.title: EN - Files of the Unexplained [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - File: Ghosts of Myrtles Plantation
1.plot: Visitors and tour guides share their chilling accounts about the Myrtles Plantation, a hot spot for hauntings and a place with a dark, complicated past.

1.title: EN - Files of the Unexplained [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - File: Missing Yuba County Five
1.plot: In 1978, five men vanished in Yuba County. Disturbing evidence fueled a series of questions: Did they get lost — or was something more sinister at play?

1.title: EN - Files of the Unexplained [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - File: Government's UFO Conspiracy
1.plot: Since the '70s, US military personnel have reported strange sightings and dealt with mysterious health issues but were forced to stay silent — until now.

1.title: EN - Files of the Unexplained [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - File: Haunting of Lake Lanier
1.plot: With multiple deaths reported each year, Lake Lanier has sparked spooky folklore, leading locals and others to question what lies beneath the surface.

1.title: EN - Files of the Unexplained [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - File: Mysteries of Mt. Shasta
1.plot: Steeped in legend, Mount Shasta and its rich Indigenous history have attracted spiritual seekers, cult leaders and secret societies for decades.

1.title: EN - Files of the Unexplained [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - File: Bizarre Blobs of Washington
1.plot: When unknown substances fell from the sky in Oakville in 1994 and caused unexplained illnesses among residents, theories about their origins emerged.

1.title: EN - Files of the Unexplained [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - File: Floating Feet of Salish Sea
1.plot: In recent history, a bizarre mystery has rattled beachcombers and investigators alike: Why are severed feet being found on the shores of the Salish Sea?

meta.plot: A grifter in 1960s New York is hired to convince a wealthy man's son to return home from Italy and begins a life of deceit, fraud and murder.

1.title: EN - RIPLEY [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - I A HARD MAN TO FIND
1.plot: Tom Ripley's life of petty crime in New York City detours with an offer to bring a wealthy man's wayward son home from Europe.

1.title: EN - RIPLEY [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - II SEVEN MERCIES
1.plot: On Italy's Amalfi Coast, Tom settles into Dickie's grand villa, but not without arousing suspicion from his girlfriend Marge.

1.title: EN - RIPLEY [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - III SOMMERSO
1.plot: With funds low and his future in Italy in jeopardy, Tom puts a dark scheme into motion.

1.title: EN - RIPLEY [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - IV LA DOLCE VITA
1.plot: Tom must deal with Marge's deep skepticism before embarking on a new, fictitious life in Rome.

1.title: EN - RIPLEY [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - V LUCIO
1.plot: Ensconced in a lovely Rome apartment, Tom's perfect life is threatened by the arrival of an unexpected visitor.

1.title: EN - RIPLEY [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - VI SOME HEAVY INSTRUMENT
1.plot: A ghastly discovery leads Rome police to Tom's doorstep, beginning a game of cat and mouse with its lead investigator.

1.title: EN - RIPLEY [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - VII MACABRE ENTERTAINMENT
1.plot: As Inspector Ravini expands his murder investigation, an elusive Tom plots his next moves from Sicily.

1.title: EN - RIPLEY [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - VIII NARCISSUS
1.plot: Tom reinvents himself again, creating an enviable life in Venice — as long as his lies hold.

meta.plot: England, 1705: Framed for murder and on the run with her sisters, Nell Jackson turns her hand to highway robbery to survive. Aided by her superpowered sidekick, a plucky little sprite called Billy Blind, Nell realizes that fate has put her on the wrong side of the law for a reason. A reason much bigger than she could have ever imagined: to defeat a magical plot against the Queen of England.

1.title: EN - Renegade Nell [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Don't Call Me Nelly
1.plot: England, 1705: Nell Jackson's supernatural fighting skills stir up trouble on her return from war.

1.title: EN - Renegade Nell [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Tracks Less Well Trod
1.plot: On the run from the law, Nell, Roxy and George turn to highway robbery to survive.

1.title: EN - Renegade Nell [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - A Private Joke with the Queen
1.plot: Poynton's dark magic catches up with Nell. One of her sisters is dangerously wounded in the escape.

1.title: EN - Renegade Nell [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Devil's Dung
1.plot: Nell risks capture to find a doctor, and the gang receive help from some unlikely sources.

1.title: EN - Renegade Nell [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Excuse Me, I'm a Doctor
1.plot: Nell goes to Newgate Prison to try and rescue Devereux, and Roxy and George meet their Uncle Jack.

1.title: EN - Renegade Nell [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Snatched by Strollers
1.plot: Nell sets out to rescue George, and Rasselas finally confronts Sofia.

1.title: EN - Renegade Nell [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Stop Printing This Muck
1.plot: The gang head to Fleet Street to stop the news sheets from printing lies about Nell.

1.title: EN - Renegade Nell [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Not Some Cheap Trick
1.plot: Nell and the gang race against time to stop Poynton and save the Queen.

meta.plot: The Defenders is a drama about two colorful Las Vegas defense attorneys who go all-in when it comes to representing their clients. Nick and Pete are the local go-to guys with an eclectic client list who are still looking to hit their own jackpot.

1.title: FR - The Defenders - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: Nick and Pete use whatever tactics necessary in order to defend a young man facing murder charges in a case unique to Vegas.

1.title: FR - The Defenders - S01E02 - Las Vegas v. Reid
1.plot: Nick Morelli works the system to free a single mother accused of running down a jogger while chit chatting on her cell phone, meanwhile, Pete Kaczmarek does his best to help a man down on his luck.

1.title: FR - The Defenders - S01E03 - Nevada v. Carter
1.plot: Nick defends a stripper accused of solicitation; Pete must take on an unwanted case after losing a hand of poker.

1.title: FR - The Defenders - S01E04 - Nevada v. Cerrato
1.plot: Nick is ready to accept a simple arson case until he realizes that his client could be convicted of first-degree murder. Meanwhile, Pete helps a lottery winner take on a casino when he loses his fortune after a night of high rolling.

1.title: FR - The Defenders - S01E05 - Nevada v. Senator Harper
1.plot: In the middle of a divorce case, a client is charged with the kidnapping and burglary; Pete defends a cabana girl accused of assault and battery.

1.title: FR - The Defenders - S01E06 - Nevada v. Rodgers
1.plot: Nick defends a man charged with attempted murder; a man is caught with stolen Elvis memorabilia.

1.title: FR - The Defenders - S01E07 - Las Vegas v. Black Betty
1.plot: Nick reluctantly defends an entertainer's girlfriend when she is charged with murder; Lisa's newest client reveals potentially dangerous information.

1.title: FR - The Defenders - S01E08 - Nevada v. Killa Diz
1.plot: Nick comes to the defense of a young rapper wanted on two counts of first-degree murder. Meanwhile, Pete takes the case of an Internet hacker facing RICO charges.

1.title: FR - The Defenders - S01E09 - Whitten v. Fenlee
1.plot: When a woman's husband dies from a fall on a construction site, Nick and Pete look to prove wrongful death against the company. Meanwhile, Pete tries to help an online blogger avoid jail after exposing an illusionist's magic trick.

1.title: FR - The Defenders - S01E10 - Nevada v. Dennis
1.plot: When a young man is pulled over carrying guns with filed-off serial numbers, Nick and Pete try to get the charges thrown out. Meanwhile, Nick agrees to help the ADA's sister save a bear from being euthanized.

1.title: FR - The Defenders - S01E11 - Nevada v. Riley
1.plot: Nick and Pete come to the aid of a troubled ex-football player charged with battery. Meanwhile, Pete becomes exasperated when his father shows up in town.

1.title: FR - The Defenders - S01E12 - Nevada v. Wayne
1.plot: Nick's personal ties to a young man charged with sexual assault prompt him to defend the accusations. Meanwhile, Pete is stunned when he has jury duty.

1.title: FR - The Defenders - S01E13 - Nevada v. Donnie the Numbers Guy
1.plot: Seventeen years after disappearing on the eve of his wife's murder trial, a man from Nick's past returns to Vegas looking to prove his innocence by relying on new technological tools.

1.title: FR - The Defenders - S01E14 - Nevada v. Doug the Mule
1.plot: When a young man is pulled over carrying 30 bricks of cocaine, Nick and Pete look to prove their client was duped by a girl he met on spring break.

1.title: FR - The Defenders - S01E15 - Nevada v. Hunter
1.plot: Facing thirty counts of possession of a controlled substance, an overconfident judge turns to Nick, who has no choice but to help acquit him of the charges.

1.title: FR - The Defenders - S01E16 - Noland v. Galloway Pharmaceuticals
1.plot: Nick and Pete go after a pharmaceutical company for faulty packaging when two victims overdose on the same drug. Lisa is secretly seeing ADA Ward all the while considering a fascinating new job offer.

1.title: FR - The Defenders - S01E17 - Nevada v. Greene
1.plot: Unable to recall any events from the previous night, the son of a hotel owner turns to Nick and Pete for help after he awakes to find a casino host strangled to death in a hot tub.

1.title: FR - The Defenders - S01E18 - Morelli v. Kaczmarek
1.plot: The firm temporarily dissolves its partnership when they have to defend a husband and wife accused of murder.

meta.plot: After a plane is hijacked, two flight attendants must outwit their assailants amid intense negotiations in the air and on the ground. Based on real events.

1.title: EN - The Hijacking of Flight 601 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Leave Her to Heaven
1.plot: After a chaotic morning at home, things only get worse for Edie — until an unlikely event becomes a chance for her to redeem herself.

1.title: EN - The Hijacking of Flight 601 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Death at Her Heels
1.plot: During a board meeting, Aerobolivar executives disagree on how to handle the crisis. Aristides makes contact with the kidnappers. Edie jumps in to help.

1.title: EN - The Hijacking of Flight 601 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Dog Day Night
1.plot: Aristides takes matters into his own hands. Edie and Barbara plot to slow down the kidnappers — and start to suspect they're not who they claim to be.

1.title: EN - The Hijacking of Flight 601 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Wretched of the Earth
1.plot: The previous lives of Ulises and Toro as struggling athletes are unveiled, shedding light on the motives that led them to their present actions.

1.title: EN - The Hijacking of Flight 601 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - 601: An Aerospace Odyssey
1.plot: Chavarriaga asks Aristides to give a false testimony, but instead he rebels and forces the crew to recalibrate their plan.

1.title: EN - The Hijacking of Flight 601 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Woman Who Knew Too Much
1.plot: The crew gives their harrowing testimonies, but a pact forces them to withhold the truth. Will Wilches tip the balance in their favor... if he survives?

meta.plot: A young woman is forced to return to her trailer-park beginnings after her political career is derailed by a sex scandal.

1.title: FR - Too Close to Home - S01E01 - Dangerously Close
1.plot: Anna finds herself in a deadly predicament that reveals her deeply guarded secret. Then Anna searches for a safe-haven after her secret is revealed.

1.title: FR - Too Close to Home - S01E02 - Alabama
1.plot: Shelby unknowingly puts her and Bonnie's lives in danger.

1.title: FR - Too Close to Home - S01E03 - Highway 16
1.plot: Anna's recent controversy sparks many questions.

1.title: FR - Too Close to Home - S01E04 - Have You Heard?
1.plot: Anna introduces her co-worker's partner, Victor, to Happy, Alabama.

meta.plot: One fateful day, all of humanity was petrified by a blinding flash of light. After several millennia, high schooler Taiju awakens and finds himself lost in a world of statues. However, he's not alone! His science-loving friend Senku's been up and running for a few months and he's got a grand plan in mind, to kickstart civilization with the power of science!

1.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Stone World
1.plot: Several thousand years after a mysterious phenomenon  turns all of humanity to stone, the extraordinarily intelligent, science-driven boy, Senku Ishigami, awakens from petrification. Facing a world of stone and the total collapse of civilization, Senku makes up his mind to use science to rebuild the world. Starting with his super strong childhood friend Taiju Oki, who awakened at the same time, they will begin to rebuild civilization from nothing. Depicting two million years of scientific history from the Stone Age to present day, the unprecedented crafting adventure story is about to begin.

1.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - King of the Stone World
1.plot: Facing immediate danger from wild animals Senku and Taiju are forced to revive Tsukasa Shishio "The Strongest High School Primate". Although Tsukasa has tremendous fighting ability and provides abundant food as their hunter, their new ally harbors an opposing view on restoring humanity.

1.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Weapons of Science
1.plot: Senku does not trust the motivation of Shishio, so he will try to hide his plans from a new and unforeseen enemy for his plan to revive civilization.

1.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Fire the Smoke Signal
1.plot: Senku has the idea of ​​creating gunpowder to have a way to balance the scale and have a chance to defeat Shishio. The production of gunpowder causes a fire. Shortly thereafter, Senku and the others discover smoke signals on the horizon. An accident? Hardly likely. Apparently there are other people in the stone world ...

1.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Stone World The Beginning
1.plot: Shishio is determined to end Senku's life if he does not promise at that moment that he will abandon his idea of ​​recovering civilization as it was before the incident.

1.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Two Nations of the Stone World
1.plot: Taiju and Yuzuriha figure out Senku's secret to reviving him. But now that he's back, they need to deal with Tsukasa.

1.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Where Two Million Years Have Gone
1.plot: Kohaku shows Senku to her village, but it's going to take some convincing before they let him in. In the meantime, he makes friends with a like-minded, promising "sorcerer."

1.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Stone Road
1.plot: Kohaku's sister, village priestess Ruri, is gravely ill. Senku, Chrome and Kohaku begin their quest to make antibiotics to save her life.

1.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Let There Be the Light of Science
1.plot: Senku starts a ramen stand in hopes of winning over support for his kingdom of science, but some people are too principled to take such a bribe. Mentalist Asagiri Gen is not one of them.

1.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - A Flimsy Alliance
1.plot: Senku and his kingdom of science successfully test the first lightbulb since the collapse. Meanwhile, Asagiri Gen, a spy from Tsukasa's empire, is killed by an unknown attacker.

1.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Clear World
1.plot: The development of glassworks, an important step for making sulfa drugs and for chemistry as a whole, turns out to have a surprising benefit for Suika.

1.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Buddies Back to Back
1.plot: To make antibiotics, Senku and his kingdom need to obtain sulfuric acid from a fountain of the stuff. The team goes prepared, but there's no guarantee that they'll make it back alive.

1.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - Masked Warrior
1.plot: All that's needed to make antibiotics is alcohol. The best way to get some is to win the Grand Bout, which the Senku and his kingdom will also need to do in order to keep Magma away from Ruri and give her the drug.

1.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S01E14 - Master of Flame
1.plot: After Magma's series of tricks to reach the final match, Chrome reveals a trick of his own! With a little extra help from Gen, Chrome just may be able to pull this one off!

1.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S01E15 - The Culmination of Two Million Years
1.plot: After Senku's unlikely victory, quick marriage, and even hastier divorce, the kingdom of science is back to work to finally finish Ruri's medicine!

1.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S01E16 - A Tale for the Ages
1.plot: Ruri reveals the origin of the village's name and Senku learns of his father's fate!

1.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S01E17 - A Hundred Nights and a Thousand Skies
1.plot: Byakuya and the astronauts' story continues, and Senku's connection to Ishigami Village and the Hundred Tales is finally revealed.

1.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S01E18 - Stone Wars
1.plot: Tsukasa's army is coming! Kinro struggles to hold the bridge against the deadly spearman Hyoga and his shock troops, but Senku and the villagers are ready with deadly new weapons of science!

1.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S01E19 - To Modernity
1.plot: Hyoga is disarmed, but the kingdom of science is still in danger - Ishigami village is in flames! And Tsukasa will soon know that Senku is still alive... How will the villagers fight off the coming invasion?

1.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S01E20 - The Age of Energy
1.plot: Work begins on creating the components for Senku's cell phone, but spinning gold wire is proving to be quite the task! Luckily, Chrome and Kaseki "invent" the water wheel and drastically improve the process!

1.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S01E21 - Spartan Crafts Club
1.plot: With Chrome and Kaseki’s water wheel finished, Ishigami Village moves into the age of electricity! But with the primitive materials available to him, will Senku be able to create a filament that can withstand the intense heat of operating a vacuum tube?

1.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S01E22 - The Treasure
1.plot: Senku, Chrome, and Magma venture into a cave in search of Tungsten, but there's a suspicious accident that leaves Senku and Chrome trapped at the bottom of a pit! What is Magma up to?!

1.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S01E23 - Wave of Science
1.plot: Senku and the rest of the village get to work on making the components for the cell phone. It's hard work but everyone is pumped!

1.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S01E24 - Voices Over Infinite Distance
1.plot: After a successful test of their new cell phone, Senku learns of a mysterious tale about a bee named Speaker who can play the voices of the dead.

2.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S02E01 - Stone Wars Beginning
2.plot: Senku continues in trying to advance the Stone World, this time he makes "space food", it is in actuality cup noodles. After Senku finishes his project, Gen has an epiphany and devises a plan to take down Tsukasa's army without violence.

2.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S02E02 - Hot Line
2.plot: While Senku's diversion buys Gen and others some time, soon Homura realizes something is not right.

2.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S02E03 - Call from the Dead
2.plot: Taiju and Yuzuriha are on the verge of tears after they hear Senku's voice, and Senku informs them of his plan to win the war without any bloodshed.

2.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S02E04 - Full Assault
2.plot: Chrome and Magma struggle with Ukyo, while Senku, gets his hands busy with building up an invention; a new hope.

2.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S02E05 - Steam Gorilla
2.plot: The final touches to the automobile are made and it is used to transport the science supplies to a fortified cliffside that's close to the Tsukasa empire. From there the automobile is upgraded into a tank, but unbeknownst to the rescue group preparations by the empire have been made to counter any vehicular attack.

2.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S02E06 - Prison Break
2.plot: Chrome must use all of his scientific knowledge to escape from his prison and save Senku and others.

2.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S02E07 - Secret Mission
2.plot: Senku decides to use the Steam-Gorilla to capture The Miracle Cave. Using Lillian's recording, Senku gains the trust of more of Tsukasa's men. Ukyo reveals he saw Yuzuriha's secret mission to reassemble the fragments of statues Tsukasa destroyed.

2.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S02E08 - Final Battle
2.plot: The Final Battle for the miracle cave starts as Senku and the Kingdom of Science conduct a frontal assault on the cave.

2.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S02E09 - To Destroy and to Save
2.plot: Senku demands a truce from Tsukasa in return for reviving his sister, Mirai, who Tsukasa comes to know is alive, but a new problem shows us when Hyoga shows his true self.

2.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S02E10 - Humanity's Strongest Tag Team
2.plot: Senku demands a truce from Tsukasa in return for reviving his sister, Mirai, who Tsukasa comes to know is alive, but a new problem shows up when Hyoga shows his true self.

2.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S02E11 - PROLOGUE OF Dr. STONE
2.plot: The Kingdom of Science is victorious, however it is not over for Senku. Senku must use all of his knowledge to cure Tsukasa who is severly injured.

3.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S03E01 - NEW WORLD MAP
3.plot: While continuing to use the hot air balloon to search for the oil, it's decided that Ishigami Village needs to take up agriculture to prevent future food shortages, as well as to produce preserved food for their upcoming sea voyage.

3.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S03E02 - Greed Equals Justice
3.plot: The Kingdom of Science will need rations to last them through their voyage to the other side of the world. But Senku, being no professional, burns all the bread he attempts to bake.

3.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S03E03 - First Contact
3.plot: Senku, brings along a team to look for the Sagara Oil Fields. Meanwhile, Suika and Francois go truffle hunting.

3.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S03E04 - Eyes of Science
3.plot: The morse code signal reading "WHY" saturates the airwaves too much for Ukyo to pinpoint a direction, so the Kingdom of Science works on a way to visualize the signal.

3.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S03E05 - Science Vessel Perseus
3.plot: Kaseki's efforts to build the science vessel Perseus hit a roadblock when he realizes that it's impossible to get all the parts to fit in practice.

3.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S03E06 - TREASURE BOX
3.plot: The Perseus crew are on their way to the treasure island, the birthplace of the Hundred Tales, where they hope to locate the treasure box left behind by the Soyuz crew.

3.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S03E07 - Ray of Despair, Ray of Hope
3.plot: The Perseus arrives at the treasure island. A recon squad consisting of Senku, Soyuz, Kohaku, and Gen set off to locate the platinum and make contact with the islanders. Ukyo later discovers something on the seafloor and send Ginro to investigate.

3.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S03E08 - The Trump Card Aboard the Science Vessel
3.plot: Amaryllis explains how she evaded petrification and how she came to her decision to sneak into the inner palace.

3.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S03E09 - Beautiful Science
3.plot: Suika and Ginro work together to rescue the mobile lab from the Perseus. Reunited with Senku and the others, the group works on items to help Kohaku with the selection process.

3.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S03E10 - SCIENCE WARS
3.plot: Amaryllis, Ginro and Kohaku are chosen to join the inner palace. The science team will need a way to communicate with them in secret, and, eventually, a way for them with the science team.

3.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S03E11 - With This Fist, a Miracle
3.plot: Kohaku has located the treasure left behind by Byakuya and the others, but it's encased in concrete. Senku has to devise a plan to quietly get at the contents inside, so as to not alert the guards.

4.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S04E01 - RYUSUI VS. SENKU
4.plot: Senku and his companions finally set off for America in search of corn. However, a dispute arises between Ryusui and Senku shortly after they depart.

4.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S04E02 - SCIENCE JOURNEY
4.plot: Maintaining morale will be critical on the long journey to the Americas. Knowing where on the ocean you are is pretty important, too. The crew of the Perseus discuss.

4.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S04E03 - Light Trap in the Darkness
4.plot: The Perseus lands in the Americas. They first head to Northern California in search of yellow dent corn, but discover a lot more than that.

4.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S04E04 - Dr. X
4.plot: The search party narrowly escaped enemy machine gun fire. Unfortunately, the respite was short-lived.

4.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S04E05 - DOCTOR VS. DOCTOR
4.plot: Tensions rise as Dr. Xeno makes his introductions to the Perseus.

4.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S04E06 - SCIENCE IS ELEGANT
4.plot: Stanley orders Luna to infiltrate the Perseus and identify Doctor Taiju. Things go sideways when it turns out to be a little too easy.

4.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S04E07 - The Two Scientists
4.plot: Senku had gotten his start in rocket building through an email exchange with Doctor Xeno. Their approaches to science soon diverged.

4.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S04E08 - LOCK ON
4.plot: NASA scientist Dr. Xeno attempts to pick off the leader of the Kingdom of Science.

4.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S04E09 - Light of Science
4.plot: With Senku having been shot, the Kingdom of Science plots its retaliation against Dr. Xeno.

4.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S04E10 - Dirty Roads
4.plot: With Senku still confined to the bed, Chrome's team begins work on the tunnel to Xeno's base.

4.title: EN - Dr. STONE [MULTI-SUB] - S04E11 - Those Who Know the Rules; Those Who Make Them
4.plot: Ryusui and Senku take to the skies in a science versus science dogfight while Xeno's forces mount a ground counterattack.

meta.plot: Asta and Yuno are two orphans who want the same thing: to become the Wizard King. Locked in a friendly rivalry, they work hard towards their goal. While Yuno excels at magic, Asta has a problem uncommon in this world: he has no powers! But, on the day they receive their grimoires, they surprise everyone. To reach their goal, they’ll each find their own path to greatness—with or without magic.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E01 - Asta and Yuno
1.plot: In this world, everyone can use magic… and in a land called the Clover Kingdom, two young men, Asta and Yuno, strive to become the Wizard King, the greatest of all magic users. Asta and Yuno were abandoned together at a church in Hage, a village in the boonies, and lived as brothers from that day onward. For some reason, however, Asta never developed the ability to use magic, even when Yuno had already mastered wind magic. Now, at last, the boys are turning fifteen, the age at which children receive their own grimoires. Asta has high hopes that receiving his grimoire will awaken his latent ability to use magic, but when the time comes…

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E02 - The Boys’ Promise
1.plot: The grimoire that Yuno received was a legendary grimoire with a four-leaf clover. A bandit named Revchi comes to steal it, and Asta comes to Yuno’s rescue.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E03 - To the Royal Capital of the Clover Kingdom!
1.plot: Asta and Yuno spend six months training for the upcoming Magic Knights Entrance Exam. Everyone seems to think Yuno is sure to pass, but worries that Asta is just wasting his time.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E04 - The Magic Knights Entrance Exam
1.plot: Asta and Yuno head toward the colosseum in the royal capital for the Magic Knights Entrance Exam, while looking around and admiring all the things they’ve never seen before.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E05 - The Path to the Wizard King
1.plot: The entrance exam finally comes to a close. The time has arrives for the captains to decide which candidates they want to join their squads.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E06 - The Black Bulls
1.plot: Asta has arrived at the home of the Black Bulls, which Yami himself called the absolute worst Magic Knights Squad. He is greeted by the squad’s unique members.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E07 - The Other New Recruit
1.plot: As a new member of the Black Bulls, Asta is thrilled to receive his very first private room, even though it’s tiny. Everything Asta sees as Magna shows him around the squad’s base is new and exciting to him.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E08 - Go! Go! First Mission
1.plot: The Magic Knights: heroes that everyone in the kingdom looks up to and dreams of becoming one day. But the new recruit, Asta, has yet to do anything that seems like what a Magic Knight should be doing, as he’s stuck doing random chores.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E09 - Beasts
1.plot: On Yami’s orders, Asta and Noelle go on their first mission with Magna to hunt wild boars. They successfully complete the mission and go to Saussy Village to meet with the mayor, Seyhe.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E10 - Those Who Protect
1.plot: Asta, Noelle, and Magna are doing their best to protect the villagers of Rayaka from the ice magic user Heath and his underlings, but Asta’s attacks don’t seem to be working, and Magna’s magical powers are running low.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E11 - What Happened on a Certain Day in the Castle Town
1.plot: It’s payday! Vanessa takes Asta and Noelle to the castle town of Kikka for a little shopping, where they encounter many familiar faces along the way.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E12 - The Wizard King Saw
1.plot: All eyes are on Asta as he and Sekke race to capture a purse-snatcher. Meanwhile, Yuno’s first Golden Dawn mission takes him to an unexpected place.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E13 - The Wizard King Saw, Continued
1.plot: Yuno never expected his last-minute detour to involve such tragedy. It’s up to the Golden Dawn to get the bottom of their mission’s many mysteries.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E14 - Dungeon
1.plot: Asta and Noelle are charged with exploring a newly discovered dungeon full of magical traps. Their leader, the battle-mad Luck, is less than helpful.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E15 - The Diamond Mage
1.plot: Suddenly the dungeon is host to several teams racing through traps to the treasure waiting in its depth—including a noted mage from an enemy nation.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E16 - Friends
1.plot: Asta, Yuno, and their squadmates must take on daunting foes on their way to the heart of the dungeon, but Luck remains dead set on fighting all alone.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E17 - Destroyer
1.plot: The Diamond Kingdom’s secret weapon wields more powerful magic than anyone has seen. The Golden Dawn team is all but decimated. Can he be defeated?

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E18 - Memories of You
1.plot: The Clover Kingdom’s Magic Knights reach the dungeon’s treasure hall, but another daunting battle keeps them from reveling in their victory for long.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E19 - Destruction and Salvation
1.plot: The dungeon itself turns against the Magic Knights as they fight to escape—and to keep a badly wounded Asta alive. Mars remembers how he came to be.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E20 - Assembly at the Royal Capital
1.plot: Asta and Noelle visits the royal capital to report on the dungeon mission, but get roped into something else entirely with their Golden Dawn friends.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E21 - Capital Riot
1.plot: The royal capital is under siege! The Magic Knight squads must set aside their quarrels and come together to defend the Clover Kingdom and its people.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E22 - Wild Magic Dance
1.plot: The best of the Magic Knights—plus Asta and Noelle—fight the hordes of undead beseiging the royal capital. Noelle suffers a crisis of confidence.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E23 - The Crimson Lion King
1.plot: Asta’s showdown with the man behind the capital invasion takes a turn. King Clover bemoans the Wizard King’s absence in his kingdom’s time of need.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E24 - Blackout
1.plot: Rades wasn’t the only invader—and the others are more powerful, their sights set far higher. The Magic Knights fall victim to a Spatial Magic spell.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E25 - Adversity
1.plot: What has become of Fuegoleon Vermillion? Yuno struggles to recover from his battle with the witch, while Asta’s cursed wounds threaten to do him in.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E26 - Wounded Beasts
1.plot: The masterminds behind the invasion reveal themselves, though their motivation remains unclear. Asta spends quality time with one of his heroes.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E27 - Light
1.plot: As life slowly returns to normal in the royal capital, the Wizard King reaches an uncomfortable conclusion about the invasion and how it came about.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E28 - The One I’ve Set My Heart On
1.plot: Finral invites two of his squadmates to a mixer, but they aren’t the only Magic Knights who show up. Asta gets closer to a certain young woman.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E29 - Path
1.plot: Old friends and fellow squad members reminisce about Asta: his humble beginnings, his craziest battles—and underlying it all, his burning ambition.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E30 - The Mirror Mage
1.plot: The Black Bulls get a day off, which Gauche spends visiting his beloved sister Marie. Then a mysterious tragedy befalls the village—is Marie safe?

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E31 - Pursuit Over the Snow
1.plot: Asta and Gauche scour the countryside in search of Nean’s children, who have fallen into the clutches of a ruthless monster thirsty for their magic.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E32 - Three-Leaf Sprouts
1.plot: As expected, there were bigger baddies behind the abduction of Nean’s children. Luckily Sister Theresa is on hand to join the fight for their freedom.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E33 - To Help Somebody Someday
1.plot: Gauche reflects on his past as he struggles with protecting Marie versus helping Asta in his downhill battle against Sally’s mutant magic monster.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E34 - Light Magic vs. Dark Magic
1.plot: Backup arrives for Asta’s showdown against the leader of the Eye of the Midnight Sun. Asta must push past his limits to pull off a tricky technique.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E35 - The Light of Judgment
1.plot: The Black Bulls seem to be on the losing end of an epic clash between two highly gifted magic users. Gauche has an idea that could turn the tables.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E36 - Three Eyes
1.plot: Three elite members of the Eye of the Midnight Sun pay a visit to their comrade Licht, prepared to make Yami and friends pay for what they’ve done.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E37 - The One with No Magic
1.plot: The Third Eye battle rages on, now with three talented Magic Knight captains providing backup. Licht reveals an intriguing tidbit about Asta’s gear.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E38 - The Magic Knight Captains Conference
1.plot: The Wizard King calls a meeting of the Magic Knight captains. Asta has barely enough time to recuperate before being summoned to the royal capital.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E39 - Three-Leaf Salute
1.plot: There’s a traitor among the captains! Marx’s spell reveals who’s been collaborating with the Eye of the Midnight Sun. Julius considers his next move.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E40 - A Black Beach Story
1.plot: The Black Bulls relax at the beach as they gear up for their secret mission. Noelle’s showing off new swimsuit—if Asta would pay any attention.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E41 - The Water Girl Grows Up
1.plot: Noelle’s magic is indispensable for the fight ahead. A new friend has some tips to help improve her magic control, but Noelle has a long way to go.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E42 - The Underwater Temple
1.plot: The eccentric high priest of the Underwater Temple makes it crystal clear that the Black Bulls won’t get their hands on the magic stone that easily.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E43 - Temple Battle Royale
1.plot: It’s the misfit magicians of the Black Bulls up against the fearsome fish-masked Temple Mages. Noelle faces a surprising foe, and Asta uses his head.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E44 - The Pointlessly Direct Fireball and the Wild Lightning
1.plot: A dangerous interloper has muscled his way into the Underwater Temple fight, and it’s up to Yami’s crew to deal with him and his mind-boggling might.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E45 - The Guy Who Doesn’t Know When to Quit
1.plot: While Asta has his hands more than full with Vetto, Gauche must think outside the box as he takes on some of the beastly mage’s talented minions.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E46 - Awakening
1.plot: The Black Bulls and their new Underwater Temple friends pull out all the stops to take down Vetto, but there’s far more to him than meets the eye.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E47 - The Only Weapon
1.plot: Vanessa and Finral find inspiration as a tattered remnant of Black Bulls bands together to tackle the mighty Vetto—who shows no sign of slowing down.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E48 - Despair vs. Hope
1.plot: Finral and Vanessa reflect on their pasts while guiding Asta’s attacks, but they’ll need to change it up to keep the furry fiend Vetto on his toes.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E49 - Beyond Limits
1.plot: Asta’s never-give-up attitude has a impact on his fellow Black Bulls. Vetto recalls his youth, while Yami comes to a realization and takes action.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E50 - End of the Battle, End of Despair
1.plot: The Black Bulls recover after their fight against the Eye of the Midnight Sun took everything out of them—literally. Asta gets himself back on track.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E51 - Proof of Rightness
1.plot: The Clover Kingdom can barely breathe a sigh of relief before the border village of Kiten is attacked by the Diamond Kingdom’s most fearsome generals.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E52 - Whoever’s Strongest Wins
1.plot: Yuno and the Golden Dawn take point in Kiten, while the Black Bulls’ contingent tend to the survivors. Yami has a little chat with William Vangeance.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E53 - Behind the Mask
1.plot: William Vangeance opens up to Yami about his past, while Finral stands up to his brother Langris. Julius questions the Diamond Kingdom’s intentions.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E54 - Never Again
1.plot: Asta gets shocking news from the top doctor in the entire Clover Kingdom. His fellow Black Bulls rally behind him, scrambling to find a way to help.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E55 - The Man Named Fanzell
1.plot: A flashback to Asta’s days learning the sword under a skilled mage with a complicated past—and a dangerous future. Noelle hopes he can help Asta now.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E56 - The Man Named Fanzell Continued
1.plot: Fanzell meets Asta again once Asta’s joined the Black Bulls, but this time he’s far from alone. In the present, Vanessa seeks a cure for Asta’s curse.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E57 - Infiltration
1.plot: Noelle’s contingent is intent on infiltrating the Forest of Witches. They’ll need mighty magic to get past the relentless security and meet the queen.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E58 - Battlefield Decision
1.plot: Faced with the destruction of her forest and the deaths of her “daughters,” the Queen of Witches helps Asta to help her fend off two invading armies.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E59 - Flames of Hatred
1.plot: Together, Asta and friends must find a way to extinguish the flames of Fana’s deep-seated hatred—and the literal flames of her fire spirit familiar.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E60 - Defectors’ Atonement
1.plot: Fanzell goes up against two of his former pupils, now among the Diamond Kingdom’s top-ranking generals—and one of them wields dangerous new powers.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E61 - The Promised World
1.plot: Mars is on a mission to save his childhood friend, even as it becomes increasingly clear that only Asta’s anti-magic stands a chance against her.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E62 - Those Who Boost Each Other Up
1.plot: Fana shares what she remembers of her past, but her touching reunion is interrupted by a relentless foe with an insatiable appetite for magic.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E63 - Not in the Slightest
1.plot: Asta undergoes a startling transformation, fighting like a man possessed. When he learns who’s behind this change, he also learns its shocking price.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E64 - The Red Thread of Fate
1.plot: Vanessa recalls her painful past as she faces off against the Queen of Witches, who is manipulating Asta into killing her squadmates before her eyes.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E65 - I’m Home
1.plot: Asta and his squadmates learn about the origins of the Eye of the Midnight Sun, Vanessa finds her place, and the Black Bulls make their way back home.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E66 - The Eye of the Midnight Sun’s Secret
1.plot: Klaus helps Yuno and Mimosa get caught up on the Magic Knight Squads’ encounters with the Eye of the Midnight Sun. Yami meets with the Wizard King.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E66 - The Eye of the Midnight Sun’s Secret
1.plot: Klaus helps Yuno and Mimosa get caught up on the Magic Knight Squads’ encounters with the Eye of the Midnight Sun. Yami meets with the Wizard King.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E67 - A Fun Festival Double Date
1.plot: The Black Bulls attend the Star Festival, where Asta and Noelle are roped into a double date. The mood is right to tell each other how they feel.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E68 - Battle to the Death?! Yami vs. Jack
1.plot: Captains Yami and Jack the Ripper are ready to settle their long-running rivalry, while their newest squad members are desperate to rein them in.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E69 - The Briar Maiden’s Melancholy
1.plot: Captain Charlotte of the Blue Rose Knights thinks back to her past, but not before she and Vanessa battle it out in more than one ill-advised contest.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E70 - Two New Stars
1.plot: The Wizard King announces the latest Magic Knight squad rankings and reveals the two top star-earners, while King Clover introduces a bold new plan.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E71 - The Uncrowned, Undefeated Lioness
1.plot: Mereoleona Vermillion, the new captain of the Crimson Lion Kings, takes the squad (and a few Black Bulls) along for training in a strong magic region.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E72 - Saint Elmo’s Fire
1.plot: Asta attempts to tap into his mysterious dark powers so he can make it to Mereoleona’s hot spring training camp. Noelle learns about her late mother.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E73 - The Royal Knights Selection Test
1.plot: Magic Knights from every squad gather for the test that will determine who’ll be a Royal Knight. The vice-captain of the Purple Orcas causes a stir.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E74 - Flower of Resolution
1.plot: Round 1 of the tournament sees Asta and Mimosa teaming up for a heated battle against three skilled senior Magic Knights. But what happened to Xerx?

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E75 - Fierce Battle
1.plot: The tournament continues as Magna and Sol fight alongside the conceited Kirsch Vermillion and Finral takes a risk with teammates Leopold and Hamon.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E76 - Mage X
1.plot: A mystery mage with a tortured past joins the competition with unconventional but powerful magic, taking everyone by surprise—friend and foe alike.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E77 - Bad Blood
1.plot: It’s Noelle chance to prove to her brother Solid that she’s far from a failure, while Alecdora Sandler takes out his jealousy on the upstart Yuno.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E78 - Peasant Trap
1.plot: Narcissist royal Kirsch takes offense at having to battle Asta the commoner, but Asta has some new tricks up his sleeve that catch Zora off guard.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E79 - Mister Delinquent vs. Muscle Brains
1.plot: It’s not looking good for Asta’s team; even anti-magic Asta has his hands full guarding their crystal from squadmate Magna’s powerful new Flame spell.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E80 - Special Little Brother vs. Failed Big Brother
1.plot: The long-awaited showdown between Finral and Langris has come around at last, and gentle Finral must prove himself to his cutthroat little brother.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E81 - The Life of a Certain Man
1.plot: The Magic Knights question Langris’ sanity as he challenges Asta to a fight in the middle of the tournament. Zora recalls his Magic Knight father.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E82 - Petit Clover! The Nightmarish Charmy SP!
1.plot: In a break from all the action, a forest-foraging Charmy falls victim to a mind-altering mushroom that gives her vivid visions of Clover Clips past.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E83 - Burn It Into You
1.plot: The semifinal bout between Asta and Langris comes to a grim conclusion. Luck has a plan that could give his team the edge over Aqua Deer captain Rill.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E84 - The Victors
1.plot: It’s the final match in the Royal Knights Selection Test. Rill seeks inspiration for his masterpiece; Yuno and Bell are ready to try something new.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E85 - Together in the Bath
1.plot: Yami suggests a leisurely bath to get Asta out of his funk. While there, he reminisces about his first battle alongside the masked William Vangeance.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E86 - Yami and Vangeance
1.plot: Yami tells another tale of his younger days in the Magic Knights: a top-secret mission given to him and William Vangeance by the Wizard King himself.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E87 - Formation of the Royal Knights
1.plot: Those who have passed the Royal Knights Selection Test assemble for the first time to be briefed on their mission: defeat the Eye of the Midnight Sun.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E88 - Storming the Eye of the Midnight Sun’s Hideout!!!
1.plot: The Royal Knights relocate to the royal capital in preparation for their attack on the floating dungeon in Gravito Stones. Klaus warns of enemy spies.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E89 - The Black Bulls’ Hideout
1.plot: Gauche, Gordon, and Grey are holding down the fort when the hideout is attacked by some familiar faces. The trio must work fast to defend their home.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E90 - Crazy Magic Battle
1.plot: The Black Bulls learn why their home base keeps changing shape; that same power is put to the test against members of the Eye of the Midnight Sun.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E91 - Mereoleona vs. Raia the Disloyal
1.plot: Fierce fighter Mereoleona takes on Raia of the Third Eye and his wide range of formidable Copy Magic spells as Zora tries to figure out how they work.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E92 - The Wizard King vs. The Leader of the Eye of the Midnight Sun
1.plot: It’s a battle for the ages as the Clover Kingdom’s mightiest mage takes on the dynamic leader of the Eye of the Midnight Sun—and an unexpected guest.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E93 - Julius Novachrono
1.plot: The battle rages on between the Wizard King and Licht, who holds a kingdom’s worth of innocent people hostage. Julius recalls his greatest motivation.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E94 - New Future
1.plot: Yami rushes to Julius’ side as the Wizard King’s battle with Licht draws to a close. Yuno’s team approaches the center of the terrorist’s hideout.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E96 - The Black Bulls Captain vs. the Crimson Wild Rose
1.plot: It’s Yami versus the elves: first Marx and Owen, then an elf-possessed Charlotte who seems bent on destroying the royal capital and everyone in it.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E97 - Overwhelming Disadvantage
1.plot: Royal Knights and disgraced mages alike encounter friends and squadmates whose bodies have been taken over by reincarnated elves. Can Black Asta help?

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E98 - The Sleeping Lion
1.plot: The vice-captain of the Crimson Lion Kings, now a reincarnated elf, turns on his squadmates with powerful Air Magic. A mighty beast awakens at last.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E99 - The Desperate Path Toward Survival
1.plot: Mereoleona is left to face five powerful elf enemies alone, putting her “undefeated” title to the test. Mimosa’s Royal Knight teammates turn on her.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E100 - We Won’t Lose to You
1.plot: Asta confronts his rival, Yuno, one of many Golden Dawn members to have been taken over by elves. Licht is spurred to action, as are Yami and Finral.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E101 - The Lives of the Village in the Sticks
1.plot: Even remote little Hage Village is not immune from the chaos overtaking the Clover Kingdom. Asta and Yuno are determined to fight for their hometown.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E102 - Two Miracles
1.plot: As Asta and Yuno battle a Poison Plant mage, Sister Lily recalls the letters they would send home. The priest is in a bad way; can Asta’s sword help?

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E103 - Release from Misfortune
1.plot: As the elves set their sights on the royal capital, bent on destroying all humankind, Asta’s newest sword may be the key to driving them out for good.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E104 - Lightning of Rage vs. Friends
1.plot: After a chance encounter with their squadmate Luck, Magna and Vanessa go to extremes in a struggle to free their friend from a crazed elf’s clutches.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E105 - Smiles, Tears
1.plot: Asta and friends stop by the ruined Black Bulls hideout to check in with their squadmates before pursuing the reincarnated elves to the royal capital.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E106 - Path of Revenge, Path of Atonement
1.plot: Fueled by Charmy’s magical meals, Asta’s team detours to defend Hecairo on their way to the royal capital and picks up a trio of most unlikely allies.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E107 - The Battle for Clover Castle
1.plot: Yami and Finral take on possessed members of the Golden Dawn; Noelle and Nozel must defend their siblings when the Silva family home is under siege.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E108 - Battlefield Dancer
1.plot: Noelle must think outside the box to gain the upper hand in the pitched battle at House Silva. Thoughts of her mother help her push past her limits.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E109 - Spatial Mage Brothers
1.plot: While Mimosa, Kirsch, and En were protecting the Vermillion residence from the elves, Langris, who had reincarnated as an elf, had arrived at the castle. He goes after the king’s life but Finral shows up with Captain Yami and Captain Jack. Despite knowing the difference in power between him and his younger brother, Finral continues to support Captain Yami and Captain Jack in this fight against Langris. Finral goes for a risky attack which injures him, and…

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E110 - The Raging Bull Joins the Showdown!!
1.plot: As the battle at Clover Castle continues the Shadow Palace appears. Captain Yami and Captain Jack get a bad feeling about this, so they try to infiltrate the palace, but Magic Knights who had reincarnated as elves keep getting in their way. Then Asta and the other Black Bulls as well as Rades, Sally, and Valtos arrive! Asta tries to undo the reincarnation spell that’s been cast on the Magic Knights, but then the Captain of the Coral Peacocks, Dorothy Unsworth, who has also reincarnated as an elf appears before them!

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E111 - The Eyes in the Mirror
1.plot: Due to Captain Dorothy’s magic, Vanessa, who can use magic to alter fate and Charmy, who can use magic to recover mana had disappeared. Asta and the remaining Black Bulls have lost the bulk of their defense and are now struggling against Gauche and Marie’s combo magic being used against them. Meanwhile, Vanessa and her team try to figure out how to get out of Captain Dorothy’s dream world.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E112 - Humans Who Can Be Trusted
1.plot: Vanessa and her team are able to figure out how to leave Captain Dorothy’s Glamour World due to quick thinking on Sally’s part, but it’s easier said than done. But then Luck gets an idea to help them out. Meanwhile, Asta continues to try to undo the reincarnation spell on Gauche and Marie but can’t even get close to them. Henry sees this and decides to make a great sacrifice…

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E113 - Storming the Shadow Palace
1.plot: After their last battle, Asta and some of the others decide to chase after Captain Yami and some others who had already headed into the Shadow Palace. However, the elves get in their way. It was then that Captain Fuegoleon and Captain Mereoleona, both who had just awakened, showed off their true powers. Asta and the others are happy to have their help, but then notice that the door to the Shadow Palace closing. In order to get Asta and his group into the palace, the other Black Bulls hold off the elves outside.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E114 - The Final Invaders
1.plot: The Black Bulls fight off the elves as Asta and the captains head into the Shadow Palace. However, they start to feel cornered from being so run down from one battle after another. It was then that Yuno had finally arrived to save them, bringing other Magic Knights he found throughout the land with him. Yuno hears the situation from Charmy and decides to head into the Shadow Palace, too. However, the entrance was now closed. But then, his pendant starts to react in a strange way…

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E115 - Mastermind
1.plot: Yuno manages to enter the Shadow Palace with his pendant and runs into Patry and the others. However, his pendant is immediately stolen. Now, all of the necessary magic stones have been collected and the elves’ wish was supposed to come true. However, an uninvited guest appears before them: A devil from another world. They find out everything that happened between the elves and humans were actually a part of his plan all along. Yuno can’t hide is astonishment at how powerful the devil is as he tries to fight it, and then Asta and Mimosa also arrive!

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E116 - The Ultimate Natural Enemy
1.plot: “When the owner of the four-leaf grimoire is filled with despair, the five-leaf clover grimoire will be born.” Patry is filled with despair after learning he had been manipulated by the devil all this time and turns into a dark elf. He then starts attacking Yuno and Asta, fueled by nothing but hatred and malice. Somehow, becoming a dark elf had made Patry even stronger, which gives Yuno and Asta an even harder time fighting him. Then Captain Nozel appears before them. Nozel happens to have the best magical attribute to fight against light magic, mercury magic.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E117 - Breaking the Seal
1.plot: The strange little black bird Nero, who kept following Asta around, suddenly appears before Finral, who had just finished fighting with his brother Langris, and demands that he take them to the Demon’s bones back in Hage Village. Finral is obviously startled that Nero’s suddenly speaking human words but obliges and takes Nero to the bones and witnesses an unbelievable sight. We will finally find out the true events that befell the elves 500 years ago! Meanwhile, back at the Shadow Palace, the devil’s eerie magic fills the room.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E118 - A Reunion Across Time and Space
1.plot: To stop the devil from leaving the Shadow Palace Asta, Yuno, and Patry, who had just regained his senses, head to the top floor. Once they get there, they are greeted by the first Wizard King, Lumiere Silvamillion Clover and the one who serves him, Secré Swallowtail。Secré is the true form of the mysterious bird, Nero, and she is a mage that uses a rare magic called sealing magic. She uses her magic to break the seal on Licht, and they are able to witness the true leader of the elves, Licht, and his true powers. An epic battle begins so that Licht and Lumiere can get revenge against the devil.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E119 - The Final Attack
1.plot: Licht and Lumiere fight against the devil using incredibly powerful magic. But the devil has incredible regeneration powers and quickly heals himself, making him difficult to defeat. Asta witnesses the two powerful mages fighting and tries to figure out if he can use his anti-magic in a more useful way. He’s able to use a new power, but it’s so powerful that he’s having a hard time controlling it. Meanwhile, Yuno also awakens to a new power… Asta and Yuno, who both aspire to be the future Wizard King, pull off an impressive attack in front of the first Wizard King!

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E120 - Dawn
1.plot: The Shadow Palace begins to shatter, but Asta and the others manage to escape. Meanwhile, the elves continued to attack the kingdom because they still didn’t know the truth. Asta is the only one who can undo the resurrection, but it won’t be easy to save all of them at once. Patry then frees Vangeance, who’s sleeping inside him, so he can use his world tree magic and Licht can use his magic that connects him with all of the elves and Asta is able to undo the resurrection of all the elves at once. Finally, the long battle is coming to an end.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E121 - Three Problems
1.plot: The battle involving the whole Clover Kingdom is finally over. But because of the battle, the kingdom was heavily damaged, so the Magic Knights were busy trying to repair everything. Meanwhile, someone rather unexpected shows up in front of Asta and the others and states three problems that will come up for the Clover Kingdom. Asta and the others are surprised, but just as they were told, someone showed up to try to judge Asta and his devil power.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E122 - As Pitch Black as It Gets
1.plot: Asta, who has the power of the devil, and Secré who used forbidden magic and turned into Nero, were called before the Magical Parliament to be judged. Asta maintains his innocence, but Damnatio Kira will do everything he can to probe that Asta is guilty. In order to save Asta and Secré, Yami shows up with the Black Bulls and they cause a ruckus. While the Black Bulls cause trouble, a few others show up…

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E123 - Nero Reminiscences… (1)
1.plot: Because she used forbidden magic, Nero survived for centuries. In the back of her mind, memories from long ago start to replay in her head. From when Nero was still called Secré and when Secré first met the most powerful and talented mage in the Clover Kingdom, Prince Lumiere. They become friends with Licht and the other elves, but due to the evil plans of a devil, the humans end up killing all of Licht’s comrades. Because of that, Licht ends up turning into a demon and Lumiere finds him in that state. What will he have to do to protect the ones he loves?

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E124 - Nero Reminiscences… (2)
1.plot: After using forbidden magic in the fight against the devil, Secré turns into a bird and ends up spending centuries all alone. During that time, she ends up meeting Asta, who ends up with Licht’s grimoire that has a different devil residing in it. Patry ends up reviving due to resurrection magic, and then he becomes the leader of the Eye of the Midnight Sun and vows to get revenge. This was all according to the devil’s plan and Secré uses her sealing magic to free Lumiere and Licht so they can finish off the devil once and for all along with Asta. The battle comes to an end, and Secré now begins her new life as a member of the Black Bulls.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E125 - Return
1.plot: The Black Bulls return to where their base originally was. Henry has to return the Raging Bull back into their hideout, but apparently, that takes some time. Meanwhile, Yami tells the Black Bulls to go find the magical beasts that escaped from the hideout. They had run away when Rades and the others had attacked the hideout and had been wandering around the forest ever since. There was even a chance that they had returned to their feral states. Their fear comes true, as one Black Bull is attacked after another.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E126 - The Blue Rose’s Confession
1.plot: The Black Bulls were ordered by the Wizard King to investigate the devils. Yami takes Asta and Nero and goes to talk to Captain Charlotte of the Blue Rose Knights, since she has experience with forbidden magic and curses. But when they get there, Charlotte suddenly runs off somewhere and they’re all in shock. Charlotte had memories of while Charla took over her body and fears that Yami had found out her true feelings and she ended up panicking. But then, she makes a decision.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E127 - Clues
1.plot: In order to find out more about the forbidden curse, Asta, Gordon, Grey, and Gauche head to Gordon’s house, since he comes from a family of famous curse mages. Once they get there, they can’t help but show their wariness towards Gordon’s family. But in the end, they end up finding out valuable information while they’re there. Meanwhile, Noelle goes to talk to the Dorothy Unsworth, the Captain of the Coral Peacocks, after her brother tells her to talk to her to find out the truth behind their mother’s death. Dorothy tells her the name of the devil who had killed her mother, and the same name is spoken by Gordon’s grandmother. That devil’s name is…

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E128 - To the Heart Kingdom!
1.plot: Thanks to Gordon’s father, Asta and the others were able to find out that there might be clues surrounding the devils in the Heart Kingdom and manage to get permission to enter the kingdom due to the fact that Mimosa had gone there previously to study overbroad. Asta, Noelle, Finral, Mimosa and Nero head to the Heart Kingdom. Asta and the others initially enjoy their trip there, but something that Langris told Finral had been bugging Finral. Suddenly, Asta and the others are faced with a rather unexpected trial. Will Asta and the other Black Bulls be able to obtain information on the devils?!

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E129 - The Devil Megicula
1.plot: Asta and the others manage to meet with the queen of the Heart Kingdom, Loropechika, who had also been chosen by the water spirit, Undine. They are able to confirm that the devil’s curse that they spotted in the Heart Kingdom was originating from Loropechika herself and that the devil was in the Spade Kingdom. Meanwhile, Vanessa, Magna, and Luck went to investigate the Diamond Kingdom and find it in ruins after a single mage of the Spade Kingdom had annihilated them. In order to defeat this devil, Loropechika asks Asta and the others for their help…

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E130 - The New Magic Knights Captain Conference
1.plot: The Magic Knight Squad Captains decide to have a meeting about the problem with the devils that ended up involving the whole Clover Kingdom. Asta and the others who were in the Heart Kingdom were also summoned and they disclose the information they gathered in front of Julius, Damnatio, and the Captains. After hearing what Asta and the others had to report, Julius tells everyone what they need to do in order to deal with the devil Megicula.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E131 - A New Resolve
1.plot: Asta and Yuno are given permission to go home to Hage for a little while.
