meta.plot: Lim Ju-kyung is a high school student. Since she was little, she has had a complex about her appearance. To hide her bare face, Ju-kyung always wears make-up. Her excellent make-up skills make her pretty and she hides her bare face in front of others. She gets involved with 2 men; Lee Su-ho and Han Seo-jun.

1.title: FR - True Beauty - S01E01 - The Errand Girl
1.plot: Kids hate her just because she’s ugly. And for the same reason, her crush cruelly rejects her confession. Thinking of ending her life, Ju Kyung stands at the edge of a rooftop. That’s when Soo Ho jumps in to save her. Days later, Ju Kyung comes across some makeup techniques, and she can’t believe her own eyes. On her first day as a transfer student, kids are captivated by Ju Kyung’s looks.

1.title: FR - True Beauty - S01E02 - With or Without Make-Up
1.plot: As soon as Soo Ho sees Ju Kyung at the comic book store, he recognizes that it’s the same girl he saw on the rooftop. He’s kind of disappointed that she doesn’t seem to remember him. Ju Kyung is anxious to see how Soo Ho will react at school the next day, but strangely he doesn’t seem to recognize her at all.

1.title: FR - True Beauty - S01E03 - Revenge Is a Dish Best Served Cold
1.plot: It seems Soo Ho knows that the no makeup Ju Kyung at the comic store is the same person as the made up Ju Kyung at school. Ju Kyung feels anxious that he might tell everyone about how ugly she actually is. She promises him that she’ll do anything he asks, but it starts to wear her out.

1.title: FR - True Beauty - S01E04 - Ju Kyung Goes on a Blind Date
1.plot: Ju Kyung prepares to go on a blind date. She asks her mother for help at her hair salon, but then Seo Jun steps into the salon when Ju Kyung’s not wearing makeup on her face. She tries to avoid meeting him. Meanwhile, Soo Ho participates in a maths competition, but he keeps feeling bothered by the fact that Ju Kyung is meeting with a man on a blind date.

1.title: FR - True Beauty - S01E05 - If He Has Feelings for Me
1.plot: Soo Ho goes all the way to meet Ju Kyung late at night with a lame excuse. Ju Kyung starts to wonder if Soo Ho has feelings for her. She asks him out. Meanwhile, a first-year student is bullied by her classmates for her ugly looks. This reminds Ju Kyung of her past school life and she decides to offer help.

1.title: FR - True Beauty - S01E06 - Ju Kyung Runs into Bullies
1.plot: Soo Ho’s father visits Saebom High School to meet Soo Ho’s teacher. Everyone at school gets surprised by the fact that Soo Ho’s father is actor Lee Joo Hun. Meanwhile, Ju Kyung runs into the bullies who used to harass her before transferring to Saebom High School. Soo Ho happens to see them and decides to help Ju Kyung.

1.title: FR - True Beauty - S01E07 - Mutual Feelings of Love
1.plot: Ju Kyung’s heart doesn’t seem to calm down whenever she sees Soo Ho. Unfortunately, she finds out that there is already someone whom Soo Ho likes. Devastated and disappointed, Ju Kyung begins to naturally avoid him. Meanwhile, Hyung Jin, the ace baseball player from Seonil High, confesses his feelings to Ju Kyung. Knowing this, Seo Jun and Soo Ho also feel the surge of affectionate feelings for Ju Kyung.

1.title: FR - True Beauty - S01E08 - Misunderstanding
1.plot: The students of Saebom High School go on a school trip. Soo Ho makes up his mind to tell Ju Kyung that he has feelings for her and even buys jewellery for her. However, Ju Kyung gets heartbroken, thinking that Soo Ho likes Soo Jin. Meanwhile, Hee Kyung gets transferred to a different department at work without prior notice.

1.title: FR - True Beauty - S01E09 - Secret Boyfriend
1.plot: Not long after reassuring each other’s feelings, Ju Kyung and Soo Ho initiate a movie-like plan to keep their relationship secret at school. However, doing so makes it difficult for them to enjoy a typical ordinary date. Soo Ho even puts up with embarrassing moments for Ju Kyung. Meanwhile, Seo Jun is having trouble getting over Ju Kyung when he bumps into her at the least expected place.

1.title: FR - True Beauty - S01E10 - Between Love and Friendship
1.plot: Ju Kyung still doesn’t want to let her friends know that her boyfriend is Soo Ho. Soo Jin tells Ju Kyung that she plans to tell Soo Ho that she has feelings for him. Ju Kyung gets torn between love and friendship. Meanwhile, Soo Ho and Seo Jun happen to meet at Ju Kyung’s house and start to make dumplings with Ju Kyung’s family.

1.title: FR - True Beauty - S01E11 - The Truth About Se Yeon
1.plot: After stumbling upon the truth behind Se Yeon’s death, Soo Ho gets into an accident as he runs out of his dad’s office, and Seo Jun also gets involved while trying to save Soo Ho. Hospitalized in the same room, Soo Ho and Seo Jun get to know each other a little better. Meanwhile, Ju Kyung and Soo Ho come to an agreement that they are both responsible for the fight earlier. However, Soo Ho can’t seem to shake off a bitter feeling.

1.title: FR - True Beauty - S01E12 - Transfer Student
1.plot: At school, Soo Ho comes back to his class, and Ju Kyung runs into Hye Min who just transferred. Hye Min asks Ju Kyung if they know each other, but Ju Kyung denies and keeps avoiding her at school. Meanwhile, Soo Jin and Se Mi make a deal, and Se Mi shares with Soo Jin the photos of Ju Kyung without makeup on her face.

1.title: FR - True Beauty - S01E13 - Only Fools Judge Others
1.plot: A video of Ju Kyung sends the whole school in turmoil. When Ju Kyung finds out that her past from the old school has been exposed, she runs away. However, it doesn’t bother Soo Ho a bit what others are saying. The only thing that worries him is whether Ju Kyung is okay or not. Meanwhile, Seo Jun does whatever he can to get to the bottom of this happening and is shocked when he finds the person responsible for the video.

1.title: FR - True Beauty - S01E14 - Trip to the Sea
1.plot: Ju Kyung comes back to school and makes up with Soo Ah. Everyone at school finally finds out that Soo Jin was the one who uploaded the photos and videos of Ju Kyung being bullied. Meanwhile, Soo Ho and Ju Kyung go on a trip to the sea, but Soo Ho forgets to bring his cell phone. Seo Jun desperately tries to reach Soo Ho.

1.title: FR - True Beauty - S01E15 - Unexpected Encounter
1.plot: Ju Kyung and Soo Ho have no other option but to accept the breakup. After, Ju Kyung stumbles upon the fact that Soo Ho is the very boy she met at the Prince Comics when she was young and struggles even more. Meanwhile, Seo Jun finds it difficult to hide feelings towards Ju Kyung and decides to act upon it. Confused by Seo Jun’s unexpected confession, Ju Kyung heads out to Namsan where she bumps into someone.

1.title: FR - True Beauty - S01E16 - Happy Ending
1.plot: Ju Kyung and Soo Ho finally confirm that their feelings for one another haven't changed after all these years. After shedding tears from their reunion, they start their happy relationship, which is more grown-up from their high school days. Meanwhile, Seo Jun, who has now moved on from his unrequited love, gets ready to debut while Hee Kyung asks Soo Ho to include "Missing Love" on Seo Joon's debut album.

1.title: FR - Scène de crime : La disparue du Cecil Hotel - S01E01 - Lost in Los Angeles
1.plot: The once-grand Cecil Hotel provides a nightmarish backdrop for the disappearance of Elisa Lam. Her final footage in an elevator triggers a viral hunt.

1.title: FR - Scène de crime : La disparue du Cecil Hotel - S01E02 - Secrets of the Cecil
1.plot: Web sleuths dissect Elisa's social media posts. A grisly discovery changes everything at the hotel already known as the Night Stalker's onetime lair.

1.title: FR - Scène de crime : La disparue du Cecil Hotel - S01E03 - Down the Rabbit Hole
1.plot: The mystery deepens: Did a crime occur? The obsessed descend on the Cecil hoping to solve the case and tumble down the rabbit hole of conspiracy.

1.title: FR - Scène de crime : La disparue du Cecil Hotel - S01E04 - The Hard Truth
1.plot: A long-awaited autopsy report arrives, but suspicions linger. Today, an unlikely target speaks his mind as experts weigh in on persistent mysteries.

meta.plot: Le créateur de "Ted Bundy : Autoportrait d'un tueur" nous plonge dans les bas-fonds du crime avec la disparition d'Elisa Lam, cliente du tristement célèbre Cecil Hotel.

1.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: Longtime ER nurse Jackie Peyton bends the rules to bring some good from a patient's senseless death, while concealing her addiction to a pain killer she gets from her boyfriend, the hospital pharmacist.

1.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S01E02 - Sweet 'n All
1.plot: Jackie and her husband, Kevin, become concerned that their older daughter Grace is suffering from anxiety disorder; hospital administrator Mrs. Akalitus drinks Jackie's Percoset-laced coffee.

1.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S01E03 - Chicken Soup
1.plot: An elderly patient checks in who has been treating his heart disease with chicken soup; Jackie discusses her daughter's anxiety with Dr. O'Hara; Eddie learns that he is to be replaced by a pill-dispensing machine.

1.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S01E04 - School Nurse
1.plot: Jackie and Kevin consider enrolling Grace in private school; the stoic Dr. O'Hara must endure the emotional thanks of a boy whose twin brother she saved; Zoey loses a patient for the first time.

1.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S01E05 - Daffodil
1.plot: Jackie breaks several rules and regulations to help a 10-year-old girl caring for her lupus-stricken mother; Mrs. Akalitus accidentally tasers herself; O'Hara treats Zoey to a meal at a four-star restaurant.

1.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S01E06 - Tiny Bubbles
1.plot: Jackie is caught off-guard when a nurse (Judith Ivey) she used to work with, who is dying of lung cancer, asks Jackie to help end her life. Meanwhile, Coop’s mother (Blythe Danner) is admitted with a gall bladder attack. We learn that he is the only son of lesbians…a fact that delights Jackie and O’Hara.

1.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S01E07 - Steak Knife
1.plot: A man is admitted with a steak knife sticking out of his chest. Eddie gives Jackie a Cartier bracelet for their one-year anniversary, but she rejects the gift. A baby is left in the nurses’ station and Akalitus takes the infant to her office.

1.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S01E08 - Pupil
1.plot: Jackie discovers that a new temp nurse is abusing drugs, but when she confronts him, he calls her on hypocrisy; Mrs. Akalitus still has the foundling infant left at the hospital; Coop reveals to Eddie that Jackie has a child.

1.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S01E09 - Nose Bleed
1.plot: Jackie admits a patient she has treated before. As his condition worsens, Zoey questions whether Jackie did enough to help him on his previous visit. Jackie’s drug use starts to cause spontaneous nose bleeds.

1.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S01E10 - Ring Finger
1.plot: Jackie and Grace begin mother-daughter tap class. Coop threatens to expose Jackie for falsifying a donor’s record. Jackie has forgotten to remove her wedding ring, and needs to get it off before meeting Eddie for a quickie.

1.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S01E11 - Pill-O-Matix
1.plot: Kevin decides to buy Jackie a new wedding ring. At work, the automated pill machine replaces Eddie. A movie critic is admitted with a broken elbow.

1.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S01E12 - Health Care And Cinema
1.plot: Kevin invites Jackie to a midnight rendezvous in order to give her a new wedding ring; the comatose movie critic wakes up but his tastes have radically changed.

2.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S02E01 - Comfort Food
2.plot: After the confrontation with Eddie at the end of season one, it’s now a few months later. Jackie has cut ties with Eddie and is determined to dive back in and spend more time with her family. Back at All Saints, she deflects blame about the narcotic shortage and endures Sam, the altered nurse and his newfound sobriety.

2.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S02E02 - Twitter
2.plot: Jackie covers for a hung-over O'Hara, while Eddie befriends Kevin and Dr. Coop gets hooked on microblogging.

2.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S02E03 - Candyland
2.plot: O'Hara offers financial help, but Jackie and Kevin refuse to take it. Eddie and Kevin's secret friendship is revealed.

2.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S02E04 - Apple Bong
2.plot: When a patient is suffering, Jackie supplies the patient with illegal marijuana to ease the pain. Meanwhile, Kevin prefers going out with Eddie rather than spend the night with Jackie and Zoey believes she is pregnant.

2.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S02E05 - Caregiver
2.plot: Jackie's life gets a little more complicated because of a security guard and O'Hara's longtime affair comes to light.

2.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S02E06 - Bleeding
2.plot: Unhappy about Eddie and Kevin's friendship, Jackie asks Eddie to stop spending time with Kevin. A pharmaceutical company rep provides Jackie with drugs.

2.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S02E07 - Silly String
2.plot: Coop insults the biggest donor of the hospital while Jackie revisits her affair with Eddie.

2.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S02E08 - Monkey Bits
2.plot: Coop arranges a date for Georgia and Eddie while Jackie's daughter Grace starts therapy.

2.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S02E09 - P. O. Box
2.plot: In order to keep her secret credit card a secret, Jackie sets up a P.O. box for the credit card bills. In the meantime, Mrs. Akalitus offers Eddie to come back as the hospital's pharmacist.

2.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S02E10 - Sleeping Dogs
2.plot: In order to get a phony prescription, Jackie falsifies an MRI. In the meantime the campaign's end has its effects on Coop and Eddie is back as the hospital's pharmacist.

2.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S02E11 - What The Day Brings
2.plot: Jackie has to confess that she used O'Hara's loan when her stash gets lost.

2.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S02E12 - Years of Service
2.plot: In the season finale, Jackie returns to All Saints where she must confront everyone.

3.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S03E01 - Game On
3.plot: In the Season 3 premiere, Jackie's marriage is strained, as is her relationship with O'Hara after the intervention; Akalitus warns the staff that nearby hospitals have closed down, straining the staff and resources; Zoey publicly confesses her affair with Lenny.

3.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S03E02 - Enough Rope
3.plot: Eddie tells Jackie that he now considers Kevin a real friend and can no longer lie to him; Jackie is remorseful when she learns that O'Hara is looking for a new employer; Akalitus announces that All Saints may get a visit from the First Lady.

3.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S03E03 - Play Me
3.plot: Kevin's younger sister Tunie visits after a breakup with her boyfriend; Lenny prepares a surprise romantic picnic for Zoey; two street vendors are brought in after a turf war turns violent; Akalitus fights Catholic bureaucrats over the hospital's chapel.

3.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S03E04 - Mitten
3.plot: Jackie finds a new hiding place for her pills and buries the hatchet with O'Hara, who becomes ER chief; Zoey works her first double shift; Kevin invites Eddie to a backyard barbecue; Jackie must tell more lies to retrieve her misplaced stash.

3.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S03E05 - Rat Falls
3.plot: Jackie runs out of drugs and Dr. Cooper decides to compete with Dr. O'Hara for the E.R. chief position.

3.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S03E06 - When The Saints Go
3.plot: Mrs. Akalitus is in a holy uproar as workers from the archdiocese remove her religious statues. Meanwhile, a new temp nurse makes his presence known in the ER, and some people don't appreciate it; Coop deals with personal, professional and podiatric problems; and Jackie tries to deal with Kevin playing matchmaker between Eddie and his sister.

3.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S03E07 - Orchids and Salami
3.plot: Kelly wins over the All Saints staff; Kevin finds pills in a dental floss dispenser; a patient soothes Coop's depression; Jackie pockets drugs.

3.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S03E08 - The Astonishing
3.plot: Jackie accuses Kelly of being inappropriate with two flirty high school girls; Coop begins to let go of childish things; Thor counsels Akalitus on her new phone system and some deeper matters; Jackie is unexpectedly delayed getting to Grace's pageant.

3.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S03E09 - Have You Met Ms. Jones?
3.plot: Just when Jackie has run out of pills, she runs into a confrontation about the drugs from Oncology that disappeared. Coop tracks down an old girlfriend on Facebook when he decides to start his own family. Heart problems make Zoey revisit her relationship with Lenny.

3.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S03E10 - Fuck The Lemurs
3.plot: Following HR's inquiry of the missing drugs, Mrs. Akalitus puts Jackie on probation. Meanwhile, Coop plans his wedding and Jackie's daughter Grace wants to be put on medication for her anxiety disorder.

3.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S03E11 - Batting Practice
3.plot: Jackie tries to stay sober and get through probation until Dr. O'Hara has a tempting offer for her. Meanwhile Eddie believes Kevin found out about the affair and Zoey throws a party for her colleagues.

3.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S03E12 - …Deaf Blind Tumor Pee-Test
3.plot: When HR demands urine samples from all the nurses, Jackie tries to avoid it as long as possible as well as her husband, who seems to have found out about her affair with Eddie.

4.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S04E01 - Kettle-Kettle-Black-Black
4.plot: After breaking up with Kevin, Jackie has to realize she needs professional help. Meanwhile, a new director at the hospital makes some personnel changes and Kevin finds out about Jackie and Eddie's affair.

4.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S04E02 - Disneyland Sucks
4.plot: Going through rehab, Jackie opens up about the beginning of her addiction. Meanwhile, Coop is the only one being excited about Cruz's ideas.

4.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S04E03 - The Wall
4.plot: Worried about her daughter, Jackie leaves rehab early against her therapist's advice and finds that returning to work greatly rattles her nerves, forcing her to struggle to maintain her sobriety; Zoey has second thoughts about her relationship with Lenny; Eddie tells Jackie that he confessed their affair to Kevin.

4.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S04E04 - Slow Growing Monsters
4.plot: Jackie catches Grace with a boy at a carnival and takes her, not before deleting the number from the boys phone. While at the carnival, Grace announces to Fiona and Zoey that Jackie went to rehab. Jackie goes to an AA meeting with Charlie only to find out that he is using again. Kevin forced Eddie to tell him what Jackie took, when they were having the affair, before telling Eddie to tell Jackie to "Kiss her kids goodbye". Jackie almost relapses when a patient gives her their medications. She throws them in a dumpster and then tries to retrieve them and falls in. She then gets out and walks away pill free. Charlie is revealed to be Dr.Cruz"s son.

4.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S04E05 - One-Armed Jacks
4.plot: Missing her family and adjusting poorly to single life, Jackie invites Kevin to meet her at a cafe but finds herself served with divorce papers instead of lunch; an attempted double suicide trauma case comes into the E.R.; Cruz institutes a draconian new dress code that is not a hit with his staff; Zoey looks for a new roommate and finds one in the lonely Jackie.

4.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S04E06 - No-Kimono-Zone
4.plot: Jackie has a disturbing dream about using; Zoey loses her ring.

4.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S04E07 - Day of the Iguana
4.plot: Jackie covers for Cruz when he has a panic attack; Zoey surveys her coworkers for the best ways to conduct a breakup; Akalitus enlists the staff in an elaborate charade when her mentor is admitted with dementia.

4.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S04E08 - Chaud & Froid
4.plot: When Cruz learns about Jackie's rehab, he takes revenge on coworkers who have been covering up her drug problems. Meanwhile, Eddie is deposed by Kevin's lawyer; a dumped Lenny decides to take off for Europe; and Coop accompanies O'Hara to her ob-gyn appointment.

4.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S04E09 - Are Those Feathers?
4.plot: Things get out of control in the emergency room due to the recent firings and an overflow of patients who have been diverted from another hospital, causing Cruz to suffer a pulmonary episode and Jackie to step in. At home, a rebellious Grace refuses to go to class unless Jackie transfers her to public school.

4.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S04E10 - Handle Your Scandal
4.plot: While Cruz is in care, Jackie goes over his head to get the ER under control, resulting in her dismissal from All Saints for insubordination. Jackie pulls Grace out of Catholic school. O'Hara goes into labour and Jackie returns to All Saints in spite of Cruz. Charlie arrives at the ER and Cruz asks Jackie to help him save Charlie's life.

5.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S05E01 - Happy Fucking Birthday
5.plot: Victims of a bus accident are treated; two doctors join the rotation; O'Hara is happy spending time with her son; Akalitus gives Eddie his job back.

5.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S05E02 - Luck of the Drawing
5.plot: Kevin demands full custody. A bus crash patient returns after contracting sepsis. Coop threatens to quit.

5.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S05E03 - Smile
5.plot: After their custody meeting, Jackie rear-ends Kevin and wakes up as a patient in her own ER. Kevin accuses her of using. Coop begins covering for Carrie and taking on a lot more work. When Carrie checks on Jackie, she writes her a prescription for Oxy, unaware she's an addict. The most unlikely person asks Jackie out on a date.

5.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S05E04 - Lost Girls
5.plot: A heavily medicated Jane Doe is brought into the ER and Jackie tasks Zoey with finding out who she is. Coop invites Carrie to dinner. Jackie faces conflict with both her daughters - Fiona has been acting out in class while Grace sneaks around the city with her older boyfriend.

5.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S05E05 - Good Thing
5.plot: Jackie is nervous about her date with Frank, so Zoey and Thor help her get ready and Eddie offers some friendly pointers. Prentiss misdiagnoses an injured dancer, but Akalitus and Coop catch his mistake before the patient leaves. Mike Cruz calls Jackie in a moment of need.

5.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S05E06 - Walk of Shame
5.plot: Jackie and Grace recover from their nights of indiscretion; Carrie uses flashcards to strengthen her skills.

5.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S05E07 - Teachable Moments
5.plot: Akalitus forgets to hire an escort for a psych patient who then lays waste to the pharmacy; Frank cancels a lunch date with Jackie; Zoey hears Coop and Carrie having sex; Jackie worries about Frank when she learns that a cop has been shot.

5.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S05E08 - Forget It
5.plot: Kevin interrupts Jackie and Frank's night. Akalitus' blood results are in and her memory loss is a result of a medication she's been taking. Zoey helps Prentiss organize his disaster of an office. Meanwhile, Jackie is convinced that Grace is sneaking behind her back to see Danny, but Grace assures her they broke up. Frank urges Jackie to work on her issues - so she attends an AA meeting.

5.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S05E09 - Heart
5.plot: Jackie and Frank have sex for the first time and he tells her he loves her. Akalitus has an extra spring in her step. Coop wants to take his mentoring of Carrie to the next level. Kevin and Grace show up at the hospital after Kevin finds a bag of pills in Grace's bag.

5.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S05E10 - Soul
5.plot: It's Jackie's one year anniversary of sobriety and she and Frank fight about their relationship. Zoey acts very professional and rigid around Prentiss after their intimate evening. Carrie's peer review does not go well. Grace has a breakdown about Jackie. Jackie takes something she shouldn't have.

6.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S06E01 - Sink or Swim
6.plot: Jackie's back to using again, but she's doing it differently this time: maintaining a clean and sober cover, going to 12-step meetings - even finding herself a sponsor - all the while getting her drugs from the towel girl at the gym. Meanwhile at All Saints, Zoey finds out that everyone knows about her 'secret' relationship with Prentiss. Season premiere.

6.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S06E02 - Pillgrimage
6.plot: Jackie steals Dr. Roman's DEA number. Coop is recruited by a 'sperm scout.'

6.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S06E03 - Super Greens
6.plot: Coop learns his sperm count is too low for donation; Carrie gets a lucky break; Akalitus' poker habit pays off; Grace drops a bomb on Jackie.

6.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S06E04 - Love Jungle
6.plot: Jackie goes off the deep end; Frank discloses a secret about his past.

6.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S06E05 - Rag and Bone
6.plot: Frank searches Jackie's house for drugs, but she removes them in time and hides her stash in a ladies room at the hospital. Later, Jackie bonds with a homeless, alcoholic nun; and finds comfort in the arms of a fellow drug user. Meanwhile, Zoey confronts Prentiss about his dissatisfaction and encourages him to do what he loves.

6.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S06E06 - Nancy Wood
6.plot: Jackie's fake identity is compromised when it's learned that Carrie's DEA number has been stolen by a woman named Nancy Wood. Meanwhile, Jackie worries about her dwindling bank account and lack of pills; and Prentiss gives Zoey a shocking message.

6.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S06E07 - Rat on a Cheeto
6.plot: Jackie is ambushed by Antoinette. Coop's dream finally comes true.

6.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S06E08 - The Lady with the Lamp
6.plot: Jackie detoxes at home - with help. Frank raises an objection about Grace.

6.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S06E09 - Candyman
6.plot: Jackie learns about a DEA investigation at the hospital that will require her to take a urine test, so she plots to get around it. Meanwhile, Kevin and Mia plan their wedding; the homeless nun returns in worse shape than ever; and Coop and Carrie find a way to skirt their no sex in the hospital rule.

6.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S06E10 - Sidecars and Spermicide
6.plot: Jackie breaks up with Frank and tries to separate herself from the people closest to her so she can keep using drugs. Meanwhile, Carrie forgets Coop's 40th birthday; the DEA investigation intensifies; and Zoey decides to become a nurse practitioner.

6.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S06E11 - Sisterhood
6.plot: Jackie reluctantly attends Kevin's wedding. Carrie makes demands on Coop.

6.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S06E12 - Flight
6.plot: Coop gets a surprise. Jackie hits the road. Season finale.

7.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S07E01 - Clean
7.plot: Picking up with her arrest, Jackie suffers through detox.

7.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S07E02 - Deal
7.plot: Jackie gets inventive, setting her sights on returning to All Saints.

7.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S07E03 - Godfathering
7.plot: Jackie's back at All Saints - but back to square one in a new role.

7.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S07E04 - Nice Ladies
7.plot: Still strapped for cash, Jackie's dealing takes a surprising turn.

7.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S07E05 - Coop Out
7.plot: Jackie stirs up trouble for the developers. Coop preps for his last day.

7.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S07E06 - High Noon
7.plot: Zoey leads the ER nurses on a walkout. Jackie battles her cravings.

7.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S07E07 - Are You With Me, Doctor Wu?
7.plot: Jackie and Eddie make a purge their stash. Dr. Prince and Akalitus bond.

7.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S07E08 - Managed Care
7.plot: Dr. Prince enlists Jackie's help with a patient. Thor reveals a secret.

7.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S07E09 - Serviam in Caritate
7.plot: Zoey finally confronts Jackie. Dr. Prince attracts a mob to All Saints.

7.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S07E10 - Jackie and the Wolf
7.plot: An unexpected knock at the door puts Jackie and Eddie in jeopardy.

7.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S07E11 - Vigilante Jones
7.plot: Jackie is forced to perform a procedure on her own. Zoey learns a secret.

7.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S07E12 - I Say a Little Prayer
7.plot: Jackie gets offered a job - and wants Zoey to come with her. Series finale.

meta.plot: Every day is a matter of life and death in a hectic New York City hospital, but for Nurse Jackie that's the easiest part. Between chronic back pain that won't quit, and a personal life on the constant edge of collapse, it's going to take a white lie here, a bent rule there, and a handful of secret strategies to relieve the pain, and stay one step ahead of total disaster.

1.plot: While in battle with Abomination and the Wrecking Crew, new Squaddie Reptil loses an Infinity Fractal. With both sides scrambling to retrieve it, Reptil, with Wolverine's help, learns to face his fears and what it means to be a hero. Meanwhile, Hulk inadvertently joins a mariachi band.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E03 - This Silver, This Surfer!
1.plot: Silver Surfer is having a difficult time trying to fit in on Earth and chooses to leave the squad. Things get complicated when Dr. Doom kidnaps him.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E04 - Hulk Talk Smack!
1.plot: During a chaotic battle with Klaw & Screaming Mimi, a fractal's cosmic power turns the Hulk into the Gray Hulk.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E05 - Enter: Dormammu!
1.plot: With supernatural wackiness plaguing the city, the Super Hero Squad enlists the help of the Sorcerer Supreme of the Earth dimension, Doctor Strange. However, the good doctor seems to be "off his rocker," babbling incoherently and summoning the Dread Dormammu to Super Hero City.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E06 - A Brat Walks Among Us!
1.plot: When the city is attacked, the squad investigates, only to find that a little girl named Brinny Bratten, who had a fractal stuck in her tiara, that gives her a large and terrifying power over reality. The Heroes For Hire are helping the Squad find her father, while Doom plans to use the chaos to his advantage.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E07 - Oh Brother!
1.plot: Loki teams up with Doctor Doom in a plot to take over Asgard. Meanwhile, the latest Infinity Fractal causes Thor to lose his memory and it's up to Iron Man and Hulk to help him remember who he is.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E08 - From the Atom...It Rises!
1.plot: A new villain named Scorpio shows up in superhero city. Nicky Fury disguises himself as a villain to infiltrate Doom's Headquarters to stop Dr. Doom from using a fractal to control a black hole.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E09 - Night in the Sanctorum!
1.plot: When Falcon is presumed the cause of crashing The Helicarrier, The Squad is forced to relocate. Meanwhile, Enchantress and M.O.D.O.K. plan to attack Superhero City while the squad is tired from moving from place to place.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E10 - This Forest Green!
1.plot: When MODOK and Abomination botched up another fractal retrieval mission, Doctor Doom pairs them up with Egghead in infiltrate the Helicarrier in micro-size. When Ant-Man is called in to help, it is a micro-sized, all-out battle for the fractal.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E11 - O Captain, My Captain!
