Meanwhile, the rest of the Super Hero Squad have an embarrassing encounter at Ringmaster's circus when Doctor Doom sent Abomination and MODOK to recruit Ringmaster.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E11 - O Captain, My Captain!
1.plot: When he is tired of all he can take with the Super Hero Squad, Wolverine joins up with the internation All-Captains Squad (consisting of Captain America, Captain Australia, Captain Brazil, Captain Britain, and Captain Lichtenstein) as Captain Canada where he helps them fight Plantman in the Amazon. Meanwhile, the rest of the Super Hero Squad have an embarrassing encounter at Ringmaster's circus when Doctor Doom sent Abomination and MODOK to recruit Ringmaster.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E12 - If This Be My Thanos!
1.plot: When the Skrulls start invading the city, the Super Hero Squad must team up with the Fantastic Four to stop them. Meanwhile, Thanos forms an alliance with Dr. Doom so he can steal an alien artifact from the Baxter Building.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E13 - Deadly is the Black Widow's Bite!
1.plot: After helping the Super Hero Squad in a battle against Screaming Mimi, Abomination and M.O.D.O.K., Black Widow joins the team. However, unknown to them, she is actually Mystique in disguise sent by Dr. Doom to steal the Infinity Fractals from the Vault.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E14 - Tremble at the Might of M.O.D.O.K.!
1.plot: When M.O.D.O.K. gains the power of an Infinity Fractal, he robs Dr. Doom of his powers and takes over as leader. Loki learns of this and decides to ally himself with M.O.D.O.K., forcing Dr. Doom to join forces with the Super Hero Squad in order to defeat M.O.D.O.K. and reclaim his rightful place as leader.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E15 - Mental Organism Designed Only for Kisses!
1.plot: Dr. Doom is fed up with the Super Hero Squad constantly foiling his plans, so Enchantress decides to help by casting a love spell on Thor to make him fall in love with her. However, the love spell accidentally hits Ms. Marvel instead, causing her to fall in love with M.O.D.O.K. Meanwhile, Skurge intends to defeat Thor himself so Enchantress will love him.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E16 - Invader from the Dark Dimension!
1.plot: When Baron Mordo possesses Iron Man turning him into the Iron Menace and escapes from the Dark Dimension, he plans to take over Super Hero City and Villainville. When Wolverine, Falcon, and Redwing end up under Baron Mordo/Iron Man's control, Hulk, Silver Surfer, and Thor must team up with Doctor Strange and Valkyrie to form a team of Defenders and stop Baron Mordo's evil plot. Doctor Doom and MODOK reluctantly help them when Iron Menace takes control of Abomination.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E17 - Tales of Suspense!
1.plot: War Machine teams up with Iron Man when Doctor Doom, Crimson Dynamo, and Melter band together in a plot to eliminate Iron Man. Meanwhile, Wolverine and Reptil face off against Abomination and M.O.D.O.K. in a game of golf.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E18 - Stranger from a Savage Land!
1.plot: When a smilodon is brought to Super Hero City from the Savage Land, a mysterious jungle lord named Ka-Zar shows up stating that the smilodon is actually his companion Zabu. When the Super Hero Squad encounter Ka-Zar, they learn of his mission and help him rescue Zabu. Meanwhile, Doctor Doom sees the Star Quartz (which will bind and merge any metal in the presence of Vibranium) around Zabu's neck and sends Toad, Thunderball, Sabretooth, and Batroc the Leaper to steal Zabu in a plot to reforge the Infinity Sword.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E19 - Mysterious Mayhem at Mutant High!
1.plot: Captain America sends Wolverine back to Xavier Academy to get his diploma and finish his remaining credits. Reptil tags along to see what Xavier Academy is like. To make matters worse, Ringmaster shows up and hypnotizes the entire X-Men team.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E20 - Election of Evil!
1.plot: The Mayor’s re-election bid goes awry when Egghead wins by a landslide (thanks to a little mass mind-control). But his reign at city hall makes life in Super Hero City a bureaucratic nightmare for heroes and villains alike. Wolverine and the Mayor are up against every hero and villain in a desperate attempt to free everyone from Egghead’s control and stop the villains’ planned invasion.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E21 - Hexed, Vexed, and Perplexed!
1.plot: Magneto is in town and he tricks his children Quicksilver and Scarlet Witch into helping in a sinister plot to steal the Infinity Fractals at the Vault for Doctor Doom. During the first fight, Falcon develops a crush on Scarlet Witch after she heals Redwing.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E22 - The Ice Melt Cometh!
1.plot: Doctor Doom sends his "Team Toxic" (consisting of Pyro, Trapster, and Zzzaz) out in a Fractal-retrieving activity at the north pole only to run afoul of Iron Man, Thor, and Wolverine. While Flatman and Reptil lecture about the polar ice caps, the world starts flooding after Trapster sets off their super-spinner machine to self-destruct. Now Iron Man must convince Iceman to help save the day.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E23 - Wrath of the Red Skull!
1.plot: It's Captain America's birthday and all he wants to do is celebrate it with his fellow Super Hero Squad members and Nick Fury. In order to show his minions what real villainy is like, Doctor Doom thaws out the WWII villain Red Skull. Captain America isn't pleased to find his old enemy up to his old tricks while Doctor Doom isn't thrilled about Red Skull's enormous ego.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E24 - Mother of Doom!
1.plot: Dr. Doom conquers Chthon's mystical dimension to free his mother Coco Von Doom. Though Doom ends up with Chthon's evil powers, he also finds himself dealing with his mother's monstrous nagging.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E25 - Last Exit Before Doomsday!
1.plot: Silver Surfer's past as Galactus' herald is revealed as he encounters another herald, Stardust. But Doctor Doom has plans of his own for Stardust and her big boss.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E26 - This Al Dente Earth!
1.plot: Galactus arrives in Super Hero City to devour the Earth! The fate of the planet hangs in the balance, but all of the city's heroes are powerless before Galactus; omnipotence.

meta.plot: The Super Hero Squad Show is an American cartoon series by Marvel Animation. It is based on the Marvel Super Hero Squad action figure line from Hasbro, which portray the Avengers, the X-Men, and various other characters of the Marvel Universe in a cartoonish super-deformed-style. It is also a self-aware parody of the Marvel characters, with influences taken from on the comedic Mini Marvels series of parody comic books, in that the heroes tend to find themselves in comedic situations, and have cartoonish bents in comparison to their usually serious personalities, and is an overall comedic take on the Avengers. The series' animation was produced by Film Roman and Marvel Animation.

Nobody knows what it's like to be the bad man… except the bad man's right-hand man, who has to take the boss' deranged ideas and turn them into functioning plans. So, when the sadistic president of the Teiai Group decides he's bored with the routine leg breaking and widow/orphan evicting, he assigns the task of coming up with something "special" to his ruthless Number Two, Yukio Tonegawa. But how do you amuse someone who destroys a dozen lives before breakfast?

There's a huge pool of potential victims in the form of TFO's swollen roster of defaulting borrowers, but if Tonegawa and his team of nearly identical men in black look-alikes can't create a "game of death" that tickles the boss' demented funny bones, they may end up playing the game themselves!

1.title: EN - Mr. TONEGAWA Middle Management Blues [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Initiative
1.plot: In Kaiji: Ultimate Survivor, he tormented the downtrodden and enticed them into playing games where their lives were wagered against incredible cash prizes. But even a cold blooded monster can't spend every moment of the day trampling others. And in the real world, death games require planning, funding, oversight, and execution. This is the story of a lone man who struggles between his employer, the president, and his own employees, the men in black...Tonegawa Yukio: Middle Manager!

1.title: EN - Mr. TONEGAWA Middle Management Blues [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Conjecture
1.plot: The second meeting of the death game production team is held, and Tonegawa needs to make up for the bad first impression he gave his workers. But between the confusing names of his team members and their bizarre objective, can the executive make sure the conversation heads in a productive direction?

1.title: EN - Mr. TONEGAWA Middle Management Blues [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Surefire
1.plot: After a vicious act of betrayal in the last meeting, Tonegawa arranges weekend trip to an all-expenses paid villa to repair the cracks in his relationship with the team... but will it be enough?

1.title: EN - Mr. TONEGAWA Middle Management Blues [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Adult
1.plot: After three unproductive meetings and a company trip, Tonegawa's team still has essentially nothing to show in terms of progress on their death game project. But after a bolt of inspiration, the middle manager himself thinks he might have the answer.

1.title: EN - Mr. TONEGAWA Middle Management Blues [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Soul-Searching
1.plot: With the proposal for Restricted Rock Paper Scissors finished, Tonegawa just needs to turn it in to President Hyoudou... The tyrannical, temperamental, explosively volatile President Hyoudou.

1.title: EN - Mr. TONEGAWA Middle Management Blues [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Self-Destruct
1.plot: As the deadline for the design of the Restricted Rock Paper Scissors cards approaches, Ebitani feels insecure because of Saemon's repeated successes. Tonegawa tries to mentor the wayward employee, but will he listen?

1.title: EN - Mr. TONEGAWA Middle Management Blues [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Proliferation
1.plot: As work begins to proceed on the first Restricted Rock Paper Scissors game, an unseen danger threatens to freeze the team's work to a standstill.

1.title: EN - Mr. TONEGAWA Middle Management Blues [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Shrimp
1.plot: After being fired from Teiai and causing Tonegawa's salary to be cut, Ebitani returns hoping to make amends.

1.title: EN - Mr. TONEGAWA Middle Management Blues [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Cutlets
1.plot: The annual round of hiring for Teiai has begun, with Tonegawa and Yamazaki interviewing potential new employees. Afterwards, Tonegawa goes out for lunch, but ends up getting a little more than he bargained for.

1.title: EN - Mr. TONEGAWA Middle Management Blues [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Rehearsal
1.plot: It's finally time for the first rehearsal game of Restricted Rock Paper Scissors. But will difficulties with equipment and participants spell trouble for Tonegawa's big project?

1.title: EN - Mr. TONEGAWA Middle Management Blues [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Business Trip
1.plot: Tonegawa hits the road, with business to attend to outside of Tokyo, and hopes to find a chance for relaxation while away from home.

1.title: EN - Mr. TONEGAWA Middle Management Blues [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Fake
1.plot: When President Hyoudou decides that he wants a body double, Tonegawa and the men in black begin a search to find the perfect doppelganger for their boss.

1.title: EN - Mr. TONEGAWA Middle Management Blues [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - Setting Sail
1.plot: The day is finally here: Tonegawa and his team are going to host the first game of Restricted Rock Paper Scissors. It's all been leading up to this, but can they pull it off without a hitch?

1.title: EN - Mr. TONEGAWA Middle Management Blues [MULTI-SUB] - S01E14 - Excursion
1.plot: We've seen that the Teiai Group runs a ruthless business. But what happens when people with debt stacked beyond the ceiling fail to show any signs of paying off their loans? Witness a trip into the secret hell on Earth inhabited by the most hapless of debtors... and how one man manages to make the most of his otherwise dire situation.

1.title: EN - Mr. TONEGAWA Middle Management Blues [MULTI-SUB] - S01E15 - Playing Hard
1.plot: One of Ootsuki's regular excursions results in a clash of epic proportions, against an unexpected opponent...

1.title: EN - Mr. TONEGAWA Middle Management Blues [MULTI-SUB] - S01E16 - Natural Enemies
1.plot: Tonegawa is Teiai's number two man, but his position isn't exactly uncontested. When his rival, Kurosawa, steps into the picture even the battle hardened middle manager finds himself at a loss.

1.title: EN - Mr. TONEGAWA Middle Management Blues [MULTI-SUB] - S01E17 - Unofficial Announcement
1.plot: The time has come for personnel changes at Teiai. When everything is said and done, who will be left on Team Tonegawa?

1.title: EN - Mr. TONEGAWA Middle Management Blues [MULTI-SUB] - S01E18 - Alignment
1.plot: Tonegawa's annual check-up leads to some lifestyle changes that are accompanied by unwanted attention, while Ootsuki finds something he never expected to encounter on one of his excursions.

1.title: EN - Mr. TONEGAWA Middle Management Blues [MULTI-SUB] - S01E19 - Newcomers
1.plot: With the recent transfers leaving him short-manned, Tonegawa welcomes three new employees to his team, and doesn't take long for two of them to start making waves within the company.

1.title: EN - Mr. TONEGAWA Middle Management Blues [MULTI-SUB] - S01E20 - Entertaining
1.plot: The man-eating Bog is a pachinko machine that makes a ludicrous amount of money for one of Teiai's underground casinos. The time has come for Tonegawa to collect the winnings, which means a showdown between him, the diabolical device, and the man who responsible for it: Ichijou!

1.title: EN - Mr. TONEGAWA Middle Management Blues [MULTI-SUB] - S01E21 - Defamation
1.plot: Overseeing the Teiai corporate Twitter exposes Tonegawa to an account that seems to exist solely to hate on his company, triggering the middle manager's combative instincts. Meanwhile, Ootsuki's underground gambling games hit a snag when a rival foreman begins running his own entertainment scheme.

1.title: EN - Mr. TONEGAWA Middle Management Blues [MULTI-SUB] - S01E22 - Conclusions
1.plot: Two stories come to a conclusion, as Ootsuki concocts a scheme to usurp Odagiri's movie business, and Tonegawa tracks down the social media troll that has been flaming Teiai.

1.title: EN - Mr. TONEGAWA Middle Management Blues [MULTI-SUB] - S01E23 - Premonition
1.plot: Tonegawa attends a class reunion where he hopes to see what's become of the classmates he always held in contempt. Meanwhile, Ootsuki's latest excursion is threatened when he gets unexpectedly sick.

1.title: EN - Mr. TONEGAWA Middle Management Blues [MULTI-SUB] - S01E24 - End of the Line
1.plot: Hyoudou's latest craving for diabolical entertainment is so twisted, people are afraid to talk about it... even the narrator! And then, wedding bells begin to ring for one member of Team Tonegawa.

meta.plot: Akira Fudo learns from his best friend Ryo Asuka that demons will revive and reclaim the world from humans. With humans hopeless against this threat, Ryo suggests combining with a demon. With this, Akira becomes Devilman, a being with the power of demon but with a human heart.

1.title: EN - Devilman Crybaby [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - I Need You
1.plot: Ryo, a young professor returning from research abroad, takes his pure-hearted, crybaby friend Akira to a decadent party, where things turn demonic.

1.title: EN - Devilman Crybaby [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - One Hand Is Enough
1.plot: Akira has become a completely different man -- he's stronger and hungrier than ever before. He seeks out Ryo for answers.

1.title: EN - Devilman Crybaby [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Believe Me!
1.plot: After getting shut down by his editor, paparazzo Nagasaki gets desperate. Silene and Kaim learn what happened to their missing fellow demon, Amon.

1.title: EN - Devilman Crybaby [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Come, Akira
1.plot: Akira's mother calls and says she'll be home soon. Everyone is looking forward to seeing her, but Ryo warns Akira not to trust any human.

1.title: EN - Devilman Crybaby [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Beautiful Silene
1.plot: Silene tracks down Amon, hoping to reawaken his demonic side. But in the ensuing battle, the human soul of Akira remains powerful.

1.title: EN - Devilman Crybaby [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Neither Demon nor Human
1.plot: At a widely broadcast track meet, Ryo plans to expose high school athlete Koda as a demon, thereby spreading fear and distrust throughout society.

1.title: EN - Devilman Crybaby [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Weak Humans, Wise Demons
1.plot: With the fear of demons gripping the world, humanity devolves into paranoia and violence. Akira tries to save other demon-human hybrids like himself.

1.title: EN - Devilman Crybaby [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - I Must Know Myself
1.plot: Ryo's actions and motives remain a mystery to himself, so he revisits his past for answers. Miki's father searches for his missing wife and son.

1.title: EN - Devilman Crybaby [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Go to Hell, You Mortals
1.plot: Betrayed and exposed, Akira becomes a target. After Miki takes to social media to defend his human soul, she and Miko find themselves under attack.

1.title: EN - Devilman Crybaby [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Crybaby
1.plot: Confronted by Akira, Ryo reveals the truth about demonkind and himself. Humans, demons and devilmen gather for an ultimate battle for the world.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E01 - Cellular Bear
1.plot: Grizzy's nap is interrupted by an annoying vibrating. He sees the forest ranger's cell phone. It has various functions, including a game to which he instantly becomes addicted.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E02 - Jurassic Bear
1.plot: Freed by the thawing ice, a mysterious giant egg slides up to the front door of the log cabin. The Lemmings watch the hatching of large baby dinosaur that immediately mistakes them for his mummies. How can Grizzy and the lemmings armed with the T rex?

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E03 - Extreme Fitness
1.plot: In order to seduce the she-bear he's infatuated with, Grizzy decides to take things in hand and slim down with the ranger's bodybuilding equipment. But before starting his exercise routine, he will first have to settle the problem of the Lemmings.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E04 - Bear Under Control
1.plot: Grizzy wants to take a nap and under all circumstances prevent the lemmings go to the chocolate cream. For this reason, he turns his refrigerator into a vault. The lemmings try in vain to break the refrigerator until they see the bear sleep and open the refrigerator. Just as he did, he woke up surprisingly.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E05 - Popcorn Party
1.plot: The Lemmings have invented a new popcorn game which consists of throwing popcorn and catching it with their mouths.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E06 - Dancing with the Bears
1.plot: Grizzy wants to learn to dance the mambo to please his lovely she-bear. He finds a learning kit at the ranger's home which has a dance carpet with footprints.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E07 - Domestic Robots
1.plot: By chance, Grizzy discovers that the ranger's new robot vacuum cleaner also gives very pleasant back massages. But the Lemmings see the new gadget more as a competition bumper car.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E08 - Mass Control
1.plot: Grizzy discovers a gadget that controls functions in the cabin. One button creates light an other surveys the house. Will Grizzy be able to rid himself to the lemmings without leaving the couch?

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E09 - Lemming Tonic
1.plot: A tired Grizzly goes to fetch a pillow but the Lemmings have different plans for the couch.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E10 - Bear Itch
1.plot: Grizzy discovers that the frenzied "break dance" the Lemmings are doing is actually due to the fleas they are infested with.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E11 - Thirst Quencher
1.plot: Another heat wave: even the riverbed is dried up. One very thirsty Grizzy discovers that the Lemmings have used the last remaining bottles of water to fill their inflatable pool.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E12 - Spider Lemmings
1.plot: The Lemmings have caught a little spider. Her sticky threads are perfect for bungee jumping. Grizzy, who has no intention of getting caught in the web, decides to crush the insec

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E13 - Random Bear
1.plot: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over chocolate-spread jar lids, which they use as chips to win goodies. But more importantly, there's s grand prize: a giant jar of Yummy.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E14 - High Voltage Bear Attack
1.plot: The Lemmings are having a rave party. When Grizzy throws their stereo into the river, he sparks a general power outage and is unable to watch his favourite shows.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E15 - Bear Luck
1.plot: This is not Grizzy's day: after making a fool of himself in front of the she-bear, he is ousted from the cabin by the Lemmings. But his luck is about to change.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E16 - Bear Scents
1.plot: When he realises that his beloved she-bear adores the smell of flowers, Grizzy decides to offer her the geraniums that decorate the window ledges of the ranger's cabin.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E17 - Bear's Best Friend
1.plot: Grizzy discovers a baby raccoon not far from the log cabin. When he sees its big moist eyes, Grizzy melts and adopts the creature.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E18 - Super Grizzy Bros
1.plot: Grizzy starts playing video game on the console. The Lemmings want to try their hand at the joystick but Grizzy refuses to interrupt his kart racing game. The Lemmings brought another joystick and starts playing with Grizzy. Both of them think they will win.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E19 - Polar Bear
1.plot: Nutty Hill is suffering from a stifling heat wave. Searching in vain for a bit of cool air, Grizzy suddenly has a brilliant idea. He'll get into the fridge, where the temperature will be more bearable.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E20 - Bear Spread
1.plot: Grizzy is frustrated: just as he was about to coat a nice big fresh salmon with chocolate spread and snuggle up in front of the Tv, he discovers that the pantry is empty!

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E21 - Role Change
1.plot: After receiving a terrible blow over the head, Grizzy is no longer the same: he thinks he's a rodent! He tries to get the gang to adopt him.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E22 - Lemming Interference
1.plot: Grizzy has prepared himself a TV dinner to eat in front of his favourite series. But his moment of pleasure is abruptly interrupted by unexplained static.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E23 - Magnetic Bear
1.plot: Grizzy sees objects moving all by themselves when the Lemmings play around with a powerful magnet.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E24 - Bear Charm
1.plot: Grizzy is persuaded that the she-bear he's in love with has been turned into a frog. Whilst he looks through the ranger's books of fairytales, the Lemmings try to recover the frog.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E25 - Fake Brother
1.plot: Grizzy builds a look-alike robot to keep the Lemmings away.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E26 - Mind in a Whirl
1.plot: After being hit over the head, the she-bear Grizzy's in love with thinks she's a Lemming.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E27 - A Sizeable Problem
1.plot: A small meteorite falls down by the table it contains jelly beans. But Grizzy uses a red beans and blue beans to chase the lemmings while riding a large birds but the end the bird got very large to chase them.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E28 - Teleportation's the Way to Go!
1.plot: Grizzy finds communicating vessels. If he sticks his hand in one, it comes out the other, regardless of the distance between them. This should satisfy Grizzy's natural lazy streak.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E29 - In the Service of His Majesty
1.plot: When he brandishes an Indian scepter that the Lemmings brought home, Grizzy sees the Lemmings bow low before him and behave like servants.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E30 - Bear Art
1.plot: Grizzy tries to impress the she-bear he's in love with by making a sculpture of her from a piece of wood. But the Lemmings gnaw at the work of art to transform it into a slide.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E31 - Happy Birthday Lemming
1.plot: The Lemmings throw a Birthday party when Happy Birthday rings out it wakes Grizzy who is sleeping after a hearty meal. Grizzy must stop the dim but for the lemmings. the party must go on.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E32 - Flower Power
1.plot: A gust of wind sweeps away the flower that Grizzy's adored she-bear wears in her hair. Grizzy sees this as a golden opportunity to dazzle her by bringing it back.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E33 - Lemming Airlines
1.plot: Grizzy is disturbed in the middle of his TV snack by a flow of incongruous objects.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E34 - Relax Bear
1.plot: Grizzy discovers that the ranger has purchased a brand new multi-function Stressless recliner.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E35 - Treasure Bear
1.plot: Under the wood floor of the log cabin, Grizzy and the Lemmings discover the entrance to an underground gallery with an old treasure card that indicates the location of a treasure.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E36 - Bear Countdown
1.plot: Grizzy finds a vintage stopwatch in the garage which lets you wind back the minute that has just passed by and it can even stop time and movement in one's surroundings.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E37 - Bear Gliding
1.plot: The Lemmings play kite-surf with a homemade kite. Grizzy notices that the she-bear he's in love with watches the kite perform arabesques in the sky with admiration.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E38 - The Sound of a Lemming
1.plot: Grizzy snatches the last jar of chocolate spread out from under the noses of the Lemmings.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E39 - Bear in the Wind
1.plot: The Lemmings play a new game, floating like flags in the breeze from the fan set at maximum.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E40 - Construction Bear
1.plot: The Lemmings have fun tearing down their Kapla block buildings, which they rebuild just as fast. Grizzy finds that the she-bear he's in love with is impressed by the construction.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E41 - Kung Fu Lemmings
1.plot: The Lemmings draw inspiration from lessons they find in a martial arts book and start breaking every wooden object they can get their hands on into two.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E42 - A Midsummer Bear's Dream
1.plot: Grizzy dreams that he's a valiant knight who has delivered his beloved. As he is about to take her in his arms, he is woken by the Lemmings who have chosen this day to blast music.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E43 - Manufacturing Secret
1.plot: Grizzy stands in front of the pantry, desperate. The stock of chocolate spread is completely depleted. He realizes that the Lemmings are making some themselves!

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E44 - Bling Bling Bear
1.plot: Inspired by a magazine with a jewelry ad showing a man offering a diamond to a woman, Grizzy imagines himself offering the ranger's engagement ring to his beloved she-bear.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E45 - Intellectual Bear
1.plot: When he accidentally sticks a computer microprocessor to his temple, Grizzy is transformed into an exceptionally intelligent being capable of predicting events to come.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E46 - Voodoo Blanket
1.plot: The Lemmings prepare a dream afternoon snack with the last jar of chocolate spread in the cupboard. Tough luck, Grizzy is coming!

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E47 - Bear Prints
1.plot: Grizzy gleefully discovers that he can print images taken with the ranger's camera which is connected to a state-of-the-art printer. He decides to immortalize and frame himself...

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E48 - Inspector Grizzy
1.plot: A van pulls up to the ranger's cabin to deliver a crate of jars of chocolate spread. While Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over a wrecking bar to open it, someone steals the crate.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E49 - No Entrance!
1.plot: As usual, Grizzy picks the door of the Ranger's log cabin to come in and make himself comfortable, but this time it's impossible to enter!

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E50 - Lemmings Indigestion
1.plot: The Lemmings have got their hands on a pack of white beans which have very strange properties: when mixed with soda, anyone who eats them turns into a stupid bouncing ball.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E51 - Sonata in Bear Major
1.plot: Grizzy wants to get rid of the old piano at any cost. But when he notices that the she-bear he's in love with likes the melody of "Für Elise," he decides to learn the piece.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E52 - Bear Fractions
1.plot: The Lemmings inherit a crate that fell off a Canadian army convoy. Inside, a case emits a sort of laser beam that divides objects into multiple miniaturized versions of themselves.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E53 - The Bear That Laid Golden Eggs
1.plot: A machine hands out surprise eggs in exchange for a coin. Amongst the lots to be won, there is a super firework rocket the Lemmings dream of and there is also a flowers which made like a necklace the Grizzy dream of for she-bear.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E54 - Crash Training Course
1.plot: Grizzy finds a high-tech gadget that enables him to learn anything within seconds, meaning that he can become the perfect bear. Lemmings also wants this gadget from Grizzy.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E55 - As Far as Bear Can Remember
1.plot: Grizzy and Lemmings find themselves in their new home for the first time and Grizzy and Lemmings meet with the food of their lives and the contest begins.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E56 - Chemical Lemmings
1.plot: The Lemmings starts playing chemistry novices with a fun experiment box at the cabin's garage which disturbs Grizzy.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E57 - Remote Control
1.plot: Grizzy's TV remote control is stolen by a partridge who collects high-tech objects in his nest perched high up in a tree; Grizzy has no other choice but to requisition the Lemmings' propulsion game to recover his possession.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E58 - The Bear and the Butterfly
1.plot: Grizzy has got it into his head to offer a butterfly to the she bear but the Lemmings fight with him over the rare specimens he is spotted.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E59 - Get Off My Tennis Shoes
1.plot: The Lemmings have discovered an addictive new game based on the astonishing bouncing properties of the running shoes. Grizzy also liked the shoes and snatch from them.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E60 - Babysitting
1.plot: She-bear asked Grizzy to babysit her she-bear kid for some time. There is no question of Grizzy tripping up, as he has no intention of taking any risks, but he hasn't reckoned on the Lemmings.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E61 - Bear Under Lock and Key
1.plot: Unwilling to share the food both he and the Lemmings are wild about, Grizzy locks it up inside the ranger's brand new and apparently burglar-proof safe.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E62 - Lemming Blues
1.plot: Grizzy is impressed by the TV show of a magician who transforms a partridge into a bouquet of flowers. To get rid of the Lemmings once and for all, Grizzy tries the magic trick on them.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E63 - Snow Lemmings
1.plot: An ice-cream getting fight between Grizzy and the Lemmings.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E64 - Augmented Bear
1.plot: Grizzy brought a tablet that had a game of catching fishes in it.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E65 - Lemmings Under Pressure
1.plot: Grizzy wants to melt the ice in which has a salmon in it using the blow dryer. However, the Lemmings are already using the dryer for their latest rocket game in the piping system.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E66 - Lemmings in Space
1.plot: Due to crackers, the forest ranger cabin accidentally comes to space with Grizzy and the Lemmings. Grizzy wants to come back to earth but lemmings does not.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E67 - Sniffer Raccoon
1.plot: After lemmings snatched the Yummy XL from Grizzy, he starts finding them with the help of a Raccoon.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E68 - Transformational Bear
1.plot: Grizzy has a pain in his body. He brought a toy, which can transform itself into a car or a robot, from lemmings.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E69 - Shaken-up Bear
1.plot: Lemmings discovers a new game of shaking. The vibrations created by Grizzy's snoring during his nap give the Lemmings an idea for a bouncing game. But when Grizzy changes positions and his snoring stops, the Lemmings must find other sources of vibrations, which disturbs Grizzy to sleep.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E70 - Piñata Party
1.plot: Grizzy finds a birthday piñata in the ranger's living room. He wants to destroy it for toffees. The Lemmings, who prefer to use it as a toy to swing from, are determined to stop Grizzy from destroying the piñata.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E71 - Bear Game
1.plot: As usual, during a fight to get Yummy XL, the jar of chocolate falls into a magical object. Both of them would play a game to gett the jar.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E72 - Ranger Lemming
1.plot: Grizzy is bothered by an object stuck in between the sofa cushions. It's a big fur lemming puppet glove and the Lemmings believe that the puppet is a Super Lemming who's stronger than Grizzy and start to obey it.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E73 - Halloween Bear
1.plot: It is Halloween and Grizzy sees that the Ranger's house is full of pumpkin, fake spiders, webs etc. Lemmings started fun in cabin. After seeing the marshmallows they both start fighting to get them.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E74 - Clean Bear
1.plot: Grizzy wants to clean himself and give a ring to she bear but for clean his body, he should have a soap on which lemmings are skating.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E75 - Wandering Spirits
1.plot: Grizzy founds a magical object that changes his spirit from moose. When lemmings see this magic, they tried to change their spirits from partridge so that they can fly in the sky.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E76 - Mirror, Mirror on the Wall
1.plot: In the forest during fishing in the river, instead of fish, Grizzy found a box in which a magical mirror is placed which has a power that when someone saw into the mirror, his dream become true in mirror.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E77 - Grizzy the Wizard
1.plot: From the fallen by a vehicle, lemmings found a magical stick which has a power to make a non-living thing into living.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E78 - Moonwalk Bear
1.plot: Both Grizzy and the Lemmings accidentally travel to the moon by crackers. Grizzy wants to come back on earth while the lemmings start having fun.

meta.plot:
Dans une réserve naturelle, Grizzy, gros ours placide et chapardeur, vit comme un roi dans la forêt canadienne, n'hésitant pas à s'approprier la cabane du garde forestier dès que celui-ci a le dos tourné, afin de se détendre et jouir du confort et des nombreuses commodités qu'offre l'habitation. Parce qu’il est au sommet de la chaîne alimentaire, l’ours estime parfaitement légitime que la cabane lui revienne, dès que son propriétaire s’en éloigne. Aucun animal, c'est sûr, n’oserait contester les avantages de l'ours. Seuls les lemmings, de petits mammifères idiots, stupides et méchants (apparentés aux cochons d'Inde), lui contestent ses privilèges. Ils sont tous prêts à en découdre pour profiter des joies de la cabane !

La cohabitation ne sera certainement pas de tout repos !

1.title: FR - L'Épouse fantôme - S01E01 - Chapter 1
1.plot: Mr. Pan grapples with an alarming proposal from the Lim family.

1.title: FR - L'Épouse fantôme - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Er Lang reveals his true identity and warns Li Lan about Tian Bai, who introduces her to someone unexpected.

1.title: FR - L'Épouse fantôme - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: As Mr. Pan's time runs out, Li Lan visits a figure from Lim Tian Ching's past and follows Lim Yan Hong at the gambling den, putting herself in danger.

1.title: FR - L'Épouse fantôme - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Amah enlists the help of a medium to open a portal. Er Lang and Li Lan hatch a plan against Tian Ching, but she must first earn his trust.

1.title: FR - L'Épouse fantôme - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Mr. Pan stumbles on evidence at the gambling den alley. At Tian Ching's feast, Er Lang pursues the man wearing green shoes -- with dire consequences.

1.title: FR - L'Épouse fantôme - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Isabel reveals her dark past, Er Lang makes a life-altering sacrifice for love, and Li Lan chooses a different path for her future.

meta.plot: Malaisie, années 1890. Piégée dans l'au-delà en tentant de rompre un sinistre contrat, Li Lan se voit plongée dans un sombre mystère au sein d'une famille aisée.

This "sibling romantic comedy" revolves around Masamune Izumi, a light novel author in high school. Masamune's little sister is Sagiri, a shut-in girl who hasn't left her room for an entire year. She even forces her brother to make and bring her meals when she stomps the floor. Masamune wants his sister to leave her room, because the two of them are each other's only family.

Masamune's novel illustrator, pen name "Eromanga," draws extremely perverted drawings, and is very reliable. Masamune had never met his illustrator, and figured he was just a disgusting, perverted otaku. However, the truth is revealed… that his "Eromanga-sensei" is his own younger sister! To add to the chaos that erupts between the siblings, a beautiful, female, best-selling shoujo manga creator becomes their rival!

1.title: EN  - Eromanga Sensei [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - My Little Sister, and the Sealed Room
1.plot: Masamune Izumi is a high school student also working as a light novel author. He works with a mysterious illustrator who draws really erotic art for his light novels. In the midst of trying to deal with school and his shut-in sister, he discovers the identity behind this Eromanga-sensei!

1.title: EN  - Eromanga Sensei [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Class Rep with a Normie Life, and a Fearless Fairy
1.plot: Megumi Jinno, the class representative for Sagiri’s class, shows up at the Izumi residence with no prior warning. Her mission is to "take Sagiri to school". How will Sagiri and Masamune handle the situation? Afterwards, Masamune runs into a mystical fairy in a pink dress…

1.title: EN  - Eromanga Sensei [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Buck Naked Mansion and the Fallen Master
1.plot: The Izumi House’s empty mansion next door has rumors of being cursed because of continuous misfortunes. But what happens when Sagiri starts hearing piano music coming from the supposed empty mansion?! And how will Masamune handle this Fallen Master?

1.title: EN  - Eromanga Sensei [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Eromanga Sensei
1.plot: After observing the younger and more popular author, Elf Yamada, work on her novel, Masamune and Elf become a little closer. Sagiri notices this, and gets suspicious of their relationship, despite Masamune saying that he and Yamada-san don’t get along at all. Regardless of their argument over this matter, Masamune begins working on his “ultimate light novel”!

1.title: EN  - Eromanga Sensei [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Let’s Plan a Light-Novel with your Little Sister
1.plot: Motivated by Masamune’s manuscript, Sagiri puts effort into getting a little closer to Masamune, despite the awkwardness. Both of them are now working towards making the manuscript into a book, starting with the project proposal. In the midst of all this, Elf sends an emergency text message to Masamune!?

1.title: EN  - Eromanga Sensei [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Masamune Izumi and the Nemesis of Ten Million Copies
1.plot: To find a clue for becoming friends with Sagiri, Megumi tries to gain an affinity for light-novels. Masamune suggests dropping by and asking if she could borrow books from Sagiri. At first, Sagiri vehemently rejects the encounter, but later presents Masamune with a certain condition…

1.title: EN  - Eromanga Sensei [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Little Sister and the Most Interesting Novel in the World
1.plot: Masamune, who is sparing no effort to publish his new title faster, immediately signs up for the light-novel competition, “Light-novel Tenkaichi Budoukai.” However, the super-popular author, Senju Muramasa, also signs up for the competition and declares to Masamune that she will crush his pointless dream! Why would she even do that?

1.title: EN  - Eromanga Sensei [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Dreaming Sagiri and Summer Fireworks
1.plot: Sagiri finds out what happened between Masamune and Muramasa. It’s not like Sagiri was happy about it or anything. In the midst of this, it’s crunch time at the editorial office as Masamune begins to turn his short story into a long novel. Elf-sensei also suggests having a wrap party at Masamune’s house as they celebrate summer in yukata outfits!

1.title: EN  - Eromanga Sensei [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Little Sister and the Fairy Island
1.plot: "I’ll call it the 'Summer Data Collection and Writing Camp'!" As a result of one of Elf’s ideas, the light-novel authors end up heading to a vacation house on an island in the “South Seas”. How far can Elf push the "Data Collection" card?

1.title: EN  - Eromanga Sensei [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Masamune Izumi and the Younger Senpai
1.plot: At the Yamada Family’s vacation house, Muramasa enthusiastically reads Masamune’s “shelved” stories. Even Masamune can’t hide his happiness when he sees someone reading his novels so passionately. However, within Muramasa’s heart filled with unhidden love towards Masamune, there was indeed a change occurring, and so Muramasa makes a certain decision.

1.title: EN  - Eromanga Sensei [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - How the Two Met and Future Siblings
1.plot: Masamune comes home from his trip, and Sagiri is happy to see him return. They now await their new novel to go on sale. On the day of, an “Izumi Masamune Faire” is held in a store in Akihabara. While Masamune and Sagiri “explore” the area, they share their stories of how they got into writing novels and illustrating.

1.title: EN  - Eromanga Sensei [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Eromanga Festival
1.plot: Masamune and Sagiri’s new work, "Sekaimo: The World’s Cutest Little Sister" is now on sale. Sagiri continues to stream from her room wearing a mask as always, and declares the curtain rising on a "Festival".

meta.plot: Decades ago, a hero from the stars left this world in peace. Now, the son of Ultraman must rise to protect the Earth from a new alien threat.

1.title: EN - Ultraman [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - A Power That Does Not Belong On Earth
1.plot: Decades since he last merged with Ultraman, Shin Hayata learns of a new threat to Earth. His son, Shinjiro, also shows signs of superhuman strength.

1.title: EN - Ultraman [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - An Inevitable Fate
1.plot: Wearing a protosuit, Shin is critically injured while saving Shinjiro from Bemular's attack. In desperation, Shinjiro returns to rescue his father.

1.title: EN - Ultraman [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Being Ultraman Isn't So Bad
1.plot: With Bemular paving the way for other alien species to attack Earth, SSSP's Edo asks Shinjiro to take on the mantle of Ultraman.

1.title: EN - Ultraman [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Release the Limiter!
1.plot: Shinjiro is sent on a mission to exterminate a hostile alien, but the target flees into the city, endangering countless civilians.

1.title: EN - Ultraman [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - An Alien Town
1.plot: After uncovering evidence of alien involvement in a string of bizarre homicides, SSSP agent Moroboshi contacts an informant inside an alien enclave.

1.title: EN - Ultraman [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Curse That Is Ultraman
1.plot: Shinjiro’s reluctance to execute homicidal aliens deeply concerns agent Moroboshi. Shin shares with his son what it truly means to be Ultraman.

1.title: EN - Ultraman [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Hidden Thoughts
1.plot: Embattled at first, Shinjiro finds his resolve and activates a latent power during his fight against a hostile alien. Rena prepares for a big concert.

1.title: EN - Ultraman [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - The Dawn of Truth
1.plot: At Rena's concert, an alien calling himself Adad demands a confrontation with Ultraman. Things go from bad to worse when Bemular joins the fray.

1.title: EN - Ultraman [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Nice To Meet You, Big Brother
1.plot: Shinijiro fears that his cover may be blown by an underclassman. Later on, he's taken aback when a rogue Ultraman shows up to aid him in battle.

1.title: EN - Ultraman [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Star Cluster Council
1.plot: Seiji dreams of a day when aliens are accepted openly on Earth. Hoping to fight for this cause, he pleads with the SSSP to bring him on board.

1.title: EN - Ultraman [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Always Stay the Way You Are
1.plot: Seiji has a tense confrontation with Shinjiro and Moroboshi over the use of his powers. Rena asks Shinjiro to give Ultraman a message.

1.title: EN - Ultraman [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Ace Killer
1.plot: Moroboshi, Shinjiro and the might of the SSSP sets out to protect Seiji on his quest to punish those responsible for the airline tragedy 12 years ago.

1.title: EN - Ultraman [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - The Real Ultraman
1.plot: The Ultraman trio are fighting a losing battle against the mercenaries, but just when things seem hopeless, Shinjiro's dormant power finally awakens.

2.title: EN - Ultraman [MULTI-SUB] - S02E01 - The Man from NY
2.plot: While meeting with Rena, Shinjiro suddenly gets a call to stop a rampaging alien. Journalist Kotaro Higashi witnesses the whole incident.

2.title: EN - Ultraman [MULTI-SUB] - S02E02 - Flames of Fury
EN - Ultraman [MULTI-SUB] - S02E03 - The Man without the Light
EN - Ultraman [MULTI-SUB] - S02E04 - Attack on SSSP
EN - Ultraman [MULTI-SUB] - S02E05 - The Golden Fortress
EN - Ultraman [MULTI-SUB] - S02E06 - ULTRAMAN No.6

3.title: EN - Ultraman [MULTI-SUB] - S03E01 - The Sign of a New Awakening
3.plot: Shinjiro agrees to help test out and develop a new suit better adapted to his changing powers — and he finds himself using it much sooner than planned.

3.title: EN - Ultraman [MULTI-SUB] - S03E02 - The Curse of Ultraman
3.plot: He can't remember what he did, but Shinjiro's forbidden from wearing his suit for a while. His father can't help but feel that there's an Ultraman curse.

3.title: EN - Ultraman [MULTI-SUB] - S03E03 - The Choice of a Hero
3.plot: Determined to do something, Shinjiro heads out to get his revenge. But then once again, he wakes up with no memory of what happened.

3.title: EN - Ultraman [MULTI-SUB] - S03E04 - No One to Trust
3.plot: Public sentiment has turned completely against Ultraman. Then suddenly, Mephisto hijacks the airwaves to deliver a message directly to the people.

3.title: EN - Ultraman [MULTI-SUB] - S03E05 - Hide and Seek
3.plot: Ide sends Taro and Moroboshi out to search for Shinjiro, who remains on the run, confused by everything that's been happening to him.

3.title: EN - Ultraman [MULTI-SUB] - S03E06 - A Warrior's Return
3.plot: Back in his hideout, Daisuke Arashi tells Shinjiro about his father's past, and they try to narrow down who Mephisto's next target might be.

3.title: EN - Ultraman [MULTI-SUB] - S03E07 - The Fourth Successor
3.plot: After getting devastating news, Rena meets with Seiji Hokuto. Shinjiro talks to Daisuke about the strange dreams he's been having about Zetton.

3.title: EN - Ultraman [MULTI-SUB] - S03E08 - TARO vs ULTRAMAN
3.plot: Rena can't understand what just happened to her, so Seiji brings her to meet the alien who raised him. Taro finally finds Shinjiro.

3.title: EN - Ultraman [MULTI-SUB] - S03E09 - Time of Awakening
3.plot: Jack shows up, surprising Taro and Shinjiro. Rena seeks some answers about where her powers come from. The SSSP gets raided by the police.

3.title: EN - Ultraman [MULTI-SUB] - S03E10 - The Disaster
3.plot: The fight against Mephisto only strengthens the anti-Ultraman sentiment. Moroboshi and Shinjiro try to break into the heavily guarded SSSP headquarters.

3.title: EN - Ultraman [MULTI-SUB] - S03E11 - A Nightmare Come True
3.plot: Shinjiro and Rena reveal some secrets to each other. Joined by his friends, Ultraman faces a powerful enemy from the past.

3.title: EN - Ultraman [MULTI-SUB] - S03E12 - Finale
3.plot: As Shinjiro struggles in his own fight, his friends put everything they can into defeating Zetton. A new chapter begins for the SSSP.

meta.plot: Living inside a fairy tale may sound like a dream, but for this heroine, it’s more of a nightmare. After her mysterious death, Rinko is reborn as Raeliana—a loved and wealthy character in a novel. But she knows the ending: her murder at the hands of her fiancé. So, she hatches a plan to stay alive, one that involves a devilish duke and a phony engagement. Can she rewrite her story?

1.title: EN - Why Raeliana Ended Up at the Duke's Mansion [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Why Raeliana Made a Deal
1.plot: After being pushed to her death by a mysterious figure, Hanasaki Rinko reincarnates in the world of a novel as Raeliana McMillan, a side character destined to be poisoned by her fiancé.

1.title: EN - Why Raeliana Ended Up at the Duke's Mansion [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Why Raeliana Made a Contract
1.plot: Raeliana moves to the Wynknight mansion so she and Noah can be officially engaged. She used her knowledge of Noah's possession of the royal seal to convince him to make the deal with her, but Noah seems unfazed, making her wonder if he'll really accept.

1.title: EN - Why Raeliana Ended Up at the Duke's Mansion [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Why Raeliana Trained in Domestic Arts
1.plot: Raeliana begins her bridal training at the Wynknight mansion. She and Noah must put on the perfect performance to convince society that their engagement is real, but the road ahead of them is clearly rocky...

1.title: EN - Why Raeliana Ended Up at the Duke's Mansion [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Why Raeliana Took Up the Fight
1.plot: Noah and Raeliana attend a ball. Raeliana attempts to get closer to the wife of Marquess Eriteal at Noah's request, hoping to make him owe her a favor, but then another character from the novel appears: the antagonist Vivian.

1.title: EN - Why Raeliana Ended Up at the Duke's Mansion [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Why Raeliana Was Taken Away
1.plot: Raeliana has been kidnapped, and a rescue by Noah and his knights is her only hope. But can they make it in time? And what kind of trap will they find waiting for them if they do?

1.title: EN - Why Raeliana Ended Up at the Duke's Mansion [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Why Raeliana Cosplayed
1.plot: Raeliana wakes up in Noah's room, with Noah lying half-naked beside her. Panicked, she seeks Adam's help in fleeing the mansion. Noah sends out all his knights to find her, but Raeliana uses a maid disguise to avoid discovery.

1.title: EN - Why Raeliana Ended Up at the Duke's Mansion [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Why Raeliana Handed Her a Handkerchief
1.plot: Raeliana attends the annual monster hunt in the Sycret Mountains, where each lady traditionally gives a handkerchief to her chosen participant, who in turn gives the lady a monster he's killed. On the first day, Noah makes a request of Raeliana...

1.title: EN - Why Raeliana Ended Up at the Duke's Mansion [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Why Raeliana's Going to the Temple
1.plot: Noah and his retinue return from their hunt with a very surprising quarry in tow. Preparations for the lighting of the sacred flame begin, but His Holiness is distracted by other matters. Raeliana's letter to Beatrice finally gets a response.

1.title: EN - Why Raeliana Ended Up at the Duke's Mansion [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Why Raeliana Was Called a Barbarian
1.plot: During a break in her purification period, Raeliana encounters His Holiness Heika, and their first meeting quickly devolves into an argument. But this only makes Heika more curious about the girl who spoke so impudently to him...

1.title: EN - Why Raeliana Ended Up at the Duke's Mansion [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Why Raeliana Called Him Grandpa
1.plot: Heika tries everything he can think of to make Raeliana agree to be his disciple. He opens the seldom-opened gate to the Holy Land and summons its knights to show off his authority, and even tells Raeliana he'll be her grandpa.

1.title: EN - Why Raeliana Ended Up at the Duke's Mansion [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Why Raeliana Feigned Ignorance
1.plot: A maid tells Raeliana about a mirror in the west building that promises to give visitors any information they want, and warns her not to go near it. But Raeliana is too curious about what could have happened to Beatrice, the novel's heroine...

1.title: EN - Why Raeliana Ended Up at the Duke's Mansion [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Why Raeliana Ended Up at the Duke’s Mansion
1.plot: Raeliana continues to wonder what's become of Beatrice. When Raeliana visits a place Beatrice visited in the novel's plot, she meets someone completely unexpected instead, and learns that the status of the royal seal has changed.

meta.plot: Raised by a kind Kaingang family, adventurous young schoolgirl Luz launches a quest with her firefly companion to learn the truth about her roots.

1.title: FR - Luz: The Light of the Heart - S01E01 - The Girl and the Firefly
1.plot: Luz is welcomed into and raised as an equal in the Kaingang community. But a secret between Gá and Baltazar could change it all.

1.title: FR - Luz: The Light of the Heart - S01E02 - A Light at the End of the Tunnel
1.plot: Joca shows Luz around the school. However, keeping her a secret becomes challenging when Sabina won't stop asking questions.

1.title: FR - Luz: The Light of the Heart - S01E03 - Fire! Fire!
1.plot: Marcos meets Luz and tries to earn her trust. Joca's fire story grabs unexpected — and unwanted — attention, especially from Principal Isabela.

1.title: FR - Luz: The Light of the Heart - S01E04 - A Flame That Never Goes Out
1.plot: After meeting Gá, Marcos finds out all about Luz's past. Sabina pushes Joca to tell the truth about his friend, leading to a big revelation.

1.title: FR - Luz: The Light of the Heart - S01E05 - The Teacher's Indigenous Cousin
1.plot: Baltazar follows a lead in his investigation. Otávio accidentally tells Principal Isabela about Luz.

1.title: FR - Luz: The Light of the Heart - S01E06 - A Singular Student
1.plot: When inspectors visit Prex, Principal Isabela faces a tough decision about Luz. Marcos and Joca have a plan to help her make the right choice.

1.title: FR - Luz: The Light of the Heart - S01E07 - Light the Way
1.plot: Nic gets in the way of Sabina's evil plan. Marcos and Dora buy new clothes for Luz, who feels pressured to take official photos for the school website.

1.title: FR - Luz: The Light of the Heart - S01E08 - Number One
1.plot: Luz makes a bold move to avoid posing for Prex's website photos. Baltazar questions Isabela. Carlos tries to intimidate Gá's family.

1.title: FR - Luz: The Light of the Heart - S01E09 - A Dark Night
1.plot: Luz searches for a photo of her grandfather. Marcos goes on a date with Fernanda. Over the weekend, the kids gather to share stories around the fire.

1.title: FR - Luz: The Light of the Heart - S01E10 - Found Among the Fireflies
1.plot: Dora reminisces about her past. Chaos breaks loose during the school's play. Marcos and Dora search for Luz.

1.title: FR - Luz: The Light of the Heart - S01E11 - The Light That Never Goes Out
1.plot: Dora persuades Luz to return to school. Carlos instructs Valéria to deal with Baltazar. Principal Isabela makes a decision regarding the fourth grade.

1.title: FR - Luz: The Light of the Heart - S01E12 - The Storyteller
1.plot: New students join the fourth grade, but not everyone's happy about it. Valéria snoops around Dora's bookshop, and Otávio has a big talk with his mother.

1.title: FR - Luz: The Light of the Heart - S01E13 - You Are Never Alone
1.plot: Carlos pays a visit to the bookshop. Gael asks Dora an important question. Meanwhile, Cadu and Sabina compete to become fourth-grade class president.

1.title: FR - Luz: The Light of the Heart - S01E14 - They've Seen the Light
1.plot: Dora's storytelling activity leads to a family reunion. Baltazar confronts Valéria. Marcos tells Luz a secret about her family that changes everything.

1.title: FR - Luz: The Light of the Heart - S01E15 - The Secret
1.plot: After hearing shocking news, Luz starts to feel unwell. Gael's ambitious plans don't go as expected. Otávio and Sabina take the stage in art class.

1.title: FR - Luz: The Light of the Heart - S01E16 - Clues
1.plot: Marcos looks into Luz's father's past. Carlos shares his plans to buy the bookshop, and Dora remembers a special gift from a past love.

1.title: FR - Luz: The Light of the Heart - S01E17 - The Firefly Necklace
1.plot: Lia grows anxious about the art competition while Nic plots a revolution. Luz attempts to visit Dora at the bookshop, but someone gets in her way.

1.title: FR - Luz: The Light of the Heart - S01E18 - Monster Grandpa
1.plot: Luz makes a special request to Lia, and Sabina steps up to help a friend. Meanwhile, Gael resorts to desperate measures to clear his debts.

1.title: FR - Luz: The Light of the Heart - S01E19 - Parents and Children
1.plot: Dora tells Marcos she needs some time near her family. The kids don't like having their performance displayed at school — it's time to take action.

1.title: FR - Luz: The Light of the Heart - S01E20 - The Firefly and the Stars
1.plot: Marcos reveals the truth about Luz's past to Dora. Principal Isabela springs into action after a meeting, and friends and families reunite at last.

meta.plot: London cop and compulsive gambler Harry Clayton is on the verge of losing everything. On the night when his huge debts are to be called in, he meets the enigmatic Eve, who gives him a mysterious bracelet said to endow the wearer with immense luck. Harry's fortunes suddenly begin to shift, but he also soon finds himself sucked into a sinister crime wave sweeping through the city.

1.title: FR - Stan Lee's Lucky Man - S01E01 - More Yang Than Yin
1.plot: The life of troubled London cop, D.I. Harry Clayton, takes an unexpected turn when a mysterious woman gives him a bracelet that seems to allow him to control luck. Will he use it to bring a killer to justice or win at the casino?

1.title: FR - Stan Lee's Lucky Man - S01E02 - Win Some, Lose Some
1.plot: Harry's lucky bracelet is put to the ultimate test as he hunts for the man behind casino boss Freddy Lau's death.

1.title: FR - Stan Lee's Lucky Man - S01E03 - Evil Eye
1.plot: Harry is drawn into the case of a robbery at Hatton Garden as he starts to realise that his good luck comes at a price.

1.title: FR - Stan Lee's Lucky Man - S01E04 - A Higher Power
1.plot: There’s a whiff of conspiracy when a woman is mysteriously kidnapped from her office in the City. Harry and Suri must pull out all the stops if they are to track her down before it’s too late.

1.title: FR - Stan Lee's Lucky Man - S01E05 - The Last Chance
1.plot: Behaving strangely after mysteriously going AWOL, Harry is called in to investigate the murder of a members’ club owner in Shoreditch. The team have a prime suspect but Harry has his own ideas about who is responsible.

1.title: FR - Stan Lee's Lucky Man - S01E06 - A Twist of Fate
1.plot: There are whispers of ritual sacrifice when a mutilated body is found at City Hall’s newest development site. Convinced that there is more to it than that, Harry puts Suri’s life at risk.

1.title: FR - Stan Lee's Lucky Man - S01E07 - The Charm Offensive
1.plot: When a young man dies fleeing for his life, Harry and Suri are forced to tread carefully as they are thrown into a world of wealthy foreign students with dangerous and powerful connections.

1.title: FR - Stan Lee's Lucky Man - S01E08 - My Brother's Keeper
1.plot: Harry is distraught when a devastating murder impacts him personally. Suri and Orwell take the case but, convinced that they have it all wrong, Harry takes things into his own hands, invoking the bracelet and breaking the rules.

1.title: FR - Stan Lee's Lucky Man - S01E09 - The House Always Wins
1.plot: Just when he is getting close, a shocking turn of events sees Harry thrown right into the dragon’s lair. With his half-brother Rich in mortal danger, Harry realises too late who is really pulling the strings.

1.title: FR - Stan Lee's Lucky Man - S01E10 - Leap of Faith
1.plot: Golding's game enters its terrifying final phase. Can Harry save his family and himself?

2.title: FR - Stan Lee's Lucky Man - S02E01 - Luck Be a Lady
2.plot: 6 months after rescuing his family from Golding, Harry Clayton is a very different man. He hasn't laid a bet in 186 days and has sworn off using the power of the bracelet - until he meets a woman with an identical bracelet.

2.title: FR - Stan Lee's Lucky Man - S02E02 - Playing With Fire
2.plot: Harry investigates a wave of hate crimes in London. Meanwhile, the alluring Isabella tests his willpower.

2.title: FR - Stan Lee's Lucky Man - S02E03 - Double Bluff
2.plot: A pie containing human flesh is discovered after a man collapses in the middle of a busy London street. Retracing the pie’s provenance, Harry and the team find that a meat wholesaler peddles a lot more than lamb, pork, beef, and chicken…

2.title: FR - Stan Lee's Lucky Man - S02E04 - The Trojan Horse
2.plot: London's Silicon Roundabout comes under scrutiny when a driverless car is hacked with fatal consequences. Meanwhile, Harry and Isabella grow closer.

2.title: FR - Stan Lee's Lucky Man - S02E05 - What Lies Beneath
2.plot: Harry and the team investigate a spate of drownings along London’s eerie canals. Behind them is a self-righteous person who doesn’t believe in second chances. It’s not long before Harry, addict and gambler, tracks them down – will he survive the final reckoning?

2.title: FR - Stan Lee's Lucky Man - S02E06 - The Point of No Return
2.plot: A ruthless hit-man takes out an entire charter plane, but for Harry and the team his motivation is a mystery. Can Harry decipher the target before he strikes again?

2.title: FR - Stan Lee's Lucky Man - S02E07 - Second Chance
2.plot: After a Soho property developer is found brutally murdered, key evidence disappears from the crime scene. Winter worries that one of his team is responsible, and Orwell is in the frame. Harry fights to clear his detective’s name, only to find himself back in the Green Dragon Casino and face to face with his old enemy, the fiery Lily-Anne Lau.

2.title: FR - Stan Lee's Lucky Man - S02E08 - The Fallen Angel
2.plot: Someone is wreaking revenge on London’s most wanted criminals, one murder at a time. Once Harry puts two and two together, he’s forced to put his life in danger and crosses a dangerous line.

2.title: FR - Stan Lee's Lucky Man - S02E09 - Lamb To The Slaughter
2.plot: Down-and-out boxer Jay Tate revels in his newly found good fortune when he finds himself victorious in the boxing ring. But for every swing there is a roundabout and with Harry and Eve on the hunt for him, how long can Jay’s winning streak last?

2.title: FR - Stan Lee's Lucky Man - S02E10 - A Hero of Our Time
2.plot: While Suri follows a trail of breadcrumbs, amassing enough evidence to bring down her prime suspect, Eve tells Harry there’s only one extreme way to stop the cunning plan against him, culminating in the most titanic of struggles.

3.title: FR - Stan Lee's Lucky Man - S03E01 - Facing Your Demons
3.plot: Harry Clayton heads to Hong Kong where Eve has been framed for murder, there he clashes with a new nemesis - hit-man Samuel Blake who is on a lifelong mission to make the bracelets his.

3.title: FR - Stan Lee's Lucky Man - S03E02 - Run Rabbit Run
3.plot: Harry's forced underground as he tries to prove his innocence. But then Blake finds a way to make him look more guilty than ever.

3.title: FR - Stan Lee's Lucky Man - S03E03 - The Zero Option
3.plot: Samuel Blake ups his game, forcing Harry to make a near-impossible choice. Meanwhile, the bracelet's power starts to wane.

3.title: FR - Stan Lee's Lucky Man - S03E04 - Missing Persons
3.plot: Suri and Harry team up to bring Blake and Gray down. Meanwhile, Blake finds a way to turn Eve against Harry - once and for all.

3.title: FR - Stan Lee's Lucky Man - S03E05 - The Sins of the Father
3.plot: Harry spots a golden chance to bring down Blake. But he risks everything when he turns to gambling to fund his sting.

3.title: FR - Stan Lee's Lucky Man - S03E06 - The Art of War
3.plot: Rich moves in with Suri as Harry fights to win back his flat. But something terrible happens when Blake and Eve go after DSI Gray.

3.title: FR - Stan Lee's Lucky Man - S03E07 - Blinded by the Light
3.plot: Madame Cheung warns Harry that time is running out and that if he does not retrieve the bracelet and return it to her then he will be a dead man. Blake and Eve stage an audacious escape from prison.

3.title: FR - Stan Lee's Lucky Man - S03E08 - End of Days
3.plot: Blake puts his grand plan into action forcing Harry to summon all of his courage to take on his nemesis without the aid of the bracelets in the last-ever episode of the thriller.

meta.plot: An intimate portrait of the war against violent extremism and the men and women devoting their lives to it. Records the fight against radical threats all over the world as it unfolds over one full year.

1.title: EN - Chain of Command - S01E01 - Part 1, ‘By, With & Through’
1.plot: Chain of Command begins with a look at the efforts of U.S. and Iraqi forces to regain control of eastern Mosul — the front lines of the war on extremism.

1.title: EN - Chain of Command - S01E02 - Part 2, ‘Perception and Reality’
1.plot: The battle for western Mosul begins, a unit deploys for Afghanistan and the war against extremism stretches to the Caribbean island of Trinidad.

1.title: EN - Chain of Command - S01E03 - Part 3, ‘Shoulder to Shoulder’
1.plot: American officials search for dangerous migrants in Colombia; back home, husband and wife Marines prepare for deployment to Afghanistan.

1.title: EN - Chain of Command - S01E04 - Part 4, ‘The End of the Beginning'
1.plot: While coalition forces in Iraq gain ground in Mosul, in Trinidad and Tobago, local Muslim leaders are the tip of the spear in the fight against ISIS.

1.title: EN - Chain of Command - S01E05 - Part 5, 'Generations'
1.plot: U.S. Marines advise and assist the Afghan army against the Taliban, and one officer watches on Skype as his son is born back home.

1.title: EN - Chain of Command - S01E06 - Part 6, 'Crossroads'
1.plot: Marines continue to work with local forces in Afghanistan, while the U.S. also looks to curb extremism across Africa as well as the jungles of Panama.

1.title: EN - Chain of Command - S01E07 - War Without Borders
1.plot: A look at the war against violent extremism in Afghanistan and Africa.

1.title: EN - Chain of Command - S01E08 - "Why we Fight"
1.plot: The war on terror looks different across the world. At Camp Shorab in Afghanistan, a group of Marines prepare to return home, but are surrounded by reminders of the dangers still haunting the country. Meanwhile in Niger, U.S. Army Special Forces work with local forces to combat extremism, but tragedy strikes when four Americans are killed in an attack. As the losses are mourned, the war against violent extremism continues.

meta.plot: Not far from the town of Domina lives Shiloh, a boy who keeps hearing a voice in his dreams about a mission he must fulfill. But what mission could he be needed for remains unknown. That all changes when he meets two Jumi, a race that’s hunted for their unique gemstones, as a sudden outbreak of attacks against the Jumi occurs. His dream, his quest, becomes clear—help the Jumi and their gemstones!
