1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E41 - Episode 41
1.plot: Ka Suo becomes determined to solve the mystery of the ancient god. The Ice Queen springs into action after a mysterious whirlpool appears.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E42 - Episode 42
1.plot: Ka Suo and Xing Jiu plan to take the fight with the ancient god to Sacred Snow Mountain, a dangerous place where magic is born.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E43 - Episode 43
1.plot: At the start of a truly mettle-testing journey, the group faces a daunting challenge from the High Priest.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E44 - Episode 44
1.plot: Yan Da encounters a startlingly familiar sword fairy. The group faces the first of four guardians on Sacred Snow Mountain.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E45 - Episode 45
1.plot: The group encounters a guardian who prefers to take an uncommon approach. Yan Da strikes a deal with Shi's soul.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E46 - Episode 46
1.plot: Ka Suo finds himself enchanted by the deceptively beautiful Southern Guardian. Chao Ya wishes to return to the Spirit Land.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E47 - Episode 47
1.plot: As the group continues to battle the powerful musician Die Che, Yan Da meets with another guardian -- as well as Yuan Ji himself.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E48 - Episode 48
1.plot: After encountering the evil Northern Guardian at Lightning Altar, Xing Gui finds herself in a crucial role. The group travels to the Mortal Kingdom.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E49 - Episode 49
1.plot: Xing Gui aids the group via the dream world. Driven by their shared love for Chao Ya, Liao Jian and Pian Feng form a strong bond.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E50 - Episode 50
1.plot: Ka Suo and Chao Ya attempt to lure the West Guardian out from the shadows, but the group is shocked by what they uncover.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E51 - Episode 51
1.plot: The group faces the daunting task of battling Yuan Ji. But a rift between the all-powerful god and Hidden Lotus may give them a fighting chance.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E52 - Episode 52
1.plot: The resurrected and transformed Shi craves revenge against Ka Suo. Li Luo and Lan Shang struggle with their new identities.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E53 - Episode 53
1.plot: As a frustrated Li Luo struggles with her amnesia, a new clan from Spirit Snow Mountain arrives at Ren Xue City.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E54 - Episode 54
1.plot: Ka Suo becomes determined to make Li Luo remember him. Shi conspires to align the Mermaid Tribe with the Fire Tribe.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E55 - Episode 55
1.plot: A treacherous Shi returns to Snowblade City to manipulate Ka Suo, who grows increasingly concerned about Li Luo.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E56 - Episode 56
1.plot: Yan Da raises the possibility to her soul-hungry father of a traitor among the Fire Tribe. Chao Ya faces a formidable challenge.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E57 - Episode 57
1.plot: Ka Suo faces the prospect of war if he doesn't deliver Lan Shang to the Fire King, forcing him to make a difficult decision.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E58 - Episode 58
1.plot: While confronting Phoenix and the Fire King, Xing Jiu soon finds himself plunged into the dark realm of the Despair Fire Kingdom.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E59 - Episode 59
1.plot: Ka Suo must confront Shi in the realm of the Fire Tribe after his brother kidnaps Li Luo and Lan Shang.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E60 - Episode 60
1.plot: With Ka Suo conveniently out of the way, the Fire King launches an attack on Snowblade City. Meanwhile, Yan Da uncovers her father’s secrets.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E61 - Episode 61
1.plot: While the completely unhinged Fire King goes on a rampage, Ka Suo has little time to let the Hidden Lotus know his final decision.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E62 - Episode 62
1.plot: The future of the Ice Tribe and many lives depend on a final battle between brothers Ka Suo and Shi.

meta.plot: Un détective privé énigmatique se bat contre ses démons intérieurs pendant son enquête sur la disparition de la petite-fille chérie d’un producteur hollywoodien.

1.title: FR - Sugar - S01E01 - Olivia
1.plot: After solving a case in Japan, private eye John Sugar returns to LA to help find a missing woman with ties to a Hollywood legend.

1.title: FR - Sugar - S01E02 - These People, These Places
1.plot: Sugar suspects Melanie's not telling the full story. Meanwhile, he and Ruby may not be the only ones looking into the mysterious body in Olivia's trunk.

1.title: FR - Sugar - S01E03 - Shibuya Crossing
1.plot: Melanie and Sugar get caught in a dicey situation—and make a new enemy. Sugar reunites with old friends, but he senses some are keeping secrets.

1.title: FR - Sugar - S01E04 - Starry-Eyed
1.plot: Sugar and Melanie track down Olivia's friend, who shares disturbing information about Davy and his family. Davy and Kenny dig into Sugar's past.

1.title: FR - Sugar - S01E05 - Boy in the Corner
1.plot: Melanie gets a surprise visit that unleashes Sugar's dark side. Ruby receives chilling guidance from a colleague. Davy makes a tragic decision.

1.title: FR - Sugar - S01E06 - Go Home
1.plot: Sugar thinks he's made a break in the case. When a double cross forces him to do the unthinkable, he turns to Melanie and Henry for help.

1.title: FR - Sugar - S01E07 - The Friends You Keep
1.plot: Sugar's fears for the safety of his friends lead him to a clandestine gathering where he learns a dangerous secret—and the truth about Olivia.

meta.plot: An ordinary walk home from school turns into an epic journey for Usato. After suddenly being dropped into another world with two fellow students, Usato learns he was summoned there by accident. But things turn around when he discovers a unique aptitude for healing magic! Now, he trains beyond human limitations, using his self-healing abilities to gain absurd strength and unrivaled stamina.

1.title: EN - The Wrong Way to Use Healing Magic [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Dragged into Another World!
1.plot: Ordinary high school student Usato is mistakenly suddenly summoned to another world along with his classmates and student council members Suzune and Kazuki.

1.title: EN - The Wrong Way to Use Healing Magic [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The Training from Hell Begins!
1.plot: Following the discovery of his unique power, Usato has been recruited/abducted into the kingdom's Rescue Team. And he has no idea the hellacious training he's in for!

1.title: EN - The Wrong Way to Use Healing Magic [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Brutal! The Darkness of Llinger!
1.plot: Usato is quite literally thrown into his next training assignment: surviving the wild woods known as the Darkness of Llinger until he can slay its most fearsome inhabitant.

1.title: EN - The Wrong Way to Use Healing Magic [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Rescue Team Member Usato!
1.plot: As the demon threat looms over the kingdom, Captain Rose decides it's high time for Usato to get a taste of what a healer's job is like on the battlefield. She tests his resolve, both mentally and physically.

1.title: EN - The Wrong Way to Use Healing Magic [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Usato, Back in the Forest!
1.plot: Usato gets drafted to help Inukami on a training expedition outside the castle to get some real combat experience. He's only supposed to be there in case things go wrong, but things definitely go wrong!

1.title: EN - The Wrong Way to Use Healing Magic [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Impending Danger...!
1.plot: Captain Rose receives grim news from the king: invasion is imminent. Can she rally her small team before all hell breaks loose? Moreover, is Usato even ready for war?

1.title: EN - The Wrong Way to Use Healing Magic [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - A Night of Decisions!
1.plot: Now that Usato, Kazuki, and Suzune all know that war is upon them, they must each steel themselves to face the battle ahead—because the invasion is coming, ready or not!

1.title: EN - The Wrong Way to Use Healing Magic [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Battalion Commander Rose
1.plot: A look back into Rose's past as a new battalion commander and her relationship with her old team. Just who were they? And where did things go wrong...?

1.title: EN - The Wrong Way to Use Healing Magic [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - The End and the Beginning
1.plot: Resolve bridges Rose's tragic past into her future as she and the rest of the Rescue Team make their way to the battlefield where they're fated to cross with the demons.

1.title: EN - The Wrong Way to Use Healing Magic [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Unhinged?! The Black Knight Appears!
1.plot: Usato, Kazuki, and Suzune finally set foot on their first battlefield. The conflict is harrowing enough as it is for all of them, but reports of a terrifying foe among the demon army have Usato in particular shaking in his boots...

1.title: EN - The Wrong Way to Use Healing Magic [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Wham! Ultimate Healing Punch!
1.plot: Usato's first battle quickly turns into a waking nightmare when he realizes his friends are tangling with their fated foe, the Black Knight. Can he make it in time to save them?

1.title: EN - The Wrong Way to Use Healing Magic [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - The True Face of the Black Knight!
1.plot: Now that Usato's first clash with the Demon Lord's army is over, he's going to have to deal with the aftermath—including a prisoner of war.

1.title: EN - The Wrong Way to Use Healing Magic [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - The Journey Begins!
1.plot: With Usato's first battle behind him, it's time to face the path ahead. He receives a special diplomatic quest from the king as well as a personal request from the mysterious fox girl, both of which will take him on a winding journey to new lands.

meta.plot: Making up for her sins in a past life as the evil princess Elise, Aoi Takamoto dedicates her life to saving people as a doctor. But a fatal accident cuts her atonement short, and suddenly, she's back to her previous life, 10 years before her death! Will her foresight and medical brilliance help her change her past ways and heal an ailing empire, or is fate doomed to repeat itself?

1.title: EN - Anthracite  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Still on Fire
1.plot: Convinced that her missing dad is in danger, Ida follows his trail to a town in the French Alps. A second disappearance brings an old case to light.

1.title: EN - Anthracite  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The 13th Disciple
1.plot: As Ida and Jaro look to old VHS tapes for clues, a suspicious Giovanna visits the Arcacia lab. Trouble brews ahead of the annual festival of Lévionna.

1.title: EN - Anthracite  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Trust No One
1.plot: Gio and Ida find common ground as they explore hidden mountain terrain. Jaro and Roméo seek out a recluse who may know the truth about Roxane Vial.

1.title: EN - Anthracite  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Levia Borelis
1.plot: Gio's theories create cracks in her marriage. Ida tries to make sense of DNA tests as Jaro and Roméo visit a psychiatric hospital in a state of chaos.

1.title: EN - Anthracite  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - A Darker Shadow
1.plot: Jaro and Gio pair up after her son makes a disturbing discovery in the mines. Roméo is the guest of honor at a tense dinner with Hari and his mother.

1.title: EN - Anthracite  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Point of Equilibrium
1.plot: As terror ensues inside the mine, a riot breaks out at the Arcacia lab. Gio desperately attempts to locate the group in the tunnel before it's too late.

meta.plot: The four Yuzuki brothers—Hayato, Mikoto, Minato, and young Gakuto—lost their parents two years ago and now work to raise themselves. Together they live, learn, fight, and forgive as brothers should.

1.title: EN - The Yuzuki Family's Four Sons [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Yuzuki's House
1.plot: The Yuzuki brothers, consisting of the eldest son, Hayato; the second son, Mikoto; the third son, Minato; and the youngest, Gakuto, have been living together since they lost their parents two years ago.

1.title: EN - The Yuzuki Family's Four Sons [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Minato and Mikoto
EN - The Yuzuki Family's Four Sons [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Something's Bothering Gakuto
EN - The Yuzuki Family's Four Sons [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Hayato's Happiness
EN - The Yuzuki Family's Four Sons [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Uta's Love
EN - The Yuzuki Family's Four Sons [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Outcome of Uta's Love
EN - The Yuzuki Family's Four Sons [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Minato's Encounter
1.plot: Minato first met his best friend Uta when they were elementary school students. Uta, who moved next to the Yuzuki family, responded coldly to Minato and Mikoto. Determined to become friends with Uta no matter what, Minato enthusiastically keeps inviting them to play, but...

1.title: EN - The Yuzuki Family's Four Sons [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Gakuto's Secret
1.plot: A class observation day was scheduled to be held in Gaku's class. However, Gaku was worried that if Hayato took a day off to attend, it would cause inconvenience at his workplace and increase his workload.

1.title: EN - The Yuzuki Family's Four Sons [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Classroom Visitation
1.plot: Gakuto is keeping his class observation day from Hayato by using a stand-in.

1.title: EN - The Yuzuki Family's Four Sons [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Mikoto and His Little Brothers
1.plot: The Yuzuki family's four brothers cherish each other deeply. Among them, the second son, Mikoto, dotes on Minato, the third son, while Minato, in turn, adores Gakuto, the youngest.

1.title: EN - The Yuzuki Family's Four Sons [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Hayato Catches a Cold
1.plot: Hayato catches a cold. Mikoto, Minato, and Gakuto are eager to care for Hayato and handle the household chores. Even when they run into the Kirishima family on their way to a trip, they keep Hayato's condition a secret, not wanting to worry them before their vacation.

1.title: EN - The Yuzuki Family's Four Sons [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - The Day-to-Day Lives of the Yuzuki Brothers
1.plot: Gakuto won a diary. Wondering what to write as the entry, Mikoto mentions, "You can also write about your thoughts and feelings." Encouraged by this, Gakuto chronicles the daily happenings in the Yuzuki household...

meta.plot: Within the shadows of Japan, a covert battle wages on. Around 200,000 ninjas still exist carrying out deadly missions as a secret organization, National Intelligence of NINJA, or NIN. But a challenger arises: UNDER NINJA. Known as UN, these ninjas oppose NIN at every turn. One such UN is Kuro, a high school loner sent to the front lines. What will be his fate and which faction will prevail?

1.title: EN - UNDER NINJA [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Throw a Rock, Hit a Ninja
1.plot: Kumogakure Kuro is a modern day ninja, but that doesn't mean his life is exciting. Bereft of any missions for a long time, he's an underachiever whiling away his days in obscurity, until he receives a special delivery.

1.title: EN - UNDER NINJA [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - I Want to Be a Ninja
1.plot: Kuro's been assigned a mission to infiltrate Kodan High School, but while waiting for his enrollment to finish, he's tasked with confronting a mysterious assailant with a very particular target.

1.title: EN - UNDER NINJA [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Boobs: So Close, Yet So Far
1.plot: Kuro sets a trap and catches a high school boy named Eita. Upon returning home Eita encounters Junna who wants to borrow his drone. Eita agrees to let her if she can find the blond foreigner.

1.title: EN - UNDER NINJA [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Do You Know What the Ninja Code Says?
1.plot: The confrontation between the Foreigner, Suzuki and Hibi continues. Junna's stepfather arrives at the location of the conflict and begins to yell at her for being outside. Then the Foreigner attacks him.

1.title: EN - UNDER NINJA [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Kumogakure Is Within the Top 10 Common Family Names in Japan (Lying)
1.plot: Kuro goes to take his placement tests for school where he meets Noguchi who is there for extra lessons. After the tests Kuro and Noguchi walk home together and Kuro introduces her to Kawado.

1.title: EN - UNDER NINJA [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Lid on This Hellish Cauldron Has Come Off
1.plot: After coming to Eita's aid in a conflict with some school delinquents, Kuro makes his way to the school's boiler room where he confronts the director. Later on the defeated Noheji requests Kuro's aid in fighting some students from Yankii High.

1.title: EN - UNDER NINJA [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Meow Meow, Meow Meow, Meow Meow Meow Meow Meow?
1.plot: After the lady at the convenience store is attacked by an invisible individual and killed, an Emergency Shinobi Notice is sent out and an investigation is launched in an effort to ascertain the identity of the culprit.

1.title: EN - UNDER NINJA [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Every Last Ninja on the Surface Will Be Annihilated
1.plot: Kuro scares Noguchi after sneaking into her room to tell her not to go to school. Yoshida recounts his history of being a writer and how it was influenced by various ninja.

1.title: EN - UNDER NINJA [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - I'm Gonna Go Down in Shinobi History
1.plot: Ranran finishes her analysis of the UN's invisibility suit and sends her findings to Kato. Saruta begins his attack on the school and starts cutting down the students and faculty.

1.title: EN - UNDER NINJA [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - A Maiden's Chest Is a Precious Thing
EN - UNDER NINJA [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Kuro Finally Took Up a Sword
1.plot: Hibi loses his fight to Yamada and now it's time for Kuro to step up to the plate. Noguchi encounters Sato and Suzuki while following orders from the Director and he leads them into a secret underground facility formerly run by the Japanese army.

1.title: EN - UNDER NINJA [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Business as Usual, Wrapped Up Tidy
1.plot: The battles at the schools reach their climax. When all is said and done who will be left standing and what will be the outcome?

meta.plot: After a rebellion overthrows the Tearmoon Empire, Princess Mia meets her demise by guillotine at just 20 years old. She awakens eight years in the past, given a second chance at life. Haunted by her memory of the guillotine, the princess sets out to rebuild the empire and prevent a return to fate. Can the selfish princess learn to be a selfless leader, even though she’s trying to save herself?

1.title: EN - Tearmoon Empire [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Princess Starting From the Chopping Block
1.plot: The Tearmoon Empire is ravaged by revolution; its imperial family deposed, imprisoned, and executed. After years of squalid imprisonment, Princess Mia meets her fate at the guillotine. She reawakens in her twelve-year-old body with a mysterious journal.

1.title: EN - Tearmoon Empire [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Princess Mia Displays Her Smug Face
1.plot: Seeking desperately to avoid a gruesome fate, Mia begins seeking allies to help her alleviate the problems that tear the empire apart in the future. To do so, she seeks out a dour four-eyed nerd mentioned in the mysterious journal.

1.title: EN - Tearmoon Empire [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Princess Mia Sows Seeds
1.plot: Princess Mia has arrived at the prestigious Saint Noel Academy. Still desperate to avoid the guillotine, she decides to avoid individuals that might contribute to that fate. However, her reputation precedes her, piquing the curiosity of her peers.

1.title: EN - Tearmoon Empire [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Shall We Dance?
1.plot: The ball is upon her, and Princess Mia's preparations have gone swimmingly. However, her dress and makeup unexpectedly being ruined completely throws off her plans. One of the nobles falls victim to an imperial kidnapping plot.

1.title: EN - Tearmoon Empire [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Princess Mia Swoons
1.plot: Ever vigilant to find new means of self-preservation, Princess Mia joins the equestrian club. As the academy's sword fighting tournament approaches, Mia finds herself wrapped up in a student tradition. She needs all the help she can get with it.

1.title: EN - Tearmoon Empire [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Sword Fighting Tournament: Prince Abel's Fight
1.plot: Keithwood rushes to prevent Mia, Chloe, Tiona, and their attendants from ruining lunch with their blatant incompetence. Then, as the tournament approaches, Prince Abel finds himself facing opponents he's desperate to overcome to prove his worth.

1.title: EN - Tearmoon Empire [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Princess Mia Sees Clearly
1.plot: Back home during a school break, Mia refocuses her efforts on the Tearmoon Empire's issues within its borders. She uses her school connections to procure resources and does everything in her power to avoid an upcoming conflict.

1.title: EN - Tearmoon Empire [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Princess Mia Grins Slyly
1.plot: Princess Mia returns to the forest with Dion to recover her hairpin and finds herself thrust into negotiations with the chief of the Lulus. Afterwards, she takes steps to properly secure the support of the Ruldovon family.

1.title: EN - Tearmoon Empire [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Princess Mia's (Love-Focused) Choice
1.plot: Princess Mia's excitement to be back at Saint Noel Academy is cut short when word of a revolution in the Kingdom of Remno reaches her and her classmates. Concerned for Prince Abel, Mia and her friends plan to sneak into Remno to look for him.

1.title: EN - Tearmoon Empire [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Princess Mia Is Kidnapped!
1.plot: As Princess Mia and Prince Sion move to rendezvous with their friends, Mia is kidnapped and separated from her last ally. While in revolutionary custody, she'll find a new ally and learn that things may not be as they seem with Remno's rebels.

1.title: EN - Tearmoon Empire [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - A Reunion, a Duel, and...
1.plot: Mia and Sion finally reunite with Prince Abel. However, the circumstances are far from happy as Sion quickly challenges Abel to a duel for his loyalty to an oppressive royal authority! Will Mia's pleas be enough to prevent bloodshed?

1.title: EN - Tearmoon Empire [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - To Keep What Was Preciously Grown From Withering
1.plot: Keithwood reveals that the Wind Crows are to blame for the unrest in Remno. Everyone assesses the situation and assaults the location where Count Dasayev Donovan is being held. The growth and faults of those present are tested in a final confrontation.

meta.plot: After the party of heroes defeated the Demon King, they restored peace to the land and returned to lives of solitude. Generations pass, and the elven mage Frieren comes face to face with humanity’s mortality. She takes on a new apprentice and promises to fulfill old friends’ dying wishes. Can an elven mind make peace with the nature of life and death? Frieren embarks on her quest to find out.

1.title: EN - Frieren: Beyond Journey's End [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Journey's End
1.plot: The world celebrates the Demon King's defeat at the hands of the Hero and his companions. Now that their great adventure is over, what will Frieren the mage do next?

1.title: EN - Frieren: Beyond Journey's End [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - It Didn't Have to Be Magic...
1.plot: Frieren instructs Fern in the use of magic while deciphering a grimoire for Heiter.

1.title: EN - Frieren: Beyond Journey's End [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Killing Magic
1.plot: While retracing the path she took on her adventure with her former traveling companions, Frieren confronts an old enemy.

1.title: EN - Frieren: Beyond Journey's End [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Land Where Souls Rest
1.plot: Frieren and Fern pay a visit to Eisen, who requests their help in finding the notes of Flamme the Legendary Mage.

1.title: EN - Frieren: Beyond Journey's End [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Phantoms of the Dead
1.plot: Frieren and Fern investigate ghost sightings at a village where people have started going missing.

1.title: EN - Frieren: Beyond Journey's End [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Hero of the Village
1.plot: Frieren and Fern enlist Stark's help to fight the solar dragon - but is he up to the task?

1.title: EN - Frieren: Beyond Journey's End [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Like a Fairy Tale
1.plot: After reflecting on the transient nature of the past as it exists in people's collective memories, Frieren unexpectedly runs into a sworn enemy.

1.title: EN - Frieren: Beyond Journey's End [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Frieren the Slayer
1.plot: As tensions in Graf Granat's domain reach a breaking point, Fern and Stark find their own resolve - and Frieren resumes an old duty.

1.title: EN - Frieren: Beyond Journey's End [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Aura the Guillotine
1.plot: While Fern and Stark make a temporary retreat with Graf Granat, Frieren's true foe awaits her outside the city.

1.title: EN - Frieren: Beyond Journey's End [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - A Powerful Mage
1.plot: Frieren's many years of training under her teacher Flamme are tested in her confrontation with Aura the Guillotine. Will Aura's scales find her wanting?

1.title: EN - Frieren: Beyond Journey's End [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Winter in the Northern Lands
1.plot: Frieren and her companions continue their journey through the northern lands, but obstacles both natural and manmade still stand in their way.

1.title: EN - Frieren: Beyond Journey's End [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - A Real Hero
1.plot: Deep in the mountains of the northern lands, Frieren and her party arrive at the Village of the Sword, where they have another job to do.

1.title: EN - Frieren: Beyond Journey's End [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - Aversion to One's Own Kind
1.plot: While passing by a village in the woods of the northern lands, Frieren and party meet Sein, a gifted priest who is nonetheless corrupt enough to give even Heiter a run for his money. But what happened in his past?

1.title: EN - Frieren: Beyond Journey's End [MULTI-SUB] - S01E14 - Privilege of the Young
1.plot: The party arrives in a large and lively town with a bustling shopping district that Frieren once visited with Himmel, but something seems to have come up between Fern and Stark.

1.title: EN - Frieren: Beyond Journey's End [MULTI-SUB] - S01E15 - Smells Like Trouble
1.plot: When the party happens upon a town whose inhabitants are all mysteriously asleep, it's time for their newest traveling companion to prove his mettle.

1.title: EN - Frieren: Beyond Journey's End [MULTI-SUB] - S01E16 - Long-Lived Friends
1.plot: Frieren pays a visit to Old Man Voll, a long-lived friend of hers, with traveling companions in tow.

1.title: EN - Frieren: Beyond Journey's End [MULTI-SUB] - S01E17 - Take Care
1.plot: Now that Sein finally has a lead on the whereabouts of his long-lost friend, is it time for him and Frieren's party to part ways?

1.title: EN - Frieren: Beyond Journey's End [MULTI-SUB] - S01E18 - First-Class Mage Exam
1.plot: Frieren and party finally arrive in Äußerst, ready to undergo the first-class mage exam, and meet a number of colorful characters who are there to do the same.

1.title: EN - Frieren: Beyond Journey's End [MULTI-SUB] - S01E19 - Well-Laid Plans
1.plot: Frieren and her new teammates hatch a plan to capture a Stille - but are the other teams just going to stand by and let it happen?

1.title: EN - Frieren: Beyond Journey's End [MULTI-SUB] - S01E20 - Necessary Killing
1.plot: The first-class mage exam intensifies as fighting breaks out between the participants - and what's at stake might even be worth killing for.

1.title: EN - Frieren: Beyond Journey's End [MULTI-SUB] - S01E21 - The World of Magic
1.plot: Frieren, Kanne, and Lawine struggle with the 13th party over possession of the Stille, but there'll be more surprises in store before their battle, and the first test, reach their conclusion.

1.title: EN - Frieren: Beyond Journey's End [MULTI-SUB] - S01E22 - Future Enemies
1.plot: After the conclusion of the first test, the exam participants have some time to kill in town. What do mages get up to on their days off?

1.title: EN - Frieren: Beyond Journey's End [MULTI-SUB] - S01E23 - Conquering the Labyrinth
1.plot: The aspiring first-class mages now face their second test: conquering the Ruins of the King's Tomb. A simple task, or so the proctor claims, but there's a reason this particular dungeon remains unexplored.

1.title: EN - Frieren: Beyond Journey's End [MULTI-SUB] - S01E24 - Perfect Replicas
1.plot: Due to the Spiegel, a legendary monster that can create perfect replicas of others, the test-takers who would conquer the Ruins of the King's Tomb must first face the ultimate enemy: themselves.

1.title: EN - Frieren: Beyond Journey's End [MULTI-SUB] - S01E25 - A Fatal Vulnerability
1.plot: A perfect imitation of Frieren stands between the test-takers and victory, but Fern believes she knows how to win. Is it time for the student to surpass the master?

1.title: EN - Frieren: Beyond Journey's End [MULTI-SUB] - S01E26 - The Height of Magic
1.plot: To defeat Spiegel, Frieren and Fern fight against Frieren's replica, but have a tough time. Meanwhile, Denken, Lavine, and the others fight against the replicas, but the magic of Sense, a first-class mage and the exam's proctor, rages.

1.title: EN - Frieren: Beyond Journey's End [MULTI-SUB] - S01E27 - An Era of Humans
1.plot: With the second test behind them, only one remains - but first, Frieren and Fern need to settle an important matter in town. What awaits them in the third test?

1.title: EN - Frieren: Beyond Journey's End [MULTI-SUB] - S01E28 - It Would Be Embarrassing When We Met Again
1.plot: As the first-class mage exam concludes and the test-takers go their separate ways, farewell leads to departure - but the next stage of Frieren's journey has only just begun.

meta.plot: A coming-of-age story about an outsider who, against all odds and numerous challenges, fights for love and acceptance and for her place in the world. The series centers on a young orphaned girl in the late 1890’s, who, after an abusive childhood spent in orphanages and the homes of strangers, is mistakenly sent to live with an elderly woman and her aging brother. Over time, 13-year-old Anne will transform their lives and eventually the small town in which they live with her unique spirit, fierce intellect and brilliant imagination.

1.title: EN - Anne with an E [Multi-Sub] - S01E01 - Your Will Shall Decide Your Destiny
1.plot: When a miscommunication brings a girl to Green Gables instead of a boy, Marilla and Matthew are faced with a life-changing decision.

1.title: EN - Anne with an E [Multi-Sub] - S01E02 - I Am No Bird, and No Net Ensnares Me
1.plot: Hoping all is not lost, Matthew races to catch up with Anne while Marilla anxiously hopes and waits for their return to Green Gables.

1.title: EN - Anne with an E [Multi-Sub] - S01E03 - But What Is So Headstrong as Youth?
1.plot: Anne is excited to begin school and make friends, but is unprepared for the bullying that occurs when she doesn’t fit in. Marilla accepts an invitation for a group.

1.title: EN - Anne with an E [Multi-Sub] - S01E04 - An Inward Treasure Born
1.plot: Anne is faced with the decision of whether or not to return to school. A fire at the Gillis house and Anne’s generous actions help her in her choice.

1.title: EN - Anne with an E [Multi-Sub] - S01E05 - Tightly Knotted to a Similar String
1.plot: Anne must deal with the inevitability of womanhood when she gets her first period. At the same time, Marilla and Matthew acclimatize to parenthood and revisit moments of their youth through Anne.

1.title: EN - Anne with an E [Multi-Sub] - S01E06 - Remorse Is the Poison of Life
1.plot: When her little sister becomes ill, Diana runs to Anne for help. Meanwhile, the Blythe farm sees change, as Marilla is reminded of what she gave up and Matthew receives some unsettling news.

1.title: EN - Anne with an E [Multi-Sub] - S01E07 - Wherever You Are Is My Home
1.plot: On the verge of losing the farm, the Cuthberts must do whatever it takes to save it. Anne is reminded of the strength of friendship and love. Season finale.

2.title: EN - Anne with an E [Multi-Sub] - S02E01 - Youth is the Season of Hope
2.plot: The Cuthberts' boarders stir excitement with a question: Could there be gold in Avonlea? Elsewhere, Gilbert makes a new friend at sea.

2.title: EN - Anne with an E [Multi-Sub] - S02E02 - Signs are Small Measurable Things, but Interpretations are Illimitable
2.plot: The steamer lands in Trinidad, bringing Bash face to face with his past. The Barrys get behind the gold rush, but Matthew and Marilla aren't so sure.

2.title: EN - Anne with an E [Multi-Sub] - S02E03 - The True Seeing is Within
2.plot: An adventure away with the Barrys teaches Anne to trust her instincts. Marilla begins to suspect that her boarders aren’t as innocent as they seem.

2.title: EN - Anne with an E [Multi-Sub] - S02E04 - The Painful Eagerness of Unfed Hope
2.plot: Anne writes letters as an "agent of romance" while Diana trains at home to be a lady. A life-changing encounter steers Gilbert toward his destiny.

2.title: EN - Anne with an E [Multi-Sub] - S02E05 - The Determining Acts of Her Life
2.plot: A game of spin the bottle prompts burning questions about love and beauty. Anne and Cole bond over their differences as Gilbert makes his way home.

2.title: EN - Anne with an E [Multi-Sub] - S02E06 - I Protest Against Any Absolute Conclusion
2.plot: Anne faces the world with a shocking new look while the town preps for its annual Christmas pantomime. Gilbert and Bash join the Cuthberts for dinner.

2.title: EN - Anne with an E [Multi-Sub] - S02E07 - Memory Has as Many Moods as the Temper
2.plot: Cole accompanies the girls to Aunt Josephine's for a lavish party filled with surprises. Back at home, Marilla's health takes a worrisome turn.

2.title: EN - Anne with an E [Multi-Sub] - S02E08 - Struggling Against the Perception of Facts
2.plot: With a wedding on the horizon, Anne wonders what kind of bride she'd like to be. Marilla sees an oculist, and Bash meets a friendly face in "The Bog."

2.title: EN - Anne with an E [Multi-Sub] - S02E09 - What We Have Been Makes Us What We Are
2.plot: A brand-new teacher brings unconventional methods -- and a motorbike -- to Avonlea. Gilbert's plan to speed up his studies leaves Bash feeling lost.

2.title: EN - Anne with an E [Multi-Sub] - S02E10 - The Growing Good of the World
2.plot: Anne rallies her friends to save Miss Stacy in the wake of a disastrous incident. Bash gets an unexpected gift, and Cole makes a surprising choice.

3.title: EN - Anne with an E [Multi-Sub] - S03E01 - A Secret Which I Desired to Divine
3.plot: Anne's 16th birthday inspires her to learn more about her genealogy. Meanwhile, the school kids prepare for the Queen's entrance exams, leaving Diana isolated.

3.title: EN - Anne with an E [Multi-Sub] - S03E02 - There is Something at Work in My Soul Which I Do Not Understand
3.plot: Anne's search takes her back to the orphanage, where she's forced to confront new realities while Elijah pays a visit to Avonlea.

3.title: EN - Anne with an E [Multi-Sub] - S03E03 - What Can Stop the Determined Heart
3.plot: As Easter approaches, Mary's illness brings change to Avonlea. An Indian Affairs agent brings news that changes Ka'kwet's life.

3.title: EN - Anne with an E [Multi-Sub] - S03E04 - A Hope of Meeting You in Another World
3.plot: Ka'kwet travels to school, while Anne embarks on the next phase of her quest. Diana pushes back against her parent's wishes resulting in an unforeseen adventure.

3.title: EN - Anne with an E [Multi-Sub] - S03E05 - I Am Fearless and Therefore Powerful
3.plot: A dance rehearsal generates sparks -- and tension. A field trip to the woods opens new horizons for Gilbert. Bash seeks help from an unexpected source.

3.title: EN - Anne with an E [Multi-Sub] - S03E06 - The Summit of My Desires
3.plot: Avonlea hosts the Island County Fair, which brings romance, heartbreak, competition, and disaster. Matthew goes head to head with an old friend, while Jerry seizes a unique opportunity and Anne seeks the advice of a fortune teller. The barn dance brings a devastating incident to light and compels Anne to take bold action.

3.title: EN - Anne with an E [Multi-Sub] - S03E07 - A Strong Effort of the Spirit of Good
3.plot: Anne rallies the town to speak out against injustice. Josie makes a brave decision. A secret comes to light, causing a rift between Anne and Diana. Miss Stacy and the kids raise the ire of the School’s Board of Directors, to disastrous results.

3.title: EN - Anne with an E [Multi-Sub] - S03E08 - Great and Sudden Change
3.plot: The students sit for the Queen's entrance exams. Ka’kwet hatches a plan. Aunt Josephine visits and brings a devious scheme. Gilbert is given an opportunity he never could have dreamed of. A new arrival in Avonlea tests Bash’s patience.

3.title: EN - Anne with an E [Multi-Sub] - S03E09 - A Dense and Frightful Darkness
3.plot: After a shocking act of violence, Oqwatnuk and Aluk call upon the Cuthberts for help. Anne is forced to confront harsh truths. Gilbert makes a decision about his future.

3.title: EN - Anne with an E [Multi-Sub] - S03E10 - The Better Feeling of My Heart
3.plot: As the students prepare to depart for Queen’s College, Gilbert takes a final chance. Marilla intervenes on Diana’s behalf. Anne embraces her future but finds that change also brings loss. Elijah returns to Avonlea. Anne has a fateful encounter in Charlottetown. Series finale.

meta.plot: When one of a group of friends downloads the mysterious Red Rose app, plans change. What starts innocently as a game of admiration rapidly descends into something much darker.

1.title: EN - Red Rose [MULTI SUB] - S01E01 - It's Grim Up North
1.plot: Summer stretches out in front of a group of teenage mates from Bolton. But when one of them downloads a mysterious app called Red Rose, their plans change.

1.title: EN - Red Rose [MULTI SUB] - S01E02 - The Garden
1.plot: Red Rose digs deeper, manipulating and isolating, demonstrating its power.

1.title: EN - Red Rose [MULTI SUB] - S01E03 - Scapegoat
1.plot: It feels like history is repeating itself. But how do you resist something when it’s turning not only your friends but the town itself against you?

1.title: EN - Red Rose [MULTI SUB] - S01E04 - Manchester Innit
1.plot: Away from Bolton, the friends are surprised by what they find. But the more they understand, the wider Red Rose casts its net.

1.title: EN - Red Rose [MULTI SUB] - S01E05 - Lockdown
1.plot: Time is running out, so the gang change tack. Red Rose has other plans – and shows them there’s no escape.

1.title: EN - Red Rose [MULTI SUB] - S01E06 - Results Day
1.plot: Dawn turns to dusk, as secrets threaten to shatter an already fractured group, pushed to the limit.

1.title: EN - Red Rose [MULTI SUB] - S01E07 - I Heart BLTN
1.plot: The endgame is in sight, but together or apart, they’re all under threat.

1.title: EN - Red Rose [MULTI SUB] - S01E08 - The Gardener
1.plot: As the gang finally get close to the heart of Red Rose, they face a dilemma they could never have imagined. How much more will they have to sacrifice to destroy it? And to what extent will they triumph over, or succumb to, their own personal demons? Can something like Red Rose truly be destroyed…?

meta.plot: The boy's name was Hitori. A stork brought the angel into the lives of a middle-aged couple who were not blessed with children. His parents were kind, his house spacious, and his meals hot. But to protect the happiness he had received, Hitori continued to hide an important secret from his parents.

1.title: EN - Migi&Dali [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Migi and Dali
1.plot:
The twin boys Migi and Dali live in an orphanage until one day they are adopted by a wealthy and gentle elderly couple, the Sonoyamas.

However, they are not taken in as the two boys 'Migi' and 'Dali,' but rather as a single boy named 'Hitori Sonoyama.' While hiding their true identities and pretending to be Hitori Sonoyama, they hatch a plan to win over the Sonoyamas.

Their scheme is highly successful; within just a day, they won the favor of the elderly couple. Inside the tent in their room, the two share a sly smile.

1.title: EN - Migi&Dali [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Welcome Party
1.plot:
Migi and Dali have been fully accepted as members of the Sonoyama family.

They behave just like real parent and child, but the twins notice that Mom and Dad are acting somewhat distant.

Suspecting that the Sonoyama couple might be hiding something, the two discreetly begin to search the house and stumble upon an unexpected secret of the couple.

Migi and Dali are shocked, wondering if they have been deceived. However, determined not to let things end this way, they execute a plan to retaliate against the Sonoyamas.

1.title: EN - Migi&Dali [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Let's make friends
1.plot:
To uncover the truth behind their mother's death, Migi and Dali finally begin to take serious action.

Their clue is the memory of the room they lived in with their mother when they were young. They remember the dimly lit space under the bed and the wallpaper patterned wih daphnia.

In order to locate the room, the twins come up with a plan to be invited over as friends to different houses.

They promptly join the Boy Scouts to make friends, but the scouts offer their friendship on one condition.

1.title: EN - Migi&Dali [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Be a good student
1.plot: The housemaid Micchan tells Migi and Dali that the Ichijo family has a room with water flea wallpaper. They begin attending school to befriend Eiji, the son of the Ichijo family. However, to get close to Eiji, they need to score well on tests and join a top class. The two start studying diligently to boost their grades, but unexpectedly, Migi falls head over heels for a certain female student in the library.

1.title: EN - Migi&Dali [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Water Flea's Song
1.plot: After achieving first place in the test, the Sonoyama family was invited to the suspicious Ichijo residence. Dali, seeing this as an opportunity, thoroughly searches the Ichijo house. However, she falls into Eiji's trap, and Migi ends up being captured.

1.title: EN - Migi&Dali [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Who Killed the Parent Bird?
1.plot: Dali continues to search the Ichijo house. Migi, by perfectly playing the role of an infant, tries to draw out the secrets of the Ichijo family.

1.title: EN - Migi&Dali [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - It Wasn't a Ghost
1.plot: "It was Eiji who killed our mother!?" To confirm the truth, Dali disguises herself as Sali and begins to approach Eiji alone.

1.title: EN - Migi&Dali [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Two ≠ One
1.plot: Shocked to discover that Sali's true identity was Dali, Migi flees to Akiyama's house to escape. Dali comes to bring Migi back for revenge, but Migi decides to live freely, not bound by revenge.

1.title: EN - Migi&Dali [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Kill Kill Kill Kill Kill
EN - Migi&Dali [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Beavers vs Mother Ichijo
1.plot: Framed as murderers by Reiko, Migi and Dali find themselves unable to reveal themselves and decide to seek help from Akiyama.

1.title: EN - Migi&Dali [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Upside-Down Woman
1.plot: Reiko, cornered by Migi and Dali, finally begins to speak about Metry, the mother of Migi and Dali. It turns out to be the story of their birth as well...

1.title: EN - Migi&Dali [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Our Revenge
1.plot: Migi and Dali, along with others, are trapped in a confinement room. Gradually, smoke from the fire started by Eiji begins to drift into the room.

1.title: EN - Migi&Dali [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - Migi and Dali
1.plot: The Ichijo house was burned down, and the incident was resolved, gradually bringing life back to normal. Migi and Dali were supposed to return to their usual lives as well, but there was one difference.

meta.plot: Ashiya has spent the first seven days of high school stuck in the infirmary because of a youkai attaching itself to him. He ends up asking the owner of a small tea room called the "Mononokean" for help. This is a tale involving the very morose owner of Mononokean guiding the youkai that happened to wander into this world go to the next world.

1.title: EN - The Morose Mononokean [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Beginning
1.plot: The day before he begins attending high school, Ashiya Hanae becomes possessed by a strange fuzzy yokai. Being possessed causes him to fall ill, and while spending the start of his high school life repeatedly making trips to the nurse's office, he comes across the contact information of the Mononokean, which specializes in exorcising yokai, and decides to call them. When Ashiya finally visits the Mononokean, he meets the morose master Abeno Haruitsuki.

1.title: EN - The Morose Mononokean [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The Ant
1.plot: When Ashiya begins working part time at the Mononokean, the master Abeno impresses upon him that he should pretend not to see any yokai other than the Mononokean's clients. However, the kind-hearted Ashiya is unable to keep his word, and the yokai won't leave him alone. Based on their surprising strength and numbers, Abeno believes there must be a powerful demon serving as their leader.

1.title: EN - The Morose Mononokean [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Zenko
1.plot: After making friends with his classmates Saga and Fushimi, Ashiya believes the high school life he dreamed of may finally be his. But before he has the chance to enjoy his new life, he's instructed to go to a certain temple alone to find and return a yokai's lost possession. At the temple, Ashiya meets a girl named Fujiwara Zenko, and it seems the lost possession in question has something to do with Zenko's father, the head priest...

1.title: EN - The Morose Mononokean [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Underworld
1.plot: When Ashiya hears that Abeno will be going to a pharmacist called the “Kiyakudo” in the Underworld, he asks to go with him. Though Abeno is reluctant to bring a human to the Underworld, he relents when the Mononokean suggests that Ashiya accompany him. Concerned for Ashiya, Abeno forbids him to travel in the Underworld alone, but Ashiya finds himself unable to keep his word again...

1.title: EN - The Morose Mononokean [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Legislative Lake
1.plot: The Legislator, one of three influential figures of the Underworld, issues a rule that Abeno must bring Ashiya to see him. Unable to defy the Legislator's rules, Abeno is forced to pay a visit to him with Ashiya in tow. As Abeno hired Ashiya without informing the Legislator, he now seeks to determine for himself if Ashiya is truly worthy of being an employee of the Mononokean. What will the Legislator conclude?

1.title: EN - The Morose Mononokean [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Ring
1.plot: Abeno is hired by a certain yokai to find a human woman's missing ring and return it to her. Unable to find the ring on his own, he gets Ashiya to help him look for it. During their search, Ashiya demonstrates a surprising talent. The ring is found, but when the time comes to return the ring to the woman, Ashiya and Abeno disagree over how they should return the lost ring to the woman

1.title: EN - The Morose Mononokean [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - The Encounter
1.plot: When Ashiya and Abeno see Zenko at school again, she asks them for help with a particular yokai. Zenko was bitten by a strange dog-like animal a few days prior. However, ordinary people can't see the bite mark, and Zenko, who was previously unable to see yokai, has begun seeing strange things. While listening to her story, a fox yokai suddenly appears behind Ashiya and Abeno. The yokai appears to recognize Abeno, but Abeno doesn't recognize him at all...

1.title: EN - The Morose Mononokean [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - The Wait
1.plot: Zenko arranges for Yahiko to help around the temple while he stays with her. Ashiya is relieved, but he soon runs into another yokai. The bird yokai Jomatsu is concerned for his heartbroken mistress Princess Anmo, who withdrew into an egg shell she made and hasn't come out for a long time. Jomatsu has been searching for the Mononokean so he can return to the Underworld with Princess Anmo still inside her egg.

1.title: EN - The Morose Mononokean [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - The Marked Difference
1.plot: When Abeno is hired to exorcise a yokai by a human, he unenthusiastically heads to the client's house with Ashiya and Fuzzy. The girl who hired him is unable to see yokai but is interested in the occult and seems very interested in their work. Abeno asks Ashiya to watch the door while he works so nobody bothers him, but the girl's mother, who doesn't believe in the supernatural, begins asking Ashiya some nosy questions.

1.title: EN - The Morose Mononokean [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - The Fool
1.plot: When Ashiya and Abeno smell a yokai on the potatoes Yahiko has been sneaking, they head to the farm where they were grown. There they encounter a yokai calling himself Nobou. Nobou has been attempting to leave the farm, but each time he does, he is enveloped in a strange smoke, forced to witness the events of his past, and returns to where he started. Nobou asked to be exorcised so he can leave the farm, but Abeno notices something about the situation.

1.title: EN - The Morose Mononokean [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - The Purple Sun
1.plot: A yokai worshipped as a kami by humans and known as Okina-sama to other yokai comes to the Mononokean with a request: to send the blind yokai Tomori back to the Underworld. After hearing Okina's story, Abeno and Ashiya immediately head to see Tomori. However, upon seeing how Tomori longs to once again see the sights of the Underworld, he tries to see what he can do before Tomori is returned to the Underworld...

1.title: EN - The Morose Mononokean [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - The Separation
1.plot: Abeno visits the Legislator to inform him that Ashiya is no longer working for the Mononokean. As Abeno rarely comes to visit without his presence being requested, the curious Legislator asks why, but when he hears what Abeno has to say...? Meanwhile, Ashiya stops by the Kiyakudo when he hears from Shizuku, where he runs into the yokai Big Boss Scree, a yokai he previously exorcised, and his children. When they hear that Ashiya is in trouble...?

1.title: EN - The Morose Mononokean [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - The End
1.plot: Reunited with the yokai he and Ashiya exorcised together, Abeno realizes the Mononokean still needs Ashiya. Abeno suddenly misses him, and with the help of the yokai, he decides to give his idea a try. Meanwhile, Ashiya wonders if the reason Abeno has been absent from school so much is because he's busy exorcising yokai and decides to check out the shrine in the mountains Yahiko mentioned.

meta.plot: Ron Kamonohashi was once regarded as a genius at the top detective training academy. But after a fatal mistake, he was expelled and forbidden to become a detective. Years later, police officer Totomaru Isshiki knocks on Ron’s door seeking help on a serial murder case. He finds Ron, now a messy-haired recluse, who agrees. Together, this mismatched detective team begins solving their first mystery!

1.title: EN - Ron Kamonohashi's Forbidden Deductions [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Case of the Metropolitan Serial Drownings
1.plot: The Metropolitan Police Department is struggling to investigate a series of murders, yet Detective Isshiki is ordered to go home. Kiku of the General Affairs Division sends him to meet a certain sleuth—a shaggy-haired eccentric named Kamonohashi Ron.

1.title: EN - Ron Kamonohashi's Forbidden Deductions [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The Case of the Locked-Room Piggy Bank Theft
1.plot: Ron is excited to solve cases by using Toto, but he's not on any good ones because his boss thinks he's useless. All he gets are odd jobs and busywork. Ron, however, is quite interested in a new report about coins going missing from a piggy bank...

1.title: EN - Ron Kamonohashi's Forbidden Deductions [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - The Case of the Benizome Hot Spring Murder (1)
1.plot: Ron wins a pair of tickets to a hot spring in a raffle. Toto accompanies him to stay at the Benizome Inn. The innkeeper who greets them is friendly, but he isn't who he seems. Plus, it isn't long before Ron's eccentricities begin to surface.

1.title: EN - Ron Kamonohashi's Forbidden Deductions [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Case of the Benizome Hot Spring Murder (2)
1.plot: There has been a murder. Ron listens to the other guests' testimonies and begins his deductions. Spitz secretly rejoices at this chance to catch Ron in the act of sleuthing, but outwardly both he and Amamiya entrust the investigation to Toto.

1.title: EN - Ron Kamonohashi's Forbidden Deductions [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Case of the Hand Collector
1.plot: Kawasemi Omito, a supremely skilled detective, leads a joint investigation into a serial killing case. Amamiya lends him Toto, whom Kawasemi deems so useless he's invisible. Ron appears at the newest crime scene as a consultant, irritating Kawasemi.

1.title: EN - Ron Kamonohashi's Forbidden Deductions [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Case of the Live Broadcast Murder
1.plot: Ron loves a certain TV show that puts psychic abilities to the test. During a live broadcast, a psychic claims he can control minds with written words. His neurosurgeon opponent refutes his claims. Then, the psychic writes the word "Death" on a card.

1.title: EN - Ron Kamonohashi's Forbidden Deductions [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - The Case of the Observatory Murder (1)
1.plot: Toto and Ron are invited to a meteor shower viewing being held on Nandan Island. Also invited is John Grizzly, an instructor at BLUE. There was a murder at the observatory years ago, so the director has brought in first-rate detectives...just in case.

1.title: EN - Ron Kamonohashi's Forbidden Deductions [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - The Case of the Observatory Murder (2)
1.plot: Ron is named main suspect in a murder and Toto investigates to clear his name. Everyone but Ron has an alibi for the time of the murder, which only seems to cement his guilt, but Toto discovers a few things that cast a new light on the incident.

1.title: EN - Ron Kamonohashi's Forbidden Deductions [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - The Case of the Observatory Murder (3)
1.plot: Toto gathers everyone together and explains the truth behind the murders. With their name exposed, the culprit takes drastic measures not to be caught, but not before revealing that there's more to this incident than anyone imagined. Toto gathers everyone together and explains the truth behind the murders. With their name exposed, the culprit takes drastic measures not to be caught, but not before revealing that there's more to this incident than anyone imagined.

1.title: EN - Ron Kamonohashi's Forbidden Deductions [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - The Case of the Poisoned Latte
1.plot: Toto is shadowed by a reporter who's a huge fan of his for the way he's solved one difficult case after another. They step into a cafe where Ron happens to be working, making things a little awkward. Then, a customer collapses to the ground—poisoned!

1.title: EN - Ron Kamonohashi's Forbidden Deductions [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - The Case of the Mad Chameleon Murder
1.plot: Toto meets Kawasemi while on a business trip to Aichi. Kawasemi's been in a slump since losing Yamane, and his powers of perception have suffered. He's investigating the Mad Chameleon, who commits a crime right in front of them!

1.title: EN - Ron Kamonohashi's Forbidden Deductions [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - The Case of the Yadagami-sama Murders (1)
1.plot: Ron agrees to take on Spitz's search request in exchange for his obtaining a file on the Bloody Training Incident. Spitz accepts Ron's terms and takes Ron and Toto to Yadamura, a village in Yamanashi prefecture where his ethnologist brother disappeared.

1.title: EN - Ron Kamonohashi's Forbidden Deductions [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - The Case of the Yadagami-sama Murders (2)

meta.plot: Sōya Kuroi has dreams of people with superpowers fighting a massive dragon in the sky, but his real life is almost as weird. He's had amnesia for about two weeks and been taken in by a maid and an anthropomorphic cat. When a UFO in the shape of a stuffed bear approaches Sorimasaka City and other metros around the world, he's startled to see seven rainbow-sparkling heroes zoom out to confront it – just like in his dream. Even weirder, the maid wants him to leave his shelter to confront these heroes and take the source of their power.

1.plot: From fearsome sharks to lowly urchins, 90 percent of marine creatures live in coastal waters. Protecting these habitats is a battle humanity must win.

1.plot: The need for fresh water is as strong as ever. However, the supply is becoming increasingly unpredictable for all manner of species.

2.plot: Left to fend for themselves until they find their footing, baby sea turtles, elephant seal pups, pumas and crabs bravely trek towards adolescence.

2.plot: As snow geese, antelope, army ants and gray whales dodge predators and pollution, get a closer look at how the modern world impacts animal migration.

meta.plot: As a legendary hero nears victory against a necromancer known as The Corpse God, things take an unexpected turn with the dark sorcerer’s final gambit—reincarnation magic. This last-ditch effort catches the brave fighter off guard, and now he’s a boy named Polka Shinoyama in a whole new world! The showdown between good and evil just got epic.

1.title: EN - Dead Mount Death Play [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Reincarnation
1.plot: A legendary necromancer known as the Corpse God is finally slain by a hero—only to wake up in the body of Polka Shinoyama, a newly assassinated boy in present-day Tokyo. Can the sorcerer survive in this strange new world?

1.title: EN - Dead Mount Death Play [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The New World
1.plot: Polka scrambles to get his bearings while facing off against his would-be killer's colleagues. Is this the prelude to a new fight for survival or the start of an unlikely friendship?

1.title: EN - Dead Mount Death Play [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Mad Dog
1.plot: Polka's recent activities have caught the eye of a police unit dedicated to hunting down the most bizarre and seemingly superhuman offenders. To a peace-seeking necromancer, these cops could be worse trouble than the criminals he's fallen in with!

1.title: EN - Dead Mount Death Play [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Monster

1.title: EN - Dead Mount Death Play [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Firestarter
1.plot: Keeping his promise to a ghost, Polka returns to his family's mansion with Misaki in tow. Can the necromancer fool the people who know the real Polka best? And can he save them from an unknown threat without arousing their suspicions?

1.title: EN - Dead Mount Death Play [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - The Invaders
1.plot: Polka's magical rampage has drawn even more unwanted attention to his new home. As if thrill-seeking magicians and underworld hitmen weren't bad enough, he now has a shrewd reporter to contend with.

1.title: EN - Dead Mount Death Play [MULTI-SUB] - S01E14 - The Corpse
1.plot: Fortune telling for a reporter is interrupted by a police raid on Polka's building, and the necromancer could find himself on the wrong end of a frame-up. Does he have a new enemy, or is he caught in the crossfire between underworld power brokers?

1.title: EN - Dead Mount Death Play [MULTI-SUB] - S01E15 - The Vampire
1.plot: One group of police officers leave empty-handed, but Polka and co. can't rest easy just yet—Inspector Iwanome is back for answers. The duo who tried to frame them hasn't given up, either, and one is a face from Takumi's past.

1.title: EN - Dead Mount Death Play [MULTI-SUB] - S01E16 - The Fake
1.plot: Misaki and Xiaoyu team up to take on Momoya. But are even the two of them together a match for this gangly member of the Agakura clan? Meanwhile, Iwanome gets a phone call from his past.

1.title: EN - Dead Mount Death Play [MULTI-SUB] - S01E17 - The Matriarch
1.plot: One Agakura assassin didn't go down easy, and now the head of the clan has come to settle the score. How will Xiaoyu cope with this face from his past? And how will Iwanome and Arase cope when the Fire-Breathing Bug crashes their interrogation?

1.title: EN - Dead Mount Death Play [MULTI-SUB] - S01E18 - The Revenge
1.plot: Iwanome unmasks the traitor in the Metropolitan Police, but subduing them won't be easy—and he isn't the only one out for payback. An enigmatic new arrival may make things unexpectedly personal for the Corpse God.

1.title: EN - Dead Mount Death Play [MULTI-SUB] - S01E19 - The Friends
1.plot: A surprise visit from an old friend prompts the Corpse God to rethink how he fits into his new world. His first step? An overdue confrontation with Xiaoyu. Meanwhile, Iwanome, Clarissa, and Solitaire pursue the same mystery in their own ways.

1.title: EN - Dead Mount Death Play [MULTI-SUB] - S01E20 - The Visitors
1.plot: The mysterious Civil visits the Corpse God to have his fortune told, and the encounter surprises both of them. The necromancer draws a step closer to the traces of his old world, but are they friend or foe?

1.title: EN - Dead Mount Death Play [MULTI-SUB] - S01E21 - The Spirit
1.plot: A fight between a Shinoyama enforcer and Civil's bodyguard brings an abrupt end to the mysterious visitor's interview with the Corpse God. But will he really leave in peace? Meanwhile, Solitaire's latest scheme causes a stir.

1.title: EN - Dead Mount Death Play [MULTI-SUB] - S01E22 - The Karma
1.plot: Civil confronts Solitaire, hoping to provoke a confrontation with the Fire-Breathing Bug, but he may get his wish sooner than he planned. Meanwhile, the Corpse God plots a rescue mission.

1.title: EN - Dead Mount Death Play [MULTI-SUB] - S01E23 - The Declaration
1.plot: The day of the showdown arrives. The Corpse God and friends prepare to rescue the real Polka while other forces maneuver in the shadows. But a surprise visit from the kidnapper himself takes events in a direction no one expected.

1.title: EN - Dead Mount Death Play [MULTI-SUB] - S01E24 - The Shinjuku War
1.plot: The Corpse God prepares to sacrifice himself to stop Civil, but his new friends have other ideas. Rescuing Polka's soul and regaining any shot at a peace will take two lifetimes worth of connections.

meta.plot: When one accidental killing leads to another, an ordinary young man finds himself stuck in an endless cat-and-mouse chase with a shrewd detective.

1.title: FR - A Killer Paradox [SUB] - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Flailing at life, Lee Tang panics after he kills a man after work. Soon, Jang Nan-gam is on the case — discovering a disturbing truth about the victim.

1.title: FR - A Killer Paradox [SUB] - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: A mysterious woman approaches Tang, claiming to know his secret and begins to blackmail him. The weight of his actions starts taking a mental toll.

1.title: FR - A Killer Paradox [SUB] - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Wondering if the same killer is behind all the murders, Nan-gam probes Roh Bin for clues, leading to an unlikely partnership between the two.

1.title: FR - A Killer Paradox [SUB] - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: As Nan-gam notices a clear pattern among the recent murders, he searches for Tang — unaware of another mysterious man who is doing the same.

1.title: FR - A Killer Paradox [SUB] - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: In his search for Tang, Song Chon confronts Bin — who desperately turns to Nan-gam for help. But Tang agrees to meet with Chon, who has a proposition.

1.title: FR - A Killer Paradox [SUB] - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Nan-gam comes face to face with Chon, who recognizes him from the past. As Bin and Tang plan their final escape, Bin receives a menacing phone call.

1.title: FR - A Killer Paradox [SUB] - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: The endgame to the chase leads to a final fight — and it's everyone versus Chon. In the process, Nan-gam finally learns the truth about his father.

meta.plot: The story centers on Keitarou Gentouga, who has the ability to be a spirit medium. In junior high school, he got someone else wrapped up in a spirit possession incident, and he has been a shut-in for more than two years. As he reintroduces himself to society as a private tutor, he meets a genius girl named Yayoi Houzuki. Yayoi is instantly able to tell that Keitarou has skill as a spirit medium, and she invites him to go with her to a haunted location. The two then start their journey capturing evil spirits.

1.title: EN - Dark Gathering - S01E01 - Yayoi Hozuki
1.plot: A glamorous woman met an unglamorous end inside that phone booth. She's still in there calling for help, but one shouldn't answer her. Keitaro is about to find out why.

1.title: EN - Dark Gathering - S01E02 - Keitaro Gentoga
1.plot: Keitaro was cursed years ago and receives exorcisms at his grandmother’s shrine. She once warned him not to enter the basement; she locked them away in the dark for a reason.

1.title: EN - Dark Gathering - S01E03 - Friends
1.plot: Yayoi and Eiko head to the psychic spot Mizuko Memorial Temple which holds its own sad secrets. And what does Yayoi want with Keitaro’s fingernails?!

1.title: EN - Dark Gathering - S01E04 - Eiko Hozuki
1.plot: Keitaro had a bad feeling about the Urban Legends class at the university. His instincts were correct: the professor should never have played that cursed videotape.

1.title: EN - Dark Gathering - S01E05 - The Freshmen Welcome Event
1.plot: Keitaro was looking to make new friends. But he should avoid certain friendships; there’s a reason people warn children to never talk to strangers.

1.title: EN - Dark Gathering - S01E06 - The Promise
1.plot: Camping was to be a reprieve, but the bridge is calling, the bridge is calling, the bridge is calling, the bridge is calLING, THE BRIDGE IS CALLING, THEBRIDGEISCALL-

1.title: EN - Dark Gathering - S01E07 - S Tunnel
1.plot: The car had three passengers when it entered the tunnel. A phantom hitchhiker demanded to be the fourth. Let. Her. In.

1.title: EN - Dark Gathering - S01E08 - Betrothed to Divinity
1.plot: The girl’s eyes shine with stars, but two spectral presences haunt her future.

1.title: EN - Dark Gathering - S01E09 - Blasphemy
1.plot: Terrifying enough to be victims in life; utterly horrific they remain so in death.

1.title: EN - Dark Gathering - S01E10 - Across Japan
1.plot: One does not defy a god lightly. If Yayoi, Keitaro and Eiko wish to save Ai, they must embark on a perilous journey across a country teeming with malevolent ghosts.

1.title: EN - Dark Gathering - S01E11 - S-Rank Danger: Castle H Ruins
1.plot: No happy tales remain within the castle’s forsaken ruins. The danger is unimaginable: Yayoi and Keitaro risk their doom, prepared as they may be.

1.title: EN - Dark Gathering - S01E12 - The Castle H Ruins, Danger Rank S!
1.plot: None who have encountered the castle spirit survived to tell the tale, but both the living and the dead should fear the High Priest; it is not salvation he prays for.

1.title: EN - Dark Gathering - S01E13 - Emancipate
1.plot: The tunnel is dangerous, and they must keep the High Priest in check. It is for that reason the trio need reinforcements; they need another Graduate.

1.title: EN - Dark Gathering - S01E14 - Old F Tunnel
1.plot: Abandon all hope ye who enter here. There is nothing for anyone in this tunnel, save for the depravity of a sadistic spirit.

1.title: EN - Dark Gathering - S01E15 - Old Old F Tunnel
1.plot: The Imprisoned Martyr is dead, but he cannot die. He longs for someone to grant him the death he desperately yearns for, and the F Tunnel ghost could be one such opponent.

1.title: EN - Dark Gathering - S01E16 - House Hunting
1.plot: Eiko did not leave the tunnel unscathed. She experienced the true terror of death, and must now ask herself if her horror obsession is worth risking her life.

1.title: EN - Dark Gathering - S01E17 - The House of the Virgin Conception
1.plot: Yayoi and Eiko have found the perfect home for the Graduates, but they soon discover the dark history of the family haunting the house—as well as their plans for Eiko.

1.title: EN - Dark Gathering - S01E18 - Morning Twilight
1.plot: The god who branded Ai takes an interest in the entity that abducted Yayoi’s mother. That can only mean one thing: a dangerous threat now brews on the horizon.

1.title: EN - Dark Gathering - S01E19 - Within the Brothel
1.plot: They’ve arrived at an old love hotel to find a Graduate, but Keitaro must locate her in a hidden room while avoiding other ghosts. Dire consequences await if they catch him.

1.title: EN - Dark Gathering - S01E20 - The Old I Watergate: An Innocent Grudge
1.plot: A little boy shows Keitaro his drawings as the trio explores an old watergate with a famous spiritualist. To his growing horror, he realizes they are all in imminent danger.

1.title: EN - Dark Gathering - S01E21 - The Old I Watergate: Resplendence
1.plot: She was beautiful once, but scorn burned her soul until nothing but spiteful ashes remained. Now, her wrathful fury is the only thing that can defeat a child’s rageful grudge.

1.title: EN - Dark Gathering - S01E22 - The Old I Watergate: Pleasure District in Flames
1.plot: The trio walk a dangerous path fraught with peril. Otogiri will not return to her prison willingly, and the spirit that replaced Nagiko is still out there somewhere.

1.title: EN - Dark Gathering - S01E23 - Scary School Stories: Hide and Seek
1.plot: Children can be cruel, that much is quite clear. Poor Sakashita lost all he held dear. He plays a game now, the rule is right here: don’t let him find you or you’ll disappear.

1.title: EN - Dark Gathering - S01E24 - Scary School Stories: Nightmare
1.plot: Dorothy has a plan that Yayoi needs to know about, especially since it involves the Spectre of Death.

1.title: EN - Dark Gathering - S01E25 - Dark Gathering
1.plot: They now have 7 Graduates, but fighting a god also requires an ambitious, daring plan. With Ai’s time running out, the trio prepare for their next journey; Kyoto awaits.

1.title: EN - A Killer Paradox [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: As Nan-gam notices a clear pattern among the recent murders, he searches for Tang — unaware of another mysterious man who is doing the same.

1.title: EN - A Killer Paradox [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Episode 6
