meta.plot: Working at an agency owned by your father, seven new idols await. They are all part of an idol unit IDOLiSH7, and each of them have unique personalities. It is your task to manage them. In order to achieve the same goals, as manager and idols together, you gather the seven ununified hearts and aim for the top.

1.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - shaking your heart
1.plot: Tsumugi Takanashi is tasked with managing Takanashi Productions' newest idol group, IDOLiSH7. After meeting the seven candidates, she's instructed to hold an audition and reject four of them. How will she decide who to keep and who to cut?

1.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - First Stage
1.plot: It's time for IDOLiSH7's first concert. Confident in her abilities to promote such a promising and talented group, Tsumugi ambitiously reserves a large outdoor venue for the event. Will they be able to fill all three thousand seats?

1.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Their Feelings
1.plot: After their disatrous first concert, Iori approaches Tsumigi with some ideas for the future of the group. Meanwhile, the boys move into their dorm and begin to learn more about each other.

1.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - A Pro's Resolve
1.plot: It's the day of the TRIGGER concert, and all the boys are excited. However, Yamato, Nagi, and Tamaki are late. As they rush to meet the others at the stadium, they run into someone unexpected...

1.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Secret
1.plot: With the ban on singing and dancing lifted, the boys eagerly resume practicing and performing. However, something's not right with Riku. Iori soon discovers the nature of the secret he's been hiding, but Riku begs him not to tell the others.

1.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Triumphant Return In The Rain
1.plot: IDOLiSH7 is set to hold its second concert in the open air arena where they first failed. With a local news station coming to cover the event, everyone is excited to put on the best performance possible. However, ominous clouds are on the horizon...

1.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Ray of Light
1.plot: Sousuke Yaotome, president of Yaotome Productions, approaches Tamaki and Sougo with a tempting offer. Sougo brushes him off, but Tamaki can't seem to walk away from the deal. Is this the end of IDOLiSH7...?

1.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Please, Music
1.plot: IDOLiSH7 is asked to appear on the popular music program Music Festa. However, their exciting opportunity doesn't go exactly as planned. Will they be able to give the performance of their lives, or does disaster await?

1.plot: Sougo Osaka and Tamaki Yotsuba are set to debut with Takanashi Productions as duo "MEZZO." But first, the group goes camping by the river, where they learn more about each other and strengthen their friendships.

1.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Expanding World
1.plot:
IDOLiSH7 begins hosting a web show to promote themselves. Though the production is far from perfect, everyone seems to be enjoying it.

Meanwhile, Yamato receives an offer to appear in a TV drama...

1.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - The Direction of Summer
1.plot: Having finally gained enough popularity, Otoharu decides it's time for IDOLiSH7 to debut. He sends them to Okinawa to film the promotional video for their debut single, but once they arrive, they discover TRIGGER is also there filming...

1.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Five and Two
1.plot:
Press conferences, an album tour, and even a TV show. Things are starting to look up for IDOLiSH7.

However, with their exhaustion finally catching up to them, the future doesn't look so sunny for MEZZO"...

1.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - What Was Lost
1.plot:
While recovering in the hospital, Sougo reveals his past and reason for becoming an idol to the other members of IDOLiSH7.

Meanwhile, Tenn grows increasingly suspicious of the origins of TRIGGER's new song.

1.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E14 - That Song Once Again
1.plot: IDOLiSH7 is invited to perform on Sound Ship along with various other artists, including TRIGGER. Given TRIGGER's popularity, it's no surprise that most of the fans in the audience are here to see them. IDOLiSH7 puts on a great performance regardless, but Riku notices that TRIGGER still hasn't come to the stage...

1.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E15 - Closing Doors
1.plot: Scandalous and malicious articles about IDOLiSH7 begin popping up more and more in tabloids. Unsure of what is true and what isn't, the members begin turning on each other. Amidst rising tensions, Tamaki is asked to appear on a TV special featuring his emotional reunion with his family, but...

1.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E16 - Resolve At Zero
1.plot: As the boys reflect on their feelings towards being idols, they find themselves drawn to the same park, where they reaffirm their commitment to IDOLiSH7. Later, Nagi reveals the secret identity of the composer of IDOLiSH7's songs...

1.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E17 - making the dream
1.plot: IDOLiSH7 wins the JIMA New Artist award, which means they'll compete against TRIGGER at Black or White! Their work has earned them the attention of Douglas Rootbank, a famous American pop-rock artist. While Iori and Tamaki wait for the others to show up for their group meeting, a strange looking maintenance employee shows up...

2.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S02E01 - A New Door
2.plot: IDOLiSH7 achieves their long-held dream of having their own namesake show, and the members feel like celebrating. President Takanashi explains that Mitsuki's talent for MCing that he's been displaying on variety programs was big for the group. Mitsuki cries tears of joy over the recognition he has received. The group begins planning more jobs to promote their show, and they are soon invited onto the show of top idols Re:vale. It will be their first real appearance with their seniors Re:vale. The members wait anxiously in their greenroom, but when Momo and Yuki arrive...?!

2.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S02E02 - Wavering Feelings
2.plot: Yuki declares that he'll recommend IDOLiSH7 for the currently undecided performance slot at the Zero Arena inaugural concert. Zero Arena's general manager is scheduled to come to their next concert, so Tsumugi, who is in charge of the group's stage production, heads to Zero Arena to gather ideas. There she encounters a gentleman who claims to have worked in stage production in the past. Tsumugi's heart is moved by the way he describes his feelings towards idols standing onstage. His hints help her finish the set, and the concert begins!

2.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S02E03 - The Proposal
2.plot: Though the concert ended without incident, Riku was unable to perform in the encore due to an asthma attack. Fortunately, it doesn't affect the Zero Arena general manager's opinion of the concert, and IDOLiSH7 is officially offered an appearance at the inaugural concert. Mitsuki and Nagi are delighted, but there are reservations about whether or not the sickly Riku can continue acting as the center. Riku tries to act tough after his recovery, making Tsumugi wonder how to approach the situation. Meanwhile, she discusses a major decision with Iori.

2.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S02E04 - A New Form
2.plot: Given Riku's unstable condition, Iori takes over as IDOLiSH7's center. The newly reborn IDOLiSH7 gets off to a solid start, both their first namesake show "Lovely Night With You!" and Mitsuki's MCing are well received, and the group's popularity grows.

2.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S02E05 - The Sudden Visitor
2.plot: Tenn pays a sudden visit to the IDOLiSH7 dorms. Riku is simultaneously perplexed and delighted, but Tenn has harsh words for him. Later, Yuki, Momo, and Ryunosuke arrive. With members of IDOLiSH7, TRIGGER, and Re:vale at the dorms, the situation gets out of control...?!

2.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S02E06 - Voice
2.plot: Re:vale brings a new offer to the table: for IDOLiSH7 and TRIGGER to appear as surprise guests at Re:vale's fifth anniversary Zero Arena inaugural concert, and for the two groups to perform together as one special group.

2.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S02E07 - Discord Bleeding Through
2.plot: Mitsuki is traumatized when he happens to overhear some fans talking about him. Riku is criticized on social media by Iori's fans and begins behaving awkwardly towards him. Though Sougo is worried about the situation, he has his own concerns regarding Tamaki...

2.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S02E08 - I Want You to Know!
2.plot: While taping a music program, Momo suddenly loses the ability to sing. Unable to determine the cause, the posters for the inaugural concert are vandalized, and uneasiness hangs in the air. Meanwhile, Tsumugi decides to convey her own feelings in an attempt to cheer up Riku and the other members, who have been feeling down.

2.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S02E09 - Something Important
2.plot: IDOLiSH7 and TRIGGER begin practicing as a special unit for Re:vale's 5th anniversary concert. While many of the members are off their game, Gaku, Tenn, and Ryunosuke discuss their thoughts, and the individual groups begin to open up to each other.

2.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S02E10 - Out of Time
2.plot: Momo remains unable to sing. He recounts Re:vale's history to the concerned members of IDOLiSH7. As an indie artist, Yuki worked with a different partner, and Momo was one of their fans.

2.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S02E11 - The Place I Want to Protect
2.plot: Graffiti is written on posters for the inaugural concert. The rumor that the missing legendary idol Zero is responsible spreads. Meanwhile, IDOLiSH7 will release a new song with their second album, and Riku will return to the center position.

2.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S02E12 - Ripples
2.plot: IDOLiSH7 is accused of appropriating Zero's songs, so Takanashi Production holds a press conference. Nagi volunteers to face the press and explains that he was officially given the rights to the song by composer Haruki Sakura. However, a suspicious man dressed as Zero appears at the press conference, aggravating the scandal.

2.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S02E13 - Lies and Formality
2.plot: Filming for the drama Tamaki and Sougo are co-starring in is going well. However, Sougo continues to worry about his encounter with Tamaki's younger sister, which he hasn't been able to tell anyone about. On the final day of the special unit's joint practice, Tamaki is shocked to discover that Sougo couldn't trust him enough to tell him about Aya.

2.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S02E14 - Trigger
2.plot: Tamaki and Aya are finally reunited. Tamaki wants the two of them to live together, but Aya informs him that she wants to remain with her new father who has been taking care of her. A surprising figure appears before the dumbfounded group. When they learn of his ambition, IDOLiSH7's feelings are united--

2.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S02E15 - DiSCOVER THE FUTURE
2.plot: Re:vale prepare to close out the inaugural concert. The IDOLiSH7 and Trigger shuffle units perform the opening act. While watching their juniors perform, Momo and Yuki look back on the past five years they've walked together.

3.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S03E01 - Clouds Covering the Stars
3.plot: IDOLiSH7 is set to hold a debut anniversary tour. Along with TRIGGER and Re:vale, all three groups are attracting a lot of attention in the idol industry. Their members attend the Akebono TV 50th anniversary party.

3.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S03E02 - Unknown Scars
3.plot: Mitsuki and Nagi learn that Yamato has a secret based on his behavior at the party. Rather than being troubled by the secret itself, Nagi can't accept that Yamato is closing himself off from his friends. Yamato himself encounters his first acting wall at the filming location of his movie...

3.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S03E03 - Rifts
EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S03E04 - The Voice Within
3.plot: An argument leads Mitsuki, Yamato, and Iori to leave the dorm. Iori and Mitsuki stay at Momo's place, while Yamato stays at Yuki's. Riku and the other boys left at the dorm feel increasingly sad to see their groupmates scattered.

3.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S03E05 - Where We Belong
3.plot: All seven members of IDOLiSH7 meet for the first time in a while at the studio. The recording session goes smoothly, but the other members anxiously watch the exchange between Mitsuki and Yamato. Sougo attempts to convince them to come back to the dorm, but when they refuse, he is at a loss.

3.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S03E06 - Feelings to Convey
3.plot: Momo gets caught up in Ryo's scheme to expose Yamato's father Shizuo Chiba. When Yamato returns to the dorm, a delighted Nagi tells everyone that Yamato's first confession will be held that night, and the members of TRIGGER and Re:vale gather at the dorm.

3.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S03E07 - Contact
3.plot: The members of IDOLiSH7 cheerfully head to work. Sougo encounters Torao at the TV station. As sons whose families run major corporations, they've previously met. Meanwhile, at Iori and Tamaki's school, transfer student Haruka Isumi takes a confrontational attitude towards them.

3.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S03E08 - Our Incomplete Selves
3.plot: Banri describes how he and Yuki met to the members of IDOLiSH7 and Tsumugi. During high school, they developed an interest in each other's songs, and eventually began making music together. Yuki named the band they started together "Re:vale."

3.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S03E09 - Re:vale
3.plot: Moved by Re:vale's concert, Momo writes a fan letter describing how "Our Incomplete Selves" made him feel. Banri and Yuki are touched by the letter, which encourages them to continue making music. Five years after the formation of their band, they're approached by a man named Kujo who offers to help them debut.

3.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S03E10 - The Training Camp Begins!
3.plot: IDOLiSH7 are selected to be personalities for the 24-hour program "Friends Day" along with Re:vale and TRIGGER. On the day of the production meeting, their 24-hour training camp to write a theme song for the program suddenly begins.

3.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S03E11 - Meticulous Malice
3.plot: With Re:vale composing the music, TRIGGER designing the choreography, and IDOLiSH7 designing costumes, through the combined efforts of all three groups, they barely manage to complete a song by the morning of their 24-hour theme song production training camp. Meanwhile, Ryo meets with Haruka, Toma, Minami, and Torao in his apartment.

3.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S03E12 - Preparing to Take Over
3.plot: Thorvaldur, a man claiming to be "Nagi's otaku friend," visits the dorm. He says he's worried about the dorm's security, but Riku and the other members fail to understand his true intentions. Meanwhile, media outlets report that Ryunosuke and popular singer Sumire Hanamaki are madly in love.

3.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S03E13 - Tetrarchy of Madness and Destruction
3.plot: In order to prove Ryunosuke's innocence, Mitsuki, Nagi, and Gaku go to negotiate directly with Ryo. Yamato and Tenn attempt to persuade Sumire, but they fail to change her mind. Anesagi anxiously tells Tsumugi and Okazaki that she's concerned there's still more to come...

3.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S03E14 - Threat
3.plot: ŹOOĻ makes a spectacular debut and has taken the spotlight. Meanwhile, TRIGGER's popularity is beginning to decline due to Ryunosuke's scandal. As the disquieting atmosphere unfolds, TRIGGER shows off their powerful singing and dancing on TV, but...

3.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S03E15 - Indestructible Soul
3.plot: TRIGGER goes missing when they're scheduled to perform at the Tokyo International Music Art Festival, so IDOLiSH7 and Re:vale work together to look for them. Ryunosuke is rescued sooner than the others thanks to Nagi's quick wits and rushes to Zero Arena, but...

3.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S03E16 - The Angel and the Monster
3.plot: IDOLiSH7 and Re:vale watch on as TRIGGER check in on each other. Tenn informs Nagi that Kujo Takamasa received a living will from Sakura Haruki. Nagi is shaken by the possible clue to finding the man he's been looking for...

3.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S03E17 - Comeback Play
3.plot: Sosuke decides to dissolve TRIGGER's contracts in order to protect Yaotome Agency. However, he allows them to continue calling themselves TRIGGER and sing their existing songs. With that in mind, Tenn and the others continue working independently and pledge to one another that they will aim to return to Zero Arena someday.

3.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S03E18 - Dear Butterfly
3.plot: IDOLiSH7 and Re:vale begin receiving different types of jobs than they had been previously. They are obviously filling in for TRIGGER. Meanwhile, ŹOOĻ is taking on more and more work, and their popularity is skyrocketing. They even appear as guests on IDOLiSH7's show "Lovely Night With You!".

3.title: EN - IDOLiSH7 [MULTI-SUB] - S03E19 - The Trio's Resolve

meta.plot: Eric Judor et Ramzy Bedia, les deux grands noms de l’humour français reforment leur duo iconique, pour se lancer un défi de taille : trouver la prochaine pépite de l’humour. Pour cela, ils vont parcourir la France et la Belgique à la recherche de talents en devenir. Les plus méritants auront la chance d’intégrer la prestigieuse Comedy Class, où nos mentors, accompagnés d’invités de grande renommée issus du monde de l’humour, les mettront à l’épreuve tout en leur prodiguant de précieux conseils.

1.title: FR - Comedy Class par Éric & Ramzy - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Éric and Ramzy will travel across France and Belgium. The comedians they have identified will then join their “Comedy Class” to receive advice from their mentors, as well as from certain big names on the French scene.

1.title: FR - Comedy Class par Éric & Ramzy - S01E02 - Episode 2
FR - Comedy Class par Éric & Ramzy - S01E03 - Episode 3
FR - Une Famille vraiment Loud - S01E01 - The Macho Man with the Plan
1.plot: Lincoln is excited to stay up late with his best friend Clyde to watch the RIP Hardcore Midnight Marathon, but his plans are ruined when his dad institutes an early curfew.

1.title: FR - Une Famille vraiment Loud - S01E02 - The Chore Thing
1.plot: When Lincoln tries to get out of his chores on Chore Day, he and Clyde end up on a police ride-a-long, drawing unwanted attention from the notorious Custard Gang leader. Meanwhile, Dad loses all of the other kids throughout the afternoon.

1.title: FR - Une Famille vraiment Loud - S01E03 - The Blemish Dilemish
1.plot: We meet the Action News Team as Lincoln finds himself taken aback by a new crush. Mom and Dad attempt to befriend a doctor to avoid the astronomical medical expenses that come with having 11 children.

1.title: FR - Une Famille vraiment Loud - S01E04 - The Banana Split Decision
1.plot: It's parent-teacher conference night and the Loud parents find themselves endlessly running around from class to class. Lincoln has his heart set on the Banana Split that their parents promised if the Loud kids get enough good reviews.

1.title: FR - Une Famille vraiment Loud - S01E05 - Ro-Bro
1.plot: When Lincoln wants to have a cool older brother, Lisa builds him one from scratch.

1.title: FR - Une Famille vraiment Loud - S01E06 - I Wanna Hold Your Hand
1.plot: Lincoln and his friends get ready for the school dance! Clyde's dad's are particularly excited that this might be the night Clyde has the ultimate meet-cute they've been waiting for, meanwhile Lincoln keeps striking out with his crush, Charlie.

1.title: FR - Une Famille vraiment Loud - S01E07 - The Guy Who Makes You Fly
1.plot: Lincoln decides to tap out of his brotherly duties and go on a vacation. Clyde steps in to take on Lincoln's role in the family, at first everything goes great, until tides turn and Clyde has to call on Lincoln for help.

1.title: FR - Une Famille vraiment Loud - S01E08 - The Manager with the Planager
1.plot: Lincoln encourages Clyde to showcase his amazing skills as a drummer, but pushes him too far. Luan meets her comedy idol while performing a comedy gig at Sunset Canyon. Luna helps Leni ace her history test by utilizing her love of fashion.

1.title: FR - Une Famille vraiment Loud - S01E09 - Heart and Soul
1.plot: Lincoln and Clyde are determined to make a name for themselves but learn that sacrificing someone else's dreams to get there isn't worth it in the end.

1.title: FR - Une Famille vraiment Loud - S01E10 - No Louds Allowed
1.plot: Tired of having his space intruded upon, Lincoln and Clyde create an exclusive club only to find Lincoln's sisters have all done the same.

1.title: FR - Une Famille vraiment Loud - S01E11 - The Princess and the Everlasting Emerald: A Royal Woods Fairytale: Part 1
1.plot: Lincoln goes on the quest to give Charlie the perfect gift to remember him by Lincoln and his family put all of their talents on the line for the first ever Loud-a-palooza to save Flip's Food and Fuel.

1.title: FR - Une Famille vraiment Loud - S01E12 - The Princess and the Everlasting Emerald: A Royal Woods Fairytale: Part 2
1.plot: Lincoln is still on the quest to give Charlie the perfect gift to remember him by Lincoln and his family put all of their talents on the line for the first ever Loud-a-palooza to save Flip's Food and Fuel.

1.title: FR - Une Famille vraiment Loud - S01E13 - What's a Mother to Redo
1.plot: After an epic Mother’s Day fail, the Loud family attempts to redeem themselves with a Mother’s Day re-do.

1.title: FR - Une Famille vraiment Loud - S01E14 - Better Together
1.plot: When Clyde finds himself in the BEST program at school Lincoln has to find a way to reconnect before the epic spitball battle they’ve been preparing for and Dad tries every trick in the book to get an annoying song out of his head.

1.title: FR - Une Famille vraiment Loud - S01E15 - Home Is Where The Hero Is
1.plot: Lincoln and Clyde set out to win a Rip Hardcore contest, excited at a chance to hang with their hero, only to learn that Lincoln’s real hero has been by his side all along.

1.title: FR - Une Famille vraiment Loud - S01E16 - Spelling and Doorbelling
1.plot: Lincoln and Clyde find themselves outmatched in the ultimate prank war, meanwhile Lisa takes on a new “sport” with some help from Lynn Jr.

1.title: FR - Une Famille vraiment Loud - S01E17 - Sweet Dreams Are Made of Cheese
1.plot: When Lucy and the Mortician’s Club bring a cursed wheel of cheese into the house Lincoln and Clyde must race to save everyone from their worst nightmares!

1.title: FR - Une Famille vraiment Loud - S01E19 - Some Buddy to Love
1.plot: Mom and Dad attempt to enjoy a day to themselves by pairing up all of the Loud siblings with each other for the day.

1.title: FR - Une Famille vraiment Loud - S01E20 - Little-Ol-Lady-Whoooo Has Talent
1.plot: The Royal Woods talent show provides the ultimate stage for all of the Loud family to show off their talents, and beat the Torkelson family once and for all.

meta.plot: 12-year-old Lincoln Loud goes on new adventures in the town of Royal Woods with his best friend Clyde McBride, while also navigating the chaos of living in a family with 10 sisters.

1.title: FR - Homicide [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Carnegie Deli Massacre
1.plot: A shooting that left three dead and two injured in an apartment above the iconic Carnegie Deli sends detectives on a relentless hunt for the killers.

1.title: FR - Homicide [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - Central Park Slaying
1.plot: After an eviscerated body is found in Central Park Lake, a pair of unlikely suspects are implicated in the killing as shocking revelations surface.

1.title: FR - Homicide [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - Vanished on Wall Street
1.plot: An office building in the Financial District becomes a 26-floor crime scene when a beloved mother and janitor mysteriously vanishes without a trace.

meta.plot: Dans cette série documentaire glaçante du créateur de "New York, police judiciaire", des enquêteurs et des procureurs reviennent sur leurs affaires d'homicide les plus complexes.
Deux fantômes détectives et une médium qui enquêtent sur des affaires pour leur clientèle surnaturelle affrontent une puissante sorcière décidée à contrecarrer leurs plans.

1.title: FR - Dead Boy Detectives - S01E01 - The Case of Crystal Palace
1.plot: After coming to the aid of a teen medium with a demonic dilemma, Edwin and Charles head to America to find a missing girl with an unexpected ally.

1.title: FR - Dead Boy Detectives - S01E02 - The Case of the Dandelion Shrine
1.plot: Trapped in a sleepy Washington town, the detectives take on a local case: helping Crystal's quirky housemate Niko get rid of her paranormal parasites.

1.title: FR - Dead Boy Detectives - S01E03 - The Case of the Devlin House
1.plot: The group tries to free a family of spirits from a nightmarish loop inside a haunted house, but it triggers an extreme case of déjà vu for one detective.

1.title: FR - Dead Boy Detectives - S01E04 - The Case of the Lighthouse Leapers
1.plot: The gang looks into a disturbing trend of deaths at a lighthouse. Crystal hears a distinct voice while piecing together clues about the seaside mystery.

1.title: FR - Dead Boy Detectives - S01E05 - The Case of the Two Dead Dragons
1.plot: While Crystal, Edwin and Charles investigate the tragic murders of two popular jocks, Niko sets up Jenny and her secret admirer on a butcher shop date.

1.title: FR - Dead Boy Detectives - S01E06 - The Case of the Creeping Forest
1.plot: A crisis forces Crystal to improvise on the job as Monty recruits the boys to locate his missing friend — but the eerie case isn't what it seems.

1.title: FR - Dead Boy Detectives - S01E07 - The Case of the Very Long Stairway
1.plot: When Edwin gets caught in a frightening situation, Charles relies on his best mate's meticulous notes to find him. A determined Crystal confronts her ex.

1.title: FR - Dead Boy Detectives - S01E08 - The Case of the Hungry Snake
1.plot: Crystal reckons with the past after memories come rushing back. With Esther's evil scheme underway, the group is forced to face their deadliest foe yet.

meta.plot: After his untimely death, this salaryman gets another shot at life! When Luciel is reborn into a magical new land, he becomes a healer in hopes of leading a peaceful life. However, he quickly learns that being a healer is much more challenging than he expected. With strict and strenuous training in store, this new life is turning out to be anything but peaceful.

1.title: EN - The Great Cleric [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Healers' Guild
1.plot: A salaryman meets an untimely demise and gets reincarnated in a fantasy world as a fifteen-year-old boy named Luciel. Luciel uses his business skills to talk his way into a nearby town's Healers' Guild, where he begins a crash course in magic.

1.title: EN - The Great Cleric [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The Adventurers' Guild
1.plot: Luciel starts to get a handle on his healing powers and what it's going to take to improve them and survive in this new world, so he charts a course for a rather unexpected training destination—the Adventurers' Guild!

1.title: EN - The Great Cleric [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - A Talent for Martial Arts
1.plot: Luciel registers with the Adventurers' Guild and begins martial arts training with chief instructor Brod. As part of that training, he is forced to drink Substance X, a mysterious and disgusting beverage that confers special powers like a cheat item.

1.title: EN - The Great Cleric [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Substance X and a Small Change
1.plot: Luciel gets a break from training to learn about butchering monsters with Gulgar's brother, Galba, and study world history and culture with Nanaella. While shopping with Nanaella one day, he discovers Monika unconscious and bleeding on the street.

1.title: EN - The Great Cleric [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Healing Clinic and the Arrival of Bottaculli
1.plot: It's been a year and Luciel needs to renew his registration at the Healer's Guild. What rank will he be? Luciel jumps into the next level of his training, when he encounters the Healer who left Monika to die...

1.title: EN - The Great Cleric [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - On a Journey
1.plot: After Luciel's encounter with Bottaculli, Brod decides that he'll need to get even stronger to survive whatever the corrupt healer might throw at him. Little do they expect the mysterious letter that's about to arrive and change everything.

1.title: EN - The Great Cleric [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - The Holy City of Shurule
1.plot: Luciel makes his intrepid, if reluctant, trip the Holy City of Shurule, where he learns more about the Church and what he'll be doing there. Is this a setup? Or just another stepping stone on the path to survival?

1.title: EN - The Great Cleric [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - A Threat in the Boss Room
1.plot: Luciel makes progress at his new job, potentially even getting in over his head. He's up against a strange encounter in the boss room, and an even more mysterious one afterward...

meta.plot: This story is about the flow of fate and the battle to keep the world on the right path. Aladdin is a boy who has set out to explore the world after being trapped in a room for most of his life. His best friend is a flute with a djinn in it named Ugo. Soon enough, Aladdin discovers he is a Magi, a magician who chooses kings, and he was born to choose kings who will follow the righteous path, battling against those who want to destroy fate. Follow his adventures as he meets others from 1001 Arabian Nights, like Ali Baba and Sinbad, and fights to keep the balance of world in check!

meta.plot: Due to a terrible accident, Keina Kagami is forced to live on life support in order to survive. The only way for her to be free is within the VRMMORPG "Leadale." One day, her life support stops functioning, and Keina loses her life. But when she wakes up, she finds herself in the world of Leadale 200 years in the future. She is now the half-elf Cayna, who possesses lost skills and OP statuses and becomes closer to the other inhabitants of this world. But among those inhabitants happen to be the "children" she made in character creation?!

1.title: EN - Leadale no Daichi nite [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - An Inn, a Tower, a Bear, and a Banquet
1.plot: Keina Kagami was injured in an accident so badly that she could not survive without being hooked up to life-support machines. One day, those life-support machines stop functioning and she loses her life. When she wakes up, she's in the world of the VRMMORPG "Leadale," and in the form of her avatar, Cayna. But something seemed a bit different than the game world she was used to...

1.title: EN - Leadale no Daichi nite [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - An Injured Person, the Royal Capital, My Sons, and a Game of Tag
1.plot: Cayna discovers that the NPC characters she created in the game were actually considered her children in this world. In order to reunite with them, she heads to the royal capital of Felskeilo. However, she is unable to see Skargo, who is the High Priest. She is able to reunite with her youngest child, the dwarf Kartatz, and learns how the other two children are doing from him.

1.title: EN - Leadale no Daichi nite [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - A Daughter, a Colosseum, Losing Control, and an Uppercut
1.plot: Cayna and Mai-Mai reunite for the first time after 200 years. Cayna was searching for the remaining Guardian Towers her gamer friends left behind but was not able to get any more information from Mai-Mai, who is the headmaster at the Royal Academy. Cayna continues her activities as an adventurer to try to gain more information and takes on a quest to take care of a supposed ghost that appears at the colosseum and...

1.title: EN - Leadale no Daichi nite [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - A Son, a Fight, a Journey, and Bandits
1.plot: Cayna recovers very quickly from her depression, just as Kartatz seeks her out, and she gets properly introduced to Skargo. Later, Elineh hires her as a caravan guard while he travels to the neighboring kingdom of Helshper, since the usual route has been beset by bandits. Although they attempt to take an alternative route, they run into an ambush set by the bandits. However, thanks to Cayna's powerful magic and some summoned allies, the bandits are easily defeated, allowing the caravan to continue on its way.

1.title: EN - Leadale no Daichi nite [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Grandsons, the Granddaughters, the Great-grandchildren, and a Fort
1.plot: Cayna visits Sakaiya with the help of Elineh to deliver the letter that Mai-Mai had asked her to deliver. Once she gets there, she finds out that the master of Sakaiya, Caerick, is actually Mai-Mai's son, which would make him Cayna's grandson! The surprise was a success! Or so Mai-Mai would've hoped, but Cayna ends up extremely angry at Mai-Mai. Not knowing how to process any of this, Cayna returns to the inn she's staying at and then encounters Caerick's twin sister Caerina and...

1.title: EN - Leadale no Daichi nite [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Rock Golem, the Chief, a Skeleton, and a Fairy
1.plot: Caerina and the other knights struggle against a horde of rock golems who attacked them.Things start to look grim but then Cayna blasts the rock golems with lightning! Caerina thanks Cayna for saving them, but she can't help but feel a bit of fear and jealousy at just how powerful Cayna is. Meanwhile, Cayna realizes that there are other players left in the world of Leadale after the battle with the rock golems.

1.title: EN - Leadale no Daichi nite [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Bear Hunting, a Queen, a Bath, and Monsters
1.plot: After returning to Felskeilo, Cayna finds a lot of quests available and takes on a quest from the The White-Tailed Black Rabbit. When she leaves the guild, she runs into Lonti and her Academy friend Mye. Lonti was trying to find Cayna to ask if she could be Mye's bodyguard because she ran away from home. Cayna then escorts the girls into the lush forest right outside of the city.

1.title: EN - Leadale no Daichi nite [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - A Battle, a Victory, a Conversation, and News
1.plot: Lopus had messed up an experiment which creates a monster penguin who starts destroying the city of Felskeilo. Cohral and Shining Saber arrive to fight with the monster but are no match for it. Cohral and Shining Saber risk their lives for one final attack against the monster when suddenly, a giant boulder passes by?!

1.title: EN - Leadale no Daichi nite [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - A Revisit, Mermaids, a Misunderstanding, and Zombies
1.plot: Cayna awakens with a hangover in a village out in the middle of nowhere. While she's dealing with a headache, she hears people talking about hearing singing coming from a well. In order to find out what's causing it, Cayna summons a flying fish and dives into the well. When she gets down there, she discovers a massive underground cavern. And what she finds down there is...

1.title: EN - Leadale no Daichi nite [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - A Butler, a Ghost Ship, an Adopted Daughter, and the Palace of the Dragon King
1.plot: While investigating the zombie village, Cayna encounters Quolkeh and Exis, who have come here on an assignment of their own, and a young girl named Luka, the only survivor of her community. After determining that the death fog must be a quest event from the game, Cayna summons a NPC butler named Roxilius to look after Luka before she, Exis and Quolkeh set out to defeat the boss monster responsible for this. With the threat eliminated, Cayna journeys to the Guardian Tower she was looking for, the Palace of the Dragon King, whose guardian accepts her as its new master. After adopting Luka as a new daughter, Cayna takes the girl and Roxilius with her.

1.title: EN - Leadale no Daichi nite [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - An Introduction, a Carriage, a Maid, and Moving
1.plot: Cayna brings Luka to Felskeilo's capital to introduce her to her other children and friends. She also receives a wagon from Elineh as a gift for her past services, and summons Roxilius' counterpart (and rival), the werecat maid Roxine, to help in her new household. After converting the wagon into a self-propelled golem, Cayna and her entourage set out for the remote village, where she introduces Luka to the locals, who promptly prepare a welcome party for her.

1.title: EN - Leadale no Daichi nite [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Relocating, Building, Flying, and the Earth
1.plot: The day after the banquet, Cayna yet again awakens to a hangover. She ends up inheriting the land where the house of the pioneer of the village once stood. Cayna uses magic to start building her house and immediately, Cayna and Luca's new house is complete. Luca stares in utter shock and Cayna reaches out her hand. Their new life together is about to begin

meta.plot: When Elvira’s editor informs her that she will be paid per article, she begins murdering people to avoid going broke. Her plans are shaken when she falls for the crime reporter.

1.title: FR - Obituary - S01E01 - Death Becomes Her
1.plot: When Elvira’s editor informs her that she will be paid per article, she begins murdering people to avoid going broke. Her plans are shaken when she falls for the crime reporter.

1.title: FR - Obituary - S01E02 - Hiccups
1.plot: Elvira targets someone sending her poison pen letters as Emerson’s real reason for coming to town is revealed - he’s trying to solve the murder of Maria Riedle in the local woods.

1.title: FR - Obituary - S01E03 - Stay of Execution
1.plot: Elvira finds herself blackmailed by a teenager who saw her murder her first victim. Ward goes to AA while Hughie catches a break when he finds the rifle used to kill Maria Riedle.

1.title: FR - Obituary - S01E04 - Weapons of Minor Destruction
1.plot: Desperate to prove to herself that she is not a monster, Elvira pursues a drunk driver released from jail who mowed down a father and daughter.

1.title: FR - Obituary - S01E05 - Wild Goose Chase
1.plot: Elvira decides on whether or not to kill her friend as Mallory reveals that she has information that Elvira may be involved in a murder. Hughie sends Emerson on a wild goose chas.

1.title: FR - Obituary - S01E06 - Body Count
1.plot: When Ward reveals what really happened the night Maria Riedle was killed, Elvira sets about framing Hughie for the crime. A surprise face returns to Kilraven.

2.title: FR - Obituary - S02E01 - The Bad Sleep Well
2.plot: Elvira’s life spirals after the death of her father. As she grieves, her secrets strain her bond with Emerson. A ruthless new boss, a scheming intern, and a murder she didn’t commit push Elvira to the edge—forcing her to fight to regain control.

2.title: FR - Obituary - S02E02 - Brain Full of Razorblades
2.plot: Elvira’s supposedly stolen car leads Rose to her, but the real shock is Oisin is found near death. As reporters swarm Kilraven, Vivienne exploits the chaos. When the guards arrest a suspect in Ruby’s murder, Elvira doubts they’ve caught the real killer.

2.title: FR - Obituary - S02E03 - It Doesn't Count as a Crime if You Had Fun
2.plot: Emerson digs into James Doe’s tattoos and Tom Quigley’s scandal. Meanwhile, Elvira faces Hughie’s manipulations as he lures her to a face-to-face meeting and threatens to reveal her secrets.

2.title: FR - Obituary - S02E04 - The Principle of Two Weaknesses
2.plot: Elvira helps Oisin frame drug dealer Albert for Ruby’s murder, but Albert ambushes her. After a violent struggle, Albert is killed, and Elvira frames him as Ruby’s killer. Meanwhile, Hughie returns, free thanks to Vivienne.

2.title: FR - Obituary - S02E05 - The Wrongful Prolongation of Life
2.plot: Elvira, hailed as a hero after killing Albert, faces suspicion from police. Hughie uncovers Ward’s role in Agnes Dunford’s death, implicating him in multiple murders. Elvira’s editor promotion stalls as the “screwdriver killer” strikes again.

meta.plot: Meet the Ghost Club! Their adventures take them all around Los Angeles as they interview ghosts, solve problems and learn about their city's history.

1.title: EN - City of Ghosts [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Sort of Japanese Restaurant
1.plot: Chef Jo's opening a new restaurant in Boyle Heights — but strange things keep happening. By learning about the past, Zelda helps solve the mystery.

1.title: EN - City of Ghosts [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Venice
1.plot: Thomas visits John, who works at a Venice skate shop. He's concerned about Sam, an 8-year-old skateboarder who says she's been hanging out with a ghost.

1.title: EN - City of Ghosts [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Leimert Park
1.plot: Drumming noises at Sonya's café keep waking up her neighbor. Eva and the Ghost Club gather clues by exploring Leimert Park's musical history.

1.title: EN - City of Ghosts [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Tovaangar
1.plot: The Ghost Club goes to the park and meets Jasper, who hears a voice in the trees. Later they learn about the Tongva — Indigenous people of Los Angeles.

1.title: EN - City of Ghosts [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Bob & Nancy
1.plot: Zen and her mom Atomic Nancy, a fluffy ghost with a punky past, help the kids investigate strange noises at the Bob Baker Marionette Theater.

1.title: EN - City of Ghosts [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Koreatown
1.plot: The team interviews Yulissa, who teaches Oaxacan music. She's looking for her missing friend Chepe, a colorful ghost who communicates by whistling.

meta.plot: Yayoi Sakamoto, a diehard fan of comedians and comedy acts, enrolls in the private Kazuki High School in Nanba (Osaka's entertainment district famous as the starting point for many comedians). She reunites with Yomogi Takahashi, a childhood friend who once formed the comedy duo "Konamonzu" with her when they were little. Before long, they find themselves putting together a routine at a park like they did before, in order to enter a local shopping area's contest. At that moment, a mysterious girl calls out to them.

1.title: EN - Teppen!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! Laughing 'til You Cry [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Chicken Chapter
1.plot: The three female high school student members of the manzai (stand-up comedy) trio Young Wai-Wai—Sakamoto Yayoi, Takahashi Yomogi, and Hosono Yuzu—have beaten the local qualifiers and are one step closer to participating in the main Teppen Grand Prix comedy competition. As a final trial, the girls must live together with the members of four other comedy teams in Takako-so, a dormitory with a distinguished history of housing famous comedians. Will the girls be able to complete the various tasks assigned to them by Seiji, the dormitory manager, and fulfill the final requirements to compete on stage?

1.title: EN - Teppen!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! Laughing 'til You Cry [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The Evil Magistrate Chapter
1.plot: One day, between their rehearsals and training activities, the five comedy teams at Takako-so are given a chance to appear on television. Only two teams are allowed, so the girls hold a lottery to decide who will go. The winners are Bullet Kunoichi, with members representing two parts of the western Kansai region, and Akudare Kingdom, with members from the eastern Kanto region. When the two teams arrive at the shooting location, they realize something strange is going on. A quirky producer suddenly appears on the unusual set and has the girls start competing in a bizarre quiz program.

1.title: EN - Teppen!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! Laughing 'til You Cry [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - The Salon Chapter
1.plot: The Takako-so residents get mislead by a string of clickbait articles with headlines like "Famous Mascot Complains to Store," "Cows Pile on Hokkaido Cookie Shop," and "Full-Scale War Breaks Out Between Takoyaki and Okonomiyaki." Meanwhile, Shirakabe Mako from Celebri-Tea struggles to do work on a frozen laptop in the cafeteria. When Yuzu offers to fix Mako's computer, what pops up on screen is a document written by White Wall, the author of all the clickbait articles.

1.title: EN - Teppen!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! Laughing 'til You Cry [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Lamp Chapter
1.plot: The three Invaders return to their home prefecture of Hokkaido for a required summer school day. On the bus ride to school, Mone starts talking about Hokkaido's seven folk legends while Chihori shares random facts about space. As Yuina responds to the girls' wacky conversation with her usual comical comebacks, she is overcome with a very strange feeling about the situation.

1.title: EN - Teppen!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! Laughing 'til You Cry [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Flour Chapter
1.plot: With manager Seiji out of town for a bodybuilding competition, the girls of Takako-so try to figure out how to take care of household chores themselves.

1.title: EN - Teppen!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! Laughing 'til You Cry [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Mail-Order Chapter
1.plot: Seiji scolds the girls for slacking off and sends all fifteen of them to a mandatory training camp at a hot springs deep in the mountains to work themselves back into shape. The hostess at the inn is herself a Teppen Grand Prix Committee member, but unlike Seiji, she tells the girls to just relax and take it easy. While the others are enjoying their onsen time, Akudare Kingdom's Ushiku Misao keeps getting a strange feeling about the place. Will the source of Misao's apprehension eventually be revealed?

1.title: EN - Teppen!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! Laughing 'til You Cry [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - The Adult Meat Chapter
1.plot: A cameraman visits Takako-so for a week to cover the girls for a documentary TV program. Told to just act naturally for the camera, the girls stick to their normal daily routine until an unusual opportunity appears and Yayoi suggests that they write and perform a live skit show. Still followed by the camera, the girls put their energy into rehearsing right up to the day of the show, but then the wrong costumes are delivered by mistake. Not wanting to disappoint their full audience, the girls do what they can to make their show a success.

1.title: EN - Teppen!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! Laughing 'til You Cry [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - The Adamski Chapter
1.plot: Celebri-Tea's Jogasaki Hikari realizes that she hasn't let her talents shine quite as much as her teammates and the other high school comedians at Takako-so. She meets with the Invaders' Hokuto Chihori, who also seems often left on the sidelines, to brainstorm ways to make their stand-up characters stand out more. While Hikari is talking, the distracted Chihori receives an unexpected message and rushes off to face her mother.

1.title: EN - Teppen!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! Laughing 'til You Cry [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - The Piñata Chapter
1.plot: Today is Celebri-Tea member Shirakabe Mako's birthday. Living with so many friends at Takako-so, Mako has good reason to expect a big party with lots of presents. However, for some reason, Mako isn't able to tell her new friends what day it is. Hoping to be pampered, but unable to say the word "birthday," Mako starts taking unusual steps to make her friends notice. Meanwhile, one other Takako-so resident also starts acting suspiciously.

1.title: EN - Teppen!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! Laughing 'til You Cry [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - The Cattle Chapter
1.plot: Returning from her normal morning run, Young Wai-Wai member Takahashi Yomogi finds an ema—a votive horse plaque used to make wishes at shrines—dropped at the entrance to the Takako-so. When she shows the plaque to Yayoi and Yuzu, they notice a menacing wish written on the back: "tonight 8 o'clock head of state assassination." Realizing that the president of the United States is visiting Japan that day, and convinced that one of other Takako-so residents must be plotting a crime, the three decide to uncover whoever is responsible and try to talk them out of it. Will they be able to identify the suspect and foil the assassination plot in time?

1.title: EN - Teppen!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! Laughing 'til You Cry [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - The Boss Battle Chapter
1.plot: With only three days left at Takako-so, the fifteen comedians are given one final test. Seiji orders them to stay inside the dormitory for three full days, no matter what happens. It sounds like a simple task at first, but Seiji also calls on some unusual visitors to challenge the girls' confidence as budding comedians and entertainers. Despite having already overcome so many trials, the five teams must put their sense of humor on the line one last time to face their biggest battle yet.

1.title: EN - Teppen!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! Laughing 'til You Cry [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - The Laughter Chapter
1.plot: As the only comedian trio unable to pass Seiji's final test, the girls of Young Wai-Wai look back on their hilarious days at Takako-so with a mix of fondness and bitter regret. Then, seemingly out of nowhere, Yuzu's housekeeper Steward appears and lightens the mood with a message from Seiji about a comeback round. Thrilled to learn that they still have one last chance, the girls start preparing their final comedy routine with the encouragement and support of their Takako-so friends.

meta.plot: This is a slightly peculiar world where the shipgirls live in. A lively and enjoyable school life for girls from different factions will begin at the naval port of Azur Lane. Living out their lives to the fullest, these girls get into various shenanigans—slowly but surely!

1.title: FR - Azur Lane: Slow Ahead! - S01E01 - Port and Starboard, Slow Ahead!
1.plot: This is a slightly different world where girls named after warships exist. Various organizations worked together to bring this academy to life, and this is where the fun and exciting school lives of these girls is about to begin!

1.title: FR - Azur Lane: Slow Ahead! - S01E02 - You Need Something Sweet After a Workout...
1.plot: Javelin and friends are exhausted from the summer heat when Baltimore shows up. When they offer to help her, they're met with an unimaginably tough schedule!

1.title: FR - Azur Lane: Slow Ahead! - S01E03 - Is Real Life a God Tier Game?
1.plot: Instead of coming to class, Ayanami is playing games, making Javelin and Z23 agonize about how to make her come back. Out of ideas, they go to consult Akashi, but they get more of an advertisement for a cute new invention than a consultation...

1.title: FR - Azur Lane: Slow Ahead! - S01E04 - Beach Time Is Barbecue Time!
1.plot: On this perfect mid-summer day, Javelin and friends are hungrily looking forward to the barbeque. ...but unfortunately Rodney's misunderstanding leads to all the food being gone. The girls then set out to find the blessings of the mountain and the fruits of the sea...

1.title: FR - Azur Lane: Slow Ahead! - S01E05 - With Friends, With Someone Special
1.plot: Admiral Graf Spee is trying to make new friends, but things don't work out so well. She then tries to find common interests with Ayanami... Like delicious snacks and how to spend your days off.

1.title: FR - Azur Lane: Slow Ahead! - S01E06 - May I Have This Dance?
1.plot: Javelin and friends find Bismarck at a party with a serious expression on her face. Will she be able to successfully ask Tirpitz for dance and then lead the little knights and the elegant ladies?

1.title: FR - Azur Lane: Slow Ahead! - S01E07 - Pay Close Attention to Keeping Things Neat and Tidy!
1.plot: A suspicious shadow is trying to break into the office. After determining the identity of the shadow, Javelin and friends end up cleaning the office along with Mikasa-daisenpai. And what's this behind the shelf, something highly classified?

1.title: FR - Azur Lane: Slow Ahead! - S01E08 - Enjoying the Fair With Everyone!
1.plot: The home port is throwing a costume academy fair. After being urged by North Carolina to dress up, Javelin and friends go and really enjoy the academy fair with an embarrassed Honolulu. Who is going to be the lucky one to get the coveted premium prize?

1.title: FR - Azur Lane: Slow Ahead! - S01E09 - Maid, At Your Service!
1.plot: Belfast is aspiring to be a first-class maid, and Bel-chan is practicing serving people. In order to know how different individual masters might feel, she asks Ayanami and Laffey to be her training partners.

1.title: FR - Azur Lane: Slow Ahead! - S01E10 - Balmy, Hot, Dizzy...
1.plot: Javelin and friends go to the big bath in order to pamper their bodies after a tiring exercise. However, due to a broken boiler, there is no hot water! That's when Zuikaku and Shoukaku begin building an outdoor bath behind the dorms.

1.title: FR - Azur Lane: Slow Ahead! - S01E11 - A Fun Amusement Park Outing?
1.plot: Tickets to "Manjuu Land" are found in a box gifted by Yukikaze. Javelin, Yukikaze and the others, along with Nagato and Mutsu, are out to have as much fun as possible at the amusement park.

1.title: FR - Azur Lane: Slow Ahead! - S01E12 - Friends Are Our Most Important Treasure
1.plot: While cleaning the storeroom, Javelin and the others find a mysterious treasure chest with Laffey inside! But it seems like Laffey's lost her memory?! How will they possibly get their precious friend's memory back? Well, you'll just have to see for yourself.

meta.plot: In a war-torn feudal Japan filled with mechs and magic, the greatest ronin never known, Yasuke, struggles to maintain a peaceful existence after a past life of violence. But when a local village becomes the center of social upheaval between warring daimyo, Yasuke must take up his sword and transport a mysterious child who is the target of dark forces and bloodthirsty warlords.

1.title: EN - Yasuke [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Ronin
1.plot: When her young daughter is stricken by a mysterious malady, Ichika asks Yasuke to bring them upriver to a special doctor, but Yasuke refuses.

1.title: EN - Yasuke [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The Old Way
1.plot: Back in 1581, Yasuke and Natsumaru have become trusted warriors serving Nobunaga. In the present day, the mercenaries catch up to Yasuke and attack.

1.title: EN - Yasuke [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Mortal Sins
1.plot: Abraham sends Haruto and Nikita out to find Saki, who uses her growing powers to fight back. Under torture, Yasuke has a flashback to a betrayal.

1.title: EN - Yasuke [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - A Long Road
1.plot: Back in the village, Saki asks Yasuke to bring her to Doctor Morisuke — and she won’t take no for an answer. But there are new enemies in pursuit.

1.title: EN - Yasuke [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Pain & Blood
1.plot: While Morisuke protects Saki from the Daimyo’s attack on the Astral Plane, Yasuke confronts the masked Dark General, who reveals their true identity.

1.title: EN - Yasuke [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Balance
1.plot: While Morisuke and his men create a protective shield around the temple, Yasuke and Saki face off with the Daimyo in Azuchi Castle.

meta.plot: Framed for a corporate crime, an adult Ted Templeton turns back into the Boss Baby to live undercover with his brother, Tim, posing as one of his kids.

1.title: EN - The Boss Baby: Back in the Crib - S01E01 - The Business Boss: Back in Baby
1.plot: The Boss Baby returns to the office to find a culture greatly changed. But to get his old job back, he'll have to steal it from his talented niece, Tina.

1.title: EN - The Boss Baby: Back in the Crib - S01E02 - The Stroll
1.plot: Tina and the Boss Baby struggle to co-lead on their first joint field mission: freeing the baby with the world's best hair from an epic lice outbreak.

1.title: EN - The Boss Baby: Back in the Crib - S01E03 - Potty Mouth
1.plot: After a cute baby says a no-no word on live TV, the Boss Baby becomes obsessed with pinning the blame on a new archnemesis: Lumpy the Park Duck.

1.title: EN - The Boss Baby: Back in the Crib - S01E04 - Imaginary Friends
1.plot: Baby culture is crawling with imaginary friends these days, but the Boss Baby isn't playing along. Enter HR with some sensitivity training.

1.title: EN - The Boss Baby: Back in the Crib - S01E05 - Turf War
1.plot: When Tina tries to calm a toddler turf war by befriending a notorious baby bully, she goes too far — and the field team's forced to rein her in.

1.title: EN - The Boss Baby: Back in the Crib - S01E06 - Trading Up
1.plot: HR makes the Boss Baby take a day off, so he decides to give Tabitha business lessons. Elsewhere, the Uncuddleables are working harder than ever.

1.title: EN - The Boss Baby: Back in the Crib - S01E07 - War of the Cheeks
1.plot: Boss Baby's quest to crush the Uncuddleables gets sidetracked by a Templeton tradition: a Go Fish tournament where the winner rules the family for a day.

1.title: EN - The Boss Baby: Back in the Crib - S01E08 - Tecky Tykes
1.plot: Boss Baby and Tina invite Tabitha to the office — and Tim tags along. But the special guests are the top suspects when the all-powerful UBO goes missing.

1.title: EN - The Boss Baby: Back in the Crib - S01E09 - Birthday Blues
1.plot: It's the Boss Baby's birthday, and he's celebrating like an adult! There's just one problem: He still needs Carol to push his stroller around Chicago.

1.title: EN - The Boss Baby: Back in the Crib - S01E10 - Sitting Ducks
1.plot: The team willingly places themselves in the care of the Uncuddleables with plans to expose them... until Tina falls hard for her tricky babysitter.

1.title: EN - The Boss Baby: Back in the Crib - S01E11 - The Big Dumpling
1.plot: In a bid to sabotage the Lil' Dumpling Pageant, the Uncuddleables replace all of Baby Corp's super-cute top performers with the not-so-cute bottom 5%.

1.title: EN - The Boss Baby: Back in the Crib - S01E12 - The Great Medieval London Fire of 1135
1.plot: A surprising partnership could turn Baby Corp's entire business model upside-down — and change the way the world looks at baby love. Time to re-org!

meta.plot: An espionage thriller and cross-culture satire about the struggles of a half-French, half-Vietnamese communist spy during the final days of the Vietnam War and his resulting exile in the United States.

1.title: FR - The Sympathizer - S01E01 - Death Wish
1.plot: With the fall of Saigon imminent, the Captain juggles the communist party, the South Vietnamese army, his CIA handler and his conscience.

1.title: FR - The Sympathizer - S01E02 - Good Little Asian
1.plot: As he adjusts to life in Los Angeles, the Captain is forced to find someone to implicate when the General begins to suspect a mole.

1.title: FR - The Sympathizer - S01E03 - Love It or Leave It
1.plot: The Captain and Bon craft a plan to quell the General's anxieties. Later, the Captain meets the Auteur, who wants to make a film about war.

1.title: FR - The Sympathizer - S01E04 - Give Us Some Good Lines
1.plot: As a reluctant consultant on a Hollywood film, the Captain navigates the egos and personalities of an increasingly chaotic production.

1.title: FR - The Sympathizer - S01E05 - All for One
1.plot: After a lengthy stint at the hospital, the Captain discovers that the General has started recruiting for a secret military operation.

1.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S01E01 - The Hunt
1.plot: Detective Charlie Hudson teams up with what he calls his "highly trained law enforcement animal" German Shepherd dog named Rex who he prefers to team up with because he doesn't talk his ear off.

1.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S01E02 - Fearless Freaks
1.plot: Charlie and Rex reveal a conspiracy within the parkour community, after a thrill-seeker falls to his death.

1.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S01E03 - Haunted By the Past
1.plot: Charlie and Rex open up a cold case that may be connected to a recent case; Donovan asks Charlie to spy on his daughter.

1.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S01E04 - School Daze
1.plot: When a controversial university professor is found dead in his classroom, Charlie and Rex investigate leads while Jesse goes undercover and soon finds himself in danger.

1.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S01E05 - The Pet Sitter
1.plot: The animal lovers of St John's are under suspicion as Charlie and Rex investigate the death of a professional pet sitter. At home, Charlie finds himself in need of Sarah's help.

1.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S01E06 - Murder She Thought
1.plot: When the pharmacist at Charlie's aunt's retirement home is found dead, she alerts him to a mysterious string of recent fatalities among the home's residents.

1.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S01E07 - Trial and Error
1.plot: Sarah finds herself in the middle of a hostage situation at a medical testing lab. When the team realizes there's no way inside without aggravating the gunman, Charlies sends Rex in to monitor the situation.

1.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S01E08 - Fast Eddie's
1.plot: After a reviled restaurateur's food truck explodes, killing one of his employees, Charlie and Rex find themselves with a few too many suspects. A flirtation has Charlie torn between a possible new love interest and Rex, who makes no secret of his feelings on the matter.

1.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S01E09 - The Mourning Show
1.plot: Charlie investigates the host of a local morning show after her media mogul husband is suddenly found dead.

1.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S01E10 - Art of Darkness
1.plot: With a gallery curator found murdered on his showroom floor and a missing sculpture, Charlie, Rex and Sarah are thrown into the world of high art. Jesse feels the burn when Sarah picks him as her new running buddy.

1.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S01E11 - Bad Water Rising
1.plot: When an activist is killed during a break-and-enter at a water bottling plant, all evidence points towards his partner-in-crime, but Charlie and Rex aren't convinced.

1.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S01E12 - A Cult Education
1.plot: When Donovan's ex, a recovering addict, wakes up with blood on her hands and a dead roommate in her apartment, the team moves quickly, finding there's more to the story.

1.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S01E13 - The Rex Files
1.plot: When a deadly car accident leads Charlie and Rex to investigate reports of a mysterious blue light in the sky, they discover the truth is more science than fiction.

2.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S02E01 - Man of Consequences
2.plot: Charlie and Rex discover a wanted criminal has been living in St. John's under a false identity for twenty years and end up in the crosshairs when the man's past catches up with him.

2.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S02E02 - Over Ice
2.plot: Charlie and Rex investigate the death of a figure skating coach who's found dead on her club's ice rink.

2.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S02E03 - Blind Justice
2.plot: When a body is found in a shipping container, Charlie teams up with a female cop from his past to solve the crime, Rex is not a fan and keeps getting between the two, keeping the path clear for Charlie and Sarah.
