meta.plot: Detective Charlie Hudson teams up with what he calls his "highly trained law enforcement animal" German Shepherd dog named Rex who he prefers to team up with because he doesn't talk his ear off.

1.title: FR - Mademoiselle Holmes - S01E01 - We Open Her Chakras Episode 1
1.plot: Charlie, a discreet cop who was stationed at the complaints office, interfered with the investigation by his colleague Chris to find Anna, a six-year-old girl. Headed by Samy, the new trainee, she will discover exceptional investigator skills, inherited from her great-grandfather: Sherlock Holmes.

1.title: FR - Mademoiselle Holmes - S01E02 - SearchK-Lista Episode 2
1.plot: Charlie is the only one to take seriously the disappearance of K-Lista, an influence. Samy and she immerse themselves in the world of social media to understand what could have happened to her: easy money, jealousy, secret relationships, many could have wanted her to harm. Unless all of this is just a staging, meant to make the buzz?

1.title: FR - Mademoiselle Holmes - S01E03 - Off Course Episode 3
1.plot: Nicolas, a friend of Charlie's youth, calls him for help when he has just had a tragic car accident for Anthony, his brother-in-law, who was in the passenger seat. But then, real accident or sabotage? Immersed in the world of vintage cars, will Charlie have enough back to find out who could have done attack on his friend?

1.title: FR - Mademoiselle Holmes - S01E04 - Baker Street Episode 4
1.plot: Her personal history led her to London and Charlie was determined to meet her half-sister. Samy, of course, accompanies him on his journey. On the way to visiting Sherlock Holmes' house, they meet Tracy, a young psychotic girl, who begs them to help her: her sister's ghost would have come to warn her that she was in great danger. Will they be able to prevent Tracy from suffering the same tragic fate as her dead sister a few years ago?

1.title: FR - Mademoiselle Holmes - S01E05 - 20 Degrees Episode 5
1.plot: Jiyoung, a talented young icerman, is found dead, frozen, in the supergelator of the factory where she worked. If her professional requirement had not brought her only friends and might lead her to revenge, Charlie will discover that the young woman voluntarily returned to the freezer... but why?

1.title: FR - Mademoiselle Holmes - S01E06 - The Last Problem Episode 6
1.plot: George, Charlie's grandfather, is in a coma after an attempted murder. The police station mobilized to find the culprit, while Charlie was excluded from the investigation. But Charlie is determined to shed light on the case, in the back of the brigade, always with Samy's help. But she soon discovers that all incriminates her...

meta.plot: Shy cop Charlie, descendant of Sherlock Holmes, lives with grandfather until a car accident changes her. Her newfound energy and brilliance as a cop lets her embrace life and solve crimes with Watson-like partner Samy.
Inspired by real events, this fictional dramatization shows Griselda Blanco's journey from Medellín to becoming "the Godmother" of Miami's drug empire.

1.title: FR - Griselda - S01E01 - Lady Comes to Town
1.plot: Griselda flees Medellín for Miami to make a fresh start. With her sons and a hidden cache in tow, she seizes a chance to establish her own business.

1.title: FR - Griselda - S01E02 - Rich White People
1.plot: Griselda welcomes some well-supplied Medellín associates to Miami, but an enemy isn't far behind. A night out fuels a bold plan to tap into a new market.

1.title: FR - Griselda - S01E03 - Mutiny
1.plot: After Griselda receives a tempting offer from a big-time supplier, she tries to win over a business rival and earn the trust of the local dealers.

1.title: FR - Griselda - S01E04 - Middle Management
1.plot: Griselda hides out in a secure compound and prepares to make her move against the Ochoas. June joins an elite tactical unit targeting drug traffickers.

1.title: FR - Griselda - S01E05 - Paradise Lost
1.plot: Griselda suspects there's an informant in her ranks as June and CENTAC gain ground. A lavish, coke-fueled birthday party descends into chaos.

1.title: FR - Griselda - S01E06 - Adios, Miami
1.plot: Feeling pressure from all sides, Griselda gets out of Miami. But with her options dwindling and enemies closing in, can she outrun fate?

meta.plot: Manji is a crass, violent samurai with a special ability: he cannot die. Cursed with immortality by the nun Yobikuni as punishment for his ruthless deeds, he has grown weary of his ageless life. The only way to lift the curse is to slay 1,000 evil men. So Manji wanders Japan, shedding the blood of the wicked on his quest to finally die.

1.title: EN - Blade of the Immortal [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Act One - Meeting
1.plot: The Edo period. Daughter of a martial arts dojo, Rin embarks on a journey to take revenge for her slain parents. For her bodyguard on the journey, she has chosen the immortal man Manji, nicknamed the Slayer of Hundreds. Her target is the head of the Ittou-ryu, Kagehisa Anotsu, the man she hates. The adventure of the man who never dies and the girl who's sworn to live for revenge unfolds.

1.title: EN - Blade of the Immortal [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Act Two - Founding
1.plot: Rin announced that she will go meet with her father's friend Souri, the painter, in her journey for revenge. Souri cannot lend her a hand, but instead gives her funds. Rin, now with a full wallet and no leads, finds her father's sword at the blacksmith from which it was supposedly stolen. However, its wielder is a swordsman of the Ittou-ryu, 'Taito Magatsu.'

1.title: EN - Blade of the Immortal [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Act Three - Dream Pangs
1.plot: A prostitute approaches Manji as he waits for Rin. Though Manji sees through the prostitutes ruse, he accepts her invitiation. But this woman, 'Makie Otonotachibana', seem to weak to be a warrior of the Ittou-ryu as she claims. After sparing Makie's life, she appears before Manji again with different eyes and hair.

1.title: EN - Blade of the Immortal [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Act Four - Rin at Odds
1.plot: Wanting to become stronger herself, Rin received training from Manji, but is still a long way off from matching him in ability, much less the Ittou-ryu. Rin, in her melancholy, is drawn in by a sound, and finds a man training on his own. 'Some day I'll be like him', Rin tells herself, then is astonished upon seeing the man's face. It's her arch-nemesis, the head of the Ittou-ryu, Kagehisa Anotsu.

1.title: EN - Blade of the Immortal [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Act Five - Song of the Bugs
1.plot: After seeing Kagehisa, Rin becomes weak at the knees. Lost in thought over her circumstances, Rin and her guard Manji are approached by a Buddhist monk. The monk is 'Eiku Shizuma' of the Ittou-ryu. He fights with Manji but is swiftly cut down. However, despite the lethal blow, Shizuma stands back up, his wound mending itself completely. Shizuma possesses an 'immortal' body, just like Manji.

1.title: EN - Blade of the Immortal [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Act Six - Wing Roots
1.plot: Rin, who has come to see the festival, meets a cheeky little kid, Renzou. At the mask shop, things get dangerous between Manji and Araya, until Araya's son Renzou shows up and the hostility dissolves. Araya and Renzou then leave. Having watched Manji from behind, for some reason Rin continues glaring at Araya with eyes full of shock and hatred.

1.title: EN - Blade of the Immortal [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Act Seven – Evil's Shadow
1.plot: Discussions of the task of naming the instructor at the Ittou-ryu school, allotted them by the shogunate, have begun. They will make the Ittou-ryu's sword known to the world. Taito Magatsu vows to make that a reality, but decides to leave from Kagehisa Anotsu's side. At the same time, Ittou-ryu leaders start to be targeted. The tip of that blade is also pointed at Magatsu.

1.title: EN - Blade of the Immortal [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Act Eight - Mugai-ryu
1.plot: Manji and Rin involve the four known as Mugai-ryu, who hold information on Kagehisa, in order to assassinate him. Lying in wait on the road that leads out of Edo, based on information only known to Rin, she and Shira close in on Kagehisa as he tries to flee from the others.

1.title: EN - Blade of the Immortal [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Act Nine - Gathering
1.plot: Rin was told of Kagehisa's whereabouts by Giichi, and now her and Manji are suspected of indiscriminate murder. Suspected criminals cannot pass the checkpoint. But thanks to a maid who was acquaintance of Rin's, she has a countermeasure. She heads alone to a village that can help her slip through the checkpoint.

1.title: EN - Blade of the Immortal [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Act Ten - Animal
1.plot: Manji wants to go after Rin, but he has no pass. That's when Souri and Magatsu appear before him. Souri tells Manji that he can acquire as many passes as Manji likes, but there's a condition. Meanwhile, a gray-haired, one-armed Shira appears before Hyakurin and Shinriji as they re-work their plan for assassinating Kagehisa.

1.title: EN - Blade of the Immortal [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Act Eleven – Fall Frost
1.plot: Having become traveling partners for the sake of their goals, Manji and Magatsu are assaulted by a group of bald men. Manji, groaning in pain, is approached from behind by Shira, who then lops off Manji's arm. Shira had reconstructed his body, and desired a rematch with Manji. But now Magatsu, whose important woman was killed by Shira, stands in his path.

1.title: EN - Blade of the Immortal [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Act Twelve – Blood of Finality
1.plot: Having left for Kaga in pursuit of Kagehisa, a collapsed Rin is rescued by the very same Kagehisa. Then, having to cooperate with Kagehisa who is pursued by the Shingoto-ryu, Rin starts to see Kagehisa, her enemy, as a human being.

1.title: EN - Blade of the Immortal [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - Act Thirteen - Twilight
1.plot: The Ittou-ryu had its members slaughtered by the shogunate. Kagehisa gathers the remaining members of Ittou-ryu in secrecy, and plots revenge against the shogunate. Manji is invited to the Mugai-ryu by Giichi, but he refuses, and they clash swords. Giichi's weapon breaks, so a truce is called. Manji decides to go meet the head of the Mugai-ryu, Habaki.

1.title: EN - Blade of the Immortal [MULTI-SUB] - S01E14 - Act Fourteen – Ammendments
1.plot: Habaki's scheme gets Manji trapped in a dungeon. Habaki uses a doctor, Burando Ayame, to try and solve the mystery of the immortality. For the sake of the advancement of medicine, Burando sinks a scalpel into Manji's body. Meanwhile, while waiting for Manji's return, Rin is caught up in a strange cohabitation with Doua and Isaku, who had been searching for a place to stay.

1.title: EN - Blade of the Immortal [MULTI-SUB] - S01E15 - Act Fifteen – Acquisition of Guts
1.plot: Burando succeeds in transplanting Manji's left arm onto the test body of Dewanosuke. From that starting point, more tests succeed. But Habaki puts pressure on Burando, and demands results. Habaki's blade closes in on the imperfectly immortalized Dewanosuke. Rin meets with Doua and Isaku in the street as she searches for Manji. That's when the official that Doua knocked over appreaches them.

1.title: EN - Blade of the Immortal [MULTI-SUB] - S01E16 - Act Sixteen – Altered Limb
1.plot: Ever since the Dewanosuke incident, Burando kept making blunders. He is finally thrown in solitary confinement by Habaki, and goes insane. But as a result of his madness, Burando grasps something important about the immortality experiments: That humans are essentially otters. Meanwhile, Rin and Doua resolve to infiltrate Edo Castle to rescue the surrounded Manji and Isaku.

1.title: EN - Blade of the Immortal [MULTI-SUB] - S01E17 - Act Seventeen – Ceremonial Bond
1.plot: Manji and Rin finally reunite. But the formidable foe they made in Habaki in the dungeon blocks their escape. Then Doua and the presumed dead Isaku arrive as backup. The dungeon begins to cave in. As their escape nears, an unexpected person appears before Rin and Manji. Then, the answer that Burando arrived at from the results of his experiments...

1.title: EN - Blade of the Immortal [MULTI-SUB] - S01E18 - Act Eighteen – Banshee's Cries
1.plot: After his failure at Edo Castle, Habaki is dismissed as head clerk. But still, in order to annihilate the Ittou-ryu, he heads up the Rokki-dan in hopes of subjugation. However, the new head clerk, Ugen, decides that Ittou-ryu, having left Edo, is now in the clear. Furthermore, to ensure he abides by the agreement, Habaki's wife and children are taken hostage.

1.title: EN - Blade of the Immortal [MULTI-SUB] - S01E19 - Act Nineteen – Massacre
1.plot: The Ittour-ryu are pursued by the Rokki-dan, lead by Habaki. Upon hearing this, Run and Manji decide to pursue as well. Even with all these people leaving Edo to chase the Ittou-ryu, the four leasers appointed by Kagehisa Anotsu are nowhere to be found. Then, in the wee hours of the morning, Kagehisa and the other three stand at the Ootemon in front of Edo Castle.

1.title: EN - Blade of the Immortal [MULTI-SUB] - S01E20 - Act Twenty – Unending
1.plot: Rin and Manji chase after Kagehisa, but Shira attacks them and Rin is taken away. Manji goes to rescue her, and meets not only Shinra, but Renzou as well. Manji fights Shinra in order to rescue Rin. But astoundingly, what slashes at Manji is Shira's left arm, which should have been lost.

1.title: EN - Blade of the Immortal [MULTI-SUB] - S01E21 - Act Twenty One – Trap
1.plot: Manji is wounded from his duel with Shinra. Renzou picks up a sword and tries to kill Manji, but Rin and the others talk him down. Meanwhile, Habaki is livid upon learning of the attack on Edo Castle. Habaki wants to pursue Ittou-ryu, even in absence of its leader. As a result, one of the Ittou-ryu enters a mountain village. Habaki's daughter, Ryou, tries to subdue him to be of use to her father.

1.title: EN - Blade of the Immortal [MULTI-SUB] - S01E22 - Act Twenty Two – Ten Final Pushes
1.plot: Arashino, Hasshuu, and Murasaki of the Rokki-dan act as the vanguard in the clash with the Ittou-ryu. The crucial Abayama manages to escape with the help of his followers. But then he hast to confront Giichi and Hyakurin, who pursued Abayama to assist Habaki.

1.title: EN - Blade of the Immortal [MULTI-SUB] - S01E23 - Act Twenty Three – 100 Spectacular Dances
1.plot: The Ittou-ryu, Rokki-dan, and Manji and Rin all gather in Nakaminato, as if guided there. They all bear their motives on their swords in the moment they begin their final deathmatch. Deceive, subdue, and dance in chaos. Sparks will fly in the decisive batte between the strongest. The last laugh belongs to...

1.title: EN - Blade of the Immortal [MULTI-SUB] - S01E24 - Final Act – Blade of the Immortal
1.plot: The lives of those gathered fizzle out one after another. Those remaining are battered and bruised. Yet still they take up their swords, and slam their convictions against one another. The last one standing... And the revenge that was fulfilled... The curtain now closes on the tale of the man with an eternal life, and of those people whose finite lives were a blaze of passion.

meta.plot: The life of athlete Colin Kaepernick and his adoptive parents as they navigate the challenges of raising a black son in a white family and community.

1.title: EN - Colin in Black and White [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Cornrows
1.plot: Inspired by his basketball idol, eighth grader Colin embraces his individuality and hip-hop culture in a way that startles his parents and coaches.

1.title: EN - Colin in Black and White [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Quarterbackin'
1.plot: With dreams of being a high school varsity quarterback, Colin learns the hard way that talent isn't the only thing he'll need to prosper on the field.

1.title: EN - Colin in Black and White [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Road Trip
1.plot: While traveling with his parents to baseball tournaments, Colin experiences a series of events that challenge his view about his place in the world.

1.title: EN - Colin in Black and White [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Decision
1.plot: In his junior year of high school, Colin is besieged by college baseball offers — and opinions. But he considers holding out for a future in football.

1.title: EN - Colin in Black and White [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Crystal
1.plot: Colin works up the courage to ask his crush to the homecoming dance as his mother tries to intervene and his friends challenge his standard of beauty.

1.title: EN - Colin in Black and White [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Dear Colin
1.plot: In his senior year, Colin awaits an acceptance letter and the chance to play college football as his journey of perseverance leads to a profound lesson.

meta.plot: It’s 1923, and the mysterious blood source Ascra has unleashed a horde of vampires across Japan. In response, the government spawns Code Zero. With S-rank vampire Defrott and the rookie Kurusu, this kill squad is made for one reason: to hunt the undead!

1.title: EN - MARS RED [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Dawn
1.plot: Early summer, 1923. Major Yoshinobu Maeda arrive in Tokyo to question an actress who revived as a vampire after being crushed by a falling prop. Will he be able to communicate with the confused woman, who only recites lines from her last performance?

1.title: EN - MARS RED [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Till Death Do Us Part
1.plot: Maeda meets the vampires under his command for the first time, including an old classmate. Their first mission: Hunting down a vampire couple who have been attacking humans in Tokyo.

1.title: EN - MARS RED [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - His Dream
1.plot: Yamagami and Kurusu reflect on their new vampiric lives as it sinks in that they are now legally dead. Meanwhile, the army brass pressure Maeda and Nakajima for results, aiming to cut funding for Code Zero.

1.title: EN - MARS RED [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Unknown Song
1.plot: Kurusu still struggles to use his vampire powers in combat as Code Zero investigates a series of strange deaths in the Yoshiwara red-light district.

1.title: EN - MARS RED [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Persona Non Grata
1.plot: While Maeda convalesces, officials move to disband Code Zero and replace them with a force of British vampires. With less than a month until the deadline, Code Zero tracks the barrels of Ascra to Yokohama.

1.title: EN - MARS RED [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Last Blue Sky
1.plot: Takeuchi and Suwa follow the mysterious vampire units. Meanwhile, Yamagami and Kurusu return to base, where they are surprised to find Maeda. How will each of them react as Nakajima reveals his true plan?

1.title: EN - MARS RED [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - The Letter
1.plot: Defrott appears before Maeda as he lies injured in the rubble. The sight of Maeda prompts Defrott to reflect on the time he spent with Misaki. What events led up to her death, and how did she become a vampire?

1.title: EN - MARS RED [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Purgatory
1.plot: In the aftermath of the earthquake, Kurusu wanders the decimated cityscape in search of the other members of Code Zero. The military steps up its measures against vampires, who attack the people in increasing numbers, but is their help what it seems?

1.title: EN - MARS RED [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Suspicion
1.plot: Kurusu heads to Tsukishima Island, drawn by rumors that someone who looks like Suwa is killing child vampires. What he finds there, however, shocks him and tests his faith in the other members of Code Zero.

1.title: EN - MARS RED [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - A Midsummer Night's Dream Gone By
1.plot: The reunited members of Code Zero plan their next move. Meanwhile, Aoi convinces Defrott to return to the stage for a charity performance. But will any of them be prepared for Rufus's latest scheme?

1.title: EN - MARS RED [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Dark Wings
1.plot: Maeda appears before Defrott and Aoi in Rufus's trap on Tsukishima Island. With Aoi losing blood fast, Kurusu will have to cross Tokyo in broad daylight if her hopes to reach her in time. Meanwhile, Ltg. Nakajima receives an unexpected summons.

1.title: EN - MARS RED [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - King of Fools
1.plot: Rufus finally reveals the full scope of his ambitions and moves to eliminate the remaining members of Code Zero. How will they each respond to the threat, and will Defrott confront Rufus openly after the failed attempt on his life?

1.title: EN - MARS RED [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - Frailty, Thy Name Is...
1.plot: The remaining vampire units gather as Kurusu and Maeda face off in front of Tokyo Station. Does Kurusu have the strength, or the will, to overcome his former leader? And how will Aoi react to the outcome?

meta.plot: Narrée en VO par Cate Blanchett, cette magnifique série sur la nature explore l'intelligence, l'ingéniosité et le caractère interconnecté de la vie sur notre planète.

1.title: FR - Notre monde vivant [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Nature's Amazing Network
1.plot: Rhinos in Nepal, reindeer in the Arctic and agoutis in the Amazon — every creature, big and small, is connected to nature's vast network of life.

1.title: FR - Notre monde vivant [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - The Rhythm of Life
1.plot: Timing is crucial. From the setting of the sun to the passing of the seasons and the phases of the moon, nature works best when it's in sync with life.

1.title: FR - Notre monde vivant [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - Breaking Point
1.plot: The impact of climate change is now impossible to ignore. As the natural world is thrown off balance, the call for action is more urgent than ever.

1.title: FR - Notre monde vivant [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - Road to Recovery
1.plot: While bushfires and poaching leave devastation in their wake, the reintroduction of a predator breathes new life into wetlands overrun by rodents.

meta.plot: An elite commando is on a mission, deep in the jungle, to find and destroy a powerful and mysterious leader.

1.title: EN - A Thousand Fangs [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Camouflage
1.plot: A special forces commando is sent deep into the jungle to eliminate one of the most wanted rebels in the region.

1.title: EN - A Thousand Fangs [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Mobuya Tir Toro
1.plot: Trapped in a cave and fearing a new attack, Díaz and Jackson look for an exit while Rojas places explosives to reinforce the entrance.

1.title: EN - A Thousand Fangs [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Dead Weight
1.plot: As Pardo fights the creature that took her, Rojas's group tries to save Trébol's life in an abandoned house.

1.title: EN - A Thousand Fangs [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Young & Stupid
1.plot: The commandos search the abandoned hydroelectric plant and lock up Flor. A mysterious discovery generates an alternative means of escape.

1.title: EN - A Thousand Fangs [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Run
1.plot: After the fire, the commandos realize that the perimeter is surrounded by Matías's warriors and a brutal attack is unleashed.

1.title: EN - A Thousand Fangs [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Contagion
1.plot: An infected soldier unleashes chaos at the military base from which the commandos departed. Rojas and the others escape Matías' warriors.

1.title: EN - A Thousand Fangs [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - The Beast
1.plot: Rojas and Castillo are taken to the pyramid while the other commandos face their worst nightmares.

meta.plot: Two teen ghosts work alongside a clairvoyant to solve mysteries for their supernatural clientele — until a powerful witch complicates their plans.

1.title: EN - Dead Boy Detectives [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Case of Crystal Palace
1.plot: After coming to the aid of a teen medium with a demonic dilemma, Edwin and Charles head to America to find a missing girl with an unexpected ally.

1.title: EN - Dead Boy Detectives [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The Case of the Dandelion Shrine
1.plot: Trapped in a sleepy Washington town, the detectives take on a local case: helping Crystal's quirky housemate Niko get rid of her paranormal parasites.

1.title: EN - Dead Boy Detectives [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - The Case of the Devlin House
1.plot: The group tries to free a family of spirits from a nightmarish loop inside a haunted house, but it triggers an extreme case of déjà vu for one detective.

1.title: EN - Dead Boy Detectives [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Case of the Lighthouse Leapers
1.plot: The gang looks into a disturbing trend of deaths at a lighthouse. Crystal hears a distinct voice while piecing together clues about the seaside mystery.

1.title: EN - Dead Boy Detectives [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Case of the Two Dead Dragons
1.plot: While Crystal, Edwin and Charles investigate the tragic murders of two popular jocks, Niko sets up Jenny and her secret admirer on a butcher shop date.

1.title: EN - Dead Boy Detectives [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Case of the Creeping Forest
1.plot: A crisis forces Crystal to improvise on the job as Monty recruits the boys to locate his missing friend — but the eerie case isn't what it seems.

1.title: EN - Dead Boy Detectives [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - The Case of the Very Long Stairway
1.plot: When Edwin gets caught in a frightening situation, Charles relies on his best mate's meticulous notes to find him. A determined Crystal confronts her ex.

1.title: EN - Dead Boy Detectives [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - The Case of the Hungry Snake
1.plot: Crystal reckons with the past after memories come rushing back. With Esther's evil scheme underway, the group is forced to face their deadliest foe yet.

meta.plot: Dans un monde en proie à des d’effroyables monstres géants connus sous le nom de kaiju, Kafka Hibino aspire à rejoindre un jour les Forces de Défense pour combattre ces terribles créatures. C’était un rêve qu’il avait avec son amie d’enfance, Mina Ashiro, mais leurs chemins ont pris des directions différentes. Aujourd’hui, Kafka nettoie les rues de leurs encombrants cadavres quand il croise la route de Reno Ichikawa. La détermination de Reno à rejoindre les Forces de Défense pousse Kafka à rejoindre Mina afin de protéger l’humanité.

1.title: FR - Kaiju No. 8 - S01E01 - The Man Who Became a Kaiju
1.plot: Kafka Hibino has almost abandoned his dream of joining the anti-Kaiju "Defense Force." He now works in Kaiju clean-up, disposing of the bodies of slain Kaiju and thinking back with regret to the days he spent with his childhood friend Mina Ashiro, captain of Defense Force's Third Division.

1.title: FR - Kaiju No. 8 - S01E02 - The Kaiju Who Defeats Kaiju
1.plot: After turning into a Kaiju, Kafka is forced to flee. His escape is interrupted, however, by the arrival of another Kaiju...

1.title: FR - Kaiju No. 8 - S01E03 - Revenge Match
1.plot: Kafka arrives for one last shot at the Defense Force entry exam... but can he pass while keeping his Kaiju powers a secret?

1.title: FR - Kaiju No. 8 - S01E04 - Fortitude 9.8
1.plot: An unexpected incident during the exam forces Kafka to use his powers at the risk of revealing his secret.

1.title: FR - Kaiju No. 8 - S01E05 - Joining Up!
1.plot: Kafka is now a member of the Defense Force, if not a full-fledged one. But Hoshina tells him he has three months to prove himself before he's fired...

1.title: FR - Kaiju No. 8 - S01E06 - Sagamihara Neutralization Operation at Daybreak
1.plot: It's time for Kafka's first mission, and he witnesses the true power of the Defense Force when a Kaiju strikes a nearby city.

1.title: FR - Kaiju No. 8 - S01E07 - Kaiju No. 9
1.plot: Reno and Iharu encounter a powerful humanoid Kaiju that quickly overwhelms them. Can help arrive in time?

1.title: FR - Kaiju No. 8 - S01E08 - Welcome to the Defense Force
1.plot: After transforming into a Kaiju to rescue Reno and Iharu, Kafka is found by Hoshina, who immediately attacks him.

1.title: FR - Kaiju No. 8 - S01E09 - Raid on Tachikawa Base
1.plot: Tachikawa base comes under attack from the air, as a powerful Kaiju has its sights set on the Defense Force.

1.title: FR - Kaiju No. 8 - S01E10 - Secret Revealed
1.plot: When the Defense Force is in danger, Kafka is forced to choose between keeping his secret and saving his comrades.

1.title: FR - Kaiju No. 8 - S01E11 - Kaiju No. 8 Captured
1.plot: Kaiju No. 8 is captured, and Kafka is at the mercy of the Defense Force's most important leaders.

1.title: FR - Kaiju No. 8 - S01E12 - Kafka Hibino
1.plot: Kafka's final fate is determined as the monster within him tries to take control.

meta.plot: Alors qu'un astéroïde se dirige inexorablement vers la Terre, une enseignante déterminée ne recule devant rien pour assurer la sécurité de ses anciens élèves.

1.title: FR - Goodbye Earth - S01E01 - Football, Bloody Hell!
1.plot: Traumatized by a tragedy that keeps haunting her, Jin Se-kyung vows to keep her loved ones safe and plots revenge against the perpetrators.

1.title: FR - Goodbye Earth - S01E02 - Love Is Back
1.plot: Suspecting Se-kyung's role in the latest murder, Kang In-a gives her a warning. But as Se-kyung plans her next move, a surprising visitor greets her.

1.title: FR - Goodbye Earth - S01E03 - I Have Butterflies...
1.plot: Ha Yun-sang's friends celebrate his sudden return, despite the mystery surrounding it. Meanwhile, Se-kyung realizes she's being watched.

1.title: FR - Goodbye Earth - S01E04 - Felix Culpa
1.plot: Se-kyung confides in In-a about the ominous threats she's been receiving. The two later embark on a dangerous mission to confront the criminal.

1.title: FR - Goodbye Earth - S01E05 - The Girl with a Cat
1.plot: Despite her recent win, Se-kyung still worries that the threat isn't over. Yun-sang receives an enigmatic proposal involving important missing figures.

1.title: FR - Goodbye Earth - S01E06 - Much Ado About Nothing
1.plot: Disorder during the joint memorial Mass leads to chaos at the church, increasing criticism and scrutiny into the whereabouts of Father Baek.

1.title: FR - Goodbye Earth - S01E07 - Arirang; Gone, but Not Forgotten
1.plot: Se-kyung discovers more about a mysterious training center, and pleads with In-a to investigate it. They soon find darker secrets lie within the building.

1.title: FR - Goodbye Earth - S01E08 - Dum Spiro Spero
1.plot: In the aftermath of the raid, the group encounters pushback from authorities — but they uncover more disturbing details about Father Baek's activities.

1.title: FR - Goodbye Earth - S01E09 - Silver Lining
1.plot: Se-kyung and Yun-sang finally confront Father Baek, who in turn leaves them with a choice, forcing Se-kyung to ask Yun-sang an impossible question.

1.title: FR - Goodbye Earth - S01E10 - Exodus, Eclipsed
1.plot: On the day of the evacuation, Se-kyung and her friends coordinate a plot to get the children to safety. But pandemonium ensues as the plane approaches.

1.title: FR - Goodbye Earth - S01E11 - Last Christmas
1.plot: Accepting the fate of the asteroid, everyone tries to carry on with their lives. But the harsh and grim realities of their last days set in.

1.title: FR - Goodbye Earth - S01E12 - Goodbye Earth
1.plot: With less than 20 days left, survivors solemnly brace for the asteroid. However, Se-kyung remains steadfast in her mission to protect the children.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E01 - The Day I Became a Shinigami
1.plot: Fifteen-year-old Ichigo Kurosaki has the uncanny ability to see ghosts, but otherwise lives an ordinary life. However, once a Shinigami named Rukia Kuchiki appears before him, everything changes.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E02 - A Shinigami's Work
1.plot: After becoming a Shinigami, Ichigo Kurosaki refuses to help Rukia Kuchiki with her work as the local Shinigami of Karakura Town.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E03 - The Older Brother's Wish, the Younger Sister's Wish
1.plot: When a Hollowfied Sora Inoue attacks his younger sister, Ichigo Kurosaki and Rukia Kuchiki set out to save her.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E04 - Cursed Parakeet
1.plot: When Yasutora Sado receives a parakeet that contains the Soul of a young boy, it is up to Ichigo Kurosaki and Rukia Kuchiki to protect him from the Hollow that is after them.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E05 - Beat the Invisible Enemy!
1.plot: Rukia Kuchiki and Yasutora Sado team up to take on the Hollow Shrieker.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E06 - Fight to the Death! Ichigo vs. Ichigo
1.plot: At Rukia Kuchiki's behest, Ichigo Kurosaki puts an artificial soul in his body to take care of it and not arouse suspicion while he carries out his Substitute Shinigami duties, but the artificial soul has its own agenda.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E07 - Greetings from a Stuffed Lion
1.plot: Ichigo Kurosaki becomes friends with the Modified Soul, Kon, and puts him into a plushie.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E08 - June 17, Memories in the Rain
1.plot: Ichigo Kurosaki goes to his mother's grave with the rest of his family.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E09 - Unbeatable Enemy
1.plot: Ichigo Kurosaki battles against Grand Fisher.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E10 - Assault on Trip at Sacred Ground!
1.plot: While grudgingly attending Don Kanonji's show with the rest of his family, Ichigo Kurosaki is forced to fight a Hollow inadvertently created by Don Kanonji himself.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E11 - The Legendary Quincy
1.plot: Ichigo Kurosaki and Rukia Kuchiki meet Uryū Ishida, a Quincy.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E12 - A Gentle Right Arm
1.plot: As Ichigo Kurosaki begins his duel with Uryū Ishida, Yasutora Sado gains a new power.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E13 - Flower and Hollow
1.plot: Orihime Inoue gains a new power in order to protect Tatsuki Arisawa.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E14 - Back to Back, a Fight to the Death!
1.plot: Ichigo Kurosaki and Uryū Ishida work together to defeat a Menos Grande.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E15 - Kon's Great Plan
1.plot: Kon decides to run away from the Kurosaki Clinic as Soul Society comes after Rukia Kuchiki.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E16 - The Encounter, Abarai Renji!
1.plot: Two Shinigami, 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai and Captain Byakuya Kuchiki, arrive in the Human World to take Rukia Kuchiki back to the Soul Society.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E17 - Ichigo Dies!
1.plot: Ichigo Kurosaki loses his Shinigami powers and Rukia Kuchiki is taken back to Soul Society.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E18 - Reclaim! The Power of the Shinigami!
1.plot: Ichigo Kurosaki begins his training with Kisuke Urahara to regain his Shinigami powers and save Rukia Kuchiki.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E19 - Ichigo Becomes a Hollow!
1.plot: Kisuke Urahara helps Ichigo Kurosaki regain his Shinigami powers.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E20 - Ichimaru Gin's Shadow
1.plot: After completing their training, Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends depart to Soul Society to rescue Rukia Kuchiki.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E01 - The Blood Warfare
2.plot: The Soul Society is observing a sudden surge in the number of Hollows being destroyed.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E02 - Foundation Stones
2.plot: Arrancars Nel Tu and Pesche Guatiche have come to seek Ichigo’s help explaining that Hueco Mundo is under attack by an unknown enemy. Unable to ignore the situation, Ichigo and his friends decide to set out for Hueco Mundo.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E03 - March of the Starcross
2.plot: Ichigo and his friends arrive in Hueco Mundo to confront Quilge Opie and learn that their latest enemy are Quincies.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E04 - Kill the Shadow
2.plot: The Wandenreich mobilizes its elite force, the Stern Ritter, to annihilate the Soul Society. Creating massive flaming pillars of Reishi as a distraction, the Stern Ritter easily enter the Soul Society to bring carnage to the Soul Reapers.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E05 - Wrath as a Lightning
2.plot: Quilge Opie uses his power to imprison Ichigo inside the Garganta. As he tries to break free, Ichigo begins to hear, through his Soul Phone, the screams of the Soul Reapers falling to the enemy's onslaught.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E06 - The Fire
2.plot: Shigekuni Genryusai Yamamoto confronts Yhwach for the first time in a thousand years. As Yhwach finally draws his sword against Genryusai, the Soul Reapers notice an abnormal change taking place across the Seireitei.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E07 - Born in the Dark
2.plot: Shigekuni Genryusai Yamamoto learns that the Yhwach he defeated was an impostor. The real Yhwach then reveals himself and easily kills Genryusai, sending a wave of shock and devastation across the Soul Reapers.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E08 - The Shooting Star Project [Zero Mix]
2.plot: Rescue efforts are being made across the Seireitei to find and help those who've survived the Stern Ritter attack. Meanwhile, Ichigo meets with Mayuri Kurotsuchi about fixing his broken Tensa Zangetsu.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E09 - The Drop
2.plot: Squad Zero brings Ichigo back to the Royal Palace to prepare for the coming battle. Meanwhile, Kyoraku is appointed as the new Head Captain to lead the Thirteen Court Guard Squads.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E10 - The Battle
2.plot: Kenpachi Zaraki removes his eye patch to fight Retsu Unohana, a.k.a. Yachiru Unohana, “The First Kenpachi.” Meanwhile, Ichigo and Renji head to Hoohden to meet Oh-Etsu Nimaiya, the man who is said to have created the Zanpakuto.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E11 - Everything but the Rain
2.plot: Ichigo is kicked out of the Royal Palace by Oh-etsu Nimaiya for failing his test. When Ichigo next opens his eyes, he finds himself standing in front of his house in the World of the Living.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E12 - Everything but the Rain: June Truth
2.plot: Squad 10 Captain Isshin Shiba of the Thirteen Court Guard Squads decides to not report his encounter with the Quincy named Masaki Kurosaki in the World of the Living to the Head Captain.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E13 - The Blade Is Me
2.plot: Ichigo learns that he is the child born of a Soul Reaper and a Quincy. Finally understanding the truth behind his heritage, Ichigo decides to return to Hoohden with a renewed resolve to finish what he has started.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E14 - The Last 9 Days

The dictionary department is known internally as the "money-eating insect," but Mitsuya uses his perseverance and attachment to the words in order to become a great editor. Mitsuya, who has poor social skills, finds himself working with another man named Masashi Nishioka, who is able to express himself better.

Araki heads to the sales department to meet this Majime.Upon meeting him, Araki sees Majime's potential and recruits him on the spot.

1.title: EN - The Great Passage [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Encounter
1.plot: After Majime transfers to the dictionary editorial department, he learns of Araki and the supervisor Matsumoto-sensei's passion for dictionaries, and tell him of Daitokai, the dictionary they are working on. Majime is consumed with worry about living up to their expectations. His landlady, Take, tells him to simply depend on each other. That night, Majime encounters a beautiful girl on the balcony.

1.title: EN - The Great Passage [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Love
1.plot: It's discovered that Majime has fallen for Take's granddaughter Kaguya. The editorial team decides to visit the restaurant where she is learning to become a chef. Majime is enamored with Kaguya as she answers Nishioka's questions. Majime admires Nishioka and his ability to engage people. Nishioka finds Majime's awkwardness entertaining. Nishioka hears a rumor about Daitokai being canceled.

1.title: EN - The Great Passage [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Steady Progress
1.plot: To stop the rumored cancellation of Daitokai, the editorial team unites to implement Nishioka's plan. Nishioka has never felt more alive while successfully executing his plan. A few months later, Majime has a day off and Take pushes him to go out with Kaguya. The two of them make their way around Tokyo. Kaugya passionately talks of cooking. Majime is moved. That night, Majime begins to write a letter to express his feelings to Kaguya.

1.title: EN - The Great Passage [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Waver
1.plot: The director informs Nishioka the conditions for the Daitokai's continuation, which are the revision of another dictionary and Nishioka's transfer to the marketing department. Nishioka's shocked, but seeing the team's joy with the sample copies of Daitokai, he vows to do all he can before his transfer. Later, Majime works up the courage to hand Kaguya his letter.

1.title: EN - The Great Passage [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Resonance
1.plot: The morning after handing her the love letter, Majime panics and runs when he sees Kaguya. That afternoon, Nishioka reveals his transfer to the shocked team. Majime worries over losing Nishioka. That night, spurred by Nishioka, Majime presses Kaguya for a reply. She's overwhelmed and retreats to her room. Majime thinks it's over, mildly depressed, but after rereading the letter she comes back and tells him she likes him too.

1.title: EN - The Great Passage [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Trust
1.plot: Spotting issues with a professor's manuscript, Nishoka and Majime propose amendments. Majime reaffirms that they need Nishioka. But Nishioka reassures Majime that he will always be there for him. A few days later, the professor is livid with the changes, and Nishioka goes to apologize. The professor is upset, but Nishioka manages to win him over. Nishioka and Majime go down their separate paths.

1.title: EN - The Great Passage [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Compile
1.plot: Thirteen years pass and a new employee Kishibe arrives. With a fashion magazine background, she wonders why she has been transferred here. The team throw her a welcome party. Majime tells her he thinks she's someone who values words. But she runs out of the restaurant saying she's not cut out for the job. Nishioka runs into her and assures her she is.The next day, Kishibe turns up ready to work.

1.title: EN - The Great Passage [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Blood
1.plot: Kishibe is back and ready to work. She is enamored with Matsumoto and Majime's talk on words and dictionaries. The team is on the final phase, as a special paper is also being developed specially for Daitokai. The team unify in this home stretch. After roughly a year, the paper is finally finished. Daitokai is inching closer to being completed. However, a grave mistake is discovered.

1.title: EN - The Great Passage [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Pride
1.plot: The editorial team is dumbfounded by the discovery of an omitted word. Majime decides to recheck all 240,000 words. During all of this, Matsumoto is hospitalized. Majime frantically works to complete Daitokai. The team works tirelessly day and night under the same roof. Time passes, and the rechecking is finally completed. Nishioka comes to help celebrate. Daitokai is nearly completed, but...

1.title: EN - The Great Passage [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Torch
1.plot: Majime and Araki visit Matsumoto with an advanced copy of Daitokai. Matsumoto is pleased, but he tells them he has cancer. That spring, the team gets a call informing them of his death. Daitokai is completed, and they throw a party to celebrate. Araki reads a moving thank you letter from Matsumoto. Later, Majime reflects on Matsumoto's message as he walks with Kaguya, finding peace and solace.

meta.plot: In a war-torn world of elemental magic, a young boy reawakens to undertake a dangerous mystic quest to fulfill his destiny as the Avatar, and bring peace to the world.

1.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Boy in the Iceberg
1.plot: Two teenage siblings (Sokka and Katara) living in the South Pole discover a very strange boy (Aang), along with his pet flying bison Appa, in an iceberg. But can they trust him when he accidentally draws the war to their village's doorstep?

1.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The Avatar Returns
1.plot: Katara and Sokka discover that Aang is the long-lost Avatar and must rescue him when a Firebending prince named Zuko kidnaps him.

1.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - The Southern Air Temple
1.plot: Aang is excited about going home for the first time in one hundred years, but he is shocked to find out that the temple is deserted. Aang tells Sokka and Katara about his childhood as they explore the temple, but they soon discover something that Aang never expected. Meanwhile, Zuko must make repairs to his ship and the only way he can do it is to dock his ship at his rival's naval base.

1.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Warriors of Kyoshi
1.plot: The gang arrives at Kyoshi Island and are captured by some Kyoshi warriors. When Aang reveals that he is the avatar, news quickly spreads out, eventually reaching Zuko, who then goes to Kyoshi Island to capture him.

1.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The King of Omashu
1.plot: Aang's abilities as an airbender are challenged by a king.

1.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Imprisoned
1.plot: In a nearby Earth Village, the gang meets a teenage earthbender named Haru. This village lives in fear of the Fire Nation, for soldiers there capture any earthbenders they can find.

1.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - The Spirit World: Winter Solstice (1)
1.plot: Aang and friends visit a village being terrorized by an angry spirit. Iroh is captured by Earth Kingdom soldiers.

1.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Avatar Roku: Winter Solstice (2)
1.plot: To contact the spirit of the previous Avatar, Aang must reach a temple in the Fire Nation before the sun sets on the following day. There he will learn what he must do to restore balance to the world. Zuko must defy his banishment to follow Aang.

1.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - The Waterbending Scroll
1.plot: After Katara attempts to teach Aang waterbending, but realizes that he is learning it much faster than she is, she is desperate to improve her abilities.  When Katara inadvertently stumbles across a waterbending scroll that can help improve her abilities at a pirate’s store, she decides to steal it, realizing that she couldn’t hope to afford it.

1.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Jet
1.plot: While traveling towards the North Pole, the group almost gets captured by the Fire Nation.  However, when a charismatic young man and his band of rebels attack the Fire Nation camp and rescue them, they learn that they are trying to resist the Fire Nation’s motives to expand their territory.  Katara and Aang really enjoy their time with the band of rebels, but Sokka soon discovers that they aren’t as noble as meets the eye.

1.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - The Great Divide
1.plot: While on their way to the North Pole, Aang and his friends arrive at a giant canyon where two groups of refugees are bickering over who should get to go across.  Aang decides to walk across with the two groups to ensure they don’t fight one another.  However, he soon learns that the two tribes have been feuding for one hundred years and they both believe their actions are justified.  But when the predators inside the canyon start to come out, Aang is stuck trying to defend both tribes from each other and the vicious wildlife.

1.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - The Storm
1.plot: Aang, Katara and Sokka have run out of money.  Katara suggests Sokka get a job, and coincidentally, they meet a fisherman who is looking for someone to help him out with his fishing. But when the fisherman recognizes Aang as the Avatar, he blames Aang's absence for all of the troubles of the last 100 years, and Aang runs away on his glider. Katara follows on Appa, and when she finds him, Aang begins to reveal his life before he was frozen in the iceberg. Meanwhile, Zuko and Lieutenant Jee get into a fight, but Iroh breaks it up. Soon thereafter, the Lieutenant and the rest of the crew gain a newfound respect for their leader after learning of his past.

1.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - The Blue Spirit
1.plot: While Aang, Katara and Sokka are traveling, Sokka gets a fever. Katara and Aang try to help Sokka, when Katara also catches the fever. It's up to Aang to go up on his own to save his two friends. But before he can get the medicine he is captured by the newly promoted Admiral Zhao and put in Zhao's fortress.

1.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E14 - The Fortuneteller
1.plot: When the group tries to help a man who is being attacked by a platypus-bear, they discover that the local town has a fortuneteller named Aunt Wu in it, who has been forecasting the town's fate for years. But when Sokka and Aang discover one of the fortuneteller's most vital predictions is dead wrong, they have to develop a plan to convince the stubborn townspeople that their beloved Aunt Wu was wrong.

1.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E15 - Bato of the Water Tribe
1.plot: Aang feels neglected as Katara and Sokka reunite with Bato, an old friend of their father’s from the South Pole. They begin to reminisce on their times in the past while they wait for a message to arrive from their father. Aang believes Katara and Sokka will abandon him and go out to find their father should the message arrive. However, when the messenger gives Aang the message to give to Bato, Aang betrays his friends in a way Katara or Sokka could never imagine. However, when Zuko recruits a bounty hunter named June to track Aang down, his friendship is put to the test as he must deal with the fact that he betrayed his friends while defending himself from yet another fight.

1.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E16 - The Deserter
1.plot: Aang and his friends go to a Fire Nation town so that Aang can witness some firebending, but their plan soon goes awry when it’s discovered that he is the Avatar. Fortunately, he's rescued by an individual who serves a firebending master named Jeong Jeong who has abandoned the Fire Nation, so Aang decides to use this time to attempt to learn firebending. The firebending master, however, seems reluctant to teach Aang.

1.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E17 - The Northern Air Temple
1.plot: When Aang and his friends hear rumors about surviving airbenders, they decide to stop by the Northern Air Temple on their way to the North Pole to see for themselves. What they find is a bunch of people who are not airbenders, but have mastered the art of gliding; though this upsets Aang because they have been defacing the temple. However, there was one part of the temple where nobody has been able to enter, and what Aang and his friends discover inside spells oncoming conflict.

1.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E18 - The Waterbending Master
1.plot: When Aang tries to find the north pole, he is found by the north pole instead. As they are taken there, Aang and Katara are eager to find a waterbending master, only to discover that girls are not allowed to learn waterbending.

1.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E19 - The Siege of the North (1)
1.plot: Zhao begins to launch his attack against the Northern Water Tribe. As the walls of the prestiged city begin to fall, the Avatar taps into the spirit world and seeks the help of one of the oldest spirits, in hopes of saving one of the most prominent areas of the world.

1.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E20 - The Siege of the North (2)
1.plot: Aang returns from the spirit world to a big surprise. Meanwhile, Zhao and his forces continue to press deeper into the Northern Water Tribe. Iroh makes a powerful stand and Zuko struggles to keep his plan intact.

2.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S02E01 - The Avatar State
2.plot: Plagued with nightmares featuring the devastating power of his Avatar State, Aang and the gang meet an Earth Kingdom general who has big plans for defeating the Fire Nation. Meanwhile, Zuko and Iroh, having survived the failed attack on the North Water Tribe, have a surprise visit from Zuko's sister with seemingly good news.

2.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S02E02 - The Cave of Two Lovers
2.plot: On their way to Omashu, Aang, Katara, and Sokka meet a group of nomads who show them a shortcut through the "Cave of Two Lovers". But when the group becomes trapped in the cave, it's up to Aang and Katara to save the group by trusting in love, possibly questioning their relationship. Meanwhile, Iroh gets a lethal rash so Zuko and Iroh head to a small Earth Kingdom town for help, hoping their real identities will not be discovered.

2.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S02E03 - Return to Omashu
2.plot: Despite the shocking news the gang have just discovered, Aang insists on trying to find King Bumi within Omashu's borders, even with the dangers that will await him and his friends if his real identity is discovered.  Meanwhile Azula goes in search of old friends to help her with her mission.

2.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S02E04 - The Swamp
2.plot: A mysterious tornado pulls the kids into a supernatural swamp where Katara, Sokka and Aang have mysterious visions. Meanwhile, Momo and Appa are chased by rogue swamp dwellers and only Aang and the gang can save them.

2.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S02E05 - Avatar Day
2.plot: Aang and the gang discover an Earth town that celebrates something called "Avatar Day." But when they get there and learn the festival is of "anti-Avatar" sentiment and Aang is put on trial for a crime a past incarnation allegedly committed. Looking to clear the Avatar's good name, Katara and Sokka venture back to a familiar  place to gather evidence and discover the truth.

2.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S02E06 - The Blind Bandit
2.plot: In search for an Earthbending teacher for Aang, the kids go to an underground Earthbending tournament called Earth Rumble 6, where they encounter Toph, a blind but powerful Earthbending girl. After seeing her unique style of Earthbending, Aang wants Toph to become his teacher, but there are complications with Toph's family.

2.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S02E07 - Zuko Alone
2.plot: Zuko travels by himself to an Earth Kingdom town were he meets a local boy. The two almost become friends, while Zuko suffers from flashbacks of his past.

2.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S02E08 - The Chase
2.plot: Tired from trying to escape a machine that shows up every time they try to sleep, Aang and the gang have to escape Azula and her team, but their exhaustion leads to a tight situation. Meanwhile, Zuko must deal with something personal, and Iroh bonds with an unlikely individual.

2.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S02E09 - Bitter Work
2.plot: Toph's instructing abilities come into question when Aang cannot seem to overcome a block that keeps him from earthbending. Sokka gets himself in a jam, while befriending what was, moments before, his next meal, and Iroh and Zuko begin training utilizing new philosophies and methods that originate from the other elements.

2.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S02E10 - The Library
2.plot: When Aang and his friends find a professor who knows of a library that contains information about the world, Sokka decides to go there to hopefully find some information to use against the Fire Nation. The library is guarded by the knowledge spirit, Wan Shi Tong, who doesn't welcome humans into his library, because he believes they only seek information for evil purposes. When Wan Shi Tong discovers Sokka wasn't being truthful with him, he begins to sink the library, bringing the kids down with it.

2.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S02E11 - The Desert
2.plot: Aang searches for Appa while Katara struggles to keep everyone together to survive in the vast desert. Meanwhile, Iroh and Zuko seek help from an ancient secret society.

2.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S02E12 - The Serpent's Pass
2.plot: When Aang and the gang meet up with a group of refugees, they tell the gang where they can get on a ferry to Ba Sing Se. But after a series of events they have to take a deadly route called the serpent's pass with the help of an old friend, Suki. Meanwhile Zuko and Iroh meet up with a boy named Jet and his freedom fighters.

2.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S02E13 - The Drill
2.plot: Having made it to the outer wall of Ba Sing Se, the kids confront a Fire Nation army that is driving a massive Fire Nation drill, which poses an imminent threat to the last Earth Kingdom stronghold. Meanwhile, Zuko and Iroh make crucial mistakes which begin to attract Jet's suspicions.

2.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S02E14 - City of Walls and Secrets
2.plot: Having finally made it into Ba Sing Se, the kids are given a house in the upper ring. The kids are anxious to tell the Earth King their plan but there are complications. Meanwhile, still convinced that Iroh and Zuko may be Fire Nation, Jet decides to take matters into his own hands and do whatever it takes to get the refugees to reveal their true nature.

2.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S02E15 - The Tales of Ba Sing Se
2.plot: A series of short stories, highlighting different characters and their individual adventures in the city. Tales of Katara and Toph, Iroh, Sokka, Aang, Zuko, and Momo.

2.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S02E16 - Appa's Lost Days
2.plot: Appa's journey from being abducted in the desert to the present is explored.

2.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S02E17 - Lake Laogai
2.plot: Aang and his friends continue to search for Appa and, unbeknownst to them, they aren't the only ones looking for him. During their search, the kids meet up with Jet, whom they are understandably reluctant to trust. The kids soon realize that the Dai Li are doing their best to thwart the kids' efforts to find Appa. Meanwhile, Iroh is offered his own tea shop in the upper ring, and Zuko discovers the avatar is in the city.

2.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S02E18 - The Earth King
2.plot: The kids battle Long Feng and the Dai Li when they attempt to show the Earth King the vast conspiracy taking place in his city. Zuko becomes seriously ill and has feverish dreams as he faces a spiritual crisis.

3.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S03E01 - The Awakening
3.plot: Aang awakens to find himself aboard a captured Fire Nation ship with a full head of hair and sustaining serious injuries from the previous battle for Ba Sing Se. At his side are Katara, Sokka, and their father Hakoda who recount the events that led the four to the ship and contemplate their next move. Aang struggles to fight his own desire to face the Fire Lord before he is ready. Meanwhile, Zuko deals with his own issues as he makes his long-awaited journey home, with the fear of his father's rejection hanging over his head.

3.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S03E02 - The Headband
3.plot: To better blend in as Fire Nation citizens, Aang enrolls in a Fire Nation school, giving himself an opportunity to learn more about the Nation and to enjoy life as a normal kid for the first time since he discovered he was the Avatar. Meanwhile Zuko, growing more and more paranoid about the Avatar's false demise, brings himself to confront the imprisoned Iroh.

3.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S03E03 - The Painted Lady
3.plot: When the gang arrives at a suffering fishing village, a mysterious spirit appears to help the villagers.

3.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S03E04 - Sokka's Master
3.plot: Feeling as though he isn't contributing enough to the group, Sokka seeks out an elusive swordsmaster from whom he can learn the ways of the blade.

3.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S03E05 - The Beach
3.plot: Zuko, Azula, Mai and Ty Lee take a vacation to Ember Island. In the process, they come to learn more about themselves and each other as well as their desires for the future. Elsewhere, Aang and the others face off against a new adversary.

3.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S03E06 - The Avatar and the Firelord
3.plot: The tale of Avatar Roku and Fire Lord Sozin is revealed to Aang and Zuko by different sources.  Both learn about themselves and are shown the origins of the war.

3.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S03E07 - The Runaway
3.plot: When Katara expresses her disapproval of Toph's new way to make quick cash, the group finds her too motherly and tension grows between Katara and Toph. When Katara finally decides to participate in this scam to disprove Toph's accusations, they are left vulnerable and are forced to face the dire consequences.

3.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S03E08 - The Puppetmaster
3.plot: The gang investigates the bizarre disappearances taking place within an eerie town.

3.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S03E09 - Nightmares and Daydreams
3.plot: Four days prior the invasion, Aang becomes nervous over his soon-to-come confrontation with the Fire Lord. His anxiety gets the better of him as he begins to suffer from outrageous nightmares and hallucinations. Meanwhile, Zuko becomes upset to learn that he was not informed about a war meeting.

3.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S03E10 - The Day of Black Sun: The Invasion (1)
3.plot: The day of the eclipse has arrived, and the invasion force gathers together to make last preparations. They infiltrate the island and the battle begins. Meanwhile, Aang searches for the Fire Lord.

3.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S03E11 - The Day of Black Sun: The Eclipse (2)
3.plot: As the invasion force fights their way to the Fire Nation capital, the kids help Aang find the Fire Lord in time for the eclipse. Zuko confronts his father with shocking news.

3.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S03E12 - The Western Air Temple
3.plot: Aang and the group arrive at the Western Air Temple, with Zuko in pursuit. Zuko wishes to help the Avatar end the war by teaching him firebending.

3.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S03E13 - The Firebending Masters
3.plot: While teaching Aang firebending, Zuko realizes that he has lost all his firebending skills. To regain his powers, Zuko and Aang must seek the original source of firebending within the ruins of a lost civilization.

3.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S03E14 - The Boiling Rock (1)
3.plot: Sokka wants to break his father out of jail and asks Zuko for information on Fire Nation prisons. Sokka and Zuko head for the Boiling Rock, a prison located in the middle of a volcano, to rescue Sokka's father.

3.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S03E15 - The Boiling Rock (2)
3.plot: Zuko and Sokka make new plans to break out of the prison with Suki, Sokka's father and some others while a shocking twist leaves Azula none too happy with her two closest friends.

3.title: EN - Avatar: The Last Airbender - 2005 [MULTI-SUB] - S03E16 - The Southern Raiders
3.plot: Katara decides to confront the Fire Nation soldier responsible for her mother's death. Aang tries to talk her out of it, but she doesn't listen.

1.title: FR - La Recrue - S01E01 -
FR - La Recrue - S01E02 -
FR - Wild Cards - S01E01 - The Infinity Thief
1.plot: To regain his detective status, Cole Ellis, a demoted by-the-book cop, is assigned to work with Max Mitchell, a spirited con artist whose charismatic street smarts could help catch an elusive thief.

1.title: FR - Wild Cards - S01E02 - Show Me the Murder
1.plot: A community outreach lecture on porch pirates turns into a murder investigation when Max and Ellis find an elite sports agent dead in his condo. Max’s dad George gives her advice – from his jail cell.

1.title: FR - Wild Cards - S01E03 - Howl to Get Away with Murder
1.plot: Things go from quaint to creepy when Max and Ellis look into the disappearance of a butcher in a small rural town. The duo gets a lesson in team building and Max quizzes Ellis on his personal life.

1.title: FR - Wild Cards - S01E04 - Strangers on a Wave
1.plot: When a surfer is mysteriously killed, Detectives Simmons and Yates are assigned the case. But it’s Ellis who grabs a board and goes undercover, taking a page out of Max’s book of disguise.

1.title: FR - Wild Cards - S01E05 - The Accountant of Monte Cristo
1.plot: When Ellis’s federal agent ex-girlfriend loses an accountant scheduled to testify against the mob, she enlists their help to find him before the accountant ends up sleeping with the fishes.

1.title: FR - Wild Cards - S01E06 - Dead of Night
1.plot: When the leads of THE most popular vampire show on TV become the target of a stalker, Max and Ellis enter the world of showbiz where the behind-the-scenes drama is even wilder than what’s on screen.

1.title: FR - Wild Cards - S01E07 - Con With the Wind
1.plot: George gets a 3-day pass from jail to spend with Max but the urge to pull one more con is real. Ellis helps a troubled youth charged with a B&E after he discovers it’s a teen his brother used to know.

1.title: FR - Wild Cards - S01E08 - Eternal Sunshine of the Therapized Mind
1.plot: When a celebrated therapist and best-selling author is murdered, a bickering Max and Ellis go undercover as a married couple at her wellness retreat and discover more than their chakras.

1.title: FR - Wild Cards - S01E09 - Inside (Con)Man
1.plot: Max visits the bank to access her safe deposit box but instead becomes a hostage in a dangerous robbery. Ellis defies Chief Li's orders to wait for the Tactical Response Team, knowing Max is inside.

1.title: FR - Wild Cards - S01E10 - Romancing the Egg
1.plot: Ellis is drawn into a case involving Max, her ex, and a world-famous Imperial egg, where a cat-and-mouse heist tests their friendship, their partnership, and their trust in each other.

2.title: FR - Wild Cards - S02E01 - Con in 60 Seconds
2.plot: Begrudgingly, Ellis comes to terms with Max's betrayal knowing she risked it all to share info about his brother's killer; now assigned to a new case, they dive into a high-speed street racing ring.

2.title: FR - Wild Cards - S02E02 - Once a Con a Time in the West
2.plot: Max and Ellis saddle up for a wild west adventure as they track down the attempted murderer of a ranch family's stud horse and uncover a dark family secret.

2.title: FR - Wild Cards - S02E03 - The Lorne Identity
2.plot: A paranoid biomedical engineer with a case of amnesia comes to Ellis for help leading the team down a trail of conspiracies, corruption and secret codes.

2.title: FR - Wild Cards - S02E04 - Dial 'A' for Alibi

meta.plot: Todd McFarlane's Spawn is an animated television series which aired on HBO from 1997 through 1999. It is also released on DVD as a film series. It is based on the Spawn comic series from Image Comics, and was nominated for and won an Emmy in 1999 for Outstanding Animation Program. An unrelated series titled Spawn: The Animation is in production since 2009, with Keith David reprising his role as the titular character.
